{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相人之術古矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643200521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔孟觀人之法，著扵語孟者，豈無權輿與？","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643216905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然以人之吉凶、寿夭、䝿冨、貧賤尽繫扵相者，非","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643233289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330949900844302373"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也；以𠮷凶、壽夭、贵冨、貧賤不繫扵相者，亦非也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643233289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相有定理，而相面者不能以尽窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643249673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以不能盡穷之見而苟同，如此者𠮷，如此者","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643266057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330949902010236991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫，如此者寿夭、贵冨、貧賎也，豈能皆中㢤？","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643266057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643282441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有相逐心生之说，使非读書窮理之至，安能察人之心如聖賢也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643282441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近世口傳相人之書，","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643298825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330950103361929267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆宗麻衣道者。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643298825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然人出己見，各有不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643315209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵即五行之象，以㝎一身之形，因已往之迹，以為方来之驗則同。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643331593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之無说，固有可取者，","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643347977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330949902010318911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不必尽出麻衣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643347977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守淮楊東充饱君粟之政事之暇，留意無書，首著麻衣之说，復會諸说之宗麻衣者，類輯成編，将以搜之，","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330950103362125875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專其術，使傳于世，其","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相，外也；心，内也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故聖賢言心不言相。","logicSentenceId":"7641547116380536841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰：凶人㐫其𠮷，吉人吉無㐫，相烏足之哉。","logicSentenceId":"7641547116380553225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則是書，學者不可以不","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643397129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330949902010417215"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知也，不可以尽非也，不可以深泥也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643397129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賜進士出身、翰林院学士、经筵𧪸官兼脩國史錢塘倪岳書。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643413513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡觀人之相貌，先觀骨格，次看五行。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643921417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"量三停之長短，察面部之盈虧，觀眉目之清秀，看神氣之榮枯，取手足之厚薄，觀鬚髪之踈濁，量身材之長短，取五官之有成，看六府之有就，取五岳之歸朝，看倉庫之豊滿，觀陰陽之盛衰，看威儀之有無，辨形容之敦厚，觀","logicSentenceId":"7606695253021999114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951013018468390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色之喜滯，看體膚之細膩，觀頭之方員，頂之平塌，骨之貴賤，骨肉之粗流，氣之短促，聲之響亮，心田之好歹，俱依部位流年而推，骨格形局而斷，不可順時趨奉，有玷家傳。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253021999114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但於星𪧐、冨貴、貧賤、壽夭、窮通、榮枯、得失、流年、休咎，備皆週宻，所相於人，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643937801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"学者亦冝叅詳，推求眞妙，不可忽諸。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643954185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"十觀","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643970569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一取威儀。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022048266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如虎下山，百獸自驚；如鷹升騰，狐兎自戰。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643986953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不怒而威，不但在眼，亦觀顴骨神氣取之。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644003337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330950961361387531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二看敦重及精神。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644019721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身如萬斛之舟，駕於巨浪之中，揺而不動，引之不來。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644036105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐臥起居，神氣清靈，久坐不昧，愈加精彩。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644052489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日東升，剌人眼目，如秋月懸鏡，光輝皎潔。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644068873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面神眼神，俱如日月之明，輝輝皎皎，自然可愛，明明潔潔，久看不昏。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022064650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此相者，不大貴，亦當小貴，冨亦可許，不可妄談定。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644085257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三取清濁。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022097418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但人體厚者，自然冨貴，清者縱痩，神長必以貴推之，濁者有神謂之厚，厚者多冨，濁而無神謂之軟，軟者必孤，不孤則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644101641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951013018664998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四看頭員，頂額高。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022130186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但人頭爲一身之主，四肢之元，頭方者頂高，則爲居尊天子；額方者頂起，則爲輔佐良臣。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644118025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭員者，冨而有壽；額濶者，貴亦堪誇；頂平者，福壽綿逺。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644134409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭扁者，早歲迍邅；額塌者，少年虚耗；額低者，刑尅愚頑。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022081034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額門殺重者，早年困苦，部位傾䧟，髪際參差者，照依刑尅兼觀，不可一例而言，有悞相訣。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022113802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五看五岳及三停。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022146570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左顴爲東岳，俱要中正，不可粗露傾塌；額爲南岳，亦喜方正，不冝撇竹低塌；右顴爲","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644150793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330950961361502219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西岳，亦與左顴相同；地閣爲北岳，喜抂方員隆𣼛，不可尖削歪斜，捲竅兜上；土星爲中岳，亦冝方正聳上印堂，五岳成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529644150793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：五岳俱朝，貴壓朝班，亦且錢財自旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801527305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停者，額門、準頭、地𧢲，此面部三停也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801543689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又爲三才，又爲三主，又名三表，俱要平等。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801560073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停長，少年忙；中停長，福祿昌；下停長，老吉祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801576457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停平等，一生衣祿無虧。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801592841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若三停尖削，歪斜粗露，俱不利也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801609225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可照流年部位氣色而推，不可一體而斷。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801625609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六取五官六府。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022162954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉爲保壽官，喜清高，踈秀，灣長，亦冝","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801641993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951067657781257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高目一寸，尾拂天倉，主聰明冨貴，機巧福壽，此保壽官成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801641993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若粗濃黃淡泊，散亂低壓，乃刑傷破敗，此一官不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801658377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼爲監察官，黑白分明，或鳳眼、象眼、牛眼、龍虎眼、鶴眼、猴眼、孔雀鴛鴦眼、獅眼、喜鵲眼，神藏不露，黑如漆，白如玉，波長射耳，自然清秀有威，此監察官成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801674761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若蛇、蜂、羊、鼠、鷄、猪、魚、馬、火輪、四白等眼，赤白紗侵，晴員黑白混雜，兼神光太露，昏昧不清，此監察官不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801691145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又且愚頑兇敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801707529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330950961361600523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳爲採聽官，不論大小，止要輪廓分明，喜白過面。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801723913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水耳、土耳、金耳、牛耳、員棋耳、貼腦耳，對面不見耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801740297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高眉一寸，輪厚廓堅，紅潤姿色，内有長毫，孔小不大。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801756681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此採聽官成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801773065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或鼠耳、木耳、火耳、箭羽耳、猪耳，輪飛廓反，不好之耳，或低小軟弱，此採聽官不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801789449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不利少年，損六親。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801805833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻爲審辨官，亦冝豊隆聳直有肉，伏犀龍虎鼻，獅牛胡羊鼻，截筒盛嚢懸膽鼻，端正，不歪不偏，不粗不小，此審辨官成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801822217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若狗鼻、鯽魚、鷹嘴、劔峰、反吟、復","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801854985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951115862818854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吟，三曲三彎，露孔仰灶，扁弱，露脊露骨，太大孤峰，況又𠒋惡，貧苦無成，刑惡奸貪，此審辨宫不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801854985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口為出納官，唇紅齒白，兩唇濟豊，人中深長，仰月灣弓，四字口方，牛龍虎口，兩唇不反不昻，不掀不尖，此出納官成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801871369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或猪狗、羊口、覆船、鮕魚、卿魚、鼠食、羊飨，唇短齒露，唇黑唇皺，上唇薄，下唇反，鬚黄，焦枯粗濁，此出納宫不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801887753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：但一官成者，掌十年之貴祿冨豊；不成者，必主十年困苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801904137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六府者，天庭、日月二𧢲爲天府，宜方員明浄，不冝露","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801936905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951071914819625"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨，天府成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801936905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或欹削低塌偏尖，天府不成也，主初年運蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801953289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩颧爲人府，冝方正揷鬂，不粗不露，齊揖方拱，此人府成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801969673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若粗露高低，尖員綳皷，此人府不成也，主中年運否。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633801986057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地𧢲邊腮爲末景，地府喜輔，地閣懸𨐧，不昏不𢡖，不尖不歪，不粗不大，地府成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802002441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若高低，粗露，削尖，耳後見重腮，地府不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802018825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：一府就，掌十年之冨盛。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802035209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相反者，主十年之㐫敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802051593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951162528596006"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七取腰員背厚。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022179338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸坦腹墜，三甲三壬，體膚細嫰可也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802067977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背厚濶，腰硬腰員，最嫌背脊成坑，背薄肩垂，肩昻頸削。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802084361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰冝員冝硬，冝大冝平，不可細小，軟弱，崎灣，無庇股，臀薄尖削，露臀，冝平厚，不冝大竅。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802100745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸冝平滿，骨莫粗露，項下雙縧，心窩不陷，腹冝有槖，如葫蘆，臍下肉横生，不冝尖削，或如鵲肚、鷄胸、狗肚，此不堪也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802133513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：腰員背厚，方保玉帶朝衣，驟然不豫，慷慨過人，必主發達冨盛。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802149897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸平腹槖，故冝紫袍掛體。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802166281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖不出前，不入凡流，必須發達。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802182665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背如三甲，項後","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802199049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951071914950697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉厚，兩肩綳肉厚，腹如三壬，臍下肉長，兩腿邊肉長。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802199049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：背負三山如護甲，臍深納李腹垂箕。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802215433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此之相，必大貴，不貴之時冨可誇。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802231817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但頭大無𧢲，腹大無槖，不是農夫，必是屠傳；不是粗人，定是木作。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802248201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若尖削陷軟，狗肚鷄胸，縱冨必無結果。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802264585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：男子腰小，難主家財，亦且夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802280969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凸胸露臀，當成窮酸。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802297353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子爲僕，女子爲婢。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802313737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相中最冝推詳，不可忽畧。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802330121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八取手足。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022195722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冝細嫰隆厚，掌有八卦，紋路鮮明，或如噀血，尖起三峰，奇紋異紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802346505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節如鷄彈，指哭相稱，指大","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802362889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951205054660659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相停，掌平如鏡，或軟如綿，龍虎相吞。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802362889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌厚背厚，腕扁肘員，足背有肉，足底有紋有痣，掌畧帶灣。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802379273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手背不冝粗露筋骨，指節不冝漏縫。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802395657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：腫節漏縫，神昏神懶。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802412041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮筋露骨，身樂心憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802428425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌紅撰血，冨貴綿綿。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802444809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手軟如綿，閒且有錢。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802461193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖起三峰，福生晚景。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802477577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌平如鏡，白手興家。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802493961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋露粗率，晚年衣祿平常。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802510345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但相掌訣法，有載于後，冝與前後兼觀。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802526729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九取聲音與心田。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022228490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：要知心裡事，但看眼神清。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802543113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼乃心之門戶，觀其眼之善惡，必知心事之好歹。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802559497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802575881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951071915081769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心正則眸子瞭焉，心不正則眸子眊焉。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802575881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼視上其心必高，眼視下心有感思，眼轉動而不言，心有疑慮。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802592265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼視斜而口是心非，益巳害人，言不可聽。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022212106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼正視其人中正，無黨無偏，眼惡心必惡，眼善心必慈。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802608649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有隂隲者，或救人難厄，或救人危險，濟人貧窮，救人性命，不淫不亂，財寛量大容物人，俱有紫黃容紅氣色，發見於眼下臥蚕之官，印堂福堂之位，縱相貌不如，其心田好，終有冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802625033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若相貌堂堂，心事奸險，縱然冨貴，不日貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802657801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：未觀相貌，先看心","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802674185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951248822173734"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802674185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有相無心，相從心滅；有心無相，相從心生。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802690569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔裴度還帶，宋郊渡蟻，廉頗扶危，救人過渡，各千金不受，本是不貴之相，後反大貴，而隂隲扶之。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802706953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲音冝響喨，出自丹田，","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802723337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臍下一寸是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲響如雷灌耳，或如銅鐘玉韻，或如甕中之聲，或如銅鑼銅皷，或如金聲，或聲長尾大，如皷之響，俱要清潤。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802723337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱相貌不如，亦主冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802756105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或人小聲大，人大聲雄，俱要深逺，丹田所出，此冨貴綿逺之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802772489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭折貧賤之人，聲輕聲噎，聲浮聲散，聲低聲小，或如破鑼破皷，語音焦枯，聲大","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802788873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951175828750348"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尾焦，聲雄不員。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802788873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：冨貴之聲，出于丹田；夭賤之人，聲出舌端，或有餘韻，縱焦枯烈，早年虚耗，晚主發達矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802805257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"訣曰","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022244874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言未舉而色先變，話未盡而氣先絶，俱夭賤之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802838025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀聲音，知爲相之根本；觀陰隲，知爲相之元神。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802854409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形貌莫外乎聲音，隂隲部位不好，有此相者，竟許冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802870793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但聲音响喨者，雖貧，終能發達，不必狐疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802887177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十觀形局與五行。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022261258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形局者，乃人一身之大關也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802903561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或如","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802919945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951248822435878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍形、虎形、鶴形、獅形、孔雀形、鸛形、牛形、猴形、豹形、象形、鳯形、鴛鴦、鷺鹚、駱駝、黄鸝、練雀等形，此冨貴形相。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802919945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或猪形、狗形、羊形、馬形、鹿形、鴉形、鼠形、狐狸形，此𠒋暴、貧薄、夭折之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802936329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行者，金、木、水、火、土也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802952713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：金得金，剛毅深，木得木，資財足，水得水，文章貴，火得火，見機果，土得土，厚豊庫。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802969097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金形白色，喜白，木形瘦，喜青，水喜肥黑，火不嫌尖，冝赤色，土喜厚兮，色冝黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633802985481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此五行正局也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803001865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合此者，冨貴福壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803018249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反此者，貧賤夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7606695253022277642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但學者憑五行兼骨格推斷，相法","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803034633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951175828865036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多端。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803034633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理居總斷","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803051017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擇交在眼，","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803083785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼惡者情多薄，交之有害，然露者無心，不可不詳審也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問貴在眼，","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803083785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未有眼無神而貴且壽者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問冨在鼻，","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803083785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻爲土生金，厚而豊隆者，必冨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問壽在神，","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803083785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未有神不足而壽且貴者，縱貴亦夭也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求全在聲，士農工商，聲亮必成，不亮無終。","logicSentenceId":"7580387633803083785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上相不出此五法，拘于口耳、眉、額、手足、背腹之間者，凡庸相士也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入眼方知訣，還觀主起中。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689808905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語遲終冨顯，歩𦂳必貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689825289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犬眼休爲伴，鷄睛莫與逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689841673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項偏多蹇滿，頭小定飄蓬","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689858057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951289708445746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689858057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨露財難聚，筋浮病必攻。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689874441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇掀知命夭，腹墜祿須豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689890825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰肥知有福，額廣壽如松。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689907209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚長兼耳薄，辛苦道途中。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689923593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天道週歲有二十四節氣，人面一年氣色亦二十四變，以五行配之，無不驗者。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785689989129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但色最難審，當于清明","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690005513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951288777113619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3vp55/1-7604029190543507482_%E5%BE%AE%E4%BF%A1%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87_20260207160711_992_294.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AsH0RHqQMT7A6a76YzgynWBDl0I%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3vp55/1-7604029190543507482_微信图片_20260207160711_992_294.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7604029190543540250"},"logicSentenceId":"7580387785690005513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠁊之時觀之，又須隔絶不醉不近色，乃可决耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690005513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愼之愼之！","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690021897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色半月一換，交一節氣，子時卽變矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690038281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色在皮内肉外隱隱可掬者，方是眞氣色。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690054665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色現而安静者，應之遲；若黙點熖動不定者，應之速。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690071049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春要青，夏要紅，秋要白，冬要黑，四季月要黄，此天時氣色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690087433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木形人要青，火形人要紅，金形人要白，水形人要黑，土形人要黄，此人身之氣色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690103817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951333371019274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木形色青，要帶黑，忌白；火形色紅，要帶青，忌黑；金形色白，要帶黃，忌紅；水形色黑，要帶白，忌黃；土形色黄，要帶紅，忌青。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690120201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此五形生尅之氣色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690185737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青如晴天日未出之色，而有潤澤，爲正爲吉；如打傷痕而乾焦，則爲邪爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580387785690202121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南云：金形方正色潔白，肉不盈兮骨不薄。","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597504027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木形痩直骨節堅，色帶青兮人卓荦。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088718766116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水形圓厚重而黒，腹垂背聳眞氣魄。","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597520411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火形豐銳赤焦燥，反露氣枯無常好。","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597536795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土形敦厚色黃光，臀背露兮性樂静。","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597553179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吕尚","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597569563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951381483880474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：木痩金方乃常談，水圓土厚何須𡩖。","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597569563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麟鳳記云：相尅於中蹇難多，金木水火由不和。","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597585947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：五行㐫：","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597602331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金形帶木，𣃔削方成，初主蹇滯，末主超群。木形多金，一生剝落，父母早刑，妻子不成。水形遇土，忽破家財，疾苦連年，終身迍邅。火形水性，兩不相並，尅破妻兒，錢財無剩。土逢重木，作事無成，若非夭折，家道伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行吉：","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597602331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金逢厚土，足寳足珍，諸事營謀，遂意稱心。木水相資，富而且貴，文學英華，出塵之器。水得金生，利名雙成，知圓行方，明達果毅。火局遇木，鳶肩騰上，三十爲卿，功名葢世。土添離火，戊巳丙丁，愈煖愈隹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951384721866771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其道生成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597602331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"次察陰陽精氣神","logicSentenceId":"7580356296597618715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"骨爲陽，肉爲陰，精乃血之主，氣乃神之本，神乃精之附。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧女金鏡云：骨陽肉陰兩平和，一生終是無灾害。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461147162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽勝於陰多孤尅，陰勝於陽多夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461163546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼眼經云：大道凝成有三般，精能養血冠衆體。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461179930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王朔云：氣所以養形而化成者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461196314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易云：神者，玅萬物而爲言者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461212698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461229082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一陰一陽不偏勝，此道由來天賦定。精氣相資體之充，神攝萬靈爲主帥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"三停八卦求相稱","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461245466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三停者，有身上三停，有面上三停。八卦者，有面列八卦，有掌列八卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951381484027930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉箎云：身上三停頭足腰，看他長短欲匀調。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461261850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停長者人多貴，長短無差福不饒。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461278234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冥度經云：凡天中至印堂，曰上停；山根至準頭，曰中停；人中至地閣，曰下停。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461294618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南云：五形不正，相君終始薄寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461311002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦豐隆，須是多招財祿。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088718782500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461327386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身而三停俱勾調，掌而八卦悉豐盈。不踹玉階地，定處金谷園。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"五嶽四瀆定高深","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461343770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左顴㤗嶽，右顴華嶽，額爲衡嶽，頦爲恒嶽，鼻爲嵩嶽。一瀆耳爲江，二瀆目爲河，三瀆口爲淮，四瀆鼻爲濟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951451784708105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"大道無形無執着","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461736986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人雖具形，來自無形。相本有法，拘法則泥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成和子云：夫人肖形天地，其本來面目，無中生有，或得之而成飛禽之像，或得之而成走獸之像，色色種種，别何者爲吉人，何者爲匪人？","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461753370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗟夫，執形而論相，管中窺豹也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088718831652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不離形，不拘法，視於無形，聽於無聲，其相之善之善者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461786138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：上相之士，不相身面，其意亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461802522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461818906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以貌觀人，失之子羽。以言語觀人，失之宰予。宣尼猶然，矧庸術乎？葢道能生形，形不能生道，知此道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951468658229267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即知此形，形乎形乎，視聽冥冥，斯其至矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461818906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"揣摩蕳練出其下","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461835290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"學古人之成法，斤斤不失尺寸，此其下也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太冲子云：今得意於忘言之天，盡是棄糟粕已後。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461851674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南云：揣其形，摩其骨，什分之間不失一。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461868058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"超于什一揣摩中，便是神仙下寰世。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088718864420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461884442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"春秋伯樂善相馬，秦穆公謂伯樂之後無人已。伯樂舉九方臯，穆公乃使九方臯遍求馬于域中，數月而報得良馬，牝牡毛色畢呈。馬至，則與前報者戾，穆公不悅，曰：牝牡毛色不分，又何馬之能知？伯樂曰：若臯之所觀，天機也。得其精而忘其粗，在其内而忘其外。驗之，果良馬。夫君子之相，何異良馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951517710614555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"？學者得九方臯之術，化矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"有時或在方寸間","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461900826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"理不越于方寸，常存主于一身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖凡論云：心爲身主，五形之先。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461917210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麻衣云：未觀形貌，先相心田。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461933594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二者，皆方寸之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461949978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461966362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"心者，身之帥，心帥以正，幻形孰不正？形有不正者，無論矣。即如伏羲人首蛇身，神農人身牛首，爲三代之聖君，方寸之論，彰彰明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"有時或在郛廓外","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461982746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"石藴玉而山輝，珠藏淵而川媚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靈臺經云：骨肉丰標爲外郛，且於眞實用工夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682461999130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肘","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462015514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951468658311187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後經云：吾人性上無一物，形生惟有外皮膚。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462015514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧女心鏡云：尭眉八彩，舜目重瞳，内秉聖德，外見神姿。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462031898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此推之，内德外形之徵也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462048282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462064666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相有隱有顯，顯者易觀，隱者難見，在學者目力心思何如耳。假如有德者必有形，又有有形者而無德。湯軀九尺，而曹交類之。孔子河目，而陽虎類之。一聖一狂，天淵之懸，是不可不辨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"空空洞洞本來眞","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462081050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空空，明鏡之衷；洞洞，無物之體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心經云：色即是空，空即是色。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462113818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通仙錄云：洞洞不知天地隘，性靈還是太虗眞。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462130202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白閣道者云：不論肉，不","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462146586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951517710762011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論骨，骨肉皮囊殻漏子，空空洞洞有乾坤，即是太虚元化體。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462146586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462162970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"血肉由氣化為生，性靈具於氣化之前，是以知本眞，則知衆體。此論可與高明者道，難與庸俗者言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"彷彷佛彿難測度","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462179354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有相無心，有心無相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神機云：有形中之形，有形外之形。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462212122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形中之形，由中生色，𦖒然見於面，盎於背是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462228506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形外之形，色厲内荏，似忠非忠，似信非信是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462244890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二者，特踐形不踐","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462261274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951468658393107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形之間耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462261274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462277658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昔有人毁陳平于漢祖，曰：陳平美如冠玉。未必中之有也。誠哉斯言乎！觀人之難也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太冲子云：箇中得此閑消息，了我優游物外身。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462326810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462343194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"邵子詩曰：因探月窟方知物，爲躡天根始識人。此與上文辭異而意同。不造其玅，則何以知人，又何以知己也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"東周叔服豈欺我","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462359578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"叔服有人倫識鑒，學者當不讓于叔服。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951577487835173"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柳庄云：緊相人之有術兮，肇東周之叔服。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462392346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"監昭晰之幽隠兮，亶休咎之是卜。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088718880804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462408730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"叔服擅名于周，子卿、唐舉繼之，孰謂子卿、唐舉之後，又豈無人哉？欺我之言不誣矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"五行水火木金土","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462441498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太極生兩儀，兩儀生四象，四象生八卦，八卦生五行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南曰：天一生水，在人爲腎，腎之竅爲耳，又主骨齒。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462474266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地二生火，在人爲心，心之竅爲舌，又主血氣、毛髪。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462490650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天三生木，在人爲肝，肝之竅爲眼，又主筋膜、","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462507034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951468658491411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爪甲。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462507034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地四生金，在人爲肺，肺之竅爲鼻，又主皮膚喘息。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462523418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天五生土，在人爲脾，脾之竅爲唇，又主肉色。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462539802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宋齊丘云：凡在五行俱有祿，只宜豐厚不宐偏。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462556186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462572570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人身具此五行，惟水火乃五行之最。水屬坎，居腎，腎水旺，能養巽之肝木,木得水濟而生離之心火，火得木助而生艮之脾土，土得火益而生兑之肺金。此生生不息之機，乃水之化源無端也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"中藏五德通臟腑","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462588954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五德：仁、義、禮、智、信，臟腑：肺、肝、心、腎、脾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄神錄云：甲木主仁位居東，庚金爲義向西從。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462621722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禮依丙火南方地，智於壬癸北方中。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462638106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有戊土無方","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462654490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951577488015397"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，信立陰陽理則同。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462654490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五者本非泛然物，隱於臟腑玅無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462670874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462687258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水火木金土，肝肺心腎脾。五德配五行，仁義禮智信。發而爲四端，信則居其一。生相若無信，虚負軀殻體。吾見世間人，致餙于外矣，不知無文中，含有眞實理。眞實即爲信，四時不愆期。相中全在信，福祿壽須彌。四端豈假借，各具其一理。信寄四端中，有用無方躰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"水圓本是智之神","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462703642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水性周流無滯，智之躰似之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：眉麄并眼大，城廓更團圓。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462736410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此相名眞水，平生福自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462752794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成和子云：水形主圓，得其五圓，氣色不","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462769178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951563839586340"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雑，精神不亂，動止寛容，行久而輕也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357682462769178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語云：智者樂水，又云：智者動。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331536430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331552814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水，先天之氣耳，貫通于六合，化機不息，亘古如常，圓融似智，得其形并得其性，是爲塡水。主聰明敏逹，定賢愚也。經云：似水得水，文學貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"火有文武禮之附","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331569198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火之用有文武，禮之躰似之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：欲識火形貌，下濶上頭尖。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331601966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉止全無定，頥邊更少髯。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331618350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成和子云：火形主明，得其五露，氣色不雜，精神不亂，動止敦厚，臥久而安也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331634734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951629048446985"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331651118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以火爲神水作精，精全而後神方生。神全而後氣方備，氣備而後色方成。火之在人爲禮。得其形，并得其智，是爲真火。主威勢勇烈，定剛柔也。經云：似火得火，見機果。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"木居東位仁發生","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331667502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木之德爲仁，含生生之機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：稜稜形痩骨，凜凛更脩長。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331700270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀氣生眉眼，須知晩景光。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331716654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成和子云：木形主長，得其五長，氣色不雜，精神不亂，動止温柔，涉久而清也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331733038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331749422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木之枝幹發于甲木，位天地長生之府，配于五德，居其首，在人爲仁，得其形，并得其性，是爲眞木，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951563839668260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"精蕐茂秀，定貴賤也。經云：似木得木貲財足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"金方斷制義自然","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331765806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金之性，有樽節裁處之宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：部位要中正，三停又帶方。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331798574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金形人入格，自是有名揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331814958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成和子云：金形主方，得其五方，氣色不雜，精神不亂，動止规模，坐久而重也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331831342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331847726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金之位于乾兊，含西方肅殺之氣，秉堅剛之躰，在人爲義，得其形，并得其性，是爲眞金。主刑誅厄難，定壽夭也。經云：似金得金，剛毅深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"土定不移信常足","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331864110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土之性，定信立綱維。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951629048610825"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：端厚仍深重，安詳若㤗山。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331896878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心謀難測度，信義動人間。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331913262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成和子云：土形主厚，得其五厚，氣色不雜，精神不亂，動止敦龎，處久而静也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331929646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331946030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土浮㳺于四季，旺在辰戌丑未，寄在丙丁。一季主事十八日，其德能生萬物。在人爲性，得其形，并得其性，是爲眞土。主載育有容，定貧富也。經云：似𡈽得𡈽，厚櫃庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"此爲五德配五行","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331962414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"摠結上文而言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：木要瘦，金要方，水肥火厚土尖長。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892331995182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形體相生便爲吉，忽然相尅定爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332011566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951563839782948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332027950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蒼松翠栢，歲寒不凋，可以觀仁。精金美玉，百煉琢磨，可以觀義。火風烹飪，鼎養聖賢，可以觀禮。長江大河，天機流動，可以觀智。名山大川，載重不洩，可以觀信。人與天地並立，天地一人也，人一天地也。知此五德，配五行之說，其迨庶几乎！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"賦形天地超萬靈","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332060718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天地生人，性靈異于萬物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無形歌云：道爲貌，天爲形，黙受陰陽稟性情。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332077102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽之氣天地糙，化出塵凡幾樣人。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332093486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靈柩經云：人禀天地之氣，肖淸濁之形，爲萬物至靈也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332109870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王元君云：大","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332126254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951676431532070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道無形，而生有形，舒之彌六合，捲之不盈握，包絡天地，稟受群生者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332126254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故云：賦形天地超萬靈。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332142638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332159022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人生之道，眞精融合，二五凝成，賦其形，即賦其理，雖萬物皆具生成之道，蠢然而巳，未有如人最靈也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸鑒云：大都神氣賦於人，有若油兮又似燈。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332191790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人平却自精之實，油淸然後燈方明。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332208174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柳庄云：古者方伎之妙，有聞人之警恪，而知其必貴者，得之于人也；","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332224558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951656110030884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有察人之喜怒，而知其必貴者，得之于氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332224558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南云：形以養血，血以養氣，氣以養神，故形全則氣全，氣全則神全。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332240942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：神完則氣寛，神安則氣静，得失不足以暴其氣，喜怒不足以驚其神，其爲君子乎，福祿永其終矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332257326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332273710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"今人論神，必曰眼有精神。殊不知神之元，天一生水爲精，地二生火爲神。精合者然後神從之，内有充足之，則外有澄徹之神。如行不動色，坐不隨語，睡易醒覺，作事始終，皆精神也。論氣必曰神氣，固是，殊不知氣有三焉：有自然之氣，有所養之氣，有暴戾之氣。自然之氣，乃胎元，一呼一吸，定生人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951676431728678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之貴賤也；所養之氣，乃浩然，塞乎兩間，定人之賢愚也；暴戾之氣，乃悻悻自好，定人之善惡也。要之，神，氣之子；氣，神之母，神能留氣，氣不能留神。定訣日：妙相之法在何方，觀其神氣在學堂，氣者有之最是良。若人認得神與氣，富貴貧賤足審量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"油若竭兮燈焰熄","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332290094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣喪則神亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神解云：將全其形，先須其理。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332322862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精實氣固則神安，血枯氣散則神亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332339246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：氣壯血和則安固，血枯氣散神失奔。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332355630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謝靈運云：夭壽之人神離睫，泛而不救，無所守也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332372014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圖南云：氣冷形衰壽豈宜。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332388398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：氣短精神慢，那得有長年？","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332404782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951656110112804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332421166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神氣乃相須者也。氣旣䘮，神安得獨存？經云：神散氣聚，少孤破家。氣聚神散，作事不定。神與氣合，深逺主壽，淸秀主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"燈若明兮油潤之","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332437550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神若秀發，由氣助之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：神居形內不可見，氣以養神爲命根。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332470318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：英標淸秀心神爽，氣血調和神不昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332486702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白閣道者云：神者，百閱之秀氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332503086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如陽氣舒而山川秀發，日月現而天地清明。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332519470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332535854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951719888748595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形能養神，托氣而安。氣不多則神暴而不安。欲安其神，先養其氣，故孟子不顧萬鍾之祿，能養其氣者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肘後經云：神衰血敗氣將凋，失志落落不支持。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332585006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼箭云：荒唐失志神無宅，不到中途則夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332601390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來和子云：維維失志，失志改常，神已去矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332617774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332634158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神氣欲散，福祿將艾。雖處得意之時，無異窘迫之際，此乃神已去舍，觀之何知。歌曰：何知爲官多灾難，坐時眉攅口常嘆，何知其人必死亡，塵埃面色言失常，正無守宅謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951656110194724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"澄澄絕俗有根株","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332650542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澄澄，瑩静無雜，絕俗，出衆異常。根株，苗裔有木也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南云：精神澄徹，如止水之淵，驚之不懼，折之不囘，君子之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332683310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神解云：虚化神，神化氣，氣爲骨之苗裔，骨爲神之根株矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332699694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肘後經云：骨肉相滋不相返，精神湛粹壽康寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332716078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332732462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"峩峩怪石迷閑雲，崑山片玉已𤥨出。此至精之寳，發于外而藴于內，非天地之鍾毓，道德之涵養，而能此乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"縱然形肉充盈實","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332748846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖有形肉不如神氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951719888928819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來和子云：形亦厚，肉亦充，無神無氣怨天公。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332781614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南云：有肉而無氣，猶如蠧木，内已空虚，雖外有皮膚，暴風迅雨，鮮有不摧者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332797998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332814382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有神氣無形肉者，有根蒂而無枝葉，非時不茂。昔人有相諸葛孔眀者，日：外禀松栢枯稿之姿，内有文理根蒂之實，風兩不摧折，一日華秀，名满天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"氣散神枯虚殻子","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332830766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神氣俱亡，虚有幻軀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無形云：神也無，氣也無，空空遺下這皮膚。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332847150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殻子若値風霜殞，谷神先已向秋枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332863534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951656110293028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332879918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣以血養而助神，氣散則神枯，由心不能生血故也。心何爲而不生血？由思慮勞傷，揣摩計較，斷䘮心之虚靈，所以損耗神氣元神，元神耗則神氣亡，神氣亡，幻軀能夕乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
