{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"陰陽陶鑄幾般人","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332912686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陰陽二氣生成分，智愚賢不肖幾般。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南云：夫人之生，爲萬物之貴，懷天地五常之性，抱陰陽二氣之靈，雖秉彞之本同，肖容貌之非一。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332945454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通玄賦云：陽生陰育，天尊地卑。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332961838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭謄經云：人禀陰陽之正氣，形似天地以相同。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332978222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中聖有全德，造化","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332994606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951771503870002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無全功。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892332994606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333010990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陰陽二氣之化生也，陽先而陰後，陽施而陰受。陽者乾道，陰者坤道。乾道成男，坤道成女。禀其氣之淸者，爲聖爲賢。稟其氣之濁者，爲愚爲不肖。所以禀氣則同，淸濁有異，而人品殊矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"器識緣何分淺深","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333027374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"器者，德器。識者，識量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裴行儉云：士先器識而後文藝。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333043758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李靖云：淺淺器識庸人耳，福薄難與成功名。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333060142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：形者，人之材也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333076526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德者，人之器也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088718946340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有材矣，而付之以德，猶如雕琢而成器也，器遇拙工而棄之，是爲不材之材也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333092910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951751123615756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333109294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德在形先，形在德後。即如項羽目有重瞳，形則善矣。然而咸陽三月火，骸骨亂如麻，哭聲慘怛天地，非羽殘暴之器致之乎？竟而艤舟不渡，刎首烏江，形何足恃㢤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"也有汪洋居臺閣","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333125678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"汪洋，喻德量之寛宏。臺閣，三公元宰之位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：剛毅汪洋誰可識？","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333142062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呂尙云：器宇汪洋有容納，志氣深逺有機謀，動作使令不可料，時通亦爲公與侯。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892333158446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼箭云：器宇軒昻好丰標，必居臺閣佐明朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352507950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352524334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951818236657701"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形躰美惡，本自生成，器識卑瑣，學問可以充柘。昔柴羔貌惡未學，性至愚鹵。一見孔子之後，啓蟄不殺，方長不折，不徑不竇。居䘮泣血三年，未嘗見齒，卒成大賢。學聞之變化如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"也有輕盈處廟廷","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352540718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣驕則輕，志滿則盈，廟廷，朝延也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：幾輩堂堂相貌淸，幾人相貌太輕盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352557102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神機云：骨格精神志氣盈，早年佩玉立廟廷。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352573486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春花必定春時發，過却春時花謝傾。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352589870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352606254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德器者，蒼海之波瀾，注之不見泛，掬之不見涸，虚而能受，動而愈出，此其所以異于輕盈者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"輕盈薄識非遐福","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352622638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"輕盈薄識，不見于其身，而見于其後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951751123697676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裴行儉云：人有文才而浮急淺露，豈享富貴之器耶？","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352639022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"管輅云：處崇宦而自視巍巍然，非遐福之器也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352655406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352671790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大舜微時，耕稼陶漁，艱苦無不履歷。及身處九重，玉食萬國，自是不以爲欿，無異耕稼陶漁之時。祿位名壽兼而有之，福流子孫，眞遐福之器㢤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"汪洋大度可延齡","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352688174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絕而能續曰延。齡，年齡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白閣道者云：腹內能容三萬斛，齡如一縷亦須延。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352704558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陸賈云：漢高豁逹大度。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352720942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352737326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951818236854309"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"書曰：有容徳乃大。夫徳者，天爵也。孟云：脩其天爵，而人爵從之。即宋郊以竹渡蟻，遇胡僧相之日：公神彩異常，必活數萬性命，後日當魁天下。夫以數萬蟻命，尤陰報之速，使活天下蒼生之命，又當何如耶？延齡之說，誠非迂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"子輿巉巖師萬世","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352753710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孟軻，字子輿。巉巖，氣象巉巖也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：巉巖器宇旋旋生。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352770094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通仙錄云：巉巖器宇旋旋露，有類古玉埋千秋。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352786478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清鑒云：孟子巖巖泰山氣象，能賤齊宣之祿萬鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352802862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352819246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫有德者，其器宇恢廓，輕萬鍾一節，未足以窺其微。使務名者亦能之，𤲃竟于平時見義無難色。方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951751123812364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得之，古人謂觀其所忽是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"夷吾卑俠佐姜齊","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352835630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"管仲，字夷吾。相齊桓公，伯諸矦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子曰：管仲之器小㢤！","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352852014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子註云：局量褊淺，規模𤰞狹，謂其得君行道，而以伯終也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352868398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352884782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或謂孔子論管仲之器小，朱子釋曰：局量褊淺，規模卑狹。此論事功，未論其德容。葆和子曰：不然。器者，吾身之德，發而爲容。有其德便有其器，有其器便有其容。事功即德器之見于行也。故古人見其禮而知其政，聞其樂而知其德。𡋡柳庄曰：聞人之聲而知其素，其意于此同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"此特公私毫髪間","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352901166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用心有公私之别。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951868169912358"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄談云：丰姿異，骨格奇。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352933934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再觀才器設施爲。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352950318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才濟變意有私，小人君子不同歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352966702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱文達曰：公道私情，此事間不容髪。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352983086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892352999470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夷吾葵丘之會，名尊周室，實伯齊桓，公私之介，惟宣尼知之，所以器不能王齊而伯終也。假如人有此才，器有竒形，且大公無我，不惟福庇于一身一家，大君赤子亦蒙其福矣。人之德器，顧不重哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"出其下者無足評","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353015854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德噐不及夷吾者，無足論相矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：上貴之人方入相，中下之人豈可評？","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353048622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來和子云：南北路頭多少人，上士吾方與論評。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088718962724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951751123910668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353081390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"麻衣日，形骸局促，作事猥𤠠。器宇軒昻，一生快順。夫軒昂者，抱致逺之資。局促者，顕卑瑣之態。人品已定，貴賤已殊，無足評論固宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"福若水兮德若器","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353097774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德隨器付。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉管訣云：雖然論相而論福，尤必觀器而知德。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353114158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度冥經云：人有一分德器，必有一分衣禄；十分德器，必有十分衣祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353130542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353146926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福水，德器之喩，極善比方者也。吾嘗讀史，見古人作欹器者，中則正，滿則覆，限于其噐也。始知得福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951868170092582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二者，亦猶欹器之有限也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"噐若淺兮水盈溢","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353163310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"器小福薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼箭云：相寒福薄是前緣，噐淺分明由怨天。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353196078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胡僧云：小人形貌相有方，不見墦間乞祭郞。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353212462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"施施狀，驕妻房，易盈易溢最乖張。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353228846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏夜乞哀曽婢膝，白晝矜人更濟鏘。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353245230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"器淺志盈無逺識，直鐃富貴也尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353261614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353277998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"嘗聞孔子臍深七李，董卓亦臍深七李。經云：濟爲五藏之外表，惟喜深宽怕窄小，居上爲智居下愚。七李能容，仲尼是亘古一聖，賦此異質。董卓亦當如仲尼之聖爲是，何乃驕于盧㯰？曰：吾與公同位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951850105045033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，公□尚居中郞。㯰日：明公與我皆鴻鵠，不意明公變為鳳凰。卓喜。夫卓使有孔子之德，又有其形，是亦孔子也，何乃戮身燃臍？德不稱形故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"得志峥嶸泯德色","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353294382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德色，驕矜之態。泯，無迹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風鑑云：紅紫黃光起福堂，峥嶸得志喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353327150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謝靈運云：得志之人輕可識，辨取峥嶸及德色","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353343534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353359918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴得志之氣，三光五澤，此正本來之色也。人若處此富貴之時，未嘗不以富貴驕人，其傲慢之氣，有不及儉束于處己待人之時，圭角𤼵露，此德色也。學力到，涵養純，則無矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"失時落魄絕狐媚","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353376302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"落魄，猶言䘮氣也。狐善媚，故日狐媚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353425454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世間惟有貧賤至易移人。飢寒迫于身，壯氣消磨，雄心頓挫，鮮不奴顔拽裾于王公。程子詩：富貴不淫貧賤樂，男兒到此是豪雄。此相之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"任是不颺難錄取","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353441838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胡僧云：休嫌貌不颺，白璧璞中藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353474606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裴中立云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353490990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自題像。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾聲不揚，爾貌不颺，一黙靈臺，丹靑莫狀。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353490990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353523758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330951850105159721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人形甚美，必有甚惡；人形甚惡，必有甚美。誠能知美中有惡，惡中有美，相術不減于姑布子卿矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892353605678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"心生相貌，以理言也。夫人心雕𤥨太甚，生理盡矣。具有美形，未見有減，惟福自減耳。培養方寸，生理全矣。雖有惡形，未嘗有改，惟福自增耳。學術者，此不可不知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻乃財星，位居上宿，截筒懸膽，千倉萬箱，聳直豐隆，一生財旺富貴，中正不偏，須知永逺滔滔。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584488970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鷹嘴尖峰","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584505354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952201273081866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，破財貧寒，莫教孔仰，主無隔宿之糧。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584505354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厨竈若空，必是家無所積。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584521738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：鼻主財星瑩若隆，兩邉厨竈莫教空，仰露家無財與粟。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584538122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣相朝甲櫃豐。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584554506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛宫論曰：天倉、地庫、金甲櫃、井竈，總曰財帛宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584570890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須要豐滿明潤，財帛有餘，忽然枯削，財帛消乏。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719159332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天無地，先富後貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584587274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天薄地豐，始貧終富。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584603658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天高地厚，富貴满足，蔭及子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584620042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額尖窄狹，一生貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584636426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井竈破露，厨無宿","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584652810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952139621023780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584652810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金甲櫃豐，富貴不窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584669194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色昏黑，主破失財禄。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584685578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黄色現，主進財禄。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584701962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青黃貫鼻，主得横財。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584718346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二櫃豐厚，明潤清和，居官而受賞賜。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584734730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤主口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584751114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟位居兩睂，屬羅計，眉長過目，三四兄弟無刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584783882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉秀而踈，枝幹自然端正，有如新月，和同永逺超群。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584800266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是短粗，同氣連枝見别，睂環塞眼，鳫行必疎。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892584816650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩様眉毛，定須異母。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797104178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交連黃薄，自䘮他鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797120562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旋結囘毛，兄弟蛇䑕。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797136946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952201273327626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：眉爲兄弟軟徑長，兄弟生成四五强。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797153330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩𧢲不齊須異母，交連黃薄送他鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797169714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟宫論曰：兄弟羅計，須要豐蔚，不宐虧陷。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797186098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長秀則兄弟和睦。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797202482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短促不足，則有分離孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719175716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉有旋毛，兄弟衆多，狼性不常。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797218866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂毛散者，錢財不聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797235250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂毛逆生，仇兄賊弟，互相妬害，或是異姓同居。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719192100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂清有彩，孤騰淸高之士。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797251634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂毛過目，兄弟和睦。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797268018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂毛中斷，兄弟分散。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719208484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濃淡豐盈，義友弟兄。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797284402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色青，主兄弟闘爭，口舌黒白，兄弟","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797300786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952139621122084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797300786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黃之氣，榮貴喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797317170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅者，位居兩眼，最怕赤脉侵晴，初年破盡家園，到老無糧作蘖。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797349938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼如點漆，終身産業榮榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797366322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳳目高睂，置稅三州五縣，陰陽枯骨，莫保田園。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797382706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火眼水輪，家財傾盡。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797399090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩日：眼爲田宅主其宫，清秀分明一樣同，若是陰陽枯更露，父母家財總是空。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797415474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952237801406501"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅宫論日：土星爲田宅，主地閣要朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797448242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭豐滿明潤，主田宅進益，低塌昏暗傾欹，主破田宅。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797464626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若飛走不朝，田宅俱無。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797481010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色靑，主官非，田宅無成；黒，主杖責；白，主丁憂；紅，主成田宅喜重重。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797497394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃明，吉昌，謀無不遂，君子加官，即日得陞。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719224868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人得寵，利見貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797513778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武職或領兵馬，殺氣旺者，即行師。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797530162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主官財賦，或入運司等處。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797546546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五品至三品，三品至二品，如是詳看，六品以下，另作區處。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797562930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女者，位居兩眼下。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797595698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰涙堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797612082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽平滿，兒孫福祿","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797628466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952139621204004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797628466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隱隠臥蚕，子息還須清貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797644850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淚堂深陷，定爲男女無縁。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797661234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黒痣斜紋，到老兒孫有尅。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719241252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如吹火，獨坐蘭房。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797677618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是平滿，人中難得兒孫送老。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797694002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：男女三陽起卧蚕，瑩然光彩好兒郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797710386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸針理亂來侵位，宿債平生不可當。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797726770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女宫論日，三陰三陽，位雖豐厚，不宜枯陷。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797743154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左三陽枯，尅損男。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797759538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右三隂枯，尅損女，左眼下有卧蚕紋，生貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797775922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡男女眼下無肉者，妨害男女。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797792306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卧蚕陷者，陰隲少，","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797808690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952269837402138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當絕嗣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797808690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亂紋侵者，主假子及招義女。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797825074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾及龍宫黃色環遶，主爲陰隲紋見，曾懷陰徳濟於人，必有果報。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797841458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：精寒血竭不華色，男不旺，女不育。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797857842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若陰陽調和，精血敷暢，男女交合，故生成之道不絕。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797874226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宐推於形象外，當以理言，玄玅自見也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797890610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色靑，主產厄；黒白，主男女悲哀；紅黃，主喜至。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797906994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽位紅生兒，三陰位靑生女。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797923378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕者，位居地閣，重接水星，頦圓豐滿，侍立成群。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797956146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797972530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952139621285924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弼星朝，一呼百諾，口如四字，主呼聚喝散之權。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797972530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣尖斜，受恩深而反成怨恨。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892797988914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絞紋敗陷，奴僕不周。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798005298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墻壁低傾，恩成仇隙。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798021682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：奴僕還須地閣豐，水星兩𧢲不相容。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798038066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若言三處都無應，傾䧟紋痕總不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798054450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕宫論曰：懸壁無虧，奴僕不少。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798070834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是枯陷，僕馬俱無。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798087218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色靑，主奴馬損傷；白黑，主僕馬墜墮，不宐逺行；赤，主僕馬口舌，損馬失財。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798103602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色，勝，牛馬奴僕自旺，左","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798119986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952269837664282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門右户排立成行。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798119986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾者，位居魚尾，號日奸門。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798169138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光潤無紋，必保妻全四德。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798185522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐隆平滿，娶妻財帛盈箱。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719257636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴星侵天，因妻得禄，奸門深陷，常作新郞。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798218290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾紋多，妻防惡𣦸，奸門黯黲，自號生離，黒痣斜紋，外情好而心多淫慾。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798234674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：奸門光澤保妻宫，財帛盈箱見始終。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798251058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是奸門生黯慘，斜紋黑痣蕩淫奔。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798267442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952240112369683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾宫論曰：魚尾須要平滿，不宜尅陷。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798283826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐滿則夫貴妻榮，奴僕成行。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798300210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦女魚尾奸門明潤，得貴人爲夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798316594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人鼻如懸膽，則主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798332978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"缺陷則主防夫淫亂，敗家放蕩，不旺夫。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719274020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人面如滿月，下頦豐滿，至國母之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798349362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色靑，則主妻妾憂愁思慮；赤，主夫妻口舌；黒白，主夫妻男女之悲；紅黃色見，主夫妻男女和諧之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798365746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有暗昧，主夫妻分離，不然隔𧢲少情。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798382130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄者，印堂之下，位居山根。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798414898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隆如豐滿，福祿無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719290404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798431282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952306009243675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"接伏犀，定主文章。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798431282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩然光彩，五福俱全。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719306788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽高平，和鳴相守。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798447666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋痕低陷，連年速疾沉疴。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719323172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枯骨尖斜，未免終身受苦。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719339556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣如烟霧，災厄纒身。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719355940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根疾厄起平平，一世無災禍不生。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798480434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若値紋痕并枯骨，平生辛苦却難成。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798496818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄宫論曰：年壽明潤，康㤗。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798513202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏暗，疾病至。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719372324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色靑，主憂驚；赤，防重灾；白，主妻子之悲；黑，主身𣦸；紅黃紫，主喜氣之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798529586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952240112451603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"九遷移","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798545970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移者，位居睂𧢲，號曰天倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798562354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐盈隆滿，華彩無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798578738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾位平，到老得人欽羡，騰騰驛馬，須貴游宦四方。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798595122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額𧢲低陷，到老住塲難覓。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798611506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉連交接，此人破祖離家。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798627890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地偏斜，十居九變，生相如此，不在移門，必當改墓。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798644274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：遷移宫分在天倉，低陷平生少住塲。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798660658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾末年不相應，定因游宦却尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798677042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移宫論日：邊地、驛馬，山林、髪際，乃爲出入之所。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798693426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宐","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798709810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952340628963354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明潤絜淨，利逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798709810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若昏暗缺陷及有黑子，不宐出入，被虎狼驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892798726194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色靑，逺行主驚失財；白，主馬僕有失；黑，主道路身亡；紅黃紫，宐獲財喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892813881382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"十官禄","logicSentenceId":"7580357892813914150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄者，位居中正，上合離宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892813930534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏犀貫頂，一生不到訟庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892813946918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬朝歸，官司𨓆擾，光明瑩淨，顯達超群。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892813963302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額𧢲堂堂，犯着官司貴解。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892813979686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫痕理破，常招横事，眼如赤鯉，實𣦸徒刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892813996070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814012454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952240112549907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄榮宫仔細詳，山根倉庫要相當。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814012454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然瑩淨無痕㸃，定主官榮貴久長。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814028838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官祿宫論曰：兩眼神光如曙星，龍目鳳晴，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814045222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂明潤，兩耳色白過面，聲聞天下，福禄榮顯。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814061606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如陷缺飛走，而無名譽。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814077990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色青，主憂疑；赤，主口舌是非；白，主孝服；至紅黃上下，有詔書加官進職之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814094374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德者，位居天倉，牽連地閣，五星朝拱，平生福祿滔淊。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814143526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地相朝，德行須全五福。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814159910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頦圓額窄，須知苦在初","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814176294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952374531440650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814176294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額濶頣尖，迍否還從晩景。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719388708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉高目從，尤且平平。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814192678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉壓耳掀，休言福德。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814209062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：福德天倉地閣圓，五星光照福綿綿。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814225446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還缺陷并尖破，衣食平平更不全。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814241830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德宫論曰：天倉地庫爲福德宫，須要豐滿明潤相朝挹，重重祖蔭，福祿永崇。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814258214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若陷缺，不利。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814274598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺窄昏暗，灾厄常見，人亡家破。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719405092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢因心術損了陰隲，終是勉強，神明不佑，作事行悔。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719421476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿面春風，一團和氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814290982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色青，主憂","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814307366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952336388390924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□；赤，主酒肉，忌口舌；白，主灾疾；紅黃，吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814307366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"十二相貌","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814323750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌者，先觀五嶽，次辨三停。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814340134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盈滿，此人富貴多榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814356518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停俱等，永保平生顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814372902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五嶽朝聳，官祿榮遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814389286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行坐威嚴，爲人尊重。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719437860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額主初運，鼻管中年，地閣水星，是爲末主。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814405670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有尅陷，斷爲㐫惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814422054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：相貌須教上下停，三停平等更相生。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814438438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還一處無均等，好惡中間有改更。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814454822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952409323143218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌宫論日：骨法精神，骨肉相稱，氣相和，精神清秀，如桂林一枝，崑山片玉，如珠藏淵，如玉隱石，貴顯名流，翰苑吉士。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814471206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗𢡖而薄者，㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814487590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色滿靣紅黃明潤，大吉之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814503974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母宫論曰：日月𧢲，須要高、明淨，則父母長壽康寧；低塌則㓜失雙親。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814536742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗昧，主父母有疾。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719454244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左𧢲偏妨父，右𧢲偏妨母，或同父異母，或隨母嫁父，出祖成家，重重灾注，只宐假養，方免刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814553126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：重羅疉計，父母重拜，","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814569510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952336388456460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或父亂母淫，與外奸通，又主妨父害母。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814569510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭側額窄，多是庻出，或因奸而得。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814585894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：左睂高，右眉低，父在母先歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814602278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左睂上，右眉下，父亡母再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814618662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額削眉交者，主父母早抛。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814635046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是爲隔𧢲，反面無情。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719470628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩𧢲入頂，父母雙榮，更受祖蔭，父母聞名。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719487012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色青，主父母憂疑，又有口舌相傷；黒白，主父母䘮亡；紅黃，主雙親喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814667814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相容貴賤","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814684198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人者，以頭爲主，以眼爲權。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814700582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭則身體之首，眼則形容之光。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814716966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀頭之方圓，視眼之黑白。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814733350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭圓而必貴，目善","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814749734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952409323356210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而必慈。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814749734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼竪而性剛，睛露而性毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814766118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜視而懷妬忌，近覷而神睛藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814782502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性剛強而心必曲，氣温柔而貌必和。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814798886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿面靑藍，多逢迍否。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814815270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黄不改，必遇榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719503396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑白色侵，憂橫疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719519780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紛紛色紫，見福禄以猶遲；赤色縱橫，信官灾而將至。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814831654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知尅子害兒，必是眼下無肉，臥蚕平起，後嗣相從。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814848038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂中若旋，兄弟必全。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719536164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂横一字，足義愛人，要知奸詐孤貧，看他鼻頭尖薄，官高位顯，凖頭圓似截筒，衰困中年，定是風門牙露，露齒結喉，相中大忌。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814864422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子如此，骨肉分離。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814880806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人如此，妨夫絕子。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719552548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口小唇薄，此","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814897190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952336388571148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人多是多非。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814897190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印上雜紋，决定難迯刑法。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814913574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲兩垂向下，因知奸詐便宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814929958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知富貴聦明，須得眼如點漆，口如四字，唇似硃紅，兩𧢲朝於天倉，定是公侯之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814946342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂高耳聳，官禄榮遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814962726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看部位相學堂，須要六處不陷。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814979110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在僧道則出八千人之上，在仕途位至三公之際，初年水厄之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892814995494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有眉間黑子，痣生眼尾，中年必遭水厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892815011878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身肥項促，命不久長。","logicSentenceId":"7580357892815028262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知貴賤吉㐫，須有此本風鑑","logicSentenceId":"7580357892815044646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛尖見又損財，初年流落更多災。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015420979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官方口舌無人說，只有先賢相出來。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015437363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952545256341542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"面三停","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015453747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面之三停者，自髪際下至眉間爲上停，自眉間下至鼻爲中停，自凖下人中至頦爲下停。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015470131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫三停者，以象三才也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015486515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停象天，中停象人，下停象地。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015502899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故上停長而豐隆，方而廣濶者，主貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015519283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中停隆而直，峻而静者，主壽也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719700004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下停平而滿，端而厚者，主富也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719716388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若上停尖狹缺陷者，主多刑厄之災，妨尅父母，卑賤之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015535667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中停短促褊塌者，主不仁不義，智識短少，不得兄弟妻子之力，有主中年破損也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015552051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下停長而狹尖薄者，主無田宅，","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015568435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952429145620499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生貧苦，老而艱辛也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015568435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停皆稱，乃爲上相之人矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015584819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論形有餘","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015601203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形之有餘者，頭頂圓厚，腹背豐隆，額濶四方，唇紅齒白，耳圓成輪，鼻直如膽，眼分黑白，眉秀疎長，肩膊臍厚，胸前平廣，腹圓垂下，行坐端正，五嶽朝起，三停相稱，肉膩骨細，手長足方，望之巍巍然而來，視之怡怡而去，此皆謂形有餘也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015617587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形有餘者，令人長壽無病，富貴之榮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015633971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論神有餘","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015650355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952545256587302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神之有餘者，眼光清瑩，顧盻不斜，睂秀而長，精神聳動，容色澄徹，舉止汪洋。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015666739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恢然遠視，若秋日之照霜天；巍然近矚，似和風之動春花。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015683123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨事剛毅，如猛獸之步深山；出衆迢遙，似丹鳳而翔雲路。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015699507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其坐也，如界石不動。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015715891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其卧也，如棲鴉不遙。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719732772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其行也，洋洋然如平水之流。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719749156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其立也，昂昂然如孤峯之聳。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719765540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言不妄發，性不妄躁，喜怒不動其心，榮辱不易其操，萬態紛錯於前，而心常一，則可謂神有餘也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015732275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神有餘者，皆爲上貴之人，㐫災難入其身，天祿永其終矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015748659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952429145735187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論形不足","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015765043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形不足者，頭頂尖薄，肩膊狹斜，腰肋踈細，肘節短促，掌薄指踈，唇蹇額撻，鼻仰耳反，腰低胸陷，一睂曲，一眉直，一眼仰，一眼低，一睛大，一晴小，一顴高，一顴低，一手有紋，一手無紋，睡中眼開，言作女聲，齒黄而露，口臭而尖，秃頂無衆髪，眼深不見晴，行歩欹側，顔色痿怯，頭小而身大，上短而下長，此之謂形不足也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015781427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形不足者，多疾而短命，福薄而貧賤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015797811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論神不足","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015814195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952578559311881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不足者，似醉不醉，常如病酒，不愁似愁，常如憂戚，不睡似睡，纔睡便覺，不哭似哭，常如驚怖，不嗔似嗔，不喜似喜，不驚似驚，不癡似癡，不畏似畏，容止昏亂，色濁似染，顛癎，神色悽愴，常如大失，恍惚張惶，常如恐怖，言語瑟縮，似羞隱藏，貌見低摧，如遭凌辱，色初鮮而後暗，語初快而後訥，此皆謂神不足也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015830579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不足者，多招牢獄之厄，官亦主失位矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015863347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論骨肉","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015879731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相人之身，以骨爲主，以肉爲佐。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015896115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以骨爲形，以肉爲容。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719781924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952526830829631"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以骨爲君，以肉爲臣。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719798308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然臣不能制君，反爲之逆理。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719814692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若形好容惡，至老不作。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015912499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"容好形惡，乍苦乍樂。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719831076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使形容俱好，若有紋痣黒子，亦不爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015928883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫紋欲得深而正，黒子欲得大而明。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015945267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡相面，見顴骨肉薄而開方者，主有權衡。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015961651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若肉大骨藏，則無權衡，其人縱有官職，但常調而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719847460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有相之人，忽居貧賤，如鳳在地，不久必翔。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015978035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無相之人，忽居富貴，如草非時而生，非地而出矣，必愈疾也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719863844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"相骨","logicSentenceId":"7580357893015994419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952614571524122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨節相金石，欲峻不欲橫，欲圓不欲粗，瘦者不欲露骨，","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016010803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肉不稱骨而骨露，乃多難有𥚟之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥者不欲露肉，","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016010803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肥滯之人也，不欲滿，或滿而盈者，乃是𣦸人之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨與肉相稱，氣與血相應，骨寒而縮者，不貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016010803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂背額而停偏，骨寒而肩聳。大凡物有不全，貧賤壽富夭折，故曰不貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日𧢲之左，月角之右，有骨直起，爲金城骨，位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016027187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂有骨上至天庭，名天柱骨，從天庭貫頂，名伏犀骨，并位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016043571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上有骨卓起，名爲顴骨，主權勢。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016059955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴骨相連入耳，名王梁骨，主壽考。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016076339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自臂至肘爲龍骨，象君，欲長而大。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016092723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719880228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952526830911551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肘至腕名虎骨，象臣，欲短而細，骨欲峻而舒，圓而堅，直而應節，緊而不粗，皆堅實之象。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719880228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴骨入鬂，名驛馬骨，左目上曰日𧢲骨，右目上曰月𧢲骨，骨齊耳爲將軍骨，磽日員謂龍𧢲骨，兩溝外曰巨鰲骨，額中正兩邊爲龍𧢲骨。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016109107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：骨不聳兮且不露，又要圓淸兼秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016125491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨爲陽兮肉為陰，陰不多兮陽不附。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016141875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得陰陽骨肉均，少年不貴終身富。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016158259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952614571720730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨聳者，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016174643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨露者，無立。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719896612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨軟弱者，壽而不樂。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719912996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨横者，㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719929380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨輕者貧，賤。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719945764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨俗者，愚濁。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719962148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨寒者，窮薄。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719978532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨圓者，有福。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088719994916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨孤者，無親。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088720011300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：木骨痩而青黒色，兩頭粗大，主窮厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016191027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水骨兩頭尖，富貴不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016207411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火骨两頭粗，無德賤如奴。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088720027684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土骨大而皮粗厚，子多而又富。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088720044068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉骨堅硬，壽而不樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016223795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有旋生頭𧢲骨者，則享晚年福祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016240179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或旋生頥額者，則晚年至富也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088720060452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：貴人骨節細圓長，骨上無筋肉又香。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016256563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君骨與臣相","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016272947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952526830993471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應輔，不愁無位食天倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016272947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨粗豈得豐衣食，部位應無且莫求。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016289331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎不須相尅陷，筋纒骨上賤堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016305715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"相肉","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016322099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉所以生血而藏骨，其象猶土生萬物而成萬物者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016338483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐不欲有餘，瘦不欲不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016354867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有餘則陰勝於陽，不足則陽勝於陰。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016371251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽相勝，謂一偏之相，","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016387635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肉爲陰，骨爲陽，陰有餘，神則生血；陽有餘，神則生氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉以堅而實，直而聳，肉不欲在骨之内，爲陰不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016387635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨不欲生肉之外，爲陽有餘也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088720076836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：人肥則氣短，馬肥則氣喘。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016404019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以肉不欲多，骨不欲少也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016420403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暴肥","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016436787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952650185474074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣喘，速死之期。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016436787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉不欲橫，横則性剛而暴；肉不欲緩，緩則性懦而怕人。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016453171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥不欲亂紋路，路漏者，近𣦸之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016469555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉欲香而煖，色欲白而潤，皮欲細而滑，皆美質也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016485939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色昏而枯，皮黒而臭，龎多加塊，非令相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016502323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫神不稱枝幹，觔不束骨，肉不居體，皮不包肉，速𣦸之應也。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016518707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：骨人肉細滑如苔，紅白光凝富貴來。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016535091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揣着如綿兼又煖，一生終是少㐫災。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016551475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉𦂳皮粗最不堪，急如綳鼓命難長。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016567859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黒多紅少須多滯，遍體生光性急剛。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016584243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016600627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952526831075391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識貴人公輔相，芝蘭不帶自然香。","logicSentenceId":"7580357893016600627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
