{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉𦂳鼻端平，耳須聳又明。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122261055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海口仰弓形，晚運必通亨。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391520806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𦂳者，眉不散踈也。端者，正也。平者，直也。聳者，提起也。明者，稜角分明也。大而有收拾爲海角，朝上而不露齒曰弓晚運專指口言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"五官說","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122277439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五官者，一曰耳，爲採聽官；二曰眉，爲保壽官；三曰眼","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122293823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952591058223139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，爲監察官；四曰鼻，爲審辨官；五曰口，爲出納官。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122293823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大統賦云：一官成，十年之貴顯，一府就十載之冨豐。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122310207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但於五官之中，倘得一官成者，可享十年之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391553574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得五官俱成，其貴老終。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391569958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"採聽官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳須要色鮮，髙聳過於眉，輪廓完成，貼肉敦厚，風門𡩖大者，謂之採聽官成。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122359359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"保壽官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉須要寛廣淸長，雙分入鬂，或如懸犀新月之樣，首","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122392127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952591058288675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尾豐盈，高居額中，乃爲保壽官成。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122392127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"監察官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼須要含藏不露，黑白分明，瞳子端定，光彩射人。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122424895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或細長極寸，乃爲監察官成。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122441279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"審辨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻須要梁柱端直，印堂平濶，山根連印，年壽高隆，準圓庫起，形如懸膽，齊如截筒，色鮮黃明，乃爲審辨官成。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122474047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"出納官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952591058321443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口須要方大唇紅，端厚角弓，開大合小，乃爲出納官成。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122506815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"一曰耳爲採聽官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成敗傾欹。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122539583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傾，缺也。欹，低也。傾欹主破散成敗也。萬金相云：左耳缺，先損父。右耳缺，先損母。左右廢缺，雙親並損，主妨尅離祖，亦不欹低於眉也。詩曰：偏堂降地，破祖無疑，兄弟稀少，自身不利。偏堂，耳名也。又日降地，耳低於眉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明高聳，","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391586342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"高聳，過於眉也。郭林宗曰：耳爲君，眉爲臣，君宜上而臣宜下。高起過眉者，主貴，聰明文學，才俊冨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952591058354211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴也。萬金相云：耳高眉一寸，永不受貧困。又曰：耳如携起，名播人耳。宋齊丘曰：耳齊日角，曰大貴。許負曰：耳能齊日角，曽服不死藥，又主平生病，少壽長，才智過入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皮麄青黑飄蓬，","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391586342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郭林宗曰：左耳爲金星，右耳爲水星，色鮮者，貴而安穏。若皮粗及青色黒而乾者，主一生奔馳南北，散走他郷，終無定基也。宋齊丘曰：皮粗青黑走異郷。廣鑑集云：耳輪青黑腎蔵喪，不久也。飄蓬，謂如蓬草也。中原郊野多生，俗名蓬子科止。根類竹根，其枝葉如楊柳，盤盤旋旋，團栾而生，圓如燈毬分圓若丈餘。秋天枯死之時，風吹出土。若東風起，吹輥往西無阻者，迤逞進去，忽然換西風，復吹還東而去。若耳皮粗青黑者，爲人似蓬草，朝暮走他郷，無定止也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色如瑩玉，年少作三公。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391586342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952591058403363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣鑑集云：耳若貴賤，不取大小，先要色鮮瑩白為上。昔歐陽文忠公，耳白如面，名聲天下。人倫大統賦曰：白或過面，主聲譽之飛揚。瑩白貫輪，主信行之敦厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貼肉垂珠，紅潤自然，主財祿亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122555967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貼肉者，隱伏也。紅潤者，垂珠鮮澤也。主平生財祿綿綿，百謀百成，千求千遂，天生自然富貴。大統賦云：壽越眉兮貴□血，聰垂明兮富貼肉。許負云：耳貼肉，冨貴足。大清神鑑云：對面不見耳，問是誰家子。似此貼肉隱伏而垂珠紅潤者，主平生旺相而长冨貴。一歲入運，至十五歲䕃成，父母病少之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若尖小直如箭羽，安得不孤窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122572351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尖小者，謂之㺅耳，主孤貧。如箭羽者，其耳形直竪，似矢之翎，最爲貧賤之相，主十五歲男女並有妨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952591058452515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財破敗，長大貧賤孤獨之相。五總龜云：反耳無輪最不堪，直如箭羽少資粮。又日：雙耳尖小多妨剋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門難入指，壽原慳短，忘淺愚蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122588735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命門者，耳孔也。若窄小難入小指尖者，主愚頑短壽、無智之人。洞中經云：耳孔容針，家無一金。太清神鍳云：耳門如墨，二十之客，夭壽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無輪兼反薄，家破嚢空。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122605119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"薄者，主貧也。一歲至十五之内，妨剋破祖，長大孤貧，壽夭之相。太清神鍳云：輪爲城，内爲廓。城兜廓吉，廓兜城㐫。金鏡經云：耳無輪廓多破散。大統賦云：耳薄如紙，貧而早死。五總⿔云：能可城兜廓，不可廓兜城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952772767989812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚大垂肩極貴，天年過八十方終。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122621503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣鍳集云：耳大四寸，高聳垂肩者，主大貴壽長。蜀劉先生，耳毫垂肩，目顧其耳。宋太祖口方耳大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只因是毫生竅内，頭白老龍鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122637887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"毫者，孔内生毫也。龍鐘，竹名。其曲頭垂眉地，若人生耳毫，主長壽，似龍鐘之竹，缓曲頭低，極老之相也。郭林宗曰：借問何人年過百，耳内生毫頭半白，項下雙縧成一縷，此是人間壽星魄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：運限者，上古之壽，一百二十歲爲終，今之七十者稀。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122654271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬金相法三主，七十五歲爲約。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122670655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左耳七年，右耳八年，男左女右，又天部十年，共二十五年，爲初主。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122687039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952772768022580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黒子生在輪上者，主聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122703423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有大痣耳内者，壽長。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122719807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垂珠上者，主有財。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122736191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳前命門者，主火厄，作事有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122752575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳顯三珠者，左定嗣，右定妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122768959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰白珠，耳尖上貴，隂亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122785343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二綵紅珠，右耳中生一珠一子，二珠五子，隂亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122801727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其珠如粟米，大圓者應如綠豆，大圓者少，應氣色瑩白。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122818111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅潤者，貴而吉。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391602726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄者，病。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391619110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青者，腎衰。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391635494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑燥者，腎丧。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391651878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽輪上紅色如炎火者，七日口舌破財。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122850879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或暴焦色、𢡖靑色，其壽不永也。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122867263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"二日睂爲保壽官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952772768071732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濃厚淹畱孤獨","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122900031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。眉黑稠浓宻，主淹□蹇滯久困。五總龜云：眉濃髪厚人多滯。萬金相云：陽，男子也，陽得虎眉蹇滯，虎眉稠濃密也，主平性少快。二十六歲入運，至三十五成。此一運中，主上五年多淹滯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短促兄弟非冝。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122900031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣鑑集云：眉爲君，目爲臣，冝清長過目，宜如雁行，若短不及目者，難爲兄弟。縱有二三四，終須不靠也。萬金相云：眉長於目，兄弟五六。眉如掃箒，兄弟八九。與目同等，兄弟一兩。短不及目，兄弟不足。縱有一兩，非是同腹。二十六至三十五，上四五年不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨稜高起，性勇好爲非。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122916415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"稜骨高起者，言眉骨尖峻顯露也，則主人麄鹵，知進而不知退，知存而不知亡，知成而不知敗，自强","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952772768120884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自勝，作事不應爲而强爲，性暴好闘，不可爲友之相也。平生冝遠之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清秀彎如月樣，文章顯折桂榮奇。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122932799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣監集云：睂是目之君，膽之苗，面之表也。若得清秀彎如月樣，主爲人聰明智慧，文學博雅，必攀蟾桂，高明冨貴之相，知爲平生之福。二十六歲運至，中主便得顯煥功名。郭林宗曰：眉如新月樣，名譽四方聞。許負曰：眉如月弓，衣食不窮。大清神鍳云：眉曲栾彎多學識。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂廣，雙分入鬂，卿相位何疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122949183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉中爲印堂，名曰官祿宮、相貌宮、福德紫氣宮，一面之中，此位最干禍福。所以眉毛欲得寛廣，雙分入鬂，主生平多福而貴。二十六歲入運，行中主，大發功名。□林眞人曰：眉爲羅計之星，冝濶而不欲侵犯紫氣宮。陳圖南曰：翠睂入鬂，位至公卿。廣鍳集云：朝中無交眉宰相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952772768153652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竪毛多，主𣪩，神剛氣暴，豈有思維。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122965567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"竪睂者，謂眉毛直立而生也，多主殺性。大統賦日：主性急神猛，好闘貪殺，無思□之相也。又云：毛□性狠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交頭并印促，背祿奔馳。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122981951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭交者，言兩頭印提交鎖，侵犯印堂也。葢緣印堂是官祿宮，若得眉宇寛，則爲官，平生安穩。若交促者，無祿而一生走驟愚夫。印堂又爲命宮，眉宇爲羅計星，羅計侵犯交促，不利財祿。胡人不在此限，神强者不在此限。在此限卽爲平生之滯，六六交運至四十一，此四五年最緊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横直妨妻害子。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933122998335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫直者，言眉毛凡生直竪不順也。左妨子，右妨妻，左右如此，妻子俱傷。然為平生不利，二十八限至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952772768219188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123014719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十，此五年最是不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旋螺聚，必執旗鎗","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123014719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。旋螺，言其中毛盤旋以螺螄尾尖，盤盤旋旋而生者，主爲人剛健勇猛，可車前鎗旗之首，當先無懼而戰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低壓眼相連不斷，運至必災厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123014719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣鑒集云：眉爲羅計之星，眼爲日月之象，相眉緊緊貼而與眼相連不斷者，是羅計二星侵犯大隂大陽。大隂大陽，爲日月之臺，一身之主。二十六限至二十九不利，三十七八九亦不利。若孛星高廣，日月分明，災禍減半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123031103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952772768251956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運限者，兩睂管四年，人中主，左二年二十六七，右二年二十八九。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123031103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂生四理，黑子睂中生者，初主水厄；睂頭生者，主性剛；睂上生者，主貴官。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123047487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋理睂中十字、元字紋者，大亨。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123080255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有坤卦紋者，祿二千石。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123096639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有成土字并魚鳥形紋，主大將公卿之位。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391668262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉上氣色忽然白者，主哭泣聲服忌。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123113023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然紅色者，三日七日，主口舌官訟。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123129407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃明入華葢，日近遠喜信入宅，又主動，出爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123145791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉中忽然生亳，長，謂之壽毛，然不冝早生。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123162175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬金相云：二十生毛三十死，四十生毛命夀長。","logicSentenceId":"7580400933123178559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173332499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952859292270627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四十之上，忽然生一毫長者，三年内遇貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173332499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"三曰目爲監察官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眼浮光，雙輪噴火，殺人賊，好姦謀。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173365267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩眼浮光者，謂噴突不收，光射人也。雙輪噴火，上下眼堂紅赤，如炎火噴外也。似此者，則主人㐫惡，奸絞貪鄙，衷懷奸盗之心。然平生之惡，三十歲入運，至三十五，此五年大發。三十七至四十，此四年亦不利。大綂賦云：晴如㸃漆。許負曰：目仲赤沙起法，死須妨已。又謂之蛇眼赤沙，便是噴火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴如黠漆，應不是常流。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173381651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣鍳集云：兩睛黑光如黠漆，昭暉明朗，光彩射人者，極貴人臣，神仙高士，竒異之相。然爲平生之福，三十歲至曰十五歲，此六歲顯耀功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952859292319779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼大者，多攻藝業。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173398035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月波洞中經云：眼睛大而端定，不浮不露，黑白分明者，主可學藝業，異於衆人，成家立業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上視者，勿與交游。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173414419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上視者，或看物觀望，或觀人昻面，睛昻向上視者，主爲人賊性，自强自是，不容物，太察多疑，不可爲友，同行須在冨貴之中，不可深交。貧女曰：上視者，人多狠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜觀狼目强獨勝，慳吝更貪求。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173430803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"斜觀者，主爲人禀性剛强。獨能慳吝者，自慳不施，貪鄙愛聚，損人安已，縱居冨貴能文，亦不改慳吝之心，口腹不能相應之人也。廣鍳集云：目爲心之外户。觀其物外，而知其内也。孟子曰：𦙄中正，則眸子瞭焉；胷中不正，則眸子□焉。眸子不正，掩其惡也。善惡在目中偏正，善者正視，𥙍清睛定，惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952859292352547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則斜視不定，神濁。太清神鍳云：眼有些小病，心有些小毒；眼有十分病，心有十分毒。眼善心亦善。眼惡心亦惡。大綂賦云：斜盻者，人遭其毒。然居冨貴知書，只是心中不正，何况於小人乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓大神光露，心懷𠒋狠，訟獄堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173447187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若圓大眼晴突露光者，主𠒋暴，多招禍患，常遭囹圄之囚繫，然爲平生之㐫。二十八限至三十五歲，不利，三十七八九亦然。雖居冨貴，亦爲凶徒。若肯讀書，近君子，逺小人，其㐫減半。月波洞中經云：莫交眼突，往往見災迍。又曰：眼露心亦露。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似鷄蛇鼠目，不濫須偷。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173463571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月波洞中經云：鷄目無痕，好闘貪淫。蛇目上胞厚而心毒，鼠目左小而𥨱盜。似者，男女盜𥨱，貪婪無耻。然居冨貴，亦不改姦妬之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952859292418083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三角深藏毒害。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173479955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼生三角，㐫狠之人，常能損物害人，若是女子，妨夫不良。大綂賦云：三角多嗔，爲妨夫命。刃者，劒刃也。婦人眼生三角，如殺夫之劒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頻偷視定無良籌。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173496339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頻偷視者，謂談話之間，廣會之座，低目沉吟，常常用眼偸觀人者，乃爲人心性不定，多疑智淺之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神清爽秀，長如鳯目，身顯作王矦。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173512723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神清秀者，瞳子瑩潔，黑白分明，如曉星光射四遠也。長如鳯者，鳯目細長入鬂，極一寸五分，隂陽大冨大貴。蜀關雲長，唐房玄齡俱應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173529107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952859292450851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運限者，兩目管六年，左目三十三十一二，右目三十四五。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173529107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目有四神，黑子生在眼胞上者，貪婪作𥨱；眼下者，妨害。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173545491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色者，三隂三陽，忽然生黑氣，深者二五日，淺者二七日，家宅不寧，隂人是非。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173561875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅者，火災，眼下鋪靑者，連累口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173578259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤者，官災。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391684646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑者，破耗。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391701030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄明者，最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391717414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂人目下青者，喪夫；赤者，産厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173594643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼尾其色瑩白光潤者，主夫位增遷，財祿之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173611027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"四曰鼻爲審辨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竅小慳貪。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173643795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952859292500003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"竅者，鼻孔也。萬金相云：左右胞謂之仙庫，左胞名左庫，右胞名右庫。夫庫欲高豊厚。竅者，庫之戸也。戶欲小而齊，庫厚而隆，庫小而齊者，庫内有積也。庫狹而薄，戶大而薄者，庫無積也。竅小，庫齊之相，好聚而不捨。手寛反仰之相，無積而好施也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高隆顯宦。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173660179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣鍳集云：鼻爲土宿，萬物生於土，歸於土，象乎山岳。山不厭高，土不厭厚，又爲一面之表也。夫天地人三才之中，鼻爲人也，欲得高隆而貴。大綂賦云：惟鼻者，號嵩嶽，居中為天柱而高聳。梁，貴乎豐隆。漢髙𥘲隆準，終爲平生之福。三十五至五十中，大顯功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏斜曲陷堪傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173676563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"偏斜者，不端正，主孤滯也。曲者，主孤貧。萬金相云：鼻偏左，先損父，偏右，先損母。又曰：梁柱不直，中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952859292549155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年遭厄。六七八限至九六不利。許負曰：鼻仰突，多孤獨。陷者，坑低四陷，瘡窩疵瘕痕傷也，亦主妨厄，最不利。萬金相云：印堂□陷，才祿不旺，三十六歲，不利妻房。山根缺陷，自身傷害。三十八歲，本身不利。金匱缺陷，鎖在他鄉。三十九，遠出不利，亦重破祖。年上缺陷，哭聲不祥。四十歲，孝服哭泣動，月孛缺陷，百事爲傷，四十一歲，凡幹迍邅難成，壽上缺陷，作事乖舛，四十二歳，凡幹不利，準頭缺陷，人事不和，四十三歲，妨是非口舌。左庫缺陷，財物消散，四十四歲，破財。右庫缺陷，横事極多，四十五，大破財。此十缺陷，然爲入限不利，必須更看别位滿缺乘除者。若是𥙍陷、魚尾陷、文武陷、天地陷，色更青赤，乃爲一生孤尅貧下之相也，葢緣缺處多。若天地豊，目下平，日月明，魚尾滿，氣色正，似此者，運至有災。大綂賦云：完美宜官，破露憂辱，最忌凖頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還短促，未敢許榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173709331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952859292581923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"短促，鼻小跼促也。大綂賦云：巢窩面之儀表，欲其廣大，主冨貴，若短小跼促，主貧賤。許負曰：鼻小莫求官。大綂賦云：小而滯者作童僕。若鼻短促，童僕之相，爲平生貧賤。六六至五九，最不利於己。然鼻小之相，終身不富貴，縱有神骨相貌，亦不祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生怕十分昂露。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173725715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昂露，鼻孔仰。孔爲二庫之門，十分昻露者，謂戸門開闊，内無積也，難爲平生不利，五九大破。廣鍳：相中大忌，鷹嘴露竅。大綂賦云：井竃露破㕑無粟。井竃者，鼻孔也。又云：斜如菱藕之狀，困乏預儲。斜如菱藕者，鼻斜露似刀切藕也。預儲，僞盛米之噐也。困乏，爲無米也。照膽經云：鼻孔外仰成惡敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如懸膽，必作朝郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173742099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如懸膽者，其形從印室隆隆懸垂，直下凖頭，準頭完美如彈者是也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173758483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"似懸掛猪羊之膽，有骨法，貴作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952956319137832"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朝郎，無骨法者，冨有千金。心鏡經云：帛如懸膽終須貴，土曜當生得地来。若是山根連額起，定知榮貴作三台。許負曰：鼻如懸膽，家財巨萬。大綂賦云：圓如懸膽之形，榮食𪔂餗，爲平生之福。六六至五九，大發財祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽上縱横紋理，家破苦窮忙。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173774867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻爲年夀二位，屬中央戊己土，萬物生成之地，又爲巢窩。欲其光隆無犯者吉。若有縱橫亂紋交雜者，破祖離家，一生馳驟奔波，若終日揭貧困而厄。若得形正神剛，則主成敗走驟。若女子，不可爲配。大綂賦曰：紋若亂交，愼勿爲乎眷属，平生大破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根更折，田園不守，妻子先亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173791251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"低者，塌也。折者，橫紋斷流也。似此者，則主破祖離巢，妨害妻子也，終爲平生之患。三十七至四十歲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952956319186984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運行到此，男女並同。葢綠爲生日不順也。若更眉壓眼。神氣薄，梁柱偏，輕則中年大病刑獄，重則喪軀矣。或得形正神强，色明聲喨，其實滅半。五總龜曰：月孛宫中折又尖，家財早破事相煎。妻兒晚見尤難保，况是迍邅屬少年。萬金相云：山根斷折三十九，四十九，三年命祿中。又曰：月孛名山根，又名疾厄宫，又名妻子宫，又名月孛宮，又名嶺斷宮，司囚宮，在山根上一分，名玉嶺根斷自身傷。又曰：嶺斷宫司不自由，嶺根折断自身休。山根嶺斷三十九，嶺根道斷自身休。又曰：山懸橋道耗財，主嶺山根金道三位折也，嶺根平梁財聚三位高也。此三位嶺根道，于一面之中，諸部之内，最關禍福，學者可用意觀之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形如鷹嘴樣狡狼。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173807635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鷹嘴樣者，嶺根道三位細細低下，年壽孤聳，凖頭尖垂向下者是也。可旁觀得見，主最毒。廣鑒集","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952956319219752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云：鼻如鷹嘴，啄人心髓。貧女曰：旁觀曲凸如鷹嘴，心裡奸謀暗殺人。許負曰：生伯如鷹嘴，一生奸詐不堪言。月波洞中經云：相中大忌鷹嘴露竅。似此者，主爲人最毒，常懐嫉賢妬能，外貌僞和假寛，内實毒害。然居冨貴知書，不免貪婪奸狡，何況小人乎？又主好成要敗，四十五歲，主人破財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣大巢窩須穩。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173824019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"萬金相云：鼻爲巢窩，人之家宅也。欲其梁柱端直，年夀豊隆，廣大肉厚，接迎東西二嶽，準員庫起者，主家宅廣，人口多。三十六歲入運，至五十九歲，此十年大進人口并宅舍。大綂賦云：梁廣者，窩巢穩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光明，主財祿殊常。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173840403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太情𥙍鑒云：面部有五嶽之位，額爲南嶽衡山，属離火。頦爲北岳恒山，属坎水。左顴爲東岳泰山，属","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952956319268904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"震木；右顴爲西嶽華山，属兑金。鼻爲中嶽嵩山，属中央土。金木水火土，各有時。火主夏，水主冬，木主春，金主秋。惟土每季旺十八日，乃爲萬物生成之地。所以鼻貴乎高隆光明，色黃者，得其土之本色也。若有骨法者，主有貴祿，在庶人得財入宅。大綂賦云：梁貴乎豐隆貫額，高也；色貴乎光瑩溢目，明也。許負曰：準明印正，諸事亨通。鬼谷先生曰：欲觀在任吉㐫者，看年壽二位：一分黄明，一年無事；二分黃明，二載平安；三分黄明，三周吉利。若見非來之色，或青或赤或黑，並主當年不利。五總龜曰：年壽四時黄，財帛喜非常。廣鑒集云：心善三陽光㸃㸃，左眼胞也。脾安鼻凖見黃明。耳輪焦黑腎臓丧，年壽黄明福德生。右目上下，忽然準頭明更淨，等閑有土是通亨。土者，黄明也。曰：印堂至準庫中間，四季常得黃明，寒暑不侵，喜怒不變，乃爲平生之福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準頭黑，蘭臺黯慘，旬日必身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173856787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952956319318056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凖頭者，是土之主。蘭臺，左鼻胞名蘭臺，又右爲廷尉。海底眼曰：夫鼻者，運五臓之精華，肺之苗。肺虚則通，而色瑩光明，無病多吉；肺災則塞，而色慘黑暗，大患至而多凶。若見準頭蘭臺色慘黑暗者，大病速至，不出十日之内喪矣。病人最怕此色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：運限者，鼻管十年，自印堂三十六至右庫四十五，鼻有二節，黑子在山根者，主妨妻害子。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173873171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻側，大㐫不利。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173889555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上者，兄弟難爲。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391733798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂當中圓黑者，貴吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173905939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫氣色印堂山根光明者，吉；黯惨者，滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173922323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽黃明者，吉；黑，病；赤，官災；青，破耗；白，哭泣。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391750182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準頭黄明者，喜慶","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173938707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952956319367208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立至；黑，大病；赤紅者，破耗；白者，破毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173938707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短促唇掀色靑，齒露徧邪，骨肉相煎。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173971475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"促者，口聚也。短者，横窄也。促短者，並主孤也。大綂賦云：口如吹火似寒酸。吹者，撮聚也。通神鬼眼相曰：口有三聚。一曰猴口，吹火聚注，令人無子，孑立自身亡。二曰羊口，飮水聚注，令人孤寒，好歌樂，無衣粮。三曰鵲口，縮囊聚注，令孤寒性寡，親子另房。唇掀者，口唇番蹇也，亦主孤尅。太清神鑑曰：眼露睛，唇皮蹇，男憂賊盗，女憂産難。若去寺觀及出家，免得一身見八難。青色者，言唇氣青黑，亦主孤貧。五總龜云：貧窮似鼠常青黑，破盡田園不住家。大綂賦云：青黑禍發。齒露者，凡語笑露齒牙，孤尅。廣鑒集云：相中太忌露齒也。偏斜者，口不正也，亦主孤貧。萬金相云：海朝文、陽十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330952956319416360"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禍至；隂，二八大病。海朝武，陽，二八災病；隂，十七禍生。文左武右也。又曰：水星不正，骨肉相煎。水星，口也。骨肉，六親也，然主平生之象，五十六歲入運，至六十四歲，不利骨肉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濶而不正，虚詐不堪言。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668173987859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"横口不牧，而偏斜不正者，主爲人多奸猾，虗謬不實。大統賦曰：大言無信者畧綽。畧綽者，卽橫濶不牧也。五總龜曰：若傷歸於左畔，是非奸詐愛便宜，口唇左邊也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏薄是非谤訕。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174004243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"偏薄者，口唇薄横偏也，主好說談是非。謗訕者，不知己，口快舌長，專提人語失，取笑渾語，毀善譏調。不顧忌諱。似此之人，雖居冨貴，亦不脫小人也。五總龜曰：水星偏陷兩頭垂，尖薄無稜作乞兒。無稜者，薄也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953054004461620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如硃抹，名譽相傳。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174020627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如硃抹者，口唇紅鮮，似塗抹硃砂之紅色也，主文章才俊，其名姓傳揚四方。陳圖南曰：唇如潑砂，冨貴如華。紅色也。許負曰：口如含丹，不受飢寒。郭林宗曰：唇紅齒白食天祿，多藝多財又多富。貧女日：貴人唇紅似潑砂，更加四字足榮華，然主平生之貴。五十六歲入運，大發財祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇裏紫，食肉千里，衣祿自天然。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174037011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唇鮮紫紅色者，主冨貴，可食千里之爵祿，乃爲天生自然之福，平生之貴。五十六入限快。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆載多紋理，掩人過惡，得子孫須賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174053395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"覆載，唇之名也。萬金相云：上唇名金覆，下唇名金載。若唇上下有紋理多者，主為人寛和，見善多爲，遇惡勸歸於善，而喜避其惡，又招貴子賢孫。六綂賦云：上下紋交子孫衆，周□稜利仁信全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953054004510772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食時多哽咽，必主迍邅。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174069779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"哽咽者，□飯食吞噎，向喉咽之中，作沃沃之聲是也。迍邅者，平生蹇滯不通。張紫菱曰：食爲性之本，所以欲詳而不暴，啜不欲聲，吞不欲鳴也。五總龜曰：鳥啄猪食最賤客，相他衣食必無終。咽粗急者人多燥，鼠食從來飮食空。又曰：相食看詳緩，窮忙豈合宜。更嫌將鳥啄，更忌食淋漓。性暴吞須急，心寛食必遲。問君榮貴處，牛哺福相隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常向睡中不合，泄元氣，夭促天年。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174086163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"口者，宜言語以接萬物，博領飮味以安五臟。造化之權，禍福之柄。唇爲口之城廓，舌之門戸，一開一合，榮辱所繫也。所以夜睡開口者。泄其元氣，元氣既泄，壽不永也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親曾見低垂兩角，常被世人嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174102547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953054004559924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩角下垂者，無衣食也，最招人僧嫌。五總龜曰：口者，心之外表，賞罰之所岀，榮辱之所關，欲端而厚，言不亂發，謂之口德。若多言而亂發者，謂之口佞。若方廣有稜者，主壽。形如弓，稍向上者，主貴；若尖而薄反者，主賤。若黑子生於上唇者，平生酒肉來自然。生於口角者，災滯；生於壽帶入口，主飢餓而死。女人唇生黑子者，主淫，無媒自嫁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：運限者，口管十五年，爲末主，五十六至六十四。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174118931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口有三聚，黑子生在唇上者，主一生得酒食，唇内亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174151699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口角生者，末主水災。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174168083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋理者，壽帶入口，直飢餓不食而死。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174184467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色紅潤者則貴，黑者賤，靑者毒，白者","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174200851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953054004609076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦然，黃者病，惟繞口黃明者最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174200851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人身手欲得厚，大小相覆，滑淨光澤，必應豪貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174250003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顔色光潤，財祿日進。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174266387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人少顔色惡者，絶無官分。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174282771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坟經云：頭小爲一極，不得上天力；額小爲二極，不得父母力。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391766566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目小爲三極，無有廣知識。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174315539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻小爲四極，農作無體息。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174331923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口小爲五極，無有盛衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174348307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳小爲六極，方命難量測。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174364691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭雖大額無角，目雖大無廓落，","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174381075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻雖大樑柱弱，口雖大語畧綽，耳雖大無輪廓，腹雖大近上着，非","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174381075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953054004658228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奴卽作客，","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174381075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是無相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174381075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭雖小方且平，目雖小精且明，鼻雖小梁柱成，口雖小語媚生，如此之人，法主聰明，兼不少衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174430227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫女人，共語未了，卽面看地，如此之人，必有病也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174479379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫女人，當共人語，手拈衣帶者，便低頭荅者，必有奸婬之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174512147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額爲衡山，頦爲恒山，鼻爲嵩山，左顴爲泰山。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174544915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右顴爲華山。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174561299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中嶽要得高隆，東嶽須聳面朝應。不隆不峻則無勢，爲小人，亦無高壽。中嶽薄而無勢，則四嶽無主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953054004690996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"縱别有好處，不至大貴，無威嚴重權，壽不甚逺。中嶽不及且長者，止中壽，如尖薄，晚年見破，到頭少稱意。南嶽傾側，則主見破，不宜長家。北嶽尖陷，未主無成，終亦不貴。東西傾側無勢，則心惡毒，無慈愛。五嶽須要相朝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四瀆要深逺成就，而涯岸不走，則財榖有成，財物不耗，多蓄積。耳爲江瀆，竅要濶而深，有重城之副，緊則聰明，家業不破。目爲河瀆，深爲壽，小長則貴，光則聰明，淺則短命，昏獨多滯，圓則多夭，不大不小貴。口爲淮瀆，要方濶，而唇吻相覆載。上薄則不覆，下薄則不載，不覆不載則無壽，無晚福。不覆則家必覆。鼻爲濟瀆，要豊隆光圓，不破不露，則家必富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木星是耳，貴要輪廓分明，其位紅白色，不均大小，如門濶生得端正，不反，不尖，不小，一般更是高過眉眼。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174872595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色如銀様大好，其人當生得金木二星照命，發","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174905363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953144756715554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿定早。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174905363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺反側窄，或大或小，爲陷了金木二星，其人損田宅，破財帛，無學識也。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391799334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：金木成雙廓有輪，風門容指主聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174921747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端聳直朝羅計上，冨貴榮華日日新。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174938131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左，金耳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木開花一世貧，輪飜廓反有艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7580401668174954515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於中若有爲官者，終是區區不出塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972106788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"右，木耳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水星是口，名爲内學堂，須要唇紅濶四角，人中深，口齒端正，有文章，爲官食祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972123172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若唇齒麄，口角垂，黄色，主","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972139556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953144756748322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972139556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：口含四字似硃紅，兩角生稜向上宮。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972155940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定是文章聰俊士，少年及第作三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972172324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水星畧綽兩頭垂，尖薄無稜是乞兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972188708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是偏將居左右，是非奸詐愛便宜。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972205092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"口也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火星是額，如見額廣濶，髮際深者，有祿位衣食，及子息四五人。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972221476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人有藝學，父母尊貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972237860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當生命宫，得火星之力入，命有田宅，壽九十九。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972254244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如尖陋有多文理者，是陷了火星，乃不貴，無子息一二人，至老不得力，衣食","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972270628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953144756797474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平常，又不得兄弟力，三方無主壽，損妻破財。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972270628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：火星宮分濶方平，潤澤無紋氣色新。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972287012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨聳三條川字樣，少年及第作公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972303396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火星尖狹是常流，紋亂縱横主配囚。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972319780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤脉兩條侵日月，刀兵赴法死他州。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972336164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土星是鼻，須要準頭豐厚，兩孔不露，年上壽上平滿直，端聳不偏，其人當不陷了土星入命，并滿三分，主有福祿壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972352548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如中嶽土星不正，凖頭尖露，更凖頭高，其人陷了中嶽土星，主貧賤，少家業，主心性不直。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972368932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953144756846626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：土宿端圓似截筒，竈門孔大卽三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972385316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺廷尉來相應，必主聲名逹聖聰。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972401700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土宿歪斜受苦辛，準頭尖薄主孤貧，伤觀勾曲如鷹嘴，心裡奸謀必害人。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972418084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫氣星，印堂下是。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972434468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂分明無直紋，圓如珠，主人必貴。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391815718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色如銀樣，主大冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972450852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃者有衣食，如窄不平匀，有隱紋者，不吉，子息二三人不得力，無厚祿，損田宅。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972467236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：紫氣宮中濶又圓，拱朝帝主是英賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972483620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺廷尉來","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972500004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953144756879394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相應，末主官榮盛有錢。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972500004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫氣宮中窄又尖，小短無腮更少髯，自小爲人無實學，衣食瀟條更没添。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972516388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰太陽是眼，要黑白分明，長細雙分入鬂者，黑晴多白晴少，光彩者，其人當生得陰陽二星照命，作事俱順，骨肉俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972532772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如黑少白多，黃赤色，其人陷了二星，損父母，害妻子，破田宅，多災短命。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972549156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：日月分明是太陽，精神光彩一般强。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972565540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官不拜當朝相，也合高遷作侍郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972581924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左眼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月斜窺赤貫瞳，更","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972598308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953233231265832"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌孤露又無神。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972598308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽枯暗因刀死，莫待長年主惡終。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972614692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"右眼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛星是山根，從印堂直下分破者，其人當遭月孛照命，陷了山根，主子孫不吉，定多災危，修讀無成，破産業，妻害子息。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972631076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：月孛宜髙不宜低，瑩然光彩似琉璃。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972647460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官必定忠臣相，末主高官有好妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972663844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛宮中狹又尖，家財早破事相煎。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972680228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官豈得榮高祿，孛位當生困歲年。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972696612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山根。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953233231314984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計星是眉，二星粗黑過目入鬂際者，此衣祿之相，子息父母皆貴，親眷亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972712996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二星入命，如眉相連橫，赤色更短，主骨肉子息多犯惡死。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972729380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：羅計星君秀且長，分明貼肉應三陽。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972745764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟此貌居官職，恩義彰名播逺方。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972762148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅睺稀踈骨從高，爲人性急愛𠒋豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972778532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉毛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸邪狀似垂楊柳，見弟同胞有旋毛。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972794916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"右計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953233231364136"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六府三才三停之圖","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972811300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953233231396904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"六府論法","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972827684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六府者，兩輔骨、兩顴骨、兩頥骨，欲其充實相輔，不欲支離孤露。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972844068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靈臺秘訣云：上二府自輔角至天倉，中二府自命門至虎耳，下二府自肩骨至地閣。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972876836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六府充直，無缺陷瘢痕者，主財旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972893220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天倉峻起多財祿，地閣方停萬頃田。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972909604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"缺者不合。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972925988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"三才三停論","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972942372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才者，額爲天，欲濶而圓，名曰有天者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972958756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻爲人，欲旺而齊，名曰有人者壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972975140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頦爲地，欲方而濶，名曰","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972991524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953233231446056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有地者冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698972991524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停者，髪際至印堂爲上輔，是","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973007908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初主。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973024292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自山根至凖頭爲中府，是","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391832102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中主。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973040676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自人中至地閣爲下輔","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391848486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"末主。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973057060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自髮際至眉爲上停，眉至凖頭爲中停，準頭至地閣爲下停。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391864870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：上停長老吉昌，中停長近君王，下停長少吉祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973073444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停平等，冨貴榮顯；三停不均，孤夭貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973089828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面上三停仔細看，額高須得耳門寛。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973106212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂三部奚堪足，空有文章恐不官。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973122596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻梁隆起如懸膽，促者中","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973138980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953233231495208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽不長。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973138980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣滿來田地盛，天廷平濶子孫昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973155364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"三相所主","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973171748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額尖初主災，鼻歪中主逃。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973188132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知晩景事，地閣喜方高。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973204516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論三柱頭爲壽柱，鼻爲梁柱，足爲棟柱。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973220900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
