{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身分三停，頭爲上停，人矮小而頭大長者，有上稍無下稍；身長大而頭短小者，一生貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973253668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自肩至腰爲中停，要相稱，短而無壽，長則貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973270052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰軟而坐俱動者，無力","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973286436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953233231527976"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而無壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973286436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自腰至足爲下停，要與上停齊而不欲長，長則多病。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973302820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若上中下三停長大短小不齊者，此人無壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973319204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一身三停，相稱爲美。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973335588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停豐秀厚而長，此是平生大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973351972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是下停長且薄，似此貧窮走四方。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973368356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身上三停頭足腰，看他長短要均調。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973384740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上長下短公矦相，長短無差福不饒。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973401124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中停長者人多貴，背聳三山足寳珍。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973417508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬一脚長身又短，區區浪走一凡民。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973433892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：下長上短賤人體，形貌乾枯骨又粗。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973466660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見眼圓如竹葉，中年裡面産田無。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973483044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停短","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973499428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953324973277184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下停長，終日區區促壽疆。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973499428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停長下停短，衣食自然倉廪滿。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973515812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停俱短無虧陷，五岳端嚴冨貴全。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973532196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下兩停兼短促，一生終是受迍邅。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973548580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五行形相","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973564964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：木瘦金方水主肥，土形敦厚背如龜。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973581348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上尖下濶名爲火，五樣人形仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973597732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木色靑兮火色紅，土黄水黑是真容。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973614116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只有金形是帶白，五般顔色不相同。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973630500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩日","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973646884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953324973309952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑主憂兮白主喪，黑主重病及官方。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973663268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還進職并添喜，看取新黃滿面光。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973679652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五行象說","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973696036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人之受精於水，禀氣於火而爲人。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973712420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精合而後神生，神生而後形全。","logicSentenceId":"7580401698973728804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是知全於外者，有金木水火土之相，有飛禽走獸之相。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412508735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金不嫌方，木不嫌瘦，水不嫌肥，火不嫌尖，土不嫌濁。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412525119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似金得金剛毅深，似木得木貲財足，似水得水文學貴，似火得火見機果，似土得土厚櫃庫。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412541503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故豐厚嚴謹者，不冨卽貴；淺薄輕燥者，不貧則","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412574271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953324973375488"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412574271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如女子之氣欲其和媚，相貌欲其嚴整，若此者不冨則貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412590655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論形","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412607039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人禀隂陽之氣，肖天地之形，受五行之資，爲萬物之靈者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412623423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故頭象天，足象地，眼象日月，聲音象雷霆，血脉象江河，骨節象金石，鼻額象山岳，毫髪象草木。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412639807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天欲高逺，地欲方厚，日月欲光明，雷霆欲震響，江河欲潤，金石欲堅，山岳欲峻，草木欲秀，此皆大槩也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412656191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然郭林宗有觀人八法是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412672575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953324973408256"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論神","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412688959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫形以養血，血以養氣，氣以養神，故形全則血全，血全則氣全，氣全則神全，是短形能養神，托氣而安也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412705343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣不安則神暴而不安，能安其神，其惟君子乎！","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412721727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窹則神遊於眼，寐則神處於心，是形出處於神而爲形之表，猶日月之光外照萬物，而其神固在日月之也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412738111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼明則神清，眼昏則神濁，清則貴，濁則賤，清則窹多而寐少，濁則窹少而寐多，能推其寤者，可以貴賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412754495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫夢之境界，葢神遊於心，而其所遊之遠，亦不","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412770879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953324973473792"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出五臓六腑之間，與夫耳目視聽之門也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412770879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所遊之界與所見之事，或相盛而成，或遇事而至，亦吾身之所有也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412787263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夢中所見之事，乃吾身中，非出吾身之外也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412803647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白眼禪師說：夢有五境：一曰靈境，二曰寶境，三曰過去境，四曰見在境，五曰未來境。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412820031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神𢡖夢生，神静則境滅。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412836415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫望其形，或洒然而淸，或朗然而明，或凝然而重，然由神發於内而見於表也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412852799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神清而和，徹明而秀者，冨貴之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412869183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏而柔弱，濁而結者，貧薄之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412885567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實而静者，其神安。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412901951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虚而急者，其神慘。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391881254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953427352207398"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相主神有七","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412918335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"達摩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臧不晦，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412934719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"藏者，不露也。晦者，無神也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安不愚，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412934719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"安者，不搖動也。愚者，不變通也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發不露，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412934719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發者，發揚也。露者，輕佻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清不枯，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412934719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"清者，神逼人也。枯者，神而死也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和不弱，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412934719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"和者，可親也。弱者，可狎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怒不争，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412934719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"怒者，正氣也。争者，戾氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛不孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412934719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剛者，可敬也。孤者，可惡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：神居形内不可見，氣以養神爲命根。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412951103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣壯血和則安固，血枯氣散神光奔，英標清秀心神爽，氣血和調神不昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412967487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神之清濁爲形表，能定貴賤最堪論。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699412983871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論氣","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413000255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953427352322086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫石藴玉而山輝，沙懐金而川媚，此至精之寶，見乎色而發於形也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413016639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫形者，質也，氣所以𠑽乎質，質因氣而宏。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413033023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神完則氣寛，神安則氣静，得失不足以暴其氣，喜怒不足以驚其神，則於德爲有容，於量爲有度，乃重厚有福之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413049407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形猶材，有杞梓、梗柟、荆棘之異。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413065791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神猶土，所以治材用其噐，聲猶噐，聽其聲，然後知其噐之美惡。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391897638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣猶馬，馳之以道善惡之境。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413082175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子則善養其材，善御其德，又善治其噐，善御其馬，小人反是。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413098559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其氣寛可以容物，和可以接物，清可以表物，正可以理物。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413114943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953462026420233"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不寬則隘，不和則戾，不剛則懦，不清則濁，不正則偏。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413131327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"視其氣之淺深，察其色之燥靜，則君子小人辨矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413147711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣表而舒，和而不暴，爲福壽之人；急促不均，暴然見乎色者，爲下賤之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413164095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫經以一呼一吸爲一息，凡人一晝夜計一萬三千五百息。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413180479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今觀人之呼吸，疾徐不同，或急者十息，遲者尚未七八，而老肥者大疾，㓜瘦者差遲。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413196863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故恐古人之言猶未盡理。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413213247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫氣呼吸發乎顔表，而爲吉㐫之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413229631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其散如毛髮，其聚如黍米，望之有形，按之無迹，苟不精意以觀之，則禍福無慿也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413246015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣岀","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413262399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953462026518537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人無聲，耳不自察，或臥而不喘者，爲之龜息氣象也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413262399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呼吸氣盈而身動，近死之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413278783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孟子不顧萬鐘之祿，能養氣者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413295167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"争可欲之利，悻悻然戾其色而暴其氣者，亦何以論哉？","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413311551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩日：氣乃形之本，察之見賢愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413327935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人多急燥，君子則寛舒。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413344319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暴戾災相及，深沉福有餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413360703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誰知公輔量，虚受若重淵。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413377087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柳庄曰：從髮際至承漿，左右氣止一百二十五部，若","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413393471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953499703787571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言黑子，皆爲助相，視其骨氣美者爲妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413393471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論五音","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413409855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行散而爲萬物，人生萬物之上，聲亦辨其五音。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413426239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故木音嘹喨高暢，激越而和；火音焦烈燥怒，如火烈之聲；金音和而不戾，潤而不枯，如調簧奏曲，玉磬流音；水音圓而清，急而暢，感條達之間也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413442623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與形相養，相生者吉；與形相尅，相犯者㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413459007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論聲","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413475391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人之有聲，如鐘皷之響，噐大則聲宏，噐小則聲短，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413491775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953499703902259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神清則氣和，氣和則聲潤深而圓暢也；神濁則氣促，氣促則聲焦急而輕嘶也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413491775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故貴人之聲多出於丹田之中，與聲氣相通，混然而外達。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413508159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丹田者，聲之根也；舌端者，聲之表也。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391914022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫根深則表重，根淺則表輕，是知聲發於根而見於表也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413524543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫清而員，堅而亮，緩而烈，急而和，長而有力，勇而有節。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413540927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大如洪鍾騰韻、鼉鼓振音，小如玉水流鳴、琴徽奏曲。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413557311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見其色則粹然而後動，與其言久而後應，皆貴人之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413573695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人之言皆發舌端之上，促急而不達，何則？","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413590079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"急而嘶，緩而澁，深而滯，淺而","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391930406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953499704049715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燥大，大則散，散則破。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391930406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或輕重不均，嘹喨無節；或睚眦而暴，繁亂而浮；或如破鑼之響，敗鼓之鳴；又如寒鴉哺鶵，鵝雁哽咽；或如病猿求侣，孤雁失羣；細如蚯蚓發吟，狂如青鼉夜𢡖；有如犬之吠，如羊之鳴，皆賤薄之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391946790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男有女聲單貧賤，女有男聲亦妨害。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413622847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然身大而聲小者㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413639231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或乾溼而不齊，謂之羅網聲；大小不均，謂之雌雄聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413655615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或先遲而後急，或先急而後遲，或聲未止而氣先絶，或心未舉而色先變，皆賤之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413671999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫神定於内，氣和於外，然後可以接物，非難言有先後之","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413688383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953530863370266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叙，而色亦不變也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413688383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟神不安而意不和，則其言失先後之叙，辭色撓矣，此小人之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413704767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人稟五行之形，則氣聲亦配五行之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413721151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故土聲深厚，木聲高唱，火聲焦烈，水聲緩急，金聲和潤。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413737535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：聲輕者，斷事無能；聲破者，作事無成；聲濁者，謀運不發；聲低者，鹵鈍無文。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413753919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清吟如澗中流水者，極貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413770303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發聲澑亮自覺如甕中之響者，主五福全備之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391963174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"聽聲篇","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413786687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"許負","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲小亮高，賢貴之極。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413803071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語聲細嫩，必主貧寒，兼須危困。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413819455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953530863501338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人雄聲，終身不榮，良人早殞，虚有夫名。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413835839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子雄聲，妨㜏多兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413852223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女聲急切，妨夫一絶。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413884991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：木聲髙唱火聲焦，和潤金聲最冨饒，土語却如深甕禋，水聲員急又飄飄。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413901375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人音韻出丹田，氣實喉寛響又堅。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413917759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤不離唇舌上，一生奔走不堪言。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413934143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲大無形，托氣而發。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413950527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤者浮濁，貴者清趣。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413966911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太柔則怯，太剛則折。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391979558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隔山相聞，員長不缺。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827391995942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯乃貴人，逺見風節。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392012326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"冨格例","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413983295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953558809919525"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形厚，神安，氣清，聲揚，眉濶，耳厚，唇紅，鼻直，面方，背厚，腰正，皮滑，腹垂，牛齒，鵝行，巳上皆富貴相也，主少年奮發，家財豊厚也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699413999679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"大冨格","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414016063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳大貼肉，鼻如截筒，鼻如懸膽，面黑身白，背聳三山，聲如遠鐘，背濶胸平，腹大垂下，頭皮寛大，主大冨也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414032447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"中冨格","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414048831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停平等，五岳朝歸，五長俱全，五短俱全，五露俱全，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414065215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953558810050597"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼如丹鳳，聲似鳴鐘，秉此格者，主中冨也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414065215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"貴格例","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414081599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面黑身白，面粗身細，脚短手長，身小聲大，龍來吞虎，面短眼長，不臭而香，肉角少頂，已上皆貴相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414097983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人有此相，求功名者，官高職顯；求財利者，錢穀巨冨之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414114367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"大貴格","logicSentenceId":"7580401699414130751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎頭燕頷，曰月角起，伏犀貫頂，眼有定晴，鳳閣挿天，兩手𡸁膝，口中容拳，舌至凖頭，虎步龍行，雙鳯眼，此","logicSentenceId":"7580401699789996086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953558810165285"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲大貴之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699789996086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"中貴格","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790012470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬚如鐵線，耳白過面，眼如點漆，上長下短，口如四字，三十六牙，龍吞虎吻，此爲中貴之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790028854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"小貴格","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790045238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭高聳，地閣方圓，小便如珠，大便方細，齒白而大，眉踈目秀，口如弓角，唇似珠紅，此爲小貴之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790061622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"冨貴口訣","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790078006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰圓背厚者，冨贵。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790094390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有梁柱，左右顴起，口方而地閣方","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790110774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953593895370779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓，四維有朝拱者，主冨之相。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790110774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色潤秀，身體細膩，面正平滿，背格古怪清奇者，主冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790127158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手背厚，行立坐食端正者，主冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790143542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精神秀異，舉止沉重者，主冨相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699790159926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩顴骨凸露，主尅三妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791339574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根有横紋，尅三妻。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392618534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾枯陷，尅頭妻，眉重壓眼，尅妻。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392634918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根限，剋妻。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392651302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結喉露齒，尅妻害子。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392667686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉中有痣，妨妻。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392684070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面如麺袋，尅妻妨子。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392700454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊紋者","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392716838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953712350904371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，刑妻，一紋刑一妻，兩紋下低，刑三妻。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392716838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左目小，損妻，眼尾有紋，尅妻，三紋尅三妻。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392733222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左眼角下，神光之位青色者，主七旬内，主難爲妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392749606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑子者，主生離。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791355958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢骨重，眼尾紋長，魚尾枯，山根痣、斑、麻，三次作新郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791372342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下涙痕，尅兒女。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791405110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中斜側，尅兒。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392765990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳無輪廓，主刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392782374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根斷折，尅兒女。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392798758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中高尖，尅兒女。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392815142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三隂三陽，不宜疤痕及有紋痣。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791421494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻如界方，鼻梁劒脊骨見，地角有虧，隂氣大重，有女無男。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791437878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有背無脊，頭低步緩，狼虎之聲，","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392831526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953712351019059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主刑尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7609281827392831526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴骨生峯，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791470646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主孤無子，縱有亦是螟蛉兒，此乃俱不得力之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳無弦根，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791470646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主父母妻子生離死别，田園面耗散，無祖業之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無和氣，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791470646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主有妻無子，父母隔各，六親無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉稜骨起，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791470646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主三妻有破祖無情，主有宿疾，性剛氣暴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下無肉。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791470646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主兒女有尅，得力者少，與人無情，小人不足之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面無人色，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791503414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主與人寡合，爲人心毒，最愛便宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處事不和，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791503414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主人常招是非，主孤，有妻無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不愛老㓜，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791503414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主六親不和，救人無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉頭常蹙，","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791503414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主早年尅傷，見孤单，不傷妻女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953744605052955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，早見刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不哭常涙。","logicSentenceId":"7580401699791503414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必主傷妻尅子，晚景孤单。一雙流淚眼，只會送人亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

oteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主爲人死無所歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭欲起司空平，中正廣濶印堂淸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282551851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根不斷年壽潤，凖頭齊圓人中正。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282568235","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口好四字承漿闊，地閣朝歸倉庫盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282584619","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根圓滿驛馬豊，日月髙兮邊地静。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282601003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽肉多魚尾長，正面顴骨有神光。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282617387","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺平滿法令正，金櫃海角生微黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282633771","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陰三陽不枯焦，龍藏虎伏仍相當。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282650155","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五嶽","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282666539","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545192483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四瀆無尅破，便是人間可相郞。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282666539","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論面","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282682923","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"列百部之靈居，通五臟之神路。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282699307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟三才之成象，定一身之得失者，面也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282715691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故五嶽四瀆欲得相朝，三停諸部欲得豊滿也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282732075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貌端神凈氣和者，乃富貴之基也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282748459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫欹斜不正，傾側缺陷，色澤昏暗，氣貌醜惡者，貧賤之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282764843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以面色白如凝脂，黑如漆光，黃如蒸栗，紫如絳繒者，皆大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282781227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若面色赤暴如火者，命短卒亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282797611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛色茸茸，昏濁枯焦，無風似有塵埃，貧下夭𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733578259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面色怒","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282813995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545225251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變靑藍者，毒害之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282813995","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面作三拳者，男主尅子而貧，女主尅夫而賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282830379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面如滿月，清秀而神彩射人者，謂之朝霞之面。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282846763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男主公侯將相，女主后妃夫人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282863147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面皮厚者，性純而富；面皮薄者，性敏而貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282879531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身肥面痩者，命長性緩；身痩面肥者，命短性急。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282895915","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面白身黑者，性易而賤；面黑身白者，性難而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733594643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若面如黃𤓰者，富貴榮華；面如靑𤓰者，賢哲堪誇也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282912299","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相面","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282928683","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面欲長而方，若上下尖如棗核者，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282945067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面有六府：頭","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282961451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545258019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨爲上二府，顴骨爲中兩府，頥骨爲下兩府。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282961451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上尖者不利，下尖狹者賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282977835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無下稍，顴骨有壽紋入耳，若兼入鬂者貴，高狹者孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121282994219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頷骨闊者富，尖者窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283026987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腮骨大開闊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283043371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳後見者，心毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283059755","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面有三停：上自髪際至眉爲上停，自睂至凖頭爲中停，自准頭至地閣爲下停。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283076139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停長者貴，中停長者無中主，下停長者無下稍。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283092523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面有六曜五星：頭爲火星，鼻爲土星，左睂爲羅喉，右睂爲計都，口爲水星，左眼爲太陽，右眼爲太陰，左耳爲金星，右耳爲木星，睂中爲紫炁，山根爲月孛。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283108907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二卷三停先見，以附詄語也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545290787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：鼻梁高起豈尋常，紋促中年壽不長。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283125291","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣豊圓田宅盛，天庭平闊子孫昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283141675","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：對面不見耳，問是誰家子？","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283158059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對面不見腮，此人何處來","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283174443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"？大不□。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：面粗身細人之福，面細身粗一世貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283174443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總有玉樓無縱髪，一生無義又無親。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283207211","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相頭","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283223595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"并髪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭者，一身之尊，百骸之長，諸陽之會，五行之宗，居高而圓，象天之德也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283239979","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其骨欲豐而起，欲峻而凸，皮欲厚，","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283256363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545323555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額欲方，短則欲厚，長則欲方。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283256363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂凸者高貴，陷者夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283272747","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皮薄者，主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733611027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭有肉角者，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733627411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右陷者損母，左陷者損父。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283289131","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳後有骨，名曰壽骨，起者長年，陷者壽夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283305515","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽穴有骨，名曰扶桑骨，耳上有骨，名曰玉樓骨，竝主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283321899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行不欲摇頭，坐不欲低首，皆貧賤之相。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283338283","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際低者，性愚而夭；髪際高者，性和而壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283354667","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項後髪高，其性僻下。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283371051","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪欲疎而黑，短而潤，頭小髮長，散走他郷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283387435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪黃而焦，不貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283403819","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪短如拳，立性剛强，或赤或白，貧夭之相。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283420203","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545356323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：腦後太陽骨豐起，爲官享夀自延年。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283436587","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪疎面薄皆貧相，父母難爲左右偏。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283452971","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭小頸長，貧乏異常。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283469355","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇頭屈曲，糟糠不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283485739","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭短而圓，福祿綿緜。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733643795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹肚下垂，人僕相隨。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283502123","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：頭小髪長踪跡散，髪長頭窄命難長。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283518507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪生到耳須餓𣦸，髪捲如螺必有傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283534891","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪早白者㐫，白而再黒者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283551275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自古無濃髪宰相，亦無突髪之徤兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283567659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大槩髪欲潤澤而黒，不喜焦枯而濃。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283584043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若雙頂者，多妨父。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283600427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：頭上方圓額又平，定是富","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283616811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545389091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴有高名。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283616811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂骨連鼻終拜相，世世生生不受貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283633195","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭生角骨武封矦，腦後連山富貴流。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283649579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枕骨更生終不賤，上尖下長賤薄人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283665963","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兎頭多是性輕狂，額上金微父早亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283682347","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少年白髪多妨尅，兩鬂毛疎性不良。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283698731","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂中低下是賢人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283715115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女長頭靑嫁貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283731499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更得髮光面圖潤，必爲妃后國恩頻。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283747883","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女頭鼻面靨多，","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283764267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"厭，音業，面上黑子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再嫁重婚苦奔波。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283764267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無病面帶塵埃色，短命孤寒受坎可。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283780651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：髪靑髪細貴榮高，五妃男貴佐明朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283797035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃粗更有捲毛者，定主亾夫殺壻苗。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283813419","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩鬂毛疎好殺人，少生白","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283829803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545421859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283829803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋雙親。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283829803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有旋垂額兼垂項，多淫殺婦豈堪論。","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283846187","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論髪","logicSentenceId":"7580382121283862571","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之有髪，象山岳之有草木，草木茂盛，則山岳蔽而不明，欝而不清，故毛髪欲得宻而細，短而潤，黒而光，秀而香，乃貴人之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655112255","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫髪色黃者多妨尅，髪色赤者多災害。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655128639","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪粗硬而索者，性剛而孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733660179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪繁多而氣臭者，迍滯而貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733676563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪如蓬拳者，性狡而貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655145023","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際多者貧賤，髪際高者性和。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733692947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項後髪高，其性僻毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655161407","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以耳邊無鬂，心懷毒刅；侵睂亂額，多見灾厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655177791","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬂髪粗疎，","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655194175","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545454627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財食無餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655194175","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬂髪乾燥，憂愁至老。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733709331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬂髮細宻則血氣充滿，粗疎則血氣浮薄，滋潤則血氣旺，乾燥則血氣弱，均則貧相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪細潤澤，宐求官職。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655210559","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黒細如絲，榮貴之資。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733725715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髮鬓亂生，狡詐人憎。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655226943","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪中赤理，必主兵𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655243327","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額髪亂垂，妨母之宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655259711","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬂髪不齊，尅害妻兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655276095","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未及四十而髪白者，是謂血衰，乃性樂而命短矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655292479","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛髪硬磔如蝟毛者，爲子爲臣，必不忠孝矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655308863","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論眉","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655325247","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫睂者，媚也，爲兩目之華葢，一面之表儀。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655341631","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且謂目之英華，主賢愚之辨也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655358015","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故睂欲細平而濶，秀而長者，性","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655374399","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953575545487395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃聰明也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655374399","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫粗而濃，逆如亂，短而蹙者，性又𠒋頑也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655390783","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且睂過眼者富貴，短不覆眼者乏財，壓眼者窮逼，昂者氣剛，卓而竪者性豪，尾垂眼者性懦。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655407167","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂頭交者，貧薄，妨兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733742099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂逆生者，不良，妨妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733758483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉骨稜起者，𠒋惡多滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655423551","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂中黒子者，聰貴而賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655439935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉高居額中者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733774867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂中生白毫者，多壽。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733791251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉上多直理者，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733807635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂上多橫理者，貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733824019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉中有缺者，多奸計。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733840403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉薄如無者，多狡佞。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733856787","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：睂高聳秀，威權祿厚。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655456319","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉毛長垂，高壽無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733873171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉毛潤澤，求官易得。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655472703","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂交不分，早歲歸墳。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655489087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉如角弓，","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655505471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619654196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性善不雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655505471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂如初月，聰明超越。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655521855","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重重如絲，貪淫無守。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655538239","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彎彎如蛾，好色雖多。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655554623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂長過目，忠直有祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655571007","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂短於目，心性孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655587391","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉頭交斜，兄弟各家。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655603775","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉毛細起，不賢則貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655620159","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉角入鬂，爲人聰俊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655636543","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂俱旋毛，兄弟同胞。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655652927","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂毛婆娑，男少女多。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655669311","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂覆眉仰，兩目所仰。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655685695","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂若高直，身當淸職。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655702079","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂中紋破，迍邅常有。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655718463","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相睂","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655734847","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙睂爲羅計星，欲疎而秀，平而濶，直而長，過目豐富。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655751231","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左有旋紋者，損父，右則損母。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655767615","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛長者壽，毫白者主超","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655783999","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619686964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"群。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655783999","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉愁者孤，短不覆目者孤貧，粗者愚夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655800383","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜而卓者性豪，頭起尾低者性懦。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655833151","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂交者貧賤，不得兄弟力。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733889555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉頭有旋紋者，多好争闘刼殺。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655849535","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂是人倫紫炁星，棱高疎淡秀兼清。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655865919","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生名譽居人上，食祿榮家有政聲。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733905939","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂濃髪厚人多賤，眉逆毛粗不可論。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655898687","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有長毫過九十，愁容蹙短乏田園。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655915071","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂細平過眼，淸疎秀出群。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655931455","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更加新月樣，名譽四方聞。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655947839","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉長過眼目，弟兄須五六。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655964223","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後曲兒孫淫，絕毛離鄉曲。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740655980607","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉短家無兄弟真，濃長過目四五人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656013375","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不過兩目只言二，淡薄短散孤伶行。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656029759","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619719732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂毛濃黑財難破，紋過耳頭長不樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656046143","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂頭有痣道人術，更云有壽官寂寞。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733922323","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂後毫長壽更長，逆生非見一親亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656062527","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左睂尾上還生痣，奸私盗賊切須防。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656078911","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉後旋毛多獨自，男帶女睂淫色事。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656095295","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毫毛長生莫去嫌，此是保壽更無二。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656128063","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉後一旋弟兄二，兩旋知君有三二。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656144447","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三旋濃長四五人，濃潤無疎六七是。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656160831","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂生逆毛小㓜孤，女兒如此必妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656177215","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩睂相接人多厄，淡薄財散兄弟殂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656193599","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂骨稜高無孝心，女睂彎曲更多淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656209983","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旋毛生向睂頭後，客走他鄕少信音。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656242751","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂上紋生八","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656259135","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619752500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字形，知君兩妾悵平生。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656259135","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月骨生於額上，長壽官高富且榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656275519","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619785268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼睂：睂粗壓眼心不善，假施仁義暗毒奸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656291903","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百般生活無沾染，常思𥨵盜過平生。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656308287","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疎散睂：平生財帛多興廢，不虧我用亦無餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656324671","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外和内淡如無有，始末虚盈更不舒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656341055","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃薄睂：睂短踈散目且長，早年財帛有虚張。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656357439","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部位雖好發不久，神昏氣濁喪他鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733938707","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掃箒睂：前清後疎睂散朗，兄弟無情心妬欺。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656373823","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定有一二無後裔，老年財帛不如之。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656390207","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619818036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大刀","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656406591","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂：睂粗惡煞心奸險，見人一面假和情。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656406591","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執拘梟雄性𠒋暴，典刑不免丧其身。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656422975","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字眉：頭疎尾散壓奸門，到老數妻結不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656439359","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛一生足我用，子息終須倚螟蛉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656455743","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅漢睂：此睂相中大不歡，妻遲子晚早艱雖。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656472127","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晚年娶妾方一子，正妻不産主孤單。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656488511","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍睂：睂秀彎彎毫且稀，鴈行六七拜丹墀。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656504895","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母淸壽皆齊貴，拔萃超群天下竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656521279","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619850804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柳葉睂：眉粗帶濁濁中淸，骨肉情疎生子遲。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656537663","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友交忠信貴人盻，定須發逹顯揚名。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733955091","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劍睂：睂若山林秀且長，威權智識輔君王。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656554047","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱貧不日成清貴，孫子行行後且康。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656570431","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狮子睂：睂毫粗濁喜高眼，此相須當發逹遲。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656586815","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三遲得配獅形像，冨貴榮華老更輝。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656603199","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短促秀睂：秀短之睂壽且高，□芳雙桂俊英豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656685119","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生不違雞黍約，忠孝仁廉子亦高。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733971475","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旋螺睂：旋螺之眉世間稀，威權得此正相宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656701503","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平常之人皆不利，英雄武職應天機。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656717887","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一字睂：亳淸首尾皆如葢，富貴堪誇壽且高。","logicSentenceId":"7580382740656734271","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少年發逹登科早，夫婦齊睂到白頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256864299","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619916340"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臥蚕睂：睂彎帶秀心中巧，宛轉機關甚可人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256880683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早歲鰲頭宐可占，雁行猶恐弗相親。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256897067","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新月眉：眉淸目秀最爲良，又喜睂尾拂天倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256913451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棠棣怡怡皆富貴，他年及第拜朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256929835","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎眉：此睂雖粗且有威，平生膽志有施爲。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256946219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不官終能成大貴，遐齡鶴算鳩行虧。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758733987859","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小掃箒睂：若濃若大亳不粗，齊拂天倉尾不枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256962603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟昔情分南北，骨肉刑傷不可無。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256978987","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330953922619949108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大短促睂：短秀毫清尾畧黃，眉頭竪立最爲良，貲財來往難居積，子俊妻和鴈佀强。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888256995371","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清秀睂：秀彎長順過天倉，葢目入鬂更清長。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257011755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明早歲登科第，弟恭兄友姓名香。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257028139","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間斷睂：若黃若淡有勾絞，兄弟無綠有必傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257044523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛進退多興廢，後損爹兮先損娘。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758734004243","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交加眉：最嫌此睂主大㐫，中年末景陷牢中。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257060907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破家累及兄和弟，父在西兮母在東。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257077291","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262565376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相目論","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257093675","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之大，託日月以爲光。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257110059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月爲萬物之鑑，眼乃爲人一身之日月也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257126443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左眼爲日，父象也；右眼爲月，母象也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257142827","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寐則神處於心，寤則神依於眼，是眼爲神遊息之宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257159211","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀眼之善惡，可以見神之清濁也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257175595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼長而深光潤者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257191979","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑如黠𣾰，聰慧文章，含神不露，灼然有光者，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758734020627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細而深者，長壽，兼性隱僻。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758734037011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮而露晴者，夭𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758734053395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大而凸，圓而怒者，促壽。","logicSentenceId":"7608890758734069779","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凸暴流視者，淫盗。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710018579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眊然而偏視者，不正之人。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710034963","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤縷貫晴者，惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257208363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"視定不怯者，其神","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710051347","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262598144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壮。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710051347","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊眼者，孤而狠。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257224747","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短小者，愚賤。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710067731","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卓起者，性急。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710084115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下臥蚕者，生貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710100499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人眼黑白分明者，貌重。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257241131","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下赤色者，憂産厄，偷視淫蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710116883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神定不流者，福全。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710133267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵眼不欲怒，縷不欲赤，白不欲多，黒不欲少，勢不欲堅，視不欲偏，神不欲困，眩不欲反，光不欲流。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257257515","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其或圓而小，短而深，不善之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257273899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眼之間，名子孫宫，欲豐滿而不失陷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257290283","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"神主眼有七相","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257306667","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257323051","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
