{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀而正，","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257339435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秀者論其光，正者論其體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細而長，","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257339435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"細而不長，小巧之人，長而不細，則惡矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定而出，","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257339435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"定而不露，若不出，則愚人也。出謂神出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出而入，","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257339435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出則有神，然不入，則蕩子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257339435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262630912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下不白，","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257339435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上白多必奸，下白多必刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"視久不脫，","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257339435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神足也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇變不眊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257339435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有養也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：目秀而長，必近君王。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257355819","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼似鯽魚，必定家肥。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257372203","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目大而光，多進田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710149651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目頭破缺，家財歇滅。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710182419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目露四白，陣亾兵絕。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710198803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目如鳳鸞，必定高官。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257388587","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目有三𧢲，其人必惡。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710215187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目短睂長，愈益田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710231571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目睛如凸，必定夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257404971","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤痕侵瞳，官事重重。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257421355","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目赤睛黃，必主夭亾。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710247955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目長一寸，必佐明王。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257437739","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目烈有威，萬人皈依。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710264339","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目如羊目，相刑骨肉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257454123","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目如蜂目，惡𣦸孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710280723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目如蛇晴，狼毒孤刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257470507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目尾相垂，夫妻相離。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257486891","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：紅眼金晴，不認六親。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257503275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"烏晴少而","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257519659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262663680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白晴多，不爲囚繫主奔波。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257519659","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼如日月要分明，鳯目龍睛切要清。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257536043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕黃睛兼赤脉，一生㐫害活無成。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257552427","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮大羊晴必主㐫，身孤無着貨財空。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257568811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細深多是無心腹，斜視之人不可逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257585195","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睛目爲身主，還同日月臺。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257601579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"群星天上伏，萬象鑑中開。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257617963","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀𡡾官榮至，清長富貴來。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257634347","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫教圓更露，往徃見迍災。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257650731","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼内多白女殺夫，男兒似此亦多愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257667115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼晴黄及赤脉，男人發病女妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257683499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼深定是乏資糧，帶泣妨夫子不强。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257699883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更見目中塵蒙現，多應貧賤𣦸他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257716267","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼中黑靨","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257732651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262696448"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女多奸，兩眼方而保壽顔。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257732651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫見黑睛圓更大，定知賢士更多賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257749035","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看君左眼須然小，我且知君是長男。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257765419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見右眼輪還不薄，女人最大敢言談。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257781803","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眼胞下痣分明，家有食糧僧道人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257798187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左眼直下還生痣，封矦伯子至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257814571","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下橫肉臥蚕子，知君久遠絕子嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257830955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更生紋靨多瘢疪，尅子無兒端的是。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257847339","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下一字封矦伯，龍睂鳳眼人中貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257863723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑白分明信義流，鷄眼昏暗終是賊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257880107","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左眼小知君怕婦，魚目多在兵刑𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888257994795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小不同何所招？","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258011179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟兄生時異父母。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258027563","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262761984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍眼：黑白分明精神彩，波長眼大氣神藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258076715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此富貴非小可，竟能受祿輔明皇。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258093099","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳯眼：鳯眼波長貴自成，影光秀氣又神清。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258109483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明智慧功名遂，拔萃超群壓衆英。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710297107","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猴眼：黑睛昻上波紋矗，轉動機關亦有宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258125867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此相若全眞富貴，好食菓品坐頭低。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258142251","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262794752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象眼：上下波紋秀氣多，波長眼細亦仁和。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258191403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及時富貴皆爲玅，遐算清平樂且歌。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258207787","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鵲眼：上有如紋秀且長，平生信實有忠良。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258224171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少年發逹如平淡，終末之時更吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258240555","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獅眼：眼大威嚴性畧狂，粗睂趂此又端莊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258256939","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不貪不酷施仁政，富貴榮華福壽康。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258273323","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎眼：眼大晴黃淡金色，瞳人或短有時長。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258289707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性剛沉重而無患，富貴終年子有傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258306091","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262827520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛眼：眼大睛圓視見風，見之遠近不分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258322475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"興財巨萬無差跌，夀算綿長福祿終。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258338859","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔雀眼：眼有波明睛黒光，靑多白少惡𠒋強。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258355243","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"素廉淸潔嫌年煖，始末興隆姓字揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258371627","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴛鴦眼：眼秀睛紅潤有紗，眼圓畧露帶桃花。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258388011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻情順又且美，若還富貴恐淫些。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258404395","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳴鳯眼：上層波起亦分明，視耳睁睁不露神。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258420779","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敢取中年而遇貴，榮宗耀祖攺門庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258437163","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954037262860288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡鳯眼：平平瞻視不偏斜，笑帶和容秀氣華。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258453547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天性容人而有量，須知富貴足堪誇。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258469931","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑞鳯眼：日月分明兩角齊，二波長秀笑微微。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888258486315","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流而不動神光色，翰苑聲名逹鳯池。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340750378","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴈眼：晴如黑漆帶金黃，上下波紋二樣長。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340766762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入相爲官恭且藴，連枝同氣姓名香。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340783146","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽眼：兩日雌雄晴大小，精神光彩視人斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340799530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心非口是無誠實，富積奸謀詭不奢。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340815914","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954161862754319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴形眼：上層波秀到奸門，黑自分明淸秀瞳。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340832298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正視無偏人可愛，高明廣大貴而榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340848682","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鵝眼：數波紋秀射天倉，視物分明神更長。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340865066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白少黒多心且善，緜綿福祿老安祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340881450","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花眼：男女桃花眼不宐，逢人微笑水光迷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340897834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼皮濕淚兼斜視，自足歡娛樂且嬉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340914218","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醉眼：紅黃混雜却流光，如醉如痴心昧昂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340930602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女犯貪淫男必夭，僧人道士亦淫荒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340946986","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954161862787087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鹤眼：眼秀精神黑白清，藏神不露顕功名。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340963370","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昻昂志氣冲牛斗，富貴須當達上卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340979754","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊眼：黑淡微黃神不淸，瞳人紗様却昏晴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888340996138","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖財縱有無緣享，晚歲中年又且貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341012522","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚眼：睛露神昏若水兊，定晴逺近視汪洋。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341028906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢此眼皆亡早，百日須驚嘆夭殤。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341045290","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬眼：皮寛三角晴睁露，終日無愁濕淚堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341061674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面痩皮綳眞可嘆，刑妻尅子又奔𢗅。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341078058","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954161862819855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猪眼：白昏時露里尤濛，波厚皮寛性暴㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341094442","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴也遭刑憲罹，絕歸十惡法難容。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341110826","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇眼：堪嘆人心毒似蛇，晴紅圓露帶紅紗。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341127210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大奸大詐如狼虎，此目之人子打爺。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710313491","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴿眼：鴿眼晴黃小垤圓，搖頭擺膝坐還偏。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341143594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘男女多淫亂，少實多虛心湛然。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341159978","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鸞眼：準頭圓大眼微長，歩急言辭𡡾且良。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341176362","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身貴近君終大用，何愁不似雪衣娘。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341192746","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相山根","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341241898","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根爲孛星，鼻梁上也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341258282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜髙不宐低折。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341274666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鼻梁不斜曲而常常瑩潤者，晩年有祿，主男得賢妻，女得賢夫，富貴壽攷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341291050","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是無肉，與人不足，可宐守善心，不可與交接。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341307434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根連額，鼻梁隆隆而起，與額平者，主位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341323818","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根蹙折，鼻梁蹙小陷折者，主貧乏無成。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341340202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根枯暗，鼻梁無肉而枯暗者，主與人多不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341356586","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根不陷，主","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341372970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954161863016463"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽，山根斜曲，官災。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341372970","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：凡人眼下枯無肉，定見妻兒多不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341389354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更及山根肉亦薄，夫妻對面相泣哭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341405738","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相鼻","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341422122","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻爲中岳，其形屬土，爲一面之表，肺之靈苖也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341438506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故肺虚則鼻通，肺實則鼻塞，故鼻之通塞，以見肺之虛實也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341454890","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭圓，鼻孔不昻不露，又得蘭臺、廷尉二部相應，富貴之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341471274","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上壽上二部皆在於鼻，故主壽之長短","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341487658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954161863049231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341487658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光潤豊起者，不貴則壽富也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341504042","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色黑肉薄者，不賤則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341520426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隆高有梁者，主壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341536810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若懸膽而直截箇者，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341553194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竪有骨者，壽相。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710346259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準頭豊大，與人無害。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341569578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭尖細，好爲奸計，多生黑子者迍蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710362643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有橫紋者，主車馬傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341585962","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有縱理紋者，養他人子。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710379027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻梁圓而貫印堂者，此人主美貌之妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341602346","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：鼻如截筒，衣食豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341618730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔仰露出，夭折寒索。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710395411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻如鷹嘴，取人腦髓。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341635114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻有三曲，孤獨破屋。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341651498","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻有三凹，骨肉相抛。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341667882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭而直，得外衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341684266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭豊起，富貴無比。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341700650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭帶紅，必走西東。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341717034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻厄露骨，一生汨没。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341733418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341749802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292808925224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垂肉，貪淫不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341749802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭圓肥，足食豊衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341766186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭尖薄，孤貧削弱。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341782570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻聳天庭，四海馳名。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341798954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻梁無骨，必夭壽没。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341815338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻露見梁，客死他郷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341831722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻凖尖斜，心事勾加。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341848106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭常欲光潤，山根不得促折。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341864490","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻如懸膽身須貴，土曜當生得地來。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341880874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見山根連額起，定知榮貴至三台。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341897258","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻頭尖小人貧賤，孔仰家無隔宿糧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341913642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又怕曲如鷹嘴樣，一生奸計不堪言。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341930026","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭尖薄最窮波，鼻上橫紋痣厄多。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341946410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露穴主貧短無壽，鼻長有壽百年過。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341962794","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻偏祖去父先亡，右去須知母亦","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341979178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292808957992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341979178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴孔大而財不聚，準頭圓厚富而長。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888341995562","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根青色有灾侵，法令紋深好殺心。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342011946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻凖如鈎財上毒，宐垂如膽富年深。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342028330","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭有靨陰中有，上下生靨左右同。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342044714","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梁柱有靨陰背上，見時敢道有神功。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342061098","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法令紋中靨子惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342077482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邊父𣦸而無覺，右邊母喪亦是然。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342093866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬個之中無一錯。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342110250","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四嶽窊低鼻獨高，財散貧寒宿世招。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342126634","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露齒結喉鼻孔露，必然餓𣦸在終朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342143018","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292808990760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍鼻：龍鼻豊隆凖上齊，山根直聳若伏犀，鼻梁方正無偏曲，位至居尊九鼎時。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342159402","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎鼻：虎鼻員融不露孔，蘭臺廷尉亦須無。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342175786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不偏不曲山根大，富貴名褒世罕夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342192170","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胡羊鼻：胡年鼻大準頭豊，蘭臺廷尉亦相同。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342208554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根年壽無脊露，大貴當時富石崇。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342224938","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獅鼻：山根年壽畧低平，凖上豊大稱蘭庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342241322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若今獅形眞富貴，不然財帛有虚盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342257706","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292809023528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸膽鼻：鼻如懸膽凖頭齊，山根不斷無偏欹。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342274090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺廷尉模糊小，富貴榮華應壯期。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342290474","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏犀鼻：伏犀鼻揷天庭中，山根直上印堂隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342306858","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉不多兮骨不露，神淸位立至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342323242","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛鼻：牛鼻豊齊根且大，蘭臺廷尉又分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342339626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年夀不高且不軟，富積金資家道成。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342356010","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"截筒鼻：功名富貴截筒佳，準頭齊直不偏斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888342372394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根畧軟年壽滿，中年冨貴大成家。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772763684","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292809056296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蒜鼻：山根年壽俱平小，蘭臺廷尉準頭豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772780068","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第兄情欠心無毒，晩景中年家必隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772796452","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盛囊鼻：鼻如盛囊蘭廷小，兩邉尉灶亦員齊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772812836","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始末貲財俱大盛，功名必定掛朱衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772829220","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猴鼻：山根年壽平且大，蘭臺廷尉要分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772845604","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭豐紅不露孔，雖然富貴恐奸情。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772861988","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鷹嘴鼻：鼻梁露脊凖頭尖，又如鷹嘴鎖唇邊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772878372","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺廷尉俱短縮，啄人心髓惡奸偏。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772894756","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292809089064"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狗鼻：狗鼻年壽起骨峰，凖頭蘭尉孔邊空。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772911140","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此鼻之人主有義，惟嫌竊取濟時窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772927524","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鯽魚鼻：壽年高起如魚背，山根細小準頭垂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772943908","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉無親晴露白，一生衣食主伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772960292","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三彎三曲：鼻有三彎爲反吟，鼻有三曲爲伏吟。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772976676","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟相見是絕滅，伏吟相見淚淋淋。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888772993060","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劍鋒鼻：鼻梁露脊如刀背，凖頭無肉灶門関。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773009444","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭第無緣子尅盡，勞勞碌碌主孤單。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773025828","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292809121832"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏凹鼻：年壽低壓山根小，鼻面相生差不多。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773042212","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭臺尉些須見，不夭不貧疾見磨。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773058596","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤峯鼻：鼻大無肉灶門開，兩顴低小鼻崔嵬。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773074980","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此鼻縱大無財積，若爲僧道免哀哉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773091364","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露脊鼻：鼻痩露脊山根小，形容粗俗骨神昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773107748","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土無萬物皆零落，縱然平穩也孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773124132","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露灶鼻：孔大鼻高竅又長，須知家下少衣糧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773140516","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艱辛受苦多勞碌，末喪他鄕實可傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773156900","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292809154600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獐鼻：鼻小準尖庭灶露，金甲二櫃肉□纒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773173284","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒勞遺蔭難居守，四復三畨迍且邅。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773189668","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猩鼻：猩猩之相鼻梁高，眉眼相挨粗髪毛。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773206052","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面濶唇掀身廣厚，竟懷德重貴英豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773222436","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鹿鼻：鹿鼻豊齊凖更圓，情寛歩急義仁全。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773238820","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驚疑坐起渾無定，福禄増添得自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773255204","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猿鼻：鼻竅小而口頗尖，猖狂輕燥不尊嚴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773271588","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性靈嗔怒多憂慮，花果常時手好拈。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773287972","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292809187368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"人中論","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773304356","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中者，一身溝洫之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773320740","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如溝洫疏通，則水流而不壅；如淺狹不深，則水壅而不流。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773337124","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人中之長短，可定壽命之長短；人中之廣狹，可斷男女之多少。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773353508","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故人中所以爲壽命男女之宮也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773369892","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以欲長而不欲縮，中深而外濶，直而不斜，濶而下垂者，皆善相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773386276","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其或細而狹者，衣食逼迫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773402660","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿而平者，連邅災滯。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710411795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上狹下廣者，多子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773419044","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上廣下狹者，少兒息。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710428179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下俱狹而中心濶者，子息疾苦而難成。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710444563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下直而深者，子息滿堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773435428","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下平而","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710460947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954292809220136"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺者，子息不生。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710460947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深而長者，長壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773451812","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺而短者，夭亾。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710477331","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中屈曲者，無信之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773468196","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中端直者，忠義之士。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710493715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正而垂者，富壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773484580","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蹇而縮者，夭賤。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710510099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明如破竹者，二千石禄。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773500964","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細如懸針者，絕子貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773517348","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上有黑子者，多子。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773533732","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下有黑子者，多女。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710526483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中有黑子者，婚妻易而養兒難。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710542867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有兩黑子者，主雙生。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710559251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有橫理者，至老無兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773550116","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有竪理者，主養他子。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710575635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有縱理者，生兒宿疾。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710592019","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人中漫漫平而無者，是謂傾陷，至老絕嗣，窮苦之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773566500","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相人中篇 ","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773582884","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710657555","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791185443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中平長，至老吉昌，兼有年壽，更益兒郞。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773599268","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中短促，子孫不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773615652","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中高厚，壽年不久。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710608403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中廣平，養子不成。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710624787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖即生産，常聞哭聲。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710641171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中廣厚，奸淫未足。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710673939","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中兩黑，旳生可擬。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710690323","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：人中平淺短何堪，無信無兒見者嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773632036","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見直深長一寸，定知兒女轉加添。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773648420","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中平平子不成，三陽赤色主相争。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773664804","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色得財無盜賊，赤黒妻與外奸情。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773681188","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773697572","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791218211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中井部水橫紋，每到臨船莫進程。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773697572","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏左生兒右生女，上下平平子不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773713956","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相耳","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773730340","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳生貫腦而通心胸，爲心之司，腎之候也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773746724","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故腎氣旺則淸而聰，腎氣虚則昏而濁，所以聲譽與性行也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773763108","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚而堅，聳而長，皆壽相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773779492","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輪廓分明，聰悟。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773795876","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垂珠朝口者，主財壽，貼肉者富足。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710706707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳内生毛者壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773812260","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳有黑子，生貴子，主聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773828644","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳門濶，主智逺大。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773845028","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅濶，主官。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710723091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白，主名望。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710739475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤黑，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710755859","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳薄向前，賣盡田園。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773877796","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反而偏側，居無屋宅。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710772243","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773894180","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791250979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右大小，迍否妨害。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773894180","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光明潤澤，聲名違播。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773910564","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"塵粗焦黑，貧薄愚鹵。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710788627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其竪如木，到老不哭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773926948","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長而聳者，禄位。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773943332","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚而圓者，衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710805011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵貴人有貴眼無貴耳，賤人或有貴耳而無貴眼。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773959716","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善相者，先相其色，後相其形可也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773976100","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：耳如提起，名播人耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888773992484","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩耳垂肩，貴不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774008868","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白如面，名滿天下。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774025252","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棋子之耳，成家立計。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774041636","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳黑飛花，離祖破家。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774058020","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳薄如紙，夫𣦸無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774074404","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輪廓桃紅，性最玲隴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774090788","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩耳如紙，貧窮無倚。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774107172","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳如䑕耳，貧賤早𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774123556","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳反無輪，祖業如塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774139940","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳有垂珠，衣食自足。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774156324","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳薄無根，必","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774172708","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791283747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭天年。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774172708","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳門廣濶，聰明豁逹。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774189092","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳有城廓，壽命不促。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774205476","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳下骨員，未有餘錢。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774221860","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相耳篇 ","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774238244","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710821395","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳髙於目，合受他祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774254628","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"作爲人師也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高如睂一寸，永不踐貧困。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774271012","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳高輪廓，亦主安樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774287396","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳有刀環，五等高官。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774303780","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳門垂厚，富貴長久。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774320164","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳門容筋，家貧易去。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774336548","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳有毫毛，長壽富貴，兼没災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774352932","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目能自覩者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774369316","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳如獸耳，自安自止。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888774385700","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳門寛大，聰明財足。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888906981430","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳門薄小，命短食少。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888906997814","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白於面，名滿赤縣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907014198","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輪廓分明有墜珠，一生仁義最相宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907030582","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木星","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907046966","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791316515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得地招文學，自有聲名逹帝都。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907046966","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳反無輪最不堪，又如箭羽少資糧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907063350","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門空小人無壽，青黑皮粗走異鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907079734","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳生貼肉廓輪成，紅光盡屬富而榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907096118","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露反薄乾貧苦相。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907112502","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛長出耳壽千春。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907128886","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白過面少高名。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907145270","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前看不見富貴榮，前看見耳多貧苦，耳前生靨近聾貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907161654","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：下有垂珠肉色光，更來朝口富榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907178038","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上尖狼耳心多殺，下尖無色亦無良。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907194422","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791349283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土耳：土耳堅厚大且肥，潤紅姿色正堪宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907210806","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綿長富貴六親足，鶴髪童顔輔佐時。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907227190","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棋子耳：耳圓輪廓喜相扶，白手興家貴可圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907243574","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖業平常自創立，中年富貴若陶未。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907259958","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎耳：耳小輪廓又缺破，對面不見始爲竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907276342","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此耳此人多好險，亦能有貴有威儀。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907292726","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"箭羽耳：上節高眉寸有餘，下生箭羽没垂珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907309110","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父手祖財雖萬□，尤能破敗走西東。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907325494","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791382051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金耳：高眉一寸天輪小，耳白過面並垂珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907341878","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴聞名於朝野，只嫌損子末時孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907358262","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木耳：輪飛廓反六親薄，尤恐資財不足家。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907374646","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面部若好碌碌度，不然貧苦定虚花。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907391030","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水耳：水耳厚圓高過目，又兼貼腦有垂珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907407414","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"硬堅紅潤如卓立，富貴當朝大丈夫。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710837779","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火耳：高眉輪尖廓且反，縱有垂珠不足誇。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907423798","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根卧蚕若相應，末年無子受弥加。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907440182","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791414819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猪耳：無廓有輪耳雖厚，或前或後或垂珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907456566","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然富貴成何濟，晚景多𠒋災害生。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907472950","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低反耳：耳低廓反又輪開，年幼刑孤且損財。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907489334","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應有家財也消耗，他年恐𣦸没人埋。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907505718","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垂肩耳：耳厚郭豊珠槖肩，過睂潤澤色明鮮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907522102","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭圓額潤形容異，九五之尊奪尚賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907538486","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貼腦耳：兩耳貼腦輪廓堅，壓眉壓眼是高賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907554870","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親昆玉皆豪貴，百世流芳樂自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907571254","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791447587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開花耳：耳輪開花兼又薄，縱然骨破也徒然。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907587638","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨萬貲財尤破盡，末年貧苦不如前。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710854163","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扇風耳：兩耳向前且兠風，彼盡家財及祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907604022","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正年向福中年敗，末歲貧苦受孤窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907620406","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠耳：鼠耳髙飛根反尖，縱然過目不爲亨。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907636790","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是盜狗偷常不改，末年破敗喪牢檐。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710870547","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驢耳：有輪有廓耳雖厚，又嫌軟弱又垂珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907653174","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此耳之人必貧苦，末年㐫敗事躊蹰。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907669558","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954412791480355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相口","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907685942","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口爲言語之門，飮食之具，萬物造化之關，又爲心之外戶，賞罰之所出，是非之所會也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907702326","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端厚不妄誕，謂之口德。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907718710","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誹謗多言，謂之口賊。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710886931","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方濶有稜者，主壽貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907735094","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形如𧢲弓者，主官祿。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710903315","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橫闊而厚者，福富。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907751478","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正而不偏，厚而不薄者，衣食如四字，富足。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710919699","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖而反，偏而薄，寒賤。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710936083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不言口動，又如馬口，飢餓。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907767862","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠口，謗毁嫉妬。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710952467","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如吹火孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710968851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狗口平下，縱紋入口，飢餓。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809710985235","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫黑者，多滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907784246","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口開齒露者，無機。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711001619","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有黑子者，主酒食。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907800630","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如含丹，不受飢寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907817014","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如一撮者，","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907833398","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532135911464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907833398","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口能容拳者，出入將相。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907849782","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口闊而豊，食祿萬鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711018003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無人獨語者，其賤如鼠。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711034387","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇爲口舌之城廓，舌爲口之鋒刀，城廓欲厚，鋒刅欲利，厚則不陷，利則不鈍，乃善相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907866166","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌大口小，貧薄折夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907882550","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口小而短者貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907898934","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口色欲紅，口音欲淸，口德欲端，口唇欲厚。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907915318","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：口如撥砂，食祿榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907931702","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如抹丹，不受飢寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907948086","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如紅硃，富貴相宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907964470","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如生唇，必是賢人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907980854","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非特口德，又且性純。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888907997238","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711067155","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532135944232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口角如弓，位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908030006","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如含丹，不受飢寒，一則主富，二則主官。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908046390","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如撮聚，俱承人後，虚用心情，人賤如狗。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908062774","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如缩囊，飢𣦸無糧，縱然有子，必主别房。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908079158","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如吹火，飢寒獨坐。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908095542","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如縮螺，常樂獨謌。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711050771","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍唇鳯口，不可爲友，好說不眞，常懷麄酌。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908111926","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如赤丹，不入殷蘭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908128310","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是女子，亦得夫憐。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908144694","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口寛舌薄，必好謌樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908161078","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此之人，永無㐫惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908177462","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱理入口，飢𣦸不久。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908193846","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口邉紫色，貪財妨害。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908210230","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口開齒出，當失算數，必不久長，少即身故。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908226614","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口中有理，長相對益，豊財足祿，終無妨害。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908242998","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口未語將唇起，奸邪在心，常懷","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908259382","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532135977000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908259382","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如馬口，𡝢害貪醜。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908275766","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口中黑子，食噉皆美。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908292150","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人唇紅似撥砂，更加四字足榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908308534","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤似鼠常靑黑，破盡田園不顧家。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908324918","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水星得地口唇方，榮貴肥家子息昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908341302","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下各偏稜𧢲薄，出言毁謗太難防。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908357686","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口方四字信宜眞，兩𧢲低垂說惡聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908374070","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇上紋多存細相，青薄川紋餓𣦸名。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908390454","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如吹火少兒孫，偏左妨妻婦𣦸迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908406838","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右畔竪門田産破，黑子當□藥毒頻。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908423222","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如吹火家無子，面上三唇有義兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908439606","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌上常青難可斷，同胞兄弟也離分。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908455990","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532136009768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四字口：口角光明唇兩齊，兩頭畧仰不再低。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908472374","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明更有多才學，富貴應須若紫衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908488758","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方口：方口齊唇不露牙，唇紅光潤似殊砂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908505142","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"笑而不露齒且白，定知富貴享榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908521526","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仰月口：口如仰月上朝彎，齒白唇紅似抹丹。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908537910","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿腹文章聲價美，竟能冨貴列朝班。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908554294","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彎弓口：口似彎弓作上弦，兩唇豊厚若丹鮮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908570678","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神清氣爽終爲用，富貴終年福自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908587062","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532136042536"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛口：牛口雙唇厚且豊，平生衣禄更昌隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580382888908603446","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濁中帶清心靈巧，富貴康寧福若松。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889489989638","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍口：龍口兩唇豊且齊，光明口角更淸竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490006022","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚呼唱散權通變，玉帶圍腰世罕稀。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490022406","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎口：虎口闊大有妆拾，須知此口必容拳。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490038790","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然不貴且大富，積玉堆金樂自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490055174","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊口：羊口無鬚長且尖，兩人又薄得人嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490071558","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山尖食物如狗樣，賤且貧而𠒋又邅。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490087942","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532136075304"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猪口：猪口上唇長粗濶，下唇尖小角涎流。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490104326","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誘人訕謗心奸險，落在途中半路休。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490120710","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吹火口：口中吹火聞不收，嘴尖衣食苦强求。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490137094","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生成此口多貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711083539","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廕丁須教破且休。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490169862","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皺紋口：唇上皺紋似哭顔，縱然有壽主孤單。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490186246","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早年安樂末年敗，若有一子屬幽關。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711099923","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"櫻桃口：櫻桃口大唇胭脂。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490202630","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒似□牙密且宜。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490219014","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"笑如含蓮情和暢，聰明拔萃紫袍衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490235398","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532136108072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猴口：猴口兩唇喜又長，人中然竹更爲良。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490251782","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生衣祿皆榮足，鶴算龜齡福壽康。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490268166","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鮎魚口：鮎耳口闊角低尖，梟薄雙唇又欠圓。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490284550","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此之人主貧賤，須臾一命喪黃泉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490300934","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鯽魚口：鯽魚口小主貧窮，一生衣食不豊隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490317318","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼氣濁神枯澁，破敗漂蓬運不通。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490333702","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆船口：口𧢲□如覆破船，兩唇牛肉色烟□。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490350086","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人逢此口多爲丐，一生貧苦不須言。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490366470","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532136140840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論唇","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490382854","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇者，爲口之城廓，作舌之門户。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490399238","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一開一闔，榮辱之所。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711116307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繫者，唇也，故欲厚而不欲薄，欲稜而不欲縮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490415622","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇色紅如丹砂者，貴而福。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490432006","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑如藍靛者，灾而夭。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711132691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色昏黑者，苦疾惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490448390","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色紫光者，快樂衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711149075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色白而艶者，招貴妾。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711165459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色黃而紅者，招貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711181843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蹇縮者，夭亾。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711198227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄弱者，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711214611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上唇長者，先妨父。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490464774","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下唇長者，先妨母。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711230995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上唇薄者，言語狡詐。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711247379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下唇薄者，貧賤蹇滯。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711263763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下俱厚者，忠信之人，上下俱薄者，𡚶語。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490481158","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩唇上下不相覆者，貧寒偷盗。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490497542","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下兩相","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711280147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532136173608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稱者，言語正直。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711280147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍唇者富貴，羊唇者貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490513926","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇尖撮者，貧𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711296531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇墜下者，孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711312915","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有紋理，多子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490530310","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無絞理，性孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711329299","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：唇如雞肝，至老貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490546694","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇如青黑，餓𣦸塗陌。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711345683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇色光紅，不求自豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490563078","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇色淡黑，毒殺之客。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711362067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇平不起，飢餓莫比。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490579462","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇缺而陷，下賤不謙。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490595846","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長唇短齒，長命不𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490612230","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇生不正，言詞難定。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490628614","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
