{"lines":[{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711394835","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下唇過上唇，妨夫的是眞。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490661382","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上唇過下唇，法多虚假人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490677766","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇紫色，足衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490694150","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇常赤，爲貴客。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711378451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上唇厚，命非久。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490710534","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下唇","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711411219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954532136206376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長，主貪食。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711411219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇上下相當，語音易善，好集文章。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490726918","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女唇紫，夫早死，兼妨首子。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490743302","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇赤如丹，不要師看。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490759686","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇上下不相覆，常懷盜𥨸，終身不富。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490776070","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇多紋理，兒多無比。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490792454","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇上紋多紅似花，一生富貴足榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490808838","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇厚少語薄多訟，依此言之定不差。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490825222","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論齒","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490857990","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"搆百骨之精華，作一口之鋒刅，運化萬物，以頥六腑者，齒也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490874374","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故欲得大而宻，長而直，多而白爲隹也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490890758","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堅牢宻固者，長壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490907142","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繚亂叠生者，狡横。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711427603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露出者，暴亡。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711443987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"踈漏者，","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711460371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954648754339840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711460371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短缺者，愚下。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711476755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焦枯，橫夭。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711493139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語不見齒者，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711509523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壯而齒落者，壽促。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711525907","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十八齒者，王侯。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490923526","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十六齒者，卿相。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711542291","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十四齒者，朝郞巨福。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711558675","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十二齒者，中人福祿。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711575059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十者，平常之人。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711591443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八者，下貧之輩。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711607827","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩白者，百謀百稱。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490939910","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色者，干求阻滯。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711624211","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如白玉者，高貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490956294","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如爛銀者，淸職。","logicSentenceId":"7608890809711640595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如榴子者，福禄。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937289928746","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如劒鋒，貴壽。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937289945130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如梗米者，高年。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937289961514","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如黑椹者，命短。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937289977898","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上闊下尖如列鋸者，性粗而食肉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490972678","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上尖下濶如排肉者，性鄙而食菜。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937289994282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊齒者，子息顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889490989062","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛齒者，自身起榮。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290010666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠齒者，貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491005446","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大齒者，毒忿。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290027050","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954648754372608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：齒如含玉，受天福祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491021830","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒如爛銀，富貴不貧。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290043434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白而宻者，仕宦無殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491038214","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑而疎縫，一生災重。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290059818","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直長一寸，極貴難論。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290076202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"參差不齊，心行詐欺。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491054598","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒白如玉，自然謌樂，財食自至，不用苦作。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491087366","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒如斬銀，必是貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491103750","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒如石榴，富貴他求。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491120134","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒如龍齒，法生貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491136518","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒齦竅出，毎事漏失。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491152902","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒縫疎稀，財食無餘。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290108970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此之人，與鬼同居。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491169286","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒數三十六，貴聖有天祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491185670","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若三十向上，富貴豪望。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491202054","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足滿三十，衣食自如。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290125354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒色黑，多妨尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491218438","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十巳","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290141738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954648754405376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下，漸多飢寒，衣食必少，壽命短促。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290141738","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：齒宻方爲君子儒，分明小輩齒牙疎。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491234822","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色如白玉須相稱，年少聲名逹帝都。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491251206","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇紅齒白文章士，眼秀睂高是貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491267590","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細小短粗貧且夭，燈窓費力枉勞神。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491283974","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論舌","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491300358","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫舌之爲道，内與丹元爲號令，外與重機爲鈴鐸。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491316742","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故善性靈液也，則爲神之舍體；宻傳志慮也，則爲心之舟楫。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491333126","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以性命樞機，一身得失，有所托焉。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491349510","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是古人","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491365894","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954648754438144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"評其端醜，戒其𡚶動也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491365894","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故舌之形，欲得端而利，長而大者，上相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491382278","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若狹而長者，詐而賊。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491398662","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秃而短者，迍而蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290158122","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大而薄者，多妄謬。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290174506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖而小者，爲貪人。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290190890","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引至鼻者，位至矦王。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491415046","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛如掌者，祿至卿相。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290207274","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色紅如硃者，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491431430","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色黑如翳者，賤。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290223658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色赤如血者，祿。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290240042","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色白如灰者，貧。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290256426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌上有直理者，官至卿監。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491447814","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌上有縱紋者，職任舘殿。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290272810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌經有理而繞者，至貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491464198","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌艷而吐滿口者，至富。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290289194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古上有錦紋者，出人朝省。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491480582","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌上有黑子者，言語虚僞。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290305578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌出如蛇者，毒害。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491496966","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌斷如掘者，蹇滯。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290321962","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未語而舌先至者，好妄談。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290338346","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未言而舌","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290354730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954648754470912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㖭唇者，多淫逸。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290354730","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：舌短而大，愚齒懈怠。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491513350","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌小而長，仕宦吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290371114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長而㖭鼻，位隆輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290387498","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌出如蛇，毒害淫奢。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290403882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌形欲方，舌勢欲深。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491529734","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌無紋理，尋常之侶。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491546118","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相舌篇 ","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491562502","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290420266","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌小窄方，法主公王。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491578886","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌上長理，三公可擬。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491595270","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌小多紋理，安樂常不已。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889491611654","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌至鼻頭，必得封矦。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708093482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌大而薄，萬事虚耗。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708109866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌大口小，言不了了。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708126250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌小口大，言語捷快。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708142634","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌過粗大，生多飢餓。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290436650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌小而短，法主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708159018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌上黑紫，必無","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708175402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954648754503680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"终始。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708175402","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口語未出，其舌先見，好語他事，必自改變。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708191786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌上繡文，奴馬成羣，財帛千萬，富貴凌雲。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708208170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌有支理紋，冨貴必超昇。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708224554","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論髭髯","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708240938","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上爲祿，下爲官，寧可有祿而無官，莫教有官而無祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708257322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿無官，主富，有福有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708273706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官無祿，貧賤，財散人離。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290453034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有五官，亦主貧寒，郤有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708290090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官祿雙全，五福俱全之相。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708306474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬚拳髪捲，可作貧窮之漢，則爲亏兵祗候，𣦸㐫之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708322858","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954648754536448"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相髭鬚","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708339242","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髭鬚黑而清秀者，貴而富。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708355626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滋潤者，發福。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290469418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾燥者，蹇滯。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290485802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勁直者，性剛，不住財。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290502186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柔者，性柔。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290518570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤者，孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290534954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：捲髮赤鬚貧困路途，黑而光澤富貴無虧。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708372010","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相魚尾","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708404778","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼尾生魚尾，多財必主榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708421162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰相對照，晚歲定功名。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708437546","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論頸項","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708453930","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上扶一首之謂棟，下據四體之謂梁，高然特立者，項也。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708470314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故丕隆光潤者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580382889708503082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豊圓堅實者，大富。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290551338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"側而小，細。","logicSentenceId":"7608891937290567722","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954780480929830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"神相全編卷之四","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790338612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"明𬂪庄袁忠徹訂正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫背之爲質，觀其厚薄也，一身所恃之安危；詳其豊陷也，百歲可定之貧冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790371380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故平濶而豊者，一身少災而福；偏狹而䧟者，一世多厄而貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790387764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有骨隆然而起如伏龜，壯者，二千石祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790404148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背三甲成者，貴而壽。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517993979931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豊厚突起者，福多子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517993996315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜薄窪下者，貧寒孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994012699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方而長者，有智而","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790420532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954820515397669"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790420532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偃而短者，無識而賤。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994029083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓厚如團扇者至貴，窪深如溝渠者，至貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790436916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前見似仰而後見似俯而前者，不貴則冨矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790453300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相背","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790469684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背欲長不欲短，欲厚不欲薄。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790486068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坑䧟者，貧賤之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790502452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平濶豊厚，則安於一身矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790518836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背如有負，","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790535220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"袁天罡相馬周曰：馬君背若有負，貴驗也。後至宰相。昔行𨺚起，如負物在背也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豊厚突起，主後福，又云：多子孫，偏薄則貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790535220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790551604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954820515545125"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背脊豊隆福自堅，莫教偏薄損長年。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790551604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知三甲如何說，借問先生覔正傳。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790567988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三甲者，壘字也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論腰","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790584372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰者，爲腹之山，如物依山，以恃其安危也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790600756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故欲端而直，濶而厚者，福祿之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790617140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若偏而䧟，狹而薄者，𤰞賤之徒也。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994045467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以短薄者，多成多敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790633524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣長者，祿保永終。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994061851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直而厚者冨貴，細而薄者貧賤，凹而䧟者窮下，裊而曲者淫劣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790649908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𧋍蜴腰者，性寛而善；黃蜂腰者，性鄙而邪。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790666292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫臀高而腰䧟者，主賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790682676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰高而臀䧟者，主貧。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994078235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵腰欲","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790699060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954864199024690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端濶，臀欲平圓，則相稱也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790699060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行歩緩而輕，坐起直而平，前視如負物，後視如甲形，是謂有背無腰，初發平，平中滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790731828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有腰無背，初困中亨。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994094619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但於横發，多憂疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790748212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰背兩全，冨貴雙全，毁辱不能及，利害不能動，此乃腰背好也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790764596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：腰背負物似甲形，行輕坐起直而平。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790780980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有腰無背中年好，有背無腰早歲成。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790797364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹者，身之爐冶，所以包腸胸而化萬物者也，欲圓而長，厚而堅，勢欲垂而下，皮欲厚而清，故曰：腹圓向下，冨貴壽長。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790830132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹墜而垂，智合天機。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994111003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹象陰而藏物，勢欲向下，萬物皆聚，此所以爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994127387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹近上者，賤而愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790846516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹上而短，飯不滿碗。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994143771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹如抱兒，四方聞知。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994160155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皮厚者，少病而貴；皮薄者，多病而賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790862900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相腹篇","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790879284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負曰：腹小而下，大冨長者。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994176539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹大垂下，名遍天下。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994192923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994209307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954864199237682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如抱兒，萬國名題。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994209307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹如雀腹，貧賤無屋。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994225691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹有三甲，背有三壬，如此之人，法畜黃金。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790895668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹臍突出，壽命早卒。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790912052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：貌有殊形各有冝，腹皮垂厚足豊衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790928436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫言見一知㐫吉，須用畱心仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790944820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫胸者，百神之掖庭，萬機之枕府。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790977588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宮庭平廣，則神安而氣和；府庫傾䧟，則智淺而量小。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026790993972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故胸欲平而長，濶而厚，乃爲智高福祿之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791010356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫突而短，狹而薄者，乃","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791026740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954894125350921"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露貧薄之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791026740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸能覆身冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791043124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸短於而者，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994242075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"突然而起者，愚下。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994258459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窪然而傾者，貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994274843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平濶如底者，英豪。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994291227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狹窄如堆者，頑鈍。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994307611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨起如柴者，貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994323995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凹落如槽者窮毒。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994340379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸中黑子者，爲兵萬里，胸中毫毛，播名四方。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791059508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一二亳長而黑光者是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸濶而長者，財易積，胸狹而長者，謀難成。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994356763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉平勻者，仁智。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791075892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉高低者，愚狠。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994373147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣巳論乎胸，次則評乎乳。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791092276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳者，道血脉之英華，據心胸之左右，乃哺養子息之宮，爲辨别貴賤之表。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791108660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故乳欲得濶而黑，垂而墜，不可狹而白，曲而細也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791125044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以乳濶一尺二寸","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791141428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954894125465609"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者至貴，乳濶一尺者次貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791141428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭大者，志氣而多兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791157812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭小者，懦弱而絶嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994389531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭狹者，易貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791174196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭曲者，難養兒。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994405915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭仰者，子如玉。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791190580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭低者，兒如泥；=。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994422299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭壯而方大者，壽而福。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994438683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭白而黄者，賤而乏嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994455067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭紫如爛椹者，貴多子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994471451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭細如懸針者，財無一分。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994487835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄而無肉者，衣食不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791206964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實而有肉者，財帛豊隆。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994504219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭生毛者，多藏見解。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791223348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭黑子者，必生貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994520603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸中爲萬事之府，平正而廣濶者，冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791256116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凹凸而狹薄，","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994536987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954894125580297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994536987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男昂則愚，女昂則淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791272500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳爲血脉之穴，圓紫而垂下者，冨貴而多子。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026791288884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白小而斜狹者，窮困而蹇滞。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994553371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸狹而長，不可求望。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259863074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸廣而長，主得公王。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994569755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸短于面，法主鄙賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259879458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸上黑紫，爲兵萬里。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259895842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸獨高起，貧賤不已。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259912226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸若覆身，冨貴名真。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259928610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸不平均，未足爲人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259944994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸均平滿，豪播天畔。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259961378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸有毫毛，必主貴豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259977762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡十毫巳上，三毫巳上者，必主人長古。多毛生者，亦主貧賤，精長面出，卽爲第一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸廣而長，方智榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195259994146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260010530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954926220214281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸爲血氣之宮庭，平廣方而衣祿榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260010530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是偏斜并凹凸，定知勞碌過平生。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260026914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相心","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260043298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麻衣","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994586139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有心無相，相逐心生；有相無心，相隨心滅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260059682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯言雖簡，實人倫綱領之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260076066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心又爲五臟之主，宅神形體内，不可得而見也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260092450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其可見者，心之外表也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260108834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是知心乃神之宫室，玉戸金闕，智慮之所居。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260125218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心欲寛平博厚，不欲坑䧟窄狹。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260141602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寛博者，智慮深。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260157986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窄狹者，愚知淺。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994602523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心頭生毛，其性剛豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260174370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心頭骨凹，其性貪酷。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994618907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954926220361737"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：心爲身主，五宮之先。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260190754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神爲合止，智慮之元。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260207138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寛博平厚，榮祿高遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260223522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坑䧟偏側，貧弱夭年。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994635291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善則福至，惡則禍纏。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260239906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心宜坦然，先觀動静。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260256290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次見心田。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994651675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運智藏神，一體之先。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260272674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相者但能觀外表，内者誰能識得全。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260289058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○寛平榮貴，狹隘無錢。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260305442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不言不語心機重，發語無私梗直人，最怕笑來嗔怒者，口唇尖薄語非眞。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260321826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"詳三十六善養心要訣","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260338210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：身凸心須𢮥，心寛氣必和。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260354594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深沉言語少，終是福來多。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260370978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心思立功名，此心有剛柔，慕善近君子，有","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260387362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954957375455283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"美食分人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260387362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不評近小人。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994668059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行隂德方便。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260403746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能治家有法，不厭人乞覓。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994684443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常利人克已，不逐惡貪殺。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994700827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞事而不驚，與人不失信。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994717211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不易行攺換，夜臥不便睡。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994733595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"着馬上不囘顧，見人不憎怒。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994749979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不文過飾非，作事務周匝。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994766363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受人恩不忘，度量不褊窄。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994782747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不毀善害惡，能濟人之急。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994799131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不助强欺弱，常不忘故舊。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994815515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲事衆人同，不多言妄語。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260420130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得人物知感，言語有次序。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260436514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語次不先起，常務行善事。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994831899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不嫌惡衣食，能方圓隨時。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260452898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行善常不倦，能知人勞苦。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994848283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不念人舊惡，能竭心救難。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994864667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954957375586355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：人倫何處定枯榮，先相心田後相形。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260469282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心發善端諸福集，時藏毒害禍須生。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260485666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相臍","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260502050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臍爲觔脉之舍，六腑總領之關也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260518434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深濶者，智而有福。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260534818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺窄者愚薄。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994881051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向上者福智，向下者貧愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260551202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低者思慮逺，高者無識量。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260567586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大能容李，名播人耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260583970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或凸而出，淺而小，非善之相。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994897435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260600354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954957375668275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臍爲臟腑之父表，只要深寛怕窄小，居上則智，居下愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260600354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此理凡人知者少。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260616738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相下部","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260633122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"糓道急而方者貴，水道寛而圓者賤，大便細而方者貴，小便如撒珠者貴，陰生黑子者貴，隂莖聳出者賤，隂頭縮者貴，隂毛逆生者，夫婦不相和睦也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260649506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：大便遲緩者冨貴，速者賤，小便散如雨者貴，直下如篙攅者賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260665890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260682274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954984411955209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽夭窮通各有因，相來僻處便驚人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260682274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰頭有痣人多貴，糓道無毛一世貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260698658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穀道無毫，故賤相，而毫過多者，𦜶胱火盛，亦非貴相。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260715042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相行論","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260731426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫行者，爲進退之節，所以見貴賤之分也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260747810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之善行，如舟之遇水，無所往而不利也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260764194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不善行者，如舟之失，水必有漂泊没溺之患也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260780578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人之行，如水之流下而體不揺。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260796962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人之行，如火炎上身，輕脚重行，不欲昂首。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994913819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而脚不欲側，身不欲折。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260813346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚高則亢，太𤰞則曲，太急則暴，太緩則遲，周旋不失其節，進退各中其度者，至貴","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260829730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954984412086281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260829730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚跟不至地者，貧而夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260846114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發足如奔，散走他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260862498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵脚不欲折，頭不欲低，發足欲急，進身欲直，起步欲濶，俯然而往，不碍滯者，貴相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260878882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○龍行、虎步至貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260895266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鵝行鴨步豪富。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994930203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴行聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994946587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䑕行多疑慮。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994962971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛行巨冨。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994979355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇行性毒夭。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517994995739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀行食不足。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517995012123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鵲行狐獨。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517995028507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜行夀相。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517995044891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬行辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517995061275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行如流水，貴人行步沉重，榮貴行步輕驟，貧賤行步趨越。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260911650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明行步跳躍。","logicSentenceId":"7610706517995077659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狐獨行不低昂，冨貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145362953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：虎驟龍奔定貴榮，腰身端厚福來臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260928034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"累財積福家","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260944418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330954984412200969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥盛，看取牛龜鵝鴨行。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260944418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行如驟馬獲如猿，終日區區不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260960802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歩狹腰斜人最賤，趨翔中度富田園。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260977186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相行篇","logicSentenceId":"7580355195260993570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負曰：凡相行，須行十步卽喚廻頭，須看左轉，必有官職。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261009954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右轉無官職，又無衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145379337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行則龜行，必主聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261026338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行作鹿行、馬行，必主辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145395721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行不低昂，冨貴之相。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261042722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行步兩踵，相食早衰。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261059106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：凡相行，須令立定卽喚之舉足行。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261075490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若先舉左足者貴，先舉右足者賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261091874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行步低頭者多思慮，行步自言","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261108258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955021204406299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自語者賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261108258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行時一跬步而一俯一仰者，賤相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261124642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相坐","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261141026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行則属陽，坐則属隂，陽主動，隂主静。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261157410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凝然不動者，坐之德也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261173794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揺𦡀動者，財散之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261190178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反身轉首，入坐如狗，不端不正，貪薄之相，其貌不恭，其體不謹，謂之筋緩肉流，非壽相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261206562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐欲如山，行欲如水，體欲重，步欲舒，乃行坐之相法也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261222946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○坐如釘石貴，坐如山㨿貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261239330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐常揺膝，木揺葉落，人摇財散。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145412105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261255714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955021204520987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐如釘石起浮雲，情厚情寛說與君。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261255714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端重謹言多食祿，須知榮貴四方聞。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261272098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相人坐貌不須偏，擺膝摇身未是賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261288482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲事一身多妄語，必無珎寶住居邊。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261304866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臥者，休息之期也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261337634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲得安然而静，怡然不動，福壽之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261354018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如狗之蟠者，上相如龍之曲者，貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145428489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡而開口者，短命。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261386786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夢中咬牙者，兵死。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145444873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡中開眼者，惡死道路。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145461257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡中亂語，賤中奴僕。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145477641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仰形如屍者，貧苦短命。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145494025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臥中氣吼者，愚而易死。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145510409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合面覆臥者，餓死。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145526793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就床便困者，頑賤。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145543177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愛","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145559561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955021204619291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"側臥者，吉壽。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145559561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多展轉者，性亂。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145575945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少睡者，神清而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261403170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多睡者，神濁而賤。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145592329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臥易覺者，聰敏。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261419554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臥難醒者，愚頑。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145608713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喘息調勻者，命長。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145625097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出氣多而人氣少者，短命。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145641481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣出嘘嘘之聲者，卽死。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145657865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若睡臥輕揺，未𡮢安席者，下相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261435938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相臥","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261452322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡常龜息，氣出于耳，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580355195261468706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡輕易醒者，聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145674249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡如獖猪，氣相吼者，貧。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145690633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身如仰屍，氣粗如吼，睡不安席，展轉摇動者，皆下相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139004962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139021346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955056033923122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人臥起氣調勻，喘息恬然似不聞。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139021346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連睡一宵君不覺，手如攀物福神尊。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139037730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臥似獖猪氣不和，貧窮乏食走奔波。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139054114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更於夢裡多狂語，每向人前妄語多。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139070498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論食","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139086882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣血資之以壯，性命繫之以存者，飮食也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139103266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飮食矢節，則性暴不和矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139119650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故舉物欲徐而有序，嚼物欲寛而有容，下手欲緩，發口欲急，坐欲端莊，首欲平正。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139136034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"急而不暴，遲而不緩，應節者，相之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139152418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"含物不欲語，嚼物不欲怒。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139168802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食急者易肥，食遲者易瘦。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139185186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食少而肥者性寛。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139201570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955056034054194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食多而瘦者性亂。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145707017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食急性暴，食緩性和。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145723401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仰首含物者，寒賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139217954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如食而啄者，貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145739785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歛口食者，純和。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145756169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哆口食者，不義。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145772553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食而齒出者，辛苦短命。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139234338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食而淋落者，餓死路岐。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145788937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食如䑕者，餓夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139250722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食如馬者，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145805321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嚼似牛者，福祿。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145821705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食如羊者，尊榮。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145838089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食如虎者，將帥之權。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145854473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食如猴者，使相之位。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145870857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嚼在舌頭，一生寒苦；邊食遷顔，終身窮餓。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139267106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食欲快而不欲畱，欲詳而不欲暴，啜不欲聲，吞不欲鳴。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139283490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：虎食狼飡貴不同，逡廵不覺一盤空。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139299874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端詳遲緩宜","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139316258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955089600872486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相應，牛嚼羊吞福自豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139316258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳥啄猪飡最賤庸，相他衣祿必無終。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139332642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咽粗急者人多躁，䑕食從來飮食空。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139349026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：相食看詳緩，慌忙豈冝合。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139365410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更嫌如鳥啄，又忌食淋漓。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139381794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性暴吞須急，心寛下筋遲。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139398178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問君榮貴處，牛哺福相隨。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139414562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相德","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139430946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能忠於君，孝於親，爲衆德之先，衆行之表，不得陽賞，必爲隂報，不在其身，而在其子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139447330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善相者，先察其德，","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139463714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955089600954406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後相其形。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139463714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故德靈而形惡，無妨爲君子；形善而行㐫，難掩爲小人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139480098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荀子曰：相面不如相心，論心不如擇術。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139496482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此勸人爲善也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139512866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○形者，人之材也；德者，人之器也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139529250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"材旣美矣，而副之以德，猶加雕琢而成噐也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139545634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"噐遇拙工而棄之，是爲不材之材也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139562018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是知德在形先，形居德後也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139578402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○郭林宗觀人有九德：","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139594786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○一曰：容物之德。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145887241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰：樂善之德。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145903625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三曰：好施之徳。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145920009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四曰：進人之德。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145936393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曰：保常之德。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145952777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六曰：不忘之德。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145969161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七曰：勤身之德。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840145985545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八曰：愛物之德。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146001929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九曰：自謙之德。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146018313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955089601019942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：幾輩堂堂相貌精，幾人相貌太輕盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139611170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知說相無他技，先相修持後相形。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139627554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡在心，而見於貌，爲心之表也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139660322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"表端則心正，表𣣱則心曲。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139676706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：觀其表則知其裏矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139693090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：頭聳而堅，額方而廣。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139709474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉疎而秀，眼長而清。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146034697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳輪平厚，鼻梁聳直。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146051081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心廣而寛，背隆而厚。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146067465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中分明，口唇端正。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146083849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣和而順，聲圓而寛。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146100233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形正而峻，色明而","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146116617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955089601101862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146116617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言語有叙，飮食有節。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146133001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進退有儀，行坐有度。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146149385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人之相，而心之善行矣。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146165769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭尖額窄，眉重髪焦，耳反舌露，口大唇薄，赤脉貫睛，白暈入眼，神如驚，色如垢，凖頭尖，地閣削。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139807778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139824162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955118172471306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊目四白皆爲惡，耳小唇寛貌亦非。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139824162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒鼻偏斜心地窄，準尖額薄性情𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139840546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪驚蜂眼常懷毒，又說豺聲好害人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139856930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此形聲須攺節，莫敎隂禍自來侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139873314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：相惡元來是惡鄰，平生心不契蒼旻。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139889698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豺聲蜂目難作伴，不是人傷傷别人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139906082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
