{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白過面光凝脂，竦過於眉若有時，腹如抱兒臍納李。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139938850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂豊滿額相宜，日角光隆驛馬肥，司空平滿神","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139955234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955118172553226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光威。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139955234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將軍案上生紅紫，骨堅肉實行如飛。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139971618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睛如㸃漆耳門寛，壽上豊隆肉不乾。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314139988002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎視更加獅子鼻，眉踈清薄秀而彎。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140004386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四瀆清明及印堂，犀牛望月最爲强，日月𤂢天頦額古，膚薄色黃年少昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140020770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦而露骨人多難，火色鳶肩事必乖。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140053538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色不常隨語變，陰陽相反面塵埃。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140069922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形豊上銳筋纒束，顧視精神昏不開。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140086306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉尾毛旋并壓眼，懸針破印歩如雷，眉顰口小山根折，食物欲吞須哽噎，不知㗋結三兩重，定應肌","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140102690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955118172635146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨如氷鐵，聲似損鑼云不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140102690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面若塗膏名沐浴，此人重濁露胸臀。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140119074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南相枯乾形蹐跼。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140135458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當門兩齒號學堂，齊大面平信有常。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140168226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若諭忠信與慈孝，定知潔白氣温黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140184610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目細而深名隱僻，下斜偸視亦如然。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140217378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中正廣及狹下，笑冷無情露兩顴。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140233762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"突然項後肉且起，静坐不言口自褰。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140250146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢳸頭弄舌胸堂窄，𥧌語狂言豈是賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140266530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉斜如草","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140282914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955118172749834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竪還長，皮肉横生性暴剛。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140282914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睫下看人神反射，豺聲蜂目神光鮮。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140299298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳶肩虎吻并長鷙，赤縷干瞳氣不藏，音似破鑼枝幹折，心多姦賊主㐫亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140315682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火氣貫精，謂之眼帶殺。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140348450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色如昏醉，謂之神帶殺。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146182153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲如破鑼，謂之聲帶殺。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146198537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肢傷節破而體不具，謂之形帶殺。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146214921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好行賊害，謂之性帶殺。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146231305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳上涉惡深者，主㐫賊惡死。涉惡淺者，主沾宿疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尊嚴可畏，謂之威，主權𫝑也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140561442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如豪鷹搏兎，而百鳥自驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140577826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如怒虎出林，而百獸自戰。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146247689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢神色嚴肅，而人所自畏也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140594210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體貌敦重謂之厚，主福祿也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140610594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其量如滄海，其噐如萬斛之舟，引之不來，而𢳸之不動也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314140626978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清者，精神翹秀，謂之清，如桂林一枝，崑山片玉，酒然高秀而塵不染。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314220335139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或清而不厚，則近乎薄也。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146280457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955198330060827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六曰薄","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146362377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉是南方丙丁家，切冝踈秀有英華。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899419170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高高細曲橫天貴，不用低濃壓眼斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899435554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眼爲甲乙属東方，黑白分明𫝑要長。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899451938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疑然不動藏瞻視，必向清朝作棟梁。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899468322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○鼻爲","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899484706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955447454859315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛属西方，切要隆高貴印堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899484706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏曲左父右傷母，山根𨘣斷失須防。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899501090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○口爲戊巳土中央，唇若丹硃勢要長。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899517474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒白細多齊更宻，自然平地作公王。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899533858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○耳爲壬癸北方中，輪廓相朝白又紅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899550242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下有垂珠兼過口，壽齊松栢與山同。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899566626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五行相生歌","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899583010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳爲輪珠鼻爲梁，金水相生主大昌，眼明耳好多神。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899599394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣若不爲官冨更强，口方鼻直人雖貴，金土相生紫綬郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899615778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇紅眼黑木生火，爲人志氣足財粮。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899632162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌長唇正","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899648546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955447454892083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火生土，此人有福中年聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899648546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼長眉秀足風流，身掛金章朝省位。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899664930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五行相尅歌","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899681314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳大唇薄土尅水，衣食貧寒空有智。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899697698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇大耳薄亦如前，此相之人終不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146903049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻大眼小金尅木，一世貧寒主孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899714082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼大耳小學難成，雖有資財壽命促。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899730466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌小口大水尅火，急性孤单足人我。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899746850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳小鼻蠢亦不佳，慳貪心惡多灾禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899763234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌大鼻小火尅金，錢帛方盛禍來侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899779618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻大舌小招貧苦，壽長無子送郊林。","logicSentenceId":"7580355314899796002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼大唇小水尅土，此","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502153780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955447454957619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相之人終不冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502153780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇大眼小貴難求，到老貧寒死無墓。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502170164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五行比和相應","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502186548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳反須貼肉，鼻仰山根足。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502202932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼露黑睛，多唇反齒如玉。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146919433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臉不近於眼，合主公卿冨。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146935817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐壽不延，性氣剛難伏。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502219316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相五長","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502235700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一頭長，二面長，三身長，四手長，五足長，五者俱長，而骨貌豊隆，清秀滋潤者，善也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502252084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如骨枯稿，筋脉迸露，雖是五長，反爲賤惡之輩也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502268468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有足長手短者，主貧賤；","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502284852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955527284850725"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足短手長者，主冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502284852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：五長之人骨貌粗，只憂筋脉出皮膚。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502301236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又嫌枯稿無滋潤，衣食看來不似初。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502317620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：脚長手短人多賤，賣盡田園走四方。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502334004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手足俱長榮盛相，莫敎脚側手空長。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502350388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：大凡五體要均長，合形入相冨文章。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502366772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下停長者人多賤，又恐終身絶雁行。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502383156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955527284899877"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相五短","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502399540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五短之形，一頭短，二面短，三身短，四手短，五足短，五者俱短，而骨肉細滑，印堂明濶，五嶽朝揖者，乃爲公卿之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502415924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖是五短，而骨肉粗惡，五嶽傾䧟，則爲下賤之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502432308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或上長下短，則多冨貴；上短下長，主居貧下也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502448692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：五短之人形要小，更須骨細印堂豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502465076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"笏門五嶽相朝拱，食祿封矦有始終。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502481460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉圓眼大額如熊，脚短身","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502497844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955527284949029"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長上下同。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502497844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五短氣全爲証候，自然官祿至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502514228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相五合","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502530612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨正直而有隂陽，言正直而有剛柔，是爲天地相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502546996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"視瞻穩而聲音清，體貌重而行步輕，是爲天官相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502563380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣温粹而有光華，色淨潔而無瑕疵，是爲天心相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502579764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識量多而權亦重，度量大而面可訣，是爲天機相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502596148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敬上下而懷忠厚，愛朋友而足信行，是爲天倫相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502612532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"解曰：應多合少，官崇聲譽；合多應少，名重官矦。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502628916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應合相。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502645300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955527284998181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相五露","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502661684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼突、鼻仰、耳反、唇掀、結㗋是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502678068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眼突、促壽，耳反無知識，鼻仰，主路死，唇掀惡死，結喉必貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502694452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：一露二露，有衫無褲。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502710836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露不至五，貧夭孤苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502727220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五露俱全，福祿綿綿。","logicSentenceId":"7610706840146952201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：五露俱全福自來，二露三露反爲灾。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502743604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸門臀高爲外露，平生此相有何財。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502759988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○若遇三尖五露人，但言此相便埃塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502776372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時驛馬臨邊地，也作加官食祿人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315502792756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955599859073061"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭雖圓，折腰肢。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503611956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額雖廣，尖却頥。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063093258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨雖峻，皮却粗。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063109642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳雖厚，梁柱低。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063126026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪雖黑，粗且濃。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063142410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼雖長，眉且促。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063158794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背雖豈，手如枝。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063175178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸且濶，背成坑。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063191562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌雖紅，口如吹。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063207946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇雖方，齒不齊。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063224330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰雖厚，行如馳。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063240714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚雖厚，粗無紋。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063257098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身雖大，聲音細。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063273482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面雖白，色粗黑。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063289866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉雖豊，結却㗋。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063306250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面雖短，眼却長。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063322634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣雖清，行步欹。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063339018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語雖和，人似痴。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063355402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色雖明，視東西。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063371786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐雖正，食淋漓。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063388170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上二十種，皆有美惡相雜。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503628340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若此相者，或冨則夭，或貧則壽，或貴則貧，或先冨而後貧，或先貴而後賤，冝精思而裁之也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503644724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955599859122213"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"形神","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503661108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相人之形，又當相神。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503677492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神在眼，眼惡則傷和，恐招橫禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503693876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不欲露，露則魂遊，遊則必亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063404554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神貴則隱，然望之，有畏服之心，近則神喜，就之則爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503710260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡相寧可神有餘而形不足，不可形有餘而神不足也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503726644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神有餘者貴，形有餘者冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503743028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不欲驚，驚則損壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503759412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不欲急，急則多惧。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063420938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又當相人，噐識寛宏則能容而德乃大；識高則能曉而心乃靈。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315503775796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"噐淺卑，雖有餘資，則君子未免爲小人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699286056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955599859154981"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"精神","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699302440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一見精神瞻視速，坐來却慢事如何。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699318824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中年定有貧窮厄，破了田園事不多。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699335208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初見精神慢不全，坐來致久色方鮮。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699351592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初年雖則爲貧士，老後榮名必定賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699367976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相十天羅","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699384360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿面黑色四起者，謂死氣天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699400744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色者，爲䘮哭天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699417128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○青色者，爲憂滯天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699433512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黄色者，爲疾病天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699449896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○如脂膏塗抹者，爲酒食天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063437322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眼流而視急者，爲奸媱天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699466280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色焦如火者，爲破敗天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699482664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○如醉未醒者，","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699499048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955674781761587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲刑獄天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699499048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○語笑失節者，爲鬼掩天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699515432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣如霧昏者，爲退敗天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699531816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"又相十一天羅","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699548200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形曜天羅會者稀，額偏腦側更無鬚，印堂唇薄皮細急，休望文章折桂枝○休廢天羅不可當，唇如牛肉面澆湯，青藍滿面焦枯色，使盡家財免禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699564584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○女面天羅色易明，貌如婦女又嬌聲，家財巨萬徒然有，虚負平生志不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699580968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○脂粉天羅面似油，浮光烟熖急須收，文章縱有無官祿，妻子及刑始得休。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699597352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○光砑天羅","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699613736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955674781794355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色似銀，面如綳皷起埃塵，須然面帶紅光色，虚氣元來到底貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699613736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○𩹌寡天羅赤色多，兩𧢲旋成螺，語輕粉面無冨貴，二十看看赴泪羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699630120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○井竈天羅會者稀，鼻頭仰露齒牙踈，有時行動胸堂突，休把文章赴棘𨵾。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699646504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○倒曜天羅旺不朝，桃花之面語輕飄，冨貴之家生此子，縱有千金日漸消。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699662888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○刑獄天羅目反晴，面横脂色小人情，黑色面豊來往見，前途恐有市遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699679272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○崇砂天羅遍若涯，鼻頭斑㸃𠃶如麻，狡貪色濫還奸𥨸，下稍孤苦總堪嗟。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699695656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○急脚天羅頭帶偏，生居正在印","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699712040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955674781843507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂邊，抛祖離親防父母，辛苦三更不得眠。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699712040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：男兒不欲帶女色，女人不欲帶男形。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699728424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂反於陽夭必死，老帶嫰色壽年傾。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699744808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丈夫女子兩般詳，女要柔兮男要剛。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699761192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子属隂本要静，不言先笑亦非良。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699777576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"良婦有威而無媚，娼婦有媚而無威。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699793960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令人一見便生侮，是以生身落賤微。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699810344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"神氣章","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699826728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神濁氣清神不見，神清氣濁氣無形，直須神氣俱清","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699843112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955674781892659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"快，神氣元來忌大清。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699843112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大清曰孤，大濁曰愚。","logicSentenceId":"7610707463063453706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤而露則貧，濁而暗則賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699859496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神愁自然偏多蹙，氣蹙山來懷不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699875880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多憂却是一生娱，遇喜須臾生悲哭。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699892264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看氣促人風韻，宜逺觀兮不冝近，無憂愁嘆或嗟吁。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699908648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不和兮命将盡，胸中洞徹神在眼，神在眼兮事何限。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699925032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼神穩静必台輔，眼神端正司臺諫。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699941416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"計足謀多神氣俊，暗暗奸斜神氣傾。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699957800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要須人彩與人交，一生得意無消散。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699974184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君不見，萍梗相逢古友義，從前傾葢與識面，執手交歡與論文。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315699990568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每嘆相逢何大晚，奸婬之目神光鮮。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700006952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生須得","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700023336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955674781925427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神在眼。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700023336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神在眼兮事何限。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700039720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇目神居兩目尖，羊目神垂四方轉，牛眼神光不動𢳸，虎視耽耽威𫝑猛，神靈省睡多聰𧇖，將𢨾神昏足貧賤，斜視隨神自去來，淫亂幽居與深院。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700056104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論神居目與晴，要須傾復細叮嚀。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700072488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相形先得神所止，决定言談有重輕。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700088872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重輕在人不在目，以神寓目分遲速。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700105256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窹則神游寐處心，心處于形安可卜，實因氣引血通流，通流血化精神流。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700121640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神清定則心守宅，氣清息則守其魂。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700138024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神與魂游魂守氣，生死存亡在斯義。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700154408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽安之人神遂悟，將死之人神以去。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700170792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神窹","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700187176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955674781990963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方能守耻亷，神去不能認其故，經年面上無光色，舉動逐時人事攺。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700187176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"攺常葢爲神不靈，因踈骨肉身懈怠。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700203560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神離言亂出口忘，神昏妄語臥方床。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700219944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神爲鬼奪肉枯稿，神爲人奪精荒唐。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700236328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有精養血神氣見，精脫氣竭神俱亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700252712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精神似得不衰耗，氣血欲得不損傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700269096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神勞四肢不能久，神去觸事無威光。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700285480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神與氣兮兩相守，神旣病兮氣何久。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700301864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神使機關主動𢳸，五行在氣相纏守。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700318248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣在丹田聲逺聞，氣短聲低如㺅猻。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700334632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣結于肺鼻必滯，氣結于肝眼必翳，神氣慿君仔細看，賢愚莫出言談義。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700351016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955674782023731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不怒兮氣不住，氣住令人成病痼。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700367400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣假于血而成形，癭癅癰節從此病。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700383784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲病之色與氣離。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700400168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣不青兮色玄合，氣玄三月憂病符，氣赤目前官事咂，得財聞喜復何如。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700416552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準上天地漫如蠟，氣若浮雲色若天。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700432936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色有正定本自然，金得白兮火必赤，黄黑青兮色如焉。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700449320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有氣色無定處，朝吉祥兮暮憂苦，亦如雲霧在青天。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700465704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曉則晴兮夜風雨，色自色兮氣則氣，勸君要取玄談義。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700482088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神氣未容人易去，氣色聲玄由宻秘。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700498472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生造物五行中，每與天地相流通。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700514856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神流如夢如影響，目力觀兮如","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700531240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955674782072883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日象。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700531240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夜夢火燔心必𤍠，腎虚渉水乘扁舟。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700547624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始知神氣難尋論，指下分明亦關寸。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700564008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘藏何須諊細微。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700580392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神氣一觀君試問。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700596776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷死言神與見機，憑神不必師玄遁。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700613160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試聽壽夭容易見，體論目前分貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700645928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉動堂堂出衆儀，吐珠出語超群彦。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700662312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之若流坐如擲，動似浮雲静如石。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700678696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動静之中體用殊，更看作事操胸臆。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700695080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴨步鵝行主冨榮，鶴形龜息壽彌高，結㗋露齒多貧賤，騾嘴猪唇身必勞。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700711464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身如鼉皮必下愚，面若塵灰多乞化。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700727848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻露","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700744232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955756855902258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竅兮主無安，齒露齦兮文學失。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700744232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟卿非相殊可師，徒見文兮不見斷。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700760616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相形不論心所爲，慢恃形容寜冨貴，仁存心兮義處身，何必清眸與高鼻。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700777000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屈原鼻斷竅莊周，唇露齒，原豈虚誕妄。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700793384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周豈文學鄙。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700809768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下分明有臥蚕。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700826152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過壽侵年隂隲氣，耳内生毫忽夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700842536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鵝行鴨歩忽零替，目下須無痣，終歲常垂涙。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700858920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口低二𧢲垂，乞食與街市。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700875304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憑君目有看神氣，人道更將人事比。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700891688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内狠之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355315700908072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面惨然内𤍠之人言語利，善人簡略言辭間，舉止謙謙不自滿。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236156963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以仁擇其心，以義斷其人。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236173347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敬老慈幼憐寒","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236189731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955756855951410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤，遇物常懐不忍看。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236189731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積毀可消骨，積德可忘怨。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236206115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每在人事不在逺，天理之爲君。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236222499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試看相與神氣扶，更在當爲善。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236238883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一如成金人，始因逢百煉","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236255267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行秀氣生英特，體貌堂堂佐明國。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236288035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其噐由如百斛舟，引之𢳸動不可得。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236304419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭圓象天足象地，血脉江河與同類。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236320803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草木旣與毛髪俱，聲象雷霆分巨細。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236337187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉須相副，皮膚須潤膩，歩驟輕快怕偏側，又要骨重兼軟美。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236353571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五長之人隔江聲可聞。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236369955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五短之人要堅實。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236386339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼不欲満，","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236402723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955756855984178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長眉目分。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236402723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形象相刑相尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236419107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"存斯勻。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236435491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五短推排細尋趂。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236451875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其言人定形，形以剛柔應，五位皆有相尅勝。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236468259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣在五相最爲定，不用他觀與我求，識取休囚旺相神。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236484643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如木形生修長，頭短肩縮幼年亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236501027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然乍肥與乍白，定知客死在他鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236517411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金形方兮水圓秀，骨肉敦宏上重厚。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236533795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土形氣青官鬼臨，水形金形同納音。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236550179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金盈赤兮主憂滯，金得青兮多稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236566563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要識人生俱五行，乍勝乍舉同斯文。","logicSentenceId":"7580355316236582947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955851823530019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"神相全編卷之五","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025254415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"宋希夷陳摶秘傳 ","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"明柳庄袁忠徹訂正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"神異賦","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025287183","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有序。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五代間，有聖人陳摶，宋太祖賜其號曰希夷先生。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025303567","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陳摶，字圖南，自號扶揺子。精相法，𡮢相宋太祖。後乘驢入小路，聞宋太祖卽位，大笑墜地。曰：天下定矣。太祖召至，以野服見，服華陽巾還山，賜號白雲先生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"師麻衣，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025319951","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃仙翁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學相，諭以冬深擁爐而敎之。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025319951","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷如期而往，至蕐山石室之中。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025336335","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955839559368767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蕐山石室，乃麻衣先生修道之地也。後希夷亦隱于此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不以言語而度與，希夷隠而授之也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723583018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"但用火筋畫字于爐灰之中，以傳授此賦，又名金鎖賦，又别有銀匙歌，悉皆授之，希夷，盡其學也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：相有前定，世無預知。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025352719","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"欲預知相之前定，都非奇妙異常之資不能知。然密授此書者，又豈世俗凡下之人所能解推哉？意必希夷能之者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非神異以秘授，豈塵凡之解推。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025369103","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之生也，富貴、貧愚，夀夭、福禍、善惡，一定於相之形貌、皮髪、骨格、氣色、聲音焉，世人無有能預知者。惟希夷而巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955907423141903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫舜目重瞳，遂獲禪堯之位；","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025385487","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舜，虞帝名。瞳目，童子也。舜有重瞳之異相，遂受帝堯之禪而有天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重耳駢脅，果興霸晉之基。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723599402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重耳，晉文公名。駢，幷也。文公有駢脅之奇骨，果興晉室之基，而成霸業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發石室之丹書，莫忘吾道；剖神仙之古秘，度與希夷。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025401871","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"麻衣謂：今日開發石室冊寶之書，剖破古仙秘奥之傳受爾。希夷，吾之相法，盡於此矣，當念念不忘。可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當知骨格爲一世之榮枯，氣色定行年之休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025418255","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"骨格無異，相之體也，則一世之榮枯，可由此而知。氣色旋生，相之用也，則判行年之休咎，可由此而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955909033705511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能。知者叅之，人之貴賤，思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停平等，一生衣祿無虧。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025434639","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自髪際至印堂，爲上停，山根至于準頭，爲中停，人中至地閤爲下停，此面上三停也。頭、腰、足，爲身上三停也。古云：面上三停，额、鼻、閣。身上三停，足、頭、腰，三停平等。多衣祿；長短如差，福不饒。則衣祿豐虧。於此可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五嶽朝歸，今世錢財自旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025451023","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左顴爲東嶽，右顴爲西嶽，額爲南嶽，地閣爲北嶽，鼻爲中嶽也。此五嶽欲其朝拱豊隆，不宜缺陷傷破。混儀云：五嶽不正，相君終始，薄寒 ；入卦高隆，須是多招財祿。則錢財旺相，於此知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頦爲地閣，見晩歲之規模。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025467407","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955955519143970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□厚者富饒，尖削者貧薄。凡相人，末限在此地，閣爲水星。屬下停，若推金。水形人，尤準也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻乃財星，管中年之造化，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025483791","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"豊隆端正者貴顯，掀露斜曲者下賤。凡相人，中限在此。鼻乃土星，屬居中停。若推土形人，最應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額方而濶，初主榮華；骨有削偏，早年偃蹇，","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723615786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額爲火星，乃官祿父母之宮，在限爲初，若方正寛濶，必主初年榮華。其骨削偏䧟，須早歲見不利矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目淸眉秀，定爲聰俊之兒；","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025500175","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉分羅計，目属隂陽。眉宜秀而不粗散低垂，目宜淸而不昏暗斜視，知富貴早，必爲聰明俊秀之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣濁神枯，必是貧窮之漢。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723632170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相中言神氣最多，人所難辨。觀夫白閣道者云：神氣者，百閱之秀裔也，如陽氣舒而山川秀發。日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955909033869351"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出而天地清明，在人爲一身之主，諸相之驗。故清鑒云：大都神氣賦於人，有似油兮又似燈，氣神不濁人自富，油清然後燈方明。然則神氣濁枯者，終身不逺之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭高聳，少年富貴，可期。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025516559","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天庭位印堂之上，髪際之下，以其處于至高之位，故曰天庭。宜高聳如立壁，覆肝無瑟紋偏陷，更兼五嶽朝拱，勿必顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣方圓，晩歲榮枯，定取","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025532943","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025532943","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地閣在承漿之下，颐頦之間，爲田宅奴婢之宫，若方則貴，厚則富可期，薄則貧，方又圓，末主榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"視瞻平正，爲人剛介，平心。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723648554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"視不欲偏斜，若斜視者，其人奸邪，心必險惡，正視心地坦直，志氣剛介耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955955519340578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冷笑無情，作事機深，内重","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723664938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723664938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡與謀爲，惟冷笑而不言情由者，其人機謀必深。而難測，心量必重而不輕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準頭豊大心無毒，面肉橫生，性必凶。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723681322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"準頭爲土星，主乎信。若豊大如獅子截竹者，心必善，如鷹嘴者。性多毒也。○面肉卽顴骨與肉俱露，而横生者，其性必凶暴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723697706","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"智慧生於皮毛，苦樂觀乎手足，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025549327","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皮膚細腻光瑩，毛髪踈秀潤澤者，主智慧聰明。若反此者，必粗俗之人也。○手指節枯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025549327","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大粗硬。足背瘦長乾燥者，其人必辛苦；手若細軟潤澤，足若骨肉圓肥者，其人必然逸樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025549327","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際低而皮膚粗，終見愚頑。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025565711","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指節細而脚背肥，須知","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723714090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955973093294092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俊雅。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723714090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"髪際若額而低，皮膚燥枯而粗者，畢竟愚頑之徒也。○指節細潤如春葱，脚背肥豐而有肉者，必俊秀閑雅之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富者自然體厚，貴者定是形殊。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025582095","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"體貌豊隆者，倉庫形相異常而必貴；清奇者，骨格無𧇊而必富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方貴宦淸高，多主天庭豐濶","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025598479","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025598479","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南方以天庭爲主，天庭爲額，乃火星也。南方之人，若頭額豊濶而不偏䧟，官禄星得纒，故多爲清高。貴宦人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方公侯大貴，皆由地閣寛隆。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723730474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956000381485096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"北方以地閣爲主，地閣爲頦，乃火星也。北方之人，若頥頦寛隆而朝天庭，若臣相得局，故多爲大貴公矦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重頥豐頷，北方之人貴且强","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025614863","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025614863","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頦頥肥大而若重，兩腮頷濶而如燕頷者，貴相，北人尤强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"駝背面田，南方之人富而足。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723746858","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"駝背豐厚類駝峯，面貌方圓如田字。南方之人有此相者，既云富足矣，觀夫上文有曰：南方貴宦清高，多主天庭，似乎相戾。及觀廣鑒云：浙人俗于清，若面背豐厚，得北方厚重之相，不貴而富矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河目海口，食祿千鍾","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025631247","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025631247","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼爲四瀆之官河也；口爲百納之官海也。自若光明而不露，口若方正而不反，貴顯食祿千鈡，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955973093490700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"河目海口者，言有容納而不反露也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鐵面劍睂，兵權萬里","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723763242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723763242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鐵面者，神氣黑若鐵色也。劍眉者，稜骨如劍脊也。此相乃羅計橫行於天位，水氣遠居於火方，非兵權萬里之兆歟？言神氣忽變而黒色，定主凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍顔鳳頸，女人必配君王。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723779626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍貌如龍光之秀異，而頸若彩鳳之非常，乃后妃之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燕頷虎頭，男子定登將相。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025647631","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頷在頦額之問，骨肉豐滿稍起者，如燕頷也。頭頷方圓，口眼俱大，視有威神者，如虎頭也。男子有此者，超羣之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956045130416180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相中訣法，壽夭最難，不獨人中，惟神是定。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025664015","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相書中訣法，惟壽夭爲最難，如郭林宗觀人人法而不及壽夭者，非難，而何？不獨曰人中爲保壽宮。欲分明如破竹之形者，壽，要當以神氣爲之主也。學者宜叅之可矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目長輔采，榮登天府之人；神短無光，早赴幽冥之客。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025680399","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"輔即星輔眉也。采卽光也。若目細長而有神，眉清秀而有光，必聰明登第之士也。○目神短促而無光，視瞻無力而昏暗者，主天折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面皮虗薄，後三十壽難再期","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025696783","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025696783","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虗者，肉不稱骨也；薄者，有皮而無肉也。故經云：面皮急如鼓，不週三十五。此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉色輕浮，前四九如何可過。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723796010","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956027199881279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肉者，骨之營衛，體之基本也。色者，氣之精粹，神之胎息也。肉宜稱骨而實，色冝有氣而顯，若輕薄浮暗者，必天。故經云：肉緩筋寛色又嫩，三十六前是去程。正此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𩀱絛項下，遇休咎而愈見康强","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025713167","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025713167","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘭堂左右有兩紋，下至于項首，謂之壽絛，主壽。老人有此絛，苦，遇休囚而不凶，愈見其康吉矣。故經云：眉毫不如耳毫，耳毫不如頃下絛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡骨頂頭中，有疾厄而終無艱險。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723812394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一作凡骨頂中，葢謂頂額有几貴骨，然人難得俱全，恐非是。終不若凡骨頂中爲有理。但凡奇有奇。骨生於頂中者，雖有疾厄，而終無危險。古云：面無善靨，頭無惡骨，此其証者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨髪旋生，形容忽變，遇吉則推，逢凶可斷，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025729551","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956045130612788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫人未貴之先，雖有骨格，既仕之後，旋有形容；未富之前，雖有形容，既富之後，忽有變更，葢骨随貴生，肉隨財長，而形有五行之分。病徃於飽煖，憂出於極樂，其氣有色之變。學者仔細推之，吉㐫可斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常遭疾厄，只因根上昏沉。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723828778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"根卽山根，位在印堂之下，與年壽上位。如疾病宫，宜神色光明，不欲昏暗。而不明者，常有疾厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頻遇吉祥，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025745935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂福堂潤澤。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025745935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福堂在雨眉之上，華葢之傍，若常明潤而色紅黃者，有吉祥而無凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"涙堂深陷，蠧肉橫生；鼻凖尖垂，人中平滿，尅兒孫之無類，刑嗣續之難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723845162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下眼眶爲淚堂，宜豐滿，不欲深陷。眶中肉虗若腫，曰蠧肉，不宜横生。鼻尖爲中，宜齊大，不欲尖垂。凖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956027200028735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下善上，形如破竹而仰者，曰人中，又名曰溝洫。宜深長，不欲平滿。葢淚堂，爲男女子孫之宮，凖與人中乃宫室奴婢之位。若有此破䧟，主兒孫之有剋也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼不哭而淚汪汪，心不憂愁眉縮缩，早無刑剋，老見孤单。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025762319","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若眼不哭泣，而兩淚汪汪而濕，心無憂愁，而雙眉颦縮，此刑尅孤。獨之相也。古云：不哭常如淚，非愁却似愁。憂川常不□，榮樂半途休，學者宜細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面似橘皮，終主貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723861546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"滿面毛竅如塵垢所拭，云橘皮面是也。百一歌云：面色似橘皮，孤刑定不疑。須然生一子。却換兩重妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956091926331426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神帶桃花，也須皃晚。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723877930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若神色如桃花，嬌嫩邪淫，此等之人，恐生子不早也。○鬼谷詩云：桃花色重仍侵目，戀酒迷花寵外妻，信乎生子必晚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肩峩聲泣，不賤則孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025778703","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻若梁低，非貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723894314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肩不欲聳而若寒，聲不欲散而似哭。有此二者，貧賤孤刑之相。○鼻梁乃年壽之位，不宜低凹。有若此者，必傷財壽，非貧則夭。古云：山根斷，凖頭高，到老受設淘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴多生勞漉，爲下停長。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025795087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中停長遇君王，上停長幼善祥，下停長老吉昌。三停平等，富貴綿綿。若下停長者，未須富貴，未免平。生勞漉也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956081977442345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧窮到老不閑。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723910698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粗其骨格。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025811471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用骨格宜隆晉淸明，與氣肉相滋者，乃富貴安逸之相。若暴露粗大，氣肉不稱者，必貧窮奔波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰失䧟，部位偏虧，無隔宿之儲糧，有終身之勞苦。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723927082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如眼爲日月而不明，鼻為土星而不隆，此星辰之失陷也。餘皆傲此。額位乎天，宜高而反低；額位乎地，宜厚而反薄，此部位之偏虧也。餘亦傲此。相有如此，貧賤孤苦，終身芳漉，而無隔宿之糧也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三光明旺，財自天來；六府高强，一生富足。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025827855","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩福星及準頭曰三光，若明淸而不暗，主有天財大吉。餘謂五是即三光。○兩顴、兩頰、兩額角曰天府，若豐隆朝拱者，不貴，必然定爲富矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅光滿面，發財，家自安康。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723943466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956091926511650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五色惟白黑宜秋冬，青宜春，獨紅黄四季皆吉。若滿面常帶紅黃之色者，發财安康之福相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸脂砑光，尅子，終無成日。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723959850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"諸脂者，即面若塗膏也。砑光者，即帛用砑石、砑光之類也。面色有如此者，名爲沐浴大維，多主刑尅。子孫之相也，孛者，宜細推之可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面皮太急，雖溝洫長而壽亦虧。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723976234","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若面皮與肉俱急，如綳鼓，雖然人中深，終無壽之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩目無神，縱鼻梁高，而壽亦促。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723992618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼爲上相，以神爲主，骨法次之。若目神光，縱使鼻梁髙聳，亦非壽相之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼光如水，男女多淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025844239","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂卓如刀，陣亡兵死。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724009002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956081977589801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼光，睛之神光也。常要明静，不冝戾濕。故經云：眼濕多淫慾，為元定不祥。又云：光不欲射外，神不欲流出。若目如水，兼邪視者，邪淫人也。○睂爲羅計，其骨勢□竪似刀者，性燥好勇，終主暴亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂生二𧢲，一生快樂無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724025386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"目秀𠜍形，敢取中年遇貴。二睂俱有兩尾如角而起者，不貴，則安闕之人。○兩目細長，若𠜍形，黑白分明而清秀者，中年顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄氣發從高廣，旬日内必定轉官，黑色横自三陽，半","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025860623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年期，須防損壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025860623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黄氣，喜色也。高廣，傍太陽近邉也。此位若黄氣見者，必遷官。庶人有此氣者，亦主喜慶吉兆。○三陽在目之下，若黑氣見此位者，須防身灾不逺，亦防子疾，與女人在右。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門靑慘，必主妻災。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025893391","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽赤光，多生膿血。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025909775","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956133814878208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"奸門位在魚尾後，爲要妾宮。若青黑之色見此位者，必妻亥有灾。○年壽二宮在鼻準之上，山根之下，爲疾厄宮，若紅赤之色見此位者，主生瘡疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白氣如粉，父母川傷；靑色侵顴，兄弟唇舌。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025926159","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白氣主丧□，若在父母宮見者，必主刑傷。○顴位正面者，靑色，侵此位者，主兄弟辰舌之憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根靑黑，四九前後定多災；法令綳纒，七七之數焉可過。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724041770","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山根位在年之上，若此位常有靑黑之色者，其年主災疾。○蘭臺之傍曰法令，又名金縷，又名壽帶。宜顯順，若綳急而不顯，纒曲而不順，兼若騰蛇鎖唇而入口者，皆不壽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子眼惡，嫁卽刑夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025942543","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲刹面橫，閨房獨宿。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025958927","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956133584142377"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女人之眼，宜細長而淸秀，若圓大凹露，則惡相顯然，便爲刑夫之格矣。○若聲似破鑼，面肉橫生者，必主寡居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額尖耳反，雖三嫁而未休；顴露聲雄，縱七夫之不了。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724058154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古云：顧失削耳反，乃三夫之婦也。○古云：尅婿兩賴露，刑夫額不平。要知二度嫁女作丈夫聲，亦此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額偏不正，内淫而外貌若無；步走不正，外好而中心最惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025975311","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭額爲諸陽之首，不宜偏削。若偏而不正，及舉止輕浮而不穩重者，多主淫蕩。○行歩不平，正如風柳，乃蛇行雀躍之相，主心地險惡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956175871066146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腮見耳後，心地狡貪；眼惡鼻","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025991695","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾，中心險毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025991695","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腮即頤也，頤骨不宜太濶露。古云：耳後見垂腮，平生無徃來，必主心地狡猾贪鄙。○古云：眼若凸露。人情難睦，鼻如鷹嘴，喫人心髓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚根不着地，賣盡田園而走他。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724074538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄕。行歩爵重，富而財豐。若行歩輕浮不停，如雀躍之状者，爲破財奔彼之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻竅露而仰，卒被外災，而終旅舎。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143026008079","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：鼻仰辰孤及結喉，夭亡限跡，而走他鄉，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇不葢齒，無事招嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143026024463","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"溝洫露。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143026040847","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此爲人少力。不笑而齒龈常露者，好談人過，與衆不和。經曰：齒䟱唇露不合口。唇尖薄是□多，故招人嫌。正謂此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956133584306217"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。○溝洫卽人中不宜無髭，若少髭而人中露者，其人主一生勞碌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂太窄，子晩妻遲；懸壁昏暗，入亡家破。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143026057231","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印堂宜豐隆，太窄，若此者，不惟無宫，抑且妻子不早○，懸壁爲奴婢。宫宜光潤，若氣色昏暗者，主死亡破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
