{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若間前程，先要觀乎氣色，欲求仙兆，次則辯其形容，先以五岳爲根基，後以氣色定禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483940358","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言相人之法，先察此四者，吉凶貴賤可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大則活人性命，小則救人難厄。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483956742","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956978933563432"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相法，小而言之，預知吉凶，可以使人避凶趨吉；大而言之，决知生死，如師德上舟而凶。人免溺，可以使人免福獲福矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不爲世見隂功，亦作來生道果。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483973126","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"學相者，窮通此理，其術有益於人。其報亦及乎已也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"志超雲处，上合天機。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483989510","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"麻衣言：既通出世之術，妙合天機之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眞乃神仙之術，豈虛語哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽夭窮通，莫逃相法，富貴貧賤，奚出此篇。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445720611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明智者得之，自有神仙之見，智術之士，能精此篇，兼得師傳，非仙而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後之學者，勿傳庸俗之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445736995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375481867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"風鑑之術，于變萬化，窮通物理，豈庸夫俗子之流，所能學哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高山流水少知音，一榻白雲在深處。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484005894","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此篇譬如高山流水之操，尹音者鮮矣。乆隱於華山石室。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白雲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"深處，今遇知音希夷，故默而授之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悉精妙理，叅透玄關，得之於心，應之於目，一覽無遺，方知神異賦之不誣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445753379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"苟能悉精此□之妙理，叅透其中之玄關，了然於心目之間而無遣，方知神異賦之妙。信不誣矣。後之學者，當敬授兹篇，不可以其易而忽之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"神眼經","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445769763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"巖電道人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十年後有顯官，妙矣希夷之語。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445786147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957018011861027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"林放，字明逸，隱居林谷，往見陳希夷先生。一日，令洒掃庭除，曰：有嘉客至。明逸作樵夫拜庭下。希夷挽其上曰：君豈樵者？二十年後當有顯官，名聲聞于天下，後爲諌議大夫，改爲工部侍郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百日内秉國政，至哉唐舉之言。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445802531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蔡澤求唐舉相，曰：先生相李斯，百日之内秉國政。有之？曰：有之。蔡澤曰：臣如何？唐舉曰：吾聞聖人不相，殆先生乎？祭澤知唐舉戲之曰：富貴吾賦，自有所不知者，壽也。曰：先生之壽，從今以始。四十三歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"容貌雖出乎天然，貴賤不逃于風鑑。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445818915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴形龜息，棄書往康盧而得神仙。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445835299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宋朝陳摶有風鑑歌。○呂洞賔，唐天寶中十四年四月十四日巳時生。幼習儒業，進士岀身，開元中授江州徳化縣令。眞人鶴形龜息，虎體龍腮，鳳眼而聳，雙眉入鬂，頭濶身長。頂華陽冠，身彼唐衣，似","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375514635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"漢張子房形容。一日私行徐歩至廬山，道逢鍾離眞人，同懸葫蘆，悟一飯黄梁之語，遂棄官修道後，受天仙：一除煩惱，二去貪癡，三除淫慾，遍度有緣之人，道號純陽子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燕頷虎頭，投筆出陽關而成功業。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445851683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相者謂班超曰：君虎頭燕頷，飛而食肉，萬里矦相也。後投筆硯，出玉門關，立大功，威鎭西城。封定遠矦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白于面，終爲栍石之臣；舌紅如硃，必處廟堂之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445884451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歐陽公云：少時有相者曰：耳白于面，唇不葢齒。後官至宰相。○相法云：舌如硃紅，位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭起至玉枕，乃極品官。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445900835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：角近映珠庭，非庸人相。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445933603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相法云：天庭骨至玉枕，官居三品也。○李白舉明經，李絳曰：日角珠庭，非庸人相。明經，碌碌非子所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957048252760064"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇不着齒，善謂金鼎之羮；口可容奉，能借玉階之地。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484022278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歐陽修至宰相，相者云：唇不着齒，無事得謗。○昔日宋文圭舉進士，途中遇一叟，目文圭乆之曰：拳必人目，神仙伏也。如學道，當冲虚，不爾有大名于天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍鳳姿，天日表，知必安民；熊虎狀，豺狼聲，終當滅後。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445949987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唐太宗四歳，有書生見曰：龍鳯之姿，天日之表。年幾冠。必能濟世安民。○楚司馬子良生子越椒，子文曰：必殺之。是子也，熊虎之状，豺狼之聲，弗殺，必滅若傲氏矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂光瑩，天下文名，骨法異常，人中真貴。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484038662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"袁天罡相岑文本曰：學堂瑩，夷眉過眼，故文章振天下。○豫音。相者游錢唐，見五代錢鏐曰：此眞貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375547403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人也，骨法非常，而常願自安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出將入相，都緣足下龜紋，背印封矦，葢爲頂中犀骨。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445966371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下命論：河目龜紋，公矦之相。註曰：足下有龜紋也。○相法云：自天庭起伏，犀骨貫頂，位至封矦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡後氣從耳出，貴則無疑；笑則唇揭露牙，貧焉可見。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445982755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"袁天罡相本嶠云：睡後氣從耳出，名龜息，此大貴也。○相法云：笑語掀唇露齒，主貧賤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶定矣，富貴昭然。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445999139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見于隂徳之中，又在于形相之外。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446015523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形狀不吉，隂德文現，亦主富貴。○荀子非相篇云：相形不如相心。麻衣道者云：有心無相，相逐心生；有相無心，相隨心滅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957048253022208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位登宰相，自授夫犀帶之功。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484055046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"裴晋公形相眇小，有相者曰：郎君若不至貴，必當餓死。一日遊香山寺，有婦人以父被罪，假得玉帶三，犀帶一，以賄津要，□于𱤚楯，忘收之，度得而還之。後見相者曰：必有隂德及人，前途萬里，非某所知也，後官至宰相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"選中狀元，由造乃蟻橋之力。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446031907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宋郊入試，相者見之，未許其登第，歸于宿處，時大雨。花臺水將没。有蟻萬計周全無計。郊以竹作橋救之。後數日再見，相曰：有大隂德及物。今年及第，必中狀元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相賦","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446048291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呂純陽相貌有異，富貴不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446064675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"量肌肉之輕重，揣骨格之克隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446081059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375580171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行似龍騰，此相超羣膽志；坐如虎踞，其人出衆英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446097443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原夫喞喞噥噥者，地閣失瘦；氣氣勢勢者，天庭飽滿。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446113827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻梁聳直者，榖食豐厚；山根不折者，功名俊美。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446130211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學館清高，印堂也，凌雲折桂，涙堂深蹈，子宮也，尅子刑妻。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484071430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若更持行立正，端的忠良；更兼雞眼虎睛，决明詞理。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446146595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雞眼，橫赤色也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以鼻如鷹嘴，喫人心髓；齒如石榴，爲國封矦。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446162979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腦門敦厚者，常清貴；顴骨尖高者，不自由。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446179363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸壁無露，燕腮莫浮，金門一字四橫，偏多貪啖；鐡鎖深關罕用，却被拘留。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446195747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金門鐡鎖□也，此如無腮貪婪拘留。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446212131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾須壯大，欲象葢","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446228515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957079043375144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盤。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446228515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾頭也，天庭欲圓而聳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤若寛停，必須朝口。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446244899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坤，地閣也。宜朝上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎若清兮足才學，","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484087814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坎，口也，唇紅聲清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離若垂兮貪花柳。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484087814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"離，眉也，如分入字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震若寛上者無定止。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446261283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌若離開者，常游走。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484104198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"離兌，雨顴也，無肉主游走。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歩重一聲如奔馬，行穿兩脚聊充口。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446277667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽起三停于外越，便使愚痴。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484120582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巽，乃兩耳不貼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉也。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446294051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮若齊貫而端直，聰明富有。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446310435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"艮，鼻正直而平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齊貫也。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446326819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫何重分次第，目下異端。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446343203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刑傷者，太陽䧟，無破敗者，面門寛。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446359587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭壽者則辨其唇掀，窮險者則知其骨寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446375971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱滿者，主有厚祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446392355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼下有肉，如横指也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小得大者，必有高官。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446425123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼上重紋，眼貴有角。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妖人邪視，偷人低觀，","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446441507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賊人順視","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375612939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳳眉象眼，營生正易。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446441507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暢背鵝胃，餓死何難。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484136966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中旣現，不必鬚長。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446474275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輸廓雖小，且要有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446490659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"耳雖小，且要白。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼雖薄兮清奇穩，","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446507043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼角寛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻若仰兮竅不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446507043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻仰孔露也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉長者唇掀無害，","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446523427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉長而唇掀，則不夭折也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面大者結㗋不良。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446523427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"面雖大而結㗋。露者，則凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任是猴相之形眞，終有財糧之富足。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446539811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見形端正直，須知高貴多福。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446556195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇奔雀歩，乞丐之輩，狗坐蛟騰，毒害之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446572579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺現，以爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446588963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼内有赤筋者，是官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺也，蘭臺腫，以爲奴。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484153350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻偏面腫，多爲奴僕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柳葉眉，齊而有藝，了字眉，反而定孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446605347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却知鼻頭如懸膽，耳白綴珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446621731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女眉垂兮在宦族，男額寛兮達","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446638115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957109506555938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶都。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446638115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不識御𫟍公卿，田面本來無異，邊塵將相，龍頭必竟無殊。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446654499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫怪泄盡天機。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172446670883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綂言道遍。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172944171023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二様皆能相和合。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172944187407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二樣，頭象天，足象地者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四象相揖則無先。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484169734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而部與色相透，四象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是則富貴，否則貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172944203791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有一百二十部星辰，排于一面。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172944220175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相法百家歸一理，文字泛多難以揆。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410601499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刪出諸家奥妙歌，盡與後人容易記。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410617883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六害睂心親義絕，纔如秋月圓還缺。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410634267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻害子老不閒，作事弄巧反成拙。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410650651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根斷兮早虚花，祖業飄零足破家，兄弟無緣離祖宅，老來轉見事如麻。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410667035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂高面黑神憔悴，愛管他人事掛懷。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410683419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冷眼","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410699803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597566505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見人笑一面，不知毒在暗中來。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410699803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乍逢滿座有精神，久看原來色轉昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410716187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似此之人終壽短，縱然有壽亦孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410732571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星列曜在人面，除睂之外怡偏斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410748955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳偏口側，末年破。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410765339","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻曲迎突四十年。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410781723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀盡詩書生得寒，文章千載不爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410798107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生雖有衝天志，爭奈鶯雛翼未乾。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410814491","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面大眉寒正秀才，唇掀齒露更以災。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410830875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終朝脚跡忙忙走，富貴平生不帶來。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410847259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停短兮下停長，多成多敗値空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410863643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然營得成家計，猶如烈日照氷霜，下停短兮上停長，必爲宰相侍君王。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410880027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是庶人生得此，金珠財寶滿倉箱。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410896411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957172827914280"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形愛恢弘又怕肥，恢主榮華肥死期。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410912795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十之上肥定死，四十形恢定發時。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410929179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦自痩兮寒自寒，寒瘦之人不一般。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410945563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"痩有精神終必達，寒雖形彩定孤單。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410961947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色怕嫩兮又怕嬌，氣嬌神嫩不相饒。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410978331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老年色嫩招辛苦，少年色嫩不堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410994715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂要曲兮不要直，曲直愚人不得知。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411011099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲者多學又聰俊，直者刑妻又尅兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411027483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髭髯要黑又要稀，依稱見肉始爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411043867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最嫌濃濁焦黄色，父在東頭子在西，議論爭差識者稀，附子金鎻號銀匙。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411060251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂高性巧能通變，侍待王公在此時。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411076635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597599273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銀匙歌股肱無毛最是卤，兩頭如杖一般同。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411093019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有祖田并父廕，終須破敗受貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411109403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭痕瘢剥最爲刑，羅網之中有一名。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411125787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不兢妻并害子，更憂家道主俗信。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411142171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相中最忌興君面，男子郎君命不長。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411158555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子郎君好滛慾，僧道孤門却無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411174939","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂毛間斷至額邊，𡮢爲官非賣却田。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411191323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅破妻子三兩祻，方教個患不相纒。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411207707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好色之人眼帶花，莫教眼緊視人斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411224091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有毒無毒但看眼。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411240475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇眼之人子打爺。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411256859","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無家可靠羊睛眼，却問他人借住塲。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411273243","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有禾倉高二","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411289627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957206961127464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寸，中年猶未","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411289627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有夫娘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411289627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下凹時又主孤，陽空隂没亦同途。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411322395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯西不如鷄卵様，只冝養子與同居。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411338779","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下頭尖了作㐫殃，典却田國更賣塘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411355163","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任是張良能計策，自然顚倒見狼當。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411371547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼珠暴出惡因縁，自主家時定賣田。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411387931","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有白睛包一半，也知不𣦸在床前。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411404315","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下須橋大旺未年，邊城不佐也無錢。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411420699","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數年荒旱不欠米，只因上下庫相連。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411437083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻梁露骨是反吟，曲轉些兒是伏吟。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411453467","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟相見是絕滅，伏吟相見淚淋淋。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411469851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼兒帶秀心中巧，不讀詩書也可人。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411486235","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手作百般人可愛，縱然賣假也成眞。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411502619","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄紗染皂","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411519003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597632041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出，粟米縱","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411519003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有妻","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411519003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子也没兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411519003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘見山根高更斷，五年三次路邊啼。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411535387","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"涙痕深處排一㸃，眼下顴前𧺫一星，左眼無","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411551771","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男又無","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411551771","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女，縱然稍有也相刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411551771","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際低而㓜無父，寒毛生𧢲㓜無娘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411568155","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左顴骨出父先死，不𣦸不刑便自傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411584539","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士人𦕈眼𨺻文星，豹齒失頭定没名。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411600923","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任是文童過北斗，拾如木履不安釘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411617307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂重山根陷破財，更憂三十二年災。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411633691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土星端正終須發，土星不好去無囬。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411650075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒相之人肩過頸，享福之人耳壓眉。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411666459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有親戚檯不出，只因形似雨中鷄。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411682843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大量之人睂高眼，眼睂相定不憂悲。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411699227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉粗","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411715611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957236627488783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼細不相當，寅年吃了卯年糧。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411715611","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂三表是鎡基，只怕下長來犯之。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411731995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如水星來救護，不教人受此寒飢。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411748379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上頭雖有些模様，下停不均却壞之。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411764763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴脚之八成小輩，","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411781147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：闊脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蠻蹄孤子是婆姨。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411781147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八歳十八二十八，下至山根上至髪，","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411797531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有無活。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411797531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"計兩頭消。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706501642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十印堂莫帶殺，三二四二五十二，山根上下凖頭止。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411813915","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禾倉禄馬要相當，不識之人莫亂指，五三六三七十三。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411830299","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中排來地閣間，逐一推筭看𥚽福。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411846683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火星百歲印堂添。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411863067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下兩截分貴賤，倉庫平分定有無。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411879451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是神仙眞妙訣，莫將胡亂教","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411895835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597664809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庸夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411895835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胡僧兩眼名識覺，盡識人間善與惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411912219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不帶學堂不是賢，莫將此法亂相傳。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411928603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家風濟楚睂清秀，侷促之人虛𢃄紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411944987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"檯凳塵埃高一寸，只縁睂似火燒禽。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411961371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭如槖紅更生，或在西時或在東。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411977755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得兩頭無尅處，假饒㐫處不爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411994139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有順頦開兩井，準頭須帶兩頭條。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412010523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"音端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倉庫空䧟不由人，休說良田多萬頃，大𦛕原來天折災，䯻頭可折在層臺。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412026907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳聾眼患因羊刅，不折天年也有災。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412043291","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂頭額𧢲如龍虎，龍虎相爭定至愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412059675","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按連倉庫反爲災，鼻梁骨露不安居。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412076059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是睂間客二指，此人","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412092443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957267908575267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間手覓便宜，眼下若無凶星照，中年不祿亦豐腴。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412092443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中年倉庫看玉倉，禾倉有陷無屯儲，須要田園入庫倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412125211","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禾倉平滞有禾餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412141595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取人性命面上黑，换人骨髓眼中紅。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412157979","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見人歡喜心中破，見人睂皺太陽空。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412174363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財不住無他事，只因倉庫有長鎗。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412190747","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露井露竈不周全，那得浮生至晩年。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300412207131","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然不怕經官府，只無衣祿奄無錢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318405914651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五三六三七十三，水星羅計要相叅。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318405931035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逐一分門定禍福，水星","logicSentenceId":"7580389318405947419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫被土星覆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318405947419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數篇細話名金鎻，推明禍福令趨躱。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318405980187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試看人生無歸着，耳大無輪口無角。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318405996571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不在東街賣餛飩，","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406012955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597697577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便去西街賣𩚼飪。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406012955","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴賤定于骨法，憂喜見于形容。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406029339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人賢愚、贵賤、修短、吉㐫、成敗、利鈍，皆定于骨法也。骨焉君，肉爲臣，骨肉欲其相輔爲貴。若骨露肉薄者，主于下賤。○憂喜乃未來之事，人莫能知。憂喜未分，則氣色朝夕發于面部，青憂疑，赤口舌，白哭泣，黑𣦸墓，黄喜應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毋吝生于動作之始，成敗在乎决斷之中。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406045723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"悔各者，吉囟未見，人情雖知喜利避害，莫知缘害而見利。易日：吉㐫悔吝，生乎動作也。○成敗者，得失之本也。人之所謀，當剛斷而不可狐疑，故舉動所謀，能决則必成，少疑則事亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957302138224674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣清體羸，雖才高而不久；神强骨壯，保遐算以無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706534410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣淸體羸者，謂之形神不足，常以不病似病，雖有文學髙才，終無達壽。○人之壽大，皆在神氣骨法所主。若神强骨壯，必享逺年之壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顔如冠玉，聲若撞鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406062107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冠玉者，美玉也。人顔色要瑩然温潤，若美玉無瑕乃貴。○鐘聲良久不絶，人聲發于丹田，貴乎深逺。若淺知蹇澁破散，天賤之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四瀆須冝深且濶，五嶽必穹與隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406078491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四瀆須宜深瀾，崖岸有川流之形，不爲漫散破缺。○五嶽要有峻極之勢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五官欲其明而正，六府欲其實而充。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406094875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597730345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五官者，一口、二鼻、三耳、四目、五人中，欲其明而端正，不冝孤露偏邪。○六府者，兩輔骨、雨顴骨、兩順骨，欲其完實相郎，不欲支離狐露。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一官成，十年貴顯；一府就，十載富豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406111259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此五官中，但一官成就，則享祿十年。○此大府中，若一府就，則十載豊足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"房玄齡龍目鳳睛，三台位列。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406127643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"班仲昇燕頷虎額，萬里侯封。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706567178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唐房玄齡龍目鳯晴，則三人𮨤贵。○漢班超燕頷龍頸，封定逺矦，鎭撫萬里之外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"英眸兮掣電，豪氣兮吐虹。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406144027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"英眸者，膽視儼然，日共掣電。眼如鹰視，冨之餘，謂神彩射外也。○豪傑者，言制磊落，心氣眸嶸若吐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957334870523956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若賦性粗惡，禍必及。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406160411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如脩德惕厲，祿永終。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706583562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人賦性𠒋惡，禍必及身，終當暴𣦸。○若人常能脩身愼行，則祿位永保其終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上長下短兮，萬里之雲霄騰翼；下長上短兮，一生之踪跡飄蓬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406176795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人身腰長脚短，如賜鴞飛不霄漢，摩空𡺥里之資也。○人若脚長腰短，則上生踪跡，飄零流落，老于他郑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟人稟隂陽之和，肖天地之狀。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406193179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人稟隂陽正氣而生，誠與天地祭矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597763113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足方兮象地干下，頭圓兮似天爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406209563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"足欲軟而厚者，乃冨貫之相。○天尊地卑，乾坤定矣。故足方象地，頭圓象天。頭圓足方者冨貴；頭小足薄者貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"音聲比雷霆之遠震，眼目如日月之相望。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406225947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"音聲者，人之號令，可以及人，故日如雷靈之震。○天之日月，能照萬物，人之眼日，能知萬情，故眼目獨天之日月也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"开額若山嶽之聳，血脈如江河之漾。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406242331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻額必如山嶽之聳直高隆，可爲入格之相。人周身血脈書装，循環無窮，故如江河之漾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛髪兮草木之秀，骨節兮金石之壯。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406258715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957334870769716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"毛髮若山川草木發生。圓南曰：陽氣舒而山川秀，日月出而天地明也。○骨節宜若金石之堅固。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲察人倫，先從額上。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406275099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人稟三才，額爲天，頍爲地，鼻爲人，天圓則可貴，當先視其額，額主居位，故爲天也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏狹兮賤夭足惡；從闊兮冨貴可尚。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406291483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"额學偏斜窄狹，侵天部，嘗天壽貴賤，亦爲足惡之人。○額若高聳廣闕，則冨責俱全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見伏𡱝之骨起，定作元臣；如有握刀之橫紋，决爲上將。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406307867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏𡱝骨起印堂，至天中，隱隱骨起，直入髪際，光澤無破，必任公侯之位。○額道紋者，在左邊地至右邊地，横直之紋，如刀痕之狀，别無紋理衝破，定爲軍帥天將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597795881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右偏母妨，左偏父喪。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406324251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日月角爲父母宮，左爲日角，声爲月角，左爲父位，右爲母位，右偏主妨母，左偏主妹父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山林豐廣多逸豫，邊地缺陷足悽愴。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406340635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山林在天倉上，若此部豐廣，主平生多悅逸寛。邊地在驛馬上，邊地驛馬爲遷移宮，若有缺陷則破散，成敗可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆如肝而立如壁，壽福實繁。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406357019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聳若角而圓若環，食祿無量。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406373403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額若覆肝而平，或如立壁而直，則壽考福厚實多也。額高圓而日月骨起，主高貴長命。○凡人之額，其聳若角，其圓若環，主食天祿以終天夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957362804785186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"塵蒙而身無所資，玉潤而名高先唱。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406389787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額若無潤澤之色，如塵俟蒙覆，則無甔。○額如美玉之温潤，主聲聞淸髙而先顯，早第。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐隆明者，生必早達，𤰞薄暗者，死無所葬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406406171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額豐隆光澤，色明而無破，則早歲登科。○額小而窄陝，其色昏暗，或諸部又無所輔，則死無衣衾棺槨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福堂之上氣黯𢡖，幼歲多連。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406422555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬之前色黃光，壯年受眖。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706599946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福堂部在睂上，氣若黯𢡖不明、如塵垢者，主幼年迍滯。○驛馬在邊地下，睂毛後有紅黃色者，壯歲受君賜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597828649"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色貴悅懌，紋宜舒暢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406438939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧薄孤獨，曲水漫浪","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406455323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。顔色貴乎悦懌，不宜氣雜。若有紋理可尚者，宜乎舒展敷暢。○亂紋薄額，縱横相交，謂之曲水漫浪，撗紋爲人平昔多憂，主貧薄孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居侯伯者，偃月之勢，處師傅者，懸𭕝之象","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406471707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。謂須有雙峯，祀如偃月，王公戾伯子。○師傳者，二公位也。額有懸犀，其懸犀骨在福堂上，高隆若角，直接山林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莊足三峙，列三公以何疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406488091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛角八方，厠八位而無妄。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706616330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼎時三足者，額有伏𡱝、日月角俱起，若鼎之三足，定列三公。○牛角八方者，蓋額有八角，乃伏犀角骨、月骨、邉地骨、福堂骨、龍角骨、虎角骨、牛角骨印堂骨。有此八骨者，必登廊廟，通達八方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957392139714575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀夫睂宇寛廣，心田坦平。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406504475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"睂焉紫氣，吉皇也。若睂字寛長平門者，則心业然無私。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狼愎者低凹其骨，狂狷者徙高其稜。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406520859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"性銀之人，則習骨低凹，若眉斗高者。狂狷之人，故知進而不知退，知存而不知亡，恒有包藏之志。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢊩厚魯愚，秀濃慧明。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406537243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"睂之粗濃濁厚者，其性愚鈍，多滯疎；睂秀有彩者，主聰慧才智過人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短不及目者，貧賤；長能過眼者，寵榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406553627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉短于目者，主身貭下賤；眉長過目者，則身榮貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尾散者，咨財難聚，頭交者，身命早傾。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406570011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061084726"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉尾毫毛脫落而疎稀，主財物破散。初運二十六至二十九，財散。○印堂乃命宫也。若眉頭相交，如蜻蜓之形，毛侵印堂者，知壽之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中心直斷惠性少；兩頭高仰壯氣橫。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406586395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉中間直斷，或紋破者，其性寡有仁慈。○眉尾謂凌雲，主人之氣志。眉若兩頭高起，則有丈夫之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛直性狠。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406602779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛逆禍生。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706632714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉毛直生者，爲人性狠，亦主横天。○眉毛逆生者，其人恒有災害，亦當尅祖，主凶惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆目軟柔而少斷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406619163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偃月高揭而好爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406635547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉八字軟柔壓眼，終無正性，故爲無斷之人。○眉若偃月高揭者，則必好鬬而多爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扣促無閑，傷蜉蝣之短咎，毛長及寸。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406651931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"享龜鶴之遐齡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406668315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957425425694760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蜉断喜隂而惡陽，人若睂頭促鎻短也。印堂終日不問者，謂之鬼形，故歎其若蜉蝣之影。眉長及寸者，謂之壽亳。四十以上生者，得其壽考，必享遐齡之慶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十字高品，天文大享。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406684699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩眉閒印堂上有紋如十字者，主有高位。○若紋理似天字者，一生亨通，從有災咎，自能消散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作坤字者，祿二千石；成土字者，將百萬兵。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406701083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印堂有紋作坤卦者，則祿享于石。○成土字紋者，當帥兵百萬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"列土分茅，由玉田之高朗；紆未曳紫，蓋水鳥之圓","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406717467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成。有列士分茅之貴者，謂印堂中有紋如玉田之字。○紆朱曳紫之官，蓋印堂中紋如水鳥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲察神氣，先觀目𫏏。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406733851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賢良澄澈，豪俊精英。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406750235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061117494"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之神在目，夜則神寤于心，晝則神遊于目。欲察神氣虚實，心衞美惡，必當先視其目。故觀其外者，則知其内。○賢良之士，眼神澄徹若水；豪俊英桀之流，神和惠而黑白分門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性端正者，平視無頗；情流蕩者，轉盻不寜。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406766619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人秉性端正，則平視不側。○必情流蕩之徒，則目睛往來，轉盻不息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃潤定至于黃髪，白乾終至于白丁。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406783003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時子黃潤，可至干黄髪之壽。○眼若白乾而不秀，終作白衣之下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顧下言徐，叔向知其必死；視端趨疾，魏主見乎得情。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406799387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昭公十一年夏五月，單子會韓宣子于戚，視下言：視不登帶，言不過步，無守身之氣，死將至矣。此年冬，單于果卒。○智伯帥韓、魏之兵而攻趙，城降有日。智伯之臣絺疵見桓子、與康子，俱無喜志而有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957455310143540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"憂色。絺注問智伯日：二子必反矣。智伯以告二子。二子日：此夫說臣，使主疑解于攻趙也。二子出，而疵又曰：主何以臣之言告二子？智伯曰：子何以知之？絺疵對曰：臣見二子視臣端而趨疾，知臣得其情故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神陷短壽，睛凸極刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406815771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之壽天，皆在于神氣所主。若目神巳陷，必當天死。睛凸者，謂之蜂日，其人必至極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜盻者，人遭其毒；癡視者，自尅其形","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406832155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。斜盻之人，謂眼神側視，必遭毒而身亡，或至兵死。○神癡不秀，轉盻無力者，雖面部靑顯，自尅無祿也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406832155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淫眼神蕩，姦心内萌。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406848539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061150262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"淫亂者，职神流蕩而不收。○安侫姦罪之人，目神若塵垢之衆𣵫，不可以爲交友。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡眼神濁而如睡，驚眼神怯而如驚","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406864923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。目神濁者，不清也。加睡者，謂神困獨無力，終當人壽。○驚眼者，謂視物急而驚，其人當至彚死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病眼神困而如病未愈，醉眼神昏而如醉不醒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406881307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病眼神困，謂情倦如久病本痊，其人然無纯夀。○醉眼神昏者，神力巻怠，恒如帶酒，必至服毒而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豁如視而有威，各揚四海；逌所驚而不瞬，神耀三清。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406897691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神藏于豁，視威嚴而有力，偶然人聖而畏之，主聲名稱揚于天下。○人若偶遇不測之驚，興神澄然不攺，蓋不染座俗之汙，出于造物之外，是謂大賢之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眥圓者，其機深于城域；堂露者，乃子是乎螟蛉。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406914075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957483801985076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眥爲眼蓋画成者，言行深困，人莫川其孫測，故可謂之偏機于明。或○眼堂破露，當養愼蛉之子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犬羊鵝鴨何足算，雞鼠猴虵奚可憑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406930459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"犬眼荒淫，羊眼招褐，鹅鸭之眼，不善終。○人似雞、皋、猴、蛇之目，皆相之賤者。然而察形像，應本形者，爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豕視心圓而無定，狼顧性狠而難名。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406946843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"猪眼朦隴，黑白不分，主心術不正，貪而多欲。○狼顧者，謂囘顧與身皆轉性狼當懐殺人害物之心，多爲毒害之行，絶不可交往。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後尾有如刀裁，文斯博雅；前眥似乎曲鈎，智足經營","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406963227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。目若刀裁，文章自來；○眼前普若曲鈎，必能糧穀，深藏而能規運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061183030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟女賦，質與勇異。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406979611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禎","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706649098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明子以則爲貴，女子以柔爲順。圖南曰：隂反于陽，夫必損；陽反于隂，婦必亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和𡡾有常者，貴重；國凸不秀者，輕賤","logicSentenceId":"7580389318406995995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。男子之日，必要神冉，婦人之日，必有和惠，若和惠有恒之婦，必嘗貴重。○婦人惟眼長爲貴，若圓小高凸，粗俗不秀者，主輕賤之婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臉薄赤而少節，睛瑩澈而多貞。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407012379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臉者，爲目葢也。若目葢薄而赤者，主有不廉之行，少有貞節之懿。○睛光澄澈，湛然若水者，必有占烈之性。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下氣靑，夫必死，尾後色白，男必憎","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407028763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957512461631503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"婦女有青氣沖眼者，必喪其夫。○睂尾後自色者，天必憎嫌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三𧢲多嗔，爲妨夫之霜刃；四白帶殺，作害子之靑萍。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407045147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"婦人眼三𧢲者，性狠而多怒，如殺去之利刃。○婦人眼露四白而神壯者，謂之帶殺，乃殺子之劒也。青萍，劒名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟耳者，主聲音之聴聞，爲心賢之司牧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407061531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀其形狀顔色，見乎休处榮辱。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407077915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人所言善惡，皆從耳傳于心，故爲心腎之司牧。○耳主心腎，又爲祿星，觀其耳之形狀顏色，則人之休咎榮辱，皆可知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垂珠朝海，必延算以餘財；偃月貫輪，終朝王而執玉。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407094299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061215798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"耳垂朝口，耳尖贴脑垂肩，必取延年算數，死之後，必有餘財。○耳有城廓，如新月繼仰，光塋朝接者，定朝拱天子而爲執玉之臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓而成者和惠，偏而缺者慘酷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407110683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"耳圓成者，主于情和而多惠；偏缺者，必爲慘酷之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其薄如紙兮，貧早死，其堅如石兮，老不哭。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407127067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"耳小薄如紙者，則貧寒而早亡。○古相云：耳硬如木，至老不哭，謂多吉少凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白或過面，主聲譽之飛騰。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407143451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩且如輪，主信行之敦篤。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407159835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古相云：耳白過面，名揚四海。○耳輪廓如玉之光瑩貫輪者，主忠信篤厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似猪者，不聰而貪婪；如鼠者，好疑而積蓄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407176219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957551024029736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"猪耳大，俯耳小，只变輪廓分明，大無輪廓，又無垂珠，謂之猪耳，則人多愚訰，性多貪梦。○㬌耳本小，有廓無輪，似鼎耳之人，作事多疑，而能積蓄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輪靨雖明，假學則貴；孔毛能長，善持不覆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407192603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"耳輪有靨而明，當假學而後顯貴。○耳生毫者，乃壽考之相，善持守而不致顚危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性譎詐而難測。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407208987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋爲如猴，糧匱乏而靡充，率由似塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407225371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"猴耳尖而向前，耳門窄下，故人莫能囬其心也。○糟餉匱乏，尚能與朋友同用而無憾者，葢以耳之似鹿，由鹿有呼羣之義故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄而向前，賣盡田園；反而倒後，居無室屋。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407241755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼眼云：耳薄向前，破盡田國。○耳若反輪而後倒，耳珠又不朝海者，貧無若室。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061248566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏暗難議乎登第，焦枯屢歎其空軸。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407258139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"耳爲祿星，以耳昏暗者，爲祿星不明，則當爲寒士，終無祿位。○耳主其腎，若耳色焦枯者，爲賢氣不足，主以首實躬。○軸，巻軸也。空軸，言腹中空洞無物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽越睂兮貴巽血，聰重明兮富貼肉。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407274523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壽長者，年過于睂；位高者，色鮮巽血。○聰重之人，耳邑明潤；殷富之人，耳必貼肉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翰厭生乎黑子，智足經邦；門户起乎匿犀，功當剖竹。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407290907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其耳前輪間生黑子者，可爲興邦智略之臣。耳門骨藏豐滿者，謂之匿犀，當爲封爵之臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟鼻高者，號嵩嶽以居中，爲天柱而高矗。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407307291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻爲嵩嶽，以鼻中哭爲天柱，而高接天庭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957578236592162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梁貴乎曹隆貫額，色貴乎瑩光溢目。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407323675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其鼻所貴，惟在高隆貫額；色之所貴，在乎瑩光温潤，而能溢目。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竅小慳劣，頭低孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407340059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻孔小者，爲目間不通，其性多怪劣。○凡人準頭低者，主終身無子，孤獨之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜如芟繭之狀，困乏瓶儲；圓若懸膽之形，榮食鼎餗。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407356443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻用盂，知芟藕之狀者，家貧國乏，衣食不瞻。○鼻準完美，勢若懸膽者，傑食鼎祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青黑多凶，黃明廣福。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407372827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻乃身之主，若氣色青黑者，應遭丕測之禍；如其色之黃明，福自至也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱缺終身難薦鶚。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407389211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梁斷三十當畏鵬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407405595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061281334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天徃必要端直，若有缺陷，則終當困滯，不得騰踏。上選○羈乃不祥鳥，人見之死亡。漢賈誼三十畢而見此，爲知必死，故作鹏身賦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大而滯者爲賈旅，小而狹者作僮僕。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407421979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其鼻大而滯者，則爲商賈之人，終身奔波流落。○凡鼻小而狹者，則早離父母，必作僮僕。相日：山根斷，而幼年疾苦，爲僮僕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極貴之色，似老蠶之光明；下愚之人，若蜣蜋之局促。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407438363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相曰：蠶將老，自飼而明，然後通于肢體。人將發，自凖而明，烈後逋于諸部。故人將貴顯著，見青龍之氣，似老蠶黃明之色，乃爲極貴之光，則無不利也。○下愚之人，鼻短低凹，若蜣蜋局促，相曰：而短。貧賤人相貌，鼻短無梁，露齒牙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957578236854306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光美宜官，破露憂獄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407454747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其鼻完美成就者，宜享官祿。若破露無勢者，則平生憂苦，多致牢獄之凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭隆者誠信，法令深者嚴肅。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407471131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫凖者，爲面部之摽本，凖頭高隆，其人誠愁而萬信。○法令乃𢍂之左右絞也。若其紋理深長者，爲人敦重嚴肅，又令遐齡之壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病尖薄，慳悋小縮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407487515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻尖而薄者，一生多病；蘭臺小縮者，其性懷悋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺明兮庭旅實，井竈露兮厨無粟。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407503899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘭臺廷尉，福德官也。若蘭臺豐明者，家産殷實而多儲積，能瞻百人。○井竈若露不牧者，當庖厨空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061314102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乏，恒無自瞻之食。相曰：鼻露竅，無歸着。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨如横起，忌與結于交朋；紋若亂交，愼勿爲乎眷屬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407520283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻骨橫起者，甚不可相親而爲友。○鼻上紋理亂交者，必詭行，雖父子不同其心。若女字者，不可爲之眷屬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人中者，溝洫之態，深則疏通，淺則遲延。","logicSentenceId":"7580389318407536667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人中者，若大川之溝洫，溝流四瀆，潮接歸海，宜其寛深而長也。○深則必致享通，淺則應當困滯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺短絶嗣而夭命，深長宜子以遐年。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447761459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如其人中淺短者，絕嗣而夭命；若得深長者，宜其子孫富貴，又當壽考。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑子難産乎蓐上，橫紋殍卒于道傍。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447777843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957606514868239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人中者，月孛也。若人中有靨者，主其母産之難。○若有横紋截斷，必當餓死于途中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上狹下廣兮，多後旺，下狹上廣兮，屢孤眠。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447794227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若人中上窄下寛者，主晚年然祿，子孫成群。○如下狹上惱者，多爲孤鰥之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深長者，誠信著；寛厚者，功名𫩱。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447810611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"深長者，著有誠信，寛闊者，早立功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微如一綫之文，身塡溝壑，明由破竹之仰，家世貂蟬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447826995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"但人中微窄，𰌽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3wr2h/1-7604330540006785074_%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%871.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=XfOEFFVf5LPik3z5GdRbdTrw4jw%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3wr2h/1-7604330540006785074_图片1.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7604330540006817842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之紋痕，士死塡于溝壑之間。○若如破竹之師，長遠有酸寒，著則祖庭高貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唯口者，語言之鑰，是非之關。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447843379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發言爲開口之綸，口開則是非無不至也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061346870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福之所招，利害之所詮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447859763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言爲祿福之根，禍福乃利害之本，惟其人之所招，故言不可不愼也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端厚寡辭者，定免乎辱；誹謗多言者，必招其愆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447876147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉人之辭寡，若能謹愼于寡辭者，定免乎恥辱。誹謗多言者，謂具專談人之過惡也。如是之人，必禍咎及身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥馬輕裘，由方成于四字；出將入相，葢大容乎一拳。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447892531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若乘肥馬、衣輕裘者，由其口若四字。○出爲將帥，入爲宰輔者，葢口大而能容其拳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
