{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇欲厚，語欲端，音欲朗，色欲鮮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447908915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唇貴乎秀厚，語貴乎端嚴，音貴乎高朗，色貴乎明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957634432139279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下絞交，子孫衆；周匝稜利，仁信全。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447925299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唇上下紋失者，子孫甚衆。如周廻有稜利者，仁信皆全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"噀血餘貲，似括囊而貧薄；含丹多藝，如吹火以酸寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447941683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唇如噀血者，主有殷富之資；如括囊者，貧寒孤苦。〇古相云：唇若含丹多技藝，口如吹火必孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合勢欲小，開勢欲寛。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447958067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狗貪馬餒，鼠讒蜂單。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447974451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"口不欲不收，故含勢欲其小，而開勢則欲其大也。○凡入食物，若似讒狗之狼餐，餓馬之喃草，如皋蜂之偷食，皆下賤之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大言寡信者略綽，無機促齡者偃騫。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330447990835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如其口略綽不收，唇無稜理者，主自满不謙，凶徒寡信。○唇若偃騫者，乃無獲巧之人，又當天壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957150061379638"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑黑禍發，黃白病纏；","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448007219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"口唇靑黑者，惡禍将至；色先黄白者，大病臨身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右紋粗，定凶惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448007219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上下急蕩，多連澶。其人之左右有粗績者，定是凶徒之輩，多遭網憲。○夫急蕩者，謂不語而唇自動，多主孤苦之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如自喙者，高人終難共處；同劒鎧者，義士可與交懽","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448023603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。若口如易喙者，難與爲文。○鎧者，劒之隔手。同劒鎧者，主有信義，宜與交。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟壽算之先定，以牙齒之可觀。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448056371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其于壽算，故爲前定，觀其牙齒，而預可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"康寜者，齊且密，賤夭者，疎不連。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448072755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957658578731008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957428659339275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957686340861967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957428659372043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957710533640227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"康寧之人，其牙齒齊固而密，賤人者，則𢬾少而疎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上覆下兮少困，下掩上者晚鰥。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448089139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上覆下者，而年困滯；下掩上者，晚嵗鰥寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"班馬文章，白若瓠犀之美。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448105523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喬松壽考，瑩如崑玉之堅。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706665482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能班固、馬遷之丈者，其齒牙若瓠犀之白，高貴人也。享王喬、赤松之壽者，其人齒白瑩堅，如崑山之美玉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當門二齒缺，命蹇于沒世；學堂一官全，聲聞于天下。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448121907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當門二齒缺者，其命蹇滯，終身困窮。○當門二齒爲内學堂，若大而明者，主名聞四海。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焦黑困乏，鮮明足錢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448138291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957428659421195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若其齒牙焦黑者，乏田貧窮；鮮明者，錢財豐足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四兮命折，三十六兮壽延。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448154675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二十四齒疎而不連者，爲之鬼形，主命天。三十六兮者，主長年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖若立錐，必乏衣食之士；齊如編貝，優登廊廟之賢","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448171059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。茵失如錐者，必缺衣食。○編貝，海物，色白而瑩，齒若齊如編貝，足爲賢相，以登廊廟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌者以短小薄鈍爲下，以長大方利爲先。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448187443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舌短小薄鈍者，爲下愚之人；若其長大而方利者，則爲上卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方長者，咳唾成玉；短小者，皂隸執鞭。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448203827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舌方長者，主有才德，文高四海，出語可爲珠玉。○短小者，俗爲之舌秃。則皂𨽾執鞭之僕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957763742318607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑子凶惡，粟粒榮遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448220211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舌上有黑靨者，多爲凶惡；有粟粒者，別必居官食祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑紫布衣而肘露，鮮明金帶而腰懸。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448236595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舌上色若黯紫之色者，當貧寒露肘。舌若鮮明光瑩者，則有腰金之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七星理明，可享千鍾之祿；三川紋足，必食萬戸之田。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448252979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舌上有七星靨者，可享千鍾之厚祿。○舌上有紋如川者，必享萬戸之食。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"允謂：瘦人項短致災殃，肥人項長必天撗。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448269363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"瘦人本宜項長，而項短者，决致災禍；肥人本宜項短，而項長者，必當橫夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如罌如瓶總非吉，似鵝似豕皆不令。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448285747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957428659470347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"罂瓶，瓦器也，項下垂若器者凶。○鵝項大長，猪頭大短，如是之人，皆主惡死，不善終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐圓厚實多財產，光隆溫潤足權柄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448302131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項若豐圓厚實，與背相稱者，財產多而富足。○其光隆溫潤者，足主樞機重柄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"痩人結喉身孤兆，肥人結喉刑尅證。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448318515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"瘦人結喉者，身必孤獨。○肥人結喉者，者遭刑害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項後豐起，定爲厚福之人；頷下絛垂，永保遐齢之慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448334899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項後骨豐而起者，是爲厚福。○頷下餘條雙垂者，永保遐齡之壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫貴背之豐隆，身乃恃而安定。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448351283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫人之昔貴于豐隆，必以體之上下安持而爲可稱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957786555138088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧天絕嗣者，偏側欹斜；富貴有後者，闊厚平正。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448367667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貧穷壽天無後者，蓋爲背之偏側、欹斜不正。○富貴有後者，則背闕澤潤，堅厚而平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢若踞山之蹲虎，利賓于王，形如出海之伏龜，考終厥命。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448384051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"背勢似山中坐虎，有威力者，當利賓于王，足爲王佐；背如出海之龜，則考終壽命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍骨欲長其充實，虎骨欲短其堅硬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448400435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍骨者，臂；虎骨者，膊。上爲君，下爲臣，上壯下細者，龍吞虎；下壯上細者，虎吞龍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳥肩者，騰上必速，恐不多時；犀膊者，爲儒早亨，優于從政。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448416819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957428659503115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鳶鳥之肩者，騰上迅速，早而困之。故馬周鳶肩火色，任之要職。壯歲辭閒，急流勇退。爲人犀膊豐而圓厚，則爲文明之士。㓜逹長千大政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指節欲其織直，腕節欲其圓勁。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448433203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"平指欲纖而長，腚飾欲圓而勁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚而密者，謀必有得；薄而疎者，心多不稱。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448449587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"掌中豐厚而柔，指節塋光而密者，則足智多謀。如其掌薄骨哽，指節疎露者，平生智多不遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢若排竿，富可染；色如噀血，貴可競。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448465971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"指節若排筝者，身必貴顯；其掌如噀血者，家成鉅富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身甲才薄，涉中滿而起傾；祿厚官榮，有駟馬之形勝。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448482355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957814724100111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若掌中心轉，周圍起骨，謂之起傾。如是之人，主里賤寡學。○官祥榮高，謂掌中有印旗之形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横紋，下愚；縱理，慧性。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448498739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人掌中若有橫紋而短者，乃爲下愚；如有紋縱者，至聰明而多智慧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨露筋浮者，主身賤，皮堅肉枯者，愁囊罄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448515123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"手若露骨浮筋，主身貧下賤；若皮堅硬肉乾澀者，當愁囊篋空乏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家殷而黑子斯明，用足而橫紋乃亘。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448531507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"手中黑子，主家豪富。如有橫紋通直者，爲握刀之紋，則主財豐當足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴之相，若苔之滑而綿之軟；壽安之人，如筍之直而玉之瑩。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448547891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957428659535883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冨貴賢明之士，手滑軟而名苔若綿；康寕遐齡之人，手直如筍而白如玉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心宰視聽，内主魂魄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448564275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帥六府之氣，統五藏之神。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448580659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"心乃神之主也，掌其視聽，運行百脉之神，制五藏六府之神。故內經曰：心爲君主之官，神明生焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顔色始變，是非已分。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448597043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人顔色喜怒，方有所變，則一心之明鑑，而能預知之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡則禍結，善則福臻。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448613427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之所行，善惡咸發之于心，若其行惡，則禍至；如其行善，則福應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸凸者燥而多劣，毛長者剛而好嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448629811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胸膺骨高起者，主性急燥而多劣；若其生毛者，每多轻怒，此皆不仁寡合之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957840300998690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坑陷淺窄，愚暗而多居下時；寛平博厚，賢明而早厠縉紳。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448646195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胸貴平澗，若坑䧟淺窄者，多爲愚下之流。○若其寛平博厚者，則幼午而居官，明賢而享晚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹爲水穀之海，臍爲筋脉之源。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448662579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"包萬物而獨化，總六府以中輪。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448678963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腹爲水穀之海，臍者，總六府以居中，以爲筋脉之源。由是腹肚大而圓，臍必廣而深。相曰：腹大垂嚢。食祿令鑑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓厚富安，儉薄食乏，深寛貴富，淺窄孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448695347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腹若圓大而厚者，主家富安閒；如其腹薄而儉小者，必至乏食。腹寛厚者，主能容物富貴。淺薄窄狹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957428659585035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者，謂之囊聲孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢若垂囊，風雷四方之震；深能容李，芝蘭千里之聞。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448711731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腹垂若囊，主聲含冠世，如風雷震于四方。賦深廣能容其李者，主美譽播于邦畿之外，若蘭之馨香聞于四逺，言其美德之盛烈也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足者枝之謂，身者幹之云。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448728115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枝以蔽其幹，足以運諸身。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448744499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"枝以蔽其足。爲枝也，身乃幹也。枝當蔭其幹，足可運之身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐厚方正者多閒暇；薄澀横智者必若辛。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448760883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"足若豐厚方曰者，平生閒樂，其祿自至。若人足之薄窄枯巡，必當辛苦終身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無紋身賤，有毛家温。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448777267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957859565404200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"足底無紋者，身必貧賤；若以足面有毛者，家必殷實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富累千金，葢有弓刀之理；官封一品，由成魚鳥之紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448793651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"家積千金之富者，足底有弓刀之紋理；官至一品之極者，足底有魚烏之成纹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短小精悍者，形不足而神有餘；長大孱弱者，形有餘而神不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448810035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人身短小精悍者，葢其形雖不足，神乃有餘。若身長大孱弱者，是形有餘而神不足也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊形神而俱妙，非賢聖其孰能。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448826419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形者發乎外，神者藏于内。其形神俱妙者，非賢聖孰能得之？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏于内者，如淵珠之粹，發乎外者，若焰光之燭。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448842803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957428659634187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神藏于内者，如淵水驪珠之情粹；神發乎外者，若清夜焰燭之美光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡在人之憎愛，淸濁由目之照矚。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448859187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人心之美惡，皆著于目，美則人愛，惡則人憎，分明淸濁，聽視是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"質以氣而宏充，氣以神而化育。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448875571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"質者，形也。人之以氣而養形，故以神而生氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"質寛則氣宏而大，神安則氣靜而覆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448891955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人形體寛大，則心氣宏若，其神之所安，則氣順而能靜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是，寵辱不足驚，喜怒不足觸。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448908339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之所養，氣定而後形固，形固而後神全，神全而後心正。誠能有之，則寵辱不驚，喜怒不觸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957891748331535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣無肉者，譬若寒松；有肉無氣者，猶如蠧木。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448924723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之形體臞瘦而有神氣者，譬若寒松之堅，可享其壽；如其形體肥而無神氣者，猶似蟲之蠧木，故枯朽而速敗也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李嶠耳息而享百齡，孟軻内養而輕萬斛。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448941107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龜息者，氣自耳出，故享其壽。李嶠耳中出息，享遐齡之壽。孟子善養浩然之氣，雖齊宜王授以萬鍾之祿，不顧也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和柔剛正之謂君子，隘狹急暴之謂士卒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448957491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣和寛剛正爲君子；氣狹隘急暴，爲士卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如龜之息兮，保其遠大，如馬之馭兮，重其馳逐。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448973875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957693584162857"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龜息之細，渺然不聞。葢能如龜息者，可保長年之氣。若如馬之馭駕者，生平有馳逐之重勞者，辛苦百至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身大音小禍所隠，身小音大福所伏。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330448990259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身大音小者，形聲不相庶，故隱其禍而待其發。身小音大，神氣有餘，故燕其福而侍其時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天聲音之所發，自元言而乃𨪦，與心氣以相續。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449006643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聲音之發，起于丹川，與心氣相精而十也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"琅然其若擊名，曠然主若呵谷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449023027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯乃內藴道德，終應散穀。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449039411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聲淸則琅然若擊磬之音；聲獨則曠然如呼幽谷之奥。此謂内懷道德之人，終當享其厚祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957912296226831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之羅網者，乾溼不齊；謂之雌雄者，大小相續。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449055795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或先急而後緩，或先緩而後速，是爲粗俗之卑冗，焉遂風雲之志欲。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449072179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聲音有乾润，出而不等，若聲大聲小，相續亂出，或先急而後緩，或先緩而後急，皆爲粗俗卑下之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨四時之氣，如春蠶吐絲之微微；察五方之色，如浮雲覆日之旭旭。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449104947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辨靑、白、紅、黑，豊四時之正氣也。在于皮上者，謂之色；皮裏者，謂之氣。氣者，如粟如豆，如絲如髪，藏于紋理之中，隱于毛髪之內，細者若春蠶之絲；欲察五方，正如浮雲覆日之散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣明而饒田宅，天嶽暗而罹桎梏。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449121331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957693584228393"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地閣光明者，田宅多廣；天嶽昏暗者，刑獄多憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粟黃繒紫多豪貴，脂白苽靑合賢淑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449137715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"粟黄者，如粟粒之點嬌黄也。繒紫者，如紫線之亂盤也。是爲靑龍之氣。若面部四時常見者，乃豪貢之人。○人之面色，其白若脂，其靑若苽者，廊廟之噐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若相者精究其術，而妙悟于神，安逃禍福","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449154099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"？若相者細究此書，而得其神妙，則禍福無逃也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：嗟嗟世俗不知因，妄將容貌取其形。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449170483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得正形爲大貴，依稀相似出羣倫。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449203251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形滯之人行必失，神滯之","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449219635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957937160044584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人心不開；氣滯之人言必嬾，色滯之人面塵埃。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449219635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形神氣色都無滯，舉事心謀百事諧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449236019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色在皮而氣在血，脉聚作成多喜悅，散則成憂，靜則安，部位吉凶皆有訣。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449252403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○又曰：欲窮禍福貴賤，除觀諸家相文，聽聲、觀形、察色，有肉神、音神、眼神，總欲觀之，則自然明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449268787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○又曰：迷而不反，禍從感起，災自奢生。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449285171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老子曰：天之道，利而不害；聖人之道，爲而不爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449301555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449317939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"風鑑歌","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706681866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳希夷","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706698250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957693584261161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之所稟氣兼神，以火爲神水作精，火本爲心永爲腎。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449334323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精全而後神方生，神生而後氣方備，形備而後色方成。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449350707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是知色隨神出實，此乃氣力逐聲鳴。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449367091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有形又不如有骨，有骨又不如有神，有神又不如有氣，神之得氣旺如春。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330449383475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大都神氣賦于人，有若油兮又有燈。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892357642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人安本自精神實，油清而後神方明。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892374026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夜宿于心常寂寂，日居于眼覺惺惺。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892390410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其間或有清中濁，有時又取濁中清。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892406794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼風韻細收藏，久坐凝然力轉强。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892423178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此之人堪立事，輕浮太急少須𢗅。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892439562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其次又看形與骨，骨皮與膚須","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892455946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957966838939663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軟骨。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892455946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要其就兮與未就，旋有旋兮終不久。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892472330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然未好巳先盈，花未開兮子巳生。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892488714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老人不欲似年少，後生仍須帶老成。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892505098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男兒不欲帶女相，女子不欲帶男形。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892521482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂反于陽必損壽，老懷色嫩必須傾。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892537866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丈夫婦女兩般詳，女要柔和男要剛。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892554250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人受隂本要靜，未言先笑卽非良。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892570634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"良人有威而無媚，娼婦有媚而無威。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892587018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令人一見便生侮，所以生身落賤微。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892603402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木要瘦兮金要方，水肥土厚火尖長。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892619786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形體相生便爲吉，忽若相尅便爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892636170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金得金，剛毅深。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892652554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木得木，資財足。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706714634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水得水，文學貴。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706731018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火得火，威武大。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706747402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957693584326697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土得土，多財庫。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706763786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金不金，多伏吟。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892668938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木不木，多孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706780170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水不水，多官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706796554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火不火，多災禍。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706812938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土不土，多辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706829322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如形體本先瘦，次後身肥最爲妙，復加瘦削木乾枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892685322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木帶金兮災轉多。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892701706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦如形體始方正，次後背隆最爲應。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892718090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然始方次又尖，金帶火兮災愈添，初中最好末後災，腰小行來步又開。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892734474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初中蹇滯末後好，腹背俱生懸壁倒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892750858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生只在選人中，體俗形粗背不隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892767242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有賢自然能賢荷，學堂成就是非同。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892783626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有金之人必有面，有土之人必有背。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892800010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其或面清多極貴，面似田兮身似具。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892816394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時舉眼","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892832778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957990129926196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨身起，有時樓語和身退。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892832778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近觀有𡡾遠有威，久視愈明初見晦。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892849162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下三分一正面，常調之中豈曾見。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892865546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜息尿散屎必方，相中偏僻見非常。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892881930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠看形醜近看好，上馬大兮下馬小。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892898314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更若藏骨與藏神，八座三台官最好。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892914698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須知觀骨有四般，入耳無過壽更寛。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892931082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揷向天倉須兩府，髩生鹽司兼守土。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892947466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"借問相中何獲壽，認取神藏骨又明。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892963850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或然神短骨又露，四十三前大可驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892980234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心灰于內神槁外，相法曾明爲主人。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330892996618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨氣秀淸神肅靜，豈在凡間隱却身。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893013002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瞻視睂平眼又平，不然爲道便爲僧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893029386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫衣","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893045770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957693584359465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"師號因何得，三主如金人中臣。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893045770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無祿有官神必汎，有祿有官在神清。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893078538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"走獸飛禽類數般，莫將禽向獸中看，瘦長但向禽中取，肥知當干獸裏觀。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893094922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似禽之人不嫌瘦，如獸若肥最爲妙，禽肥必定不能飛，獸若瘦兮安快走。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893111306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎看腮兮犀看角，鳳看眼兮鶴身削。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893127690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南人似北必富貴，北似南人主崢嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893144074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吁嗟流俗不知音，也向飛走要言形。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893160458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上貴之人方入相，中下之人豈可評。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893176842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富人不過厚其身，貴士方當與論神。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893193226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴在于眼富在耳，富貴同看誤于人。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893209610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知南人體似北，身大而肥面多黑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893225994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958019209117748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知北體似南人，體瘦身輕氣薄淸。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893242378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不貴似貴終須貴，不貧似貧終處貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893258762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧中及貴由何得，看取驛馬先生骨，貴中貧反有何由，胸高體薄神何昏，淸奇古怪秀異端，七者之中亦吊看。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893275146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清而無神謂之寒，奇若無神焉有官。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893307914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古而無神謂之俗，怪若無神仍主辱。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706845706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀而無神謂之薄，異而無神多謂弱。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706862090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端而無神謂之粗。","logicSentenceId":"7606688234706878474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有神七者與當殊。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893324298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見達之人志必遼，視高之人志必强。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893340682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕下斜并赤暈，心存奸惡氣高昻。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893357066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更問神生何帶殺，認取白晴多聚血。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893373450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要辨刑中却帶刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893389834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定刑獄位有","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893406218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957693584425001"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋痕。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893406218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀氣與色宜相合，色居皮上氣居無。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893422602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來如蠶繭曳牽絲，去似馬尾毛方歌。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893438986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲福定隨日影去，福必定交終日聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893455370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看青色與黃紅，又認發時于何部。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893471754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若言隨部上觀之，吉凶悲喜定無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893488138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形滯之人行必重，神滯之人形必開。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893504522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣滯之人聲必硬，色滯之人面塵埃。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448501286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得意之人有可識，辨取三光及五澤。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893520906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然時下不知心，其部自然多黯黑，最愛有處一如無。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893537290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又忌易憂兼易樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893553674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須知相貌出天然，我若有之非外鑠。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893570058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淚堂深陷山根折，少年悲泣何曾歇，父母防害切須知。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893586442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更如睂","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893602826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958043955593268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上認高低。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893602826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"素無兄弟睂粗短，耳輪無廓主無妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893619210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有一法辨防妻，閣中枯陷少人知。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893635594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日角龍角誰謂奇，所爲不吉任何爲。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893651978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三尖五露不相人，所爲皆吉禍因齊。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893668362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不辨心而論相，是將人事逆天時。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893684746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天時人事如相稱，相逐心生信有之。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893701130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大都貴賤不相識，微妙盡夫人眼力。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893717514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居然由貌以觀之，恐誤世人認凶吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893733898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957693584457769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤密運兮，品類咸亨。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893783050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南火北水兮，東木西金，春風夏雨兮，秋霜冬水。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893799434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方丙丁合兮，主文明，北方壬癸配兮，剛威臨，東方甲乙旺兮，主慈仁，西方庚辛秀兮，風氣淳，月滿則虧兮，日中而移程。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893815818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南人五子兮，多主分，北人五妻兮，多喪身。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893832202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳳鳴而必利兮，蛇蠍出而方生，時候氣制兮，偏正不齊。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893848586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南人面如雞子兮，北人頭似斗底平。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893864970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東人短兮，西人脚長，南不相天兮，北不相颧，東不相嘴兮西不○腿。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893881354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南人似北兮必超羣，北人似南兮終飛騰。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893897738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東人似西兮而聲名，西人似東兮","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893914122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958065111711744"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893914122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南不相輕清兮，北不相重濁。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893930506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東不相色嫰兮，西不相老成。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448550438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南人形相分明兮，北人古怪而精神。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893946890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東人俊兮，骨氣漸衰，西人秀兮，氣爽而神清。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893963274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南婦貞潔兮，額廣頂平，北婦貞潔兮，五嶽平正。","logicSentenceId":"7580389330893979658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東婦貞潔兮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236290611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瞻視柔順，西婦貞潔兮，神清氣靜。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236306995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南婦淫兮赤脈貫晴，北婦淫兮，掠髩斜行。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236323379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東婦淫兮笑坐不停，西婦淫兮顴面不平。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236339763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南婦妨害兮，髪黃鴉聲，北婦妨害公額于橫紋，東婦妨害兮，四白羊晴。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236356147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西婦妨害兮，身硬男形。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236372531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子無肩兮，到老貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236388915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子無肩兮，至老榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236405299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236421683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957908345126924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口小兮，貧薄天亡；女子口小兮，聰慧智良。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236421683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子蛾睂兮，損爹損娘；女子蛾睂兮，寵妾寵房。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236438067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子剛而明怏兮，輔佐君王；女子柔而貞靜兮，宜配賢郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236454451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿有官有爵兮，十二官中兼看。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236470835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無神無色無氣兮，八卦數內循環。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236487219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴貧賤分定兮，視南北東西，人物相當。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236536371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五嶽四瀆九州兮，識運限四柱，禍福災祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236552755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麻衣眞秘訣，千載永留芳。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236569139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"太九眞人書","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448583206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大一眞人，侍天顔之咫尺，額廣足圓；趨帝闕之須臾。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236585523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂清目秀","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236601907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958113069121571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236601907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭高闊，不貴還當富有餘；地閣尖長，多憂還是家不足。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448566822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻如懸膽，平生足祿足財；耳若連腮，自是有名有譽，因甚功名較晩。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236618291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筋骨傷高，緣何壽命不長。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236634675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中短促。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236651059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口無稜角，終爲說是說非。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236667443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇若含丹，一世潤身潤屋，常是憂深遠慮，只爲睂攢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236683827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然而吉少凶多，皆因目陷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236700211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷殘骨肉，須知眼下淚痕；尅害親情，偏忌怒中喜色，欲識其心不善，眼視偏斜，要知其心不長。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236716595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇掀舌薄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236732979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒方而密，聰明勤視詩書；目潤而長，志氣貫通今古。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448599590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若知貴賤，細看分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236749363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236765747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇若掀翻，言語虚而","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236782131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957908345176076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懷奸詐；眼如深露，詭詐大而藴强梁。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236782131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五嶽不正，非盡善盡美之人；兩眼雌雄，豈由義由仁之子。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236798515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色如常變，必蹭蹬而名更遲；聲若破鐶，多刑害而心不睦。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236814899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂如一字，豈能潤屋肥家；昔若屏風，終是封妻䕃子。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236831283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹垂腰闊，衣糧足用而倉庫充；胸露臀高，家業散而壽源少。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236847667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃天庭中正，定知事事無憂；假若睂宇長弘，心主般般利益。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236864051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身宜橫闊而正匾，不入相維；體上短下長，難爲吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448615974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫行步緩重，當爲仁德；更如坐視端莊，必爲福相。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236896819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神要藏而威不露，貴而可知；色要正而","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236913203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958139841413172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣要淸，富而不𩆍。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236913203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色要細察，方斷吉凶；形要細觀，方言貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236929587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或形清而後有福，或貌古而有前程。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236945971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古怪清奇，必當詳審。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236962355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不以美善而言福，不以𨢄怪而言凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236978739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此名太一眞人書，喚作仙家神品鑑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331236995123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上輔學堂左右分，平如鏡子亦無紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237011507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼中正無傾陷，定作公侯爵位尊。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237027891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中輔學堂七十分，平光潤澤是賢臣。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237060659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼下部俱成就。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448632358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六部尚書近聖人。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237077043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下輔學堂地閣朝，承漿俱滿是官高。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237093427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如敎上輔來相在，必坐樞","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237126195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957908345208844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廷佐帝堯。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237126195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨秀神淸滿面全，學堂坑陷定難前。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237142579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天生雖有聰明性，若論求官定不然。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237158963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面部雖然短不朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237175347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神清骨秀氣超超，學堂更及分纒數，亦作郞官助聖朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237191731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部位光充肉又肥，氣昏神暗性多癡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237240883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂若有朝官祿，壽短須防主卒危。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448681510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨格粗肥面闊横，行如鴨子踏浮萍。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237257267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂若有爲官職，短命須防五十傾。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237273651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王府六官人皆有，箇箇生來無可觀。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237290035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有學堂須食祿，忽然欽陷受饑寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237306419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五露形神有學堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237322803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨清神爽定朝郎。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448697894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無學館并神氣，必定區區死路傍。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237339187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言人骨好心須好，若","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237355571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958165321760820"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有學堂須顯榮，不問富豪全不發。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237355571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富豪到底得亨通，福見精神漫不全，坐來良久氣本鮮，少年須則未榮逹，老享渠田作巨賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237371955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠看印骨宛如神，近神尤如醉病人。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237388339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似此形人卑下賤，到頭短命又饑貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237404723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面似銀盤五獄豐，神昏氣黑必無終。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237421107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豪家若產如斯子，總有資財亦是空。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237437491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形神不足頭低側，行步輕浮背又薄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237470259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤身年窮老苦，生來必定破亡家。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237486643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語言虚斜行無步，生若無人定早亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237519411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此三般應促壽，不過三十入㝠鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237535795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終曰連宵神氣淸，醒醒睡覺便分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237568563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉輕骨重無高","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237584947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957908345274380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下，學堂庶陷豈成名。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237584947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎頭龍骨人多貴，睂目分明便是官。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237601331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負當時一槩說，冷他後代好相看。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237617715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂目分明骨氣淸，眼如點漆更分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237634099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂若無官職小，縱有文章恐没聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237666867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲大雄心地惡，日窺斜視必無良。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237683251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青多白少斜歪甚，虚妄談非好闘爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237699635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼視偏斜視物斜，負窮奸詐凂人朱。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237716019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不爲盜賊幷兕惡，路死街傍沒土遮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237732403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼中赤脉雖刑死，露出睛來定惡亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237748787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不法塲臨路死，不然自縊虎狼傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237765171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白多羊眼親人低，裹帽無頭沒了睂，更若露晴須惡夭，刀兵爭𨷖更須書。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237781555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縮囊口輔","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237814323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958194056937524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老無粮，雨畔叙多早𣦸仁。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237814323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口如吹火家貧賤，縱承祖䕃費田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237830707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳本生來朝大海，亦看輪廓客垂看。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237847091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大主一生多近貴，小無輪廓不榮遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237863475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻準生來直更圓，潤如犀伏主高賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237879859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曲又高孔仰露，心中奸詐不堪言。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237896243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上部須長下亦長，腰身周正壽高强。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331237912627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐如山時行如箭，此人須貴坐高堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391479817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上部雖長下部尖，肥頭大肘不爲賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391496201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人只是常流輩，任有文章祿不遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391512585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身大鬚長面亦方，眉濃口潤凖頭長。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391528969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才五岳皆牛满，必定榮華作郡王。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391545353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩部肥圓下部尖，重行露骨不爲賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391561737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀書","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391578121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957908345307148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬卷終無亦，縱有无章壽不全。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391578121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"張方印潤三才正，出外超群耀姓名。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391594505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"岳凟學堂昔飽滿，若非將相定公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391610889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭光潔司生起，中正朝高與凖平。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391627273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼鼻聳如懸時，此是天官必小榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391643657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔角光隆滿更平，天庭朝起學堂成。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391660041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城廓潤寛邊地滿，必是王矦將相形。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448714278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額方有𧢲更身長，高聳伏犀似枕梁。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391692809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定是貴人多仔細，學堂成就佐君王。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391709193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂下黄光潤又平，眼長眉聳是公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391725577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩邊顧骨高侵鬂，福壽俱全一世榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391741961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨生髪際起天中，爲儒必解利名通。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391758345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧下之家生此子，不須囊槖月然豐","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391774729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958221601013760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；目秀眉疎細更濃，耳輪貼肉不愁窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391774729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口須方濶兼紅潤，牙若如紅心不公。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391807497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲從臍下響連長，骨秀神清面又方。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391823881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭骨更方遐上壽，筭來九十始身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391840265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飬男如女多淫慾，滿面嬌姿始害方。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391856649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"促壽更兼無福德，看看三十早身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391889417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食祿之家生子薄，到頭須是祖光榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391905801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有一官兼食祿，亦須短命少年傾；形貌雖然好十分。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391922185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好心不正定沉淪。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391938569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然有一微官職，到老虚名命不存。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391954953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭生異骨人爲貴，面若乾枯定是貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331391987721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑子靨紋多苦相，到頭衣食仰他人。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392004105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大頭無骨兼驅耳，到底貧窮日","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392036873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957908345339916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漸凉。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392036873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此之人須尅害，家財盈足也應亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392069641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閭尖小必貧虚，倉庫蹉眈舍亦無。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392086025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縣壁生紋并黑子，破家貧賤定區區。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392118793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭似鍾尖體細長，跟薄無光定路傍。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392151561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乞食𣦸時無葬地，克軍做賊自刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392167945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲低垂薄又斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392200713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤单獨自傍人家，懸壁更兼生黑子，終身貧困不生涯。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392217097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生額𧢲潤如卯，髪際低生近伴眉，定是爲奴并走使，縱然冨貴不多時。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392266249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立如錐卓坐如削，腰下無臀身又薄，不問豪家與貴子，到老無成自蹇落。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392299017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額尖大腦薄又無髮，眼嘴不堪鼻如墨，此是貧窮下賤人。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392331785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飢寒處","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392348169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958253599293475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處無衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392348169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不語自語貧下賤，妨害孤单目下見，一笑唇摇薄業財。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392364553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到老無成命乖蹇，戰堂黑氣戰中亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392380937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手滿光明志氣榮，䧟側邊庭刀下𣦸，平高爲將靖邊疆，塜墓㐫亡左右看。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392397321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨頭豐起必平安，乾枯必是䘮父母，歡陷雖知幼小難，到老隨人做僕奴。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392413705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥不露肉瘦無骨，方覺斯人壽命長。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392430089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨若露昻貧且賤，肉如露出少傾亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392446473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
