{"lines":[{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲推命祿，先相形神。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392462857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀姿儀之滿澤，量面部之三停。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392479241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957908345389068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥而無餘，豪貴若粟黃縉紫；痩而弗瘁，賢才定脂白瓜青。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392495625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼細而深，機關莫測；體魁而黑，狡猾難明。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392512009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤急性傲，塋緩心靈。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392528393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女互容，以防其人情莫久；面色更顔，安保其心事無寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392544777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲辨高低，先看額相。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392561161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上窄小貧，下寛滿貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392577545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上中分五位，無令瘢靨疵青；横列多名，盡要潤光舒暢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392593929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨起衡山，官居朝望。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392610313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直懸一理，從髪短印以封矦；横畫三紋長，身未立而父䘮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392626697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲水人重乘亂畫，貧困堪裁；山川並及八字，雄豪可讓。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392643081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其有眉定信義，眉主精神。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392659465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉要烏濶而平起，目要清光而正","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392675849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958279364886568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392675849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"缺薄行幅濃長，必豐眘之朴；低垂智淺細長，定慳劣之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392692233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尾逆弑父，毫長壽神。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392708617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日下肉生，或險無光而絶嗣；晴上胞覆，或𤺄異而奸親。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392725001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緩視性沉，赤急虚暴。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392741385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猪羊鼠鸚，貪疾天而多妨害；鷄猴蜂蛄，婬昏蠱而定盗。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392757769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧似龜囗者，莫言其冨；短同魚目者，必屢遭迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392774153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤白者，必遭兵𣦸；昏黃者，定落波津。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392806921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻兮高山，要白于而竅小，而頭低尖曲，庸兮性劣多孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392823305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梁峻凖見明圓，智譽兮名資大炫。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392839689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彎首妨親，分頭害春。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392856073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戴靨芟藕兮賤可觀，懸膽截筒兮貴可羡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392872457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱多䧟缺，女損胎而男","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392888841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958100163215396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂獄；梁足橫紋，婦害婿而夫危賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392888841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狹高危而少雁行，瀾横大而好虎戰。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392905225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根左右，一名盡要絶瘢；年上東西，四處無令有靨。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392921609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中有靨，女性欺夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392937993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或産子而生多媚色，或婚妻而不問良媒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392954377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長一寸兮破竹状，祿二干石兮烈士動。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392970761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺短曲而上寛，子少兮信行淡蕩；深長直而下廣，壽遐兮其嗣成群。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331392987145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口必方正，唇雖紋理，有紋有子，無紋無嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331393003529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劒鐔足義，如含丹而財祿彌豐；鳥嘴多言，似吹火而子孫大鄙。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331393019913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綽薄少信而好偷盜，翻嗟露齒而爲役使。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331393036297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女靨生居兩伴，左貴子而石害","logicSentenceId":"7580389331393052681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958309509398563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫；興紋立于上邉，深大澤而淺危賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331393052681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近觀青白，撮縮多般而貧賤；遥觀通紅，緩急無稜而詭許。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331393069065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中央不與，鼻正定落横亡；人中牽帶，鼻蹇必遭兵𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331393085449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳竅廣洪，性識高虚。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331393101833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醜小而不歛神道，聳長而必誦詩書。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542474779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猴意難測，祿食無餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542491163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔毫出兮延年，輔骨起而遐壽，輪靨生兮性必智，垂珠懸而祿自如。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542507547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三寸長而如田字，官高列土；兩耳大而有輪廓，異寶盈車。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542523931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上廣下狹，輸番廓露，身必受苦，錢財不聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542540315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異母元因左太黷枯貧虗先女只爲右豐潤鮮敏悟。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448763430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有察其聲色，分其善惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542573083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958100163248164"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄光色而有慶，清亮聲而無恒。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542589467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣定譬旺，音分宫羽。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448779814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨困苦之將來。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542605851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知夾禅義已遵壬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542622235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃撮其樞要，舉其大細。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542638619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄談神妙訣唐舉。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542655003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入眼先知訣，還觀起生中。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542671387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語遲當貴顯，歩促生孤窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542687771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天目應須逺，鷄眸莫與逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542704155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項偏多蹇困，頭小必飄蓬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542720539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甘露財無剰，合圓命早通。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542736923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形寒身且薄，離祖各西東。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542753307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相法西岳先生。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448796198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好頭不如好面，好面不如好身，先要三停相稱，五官","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542769691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958333035184128"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六府相成。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542769691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉秀眼長冨貴，色明印淨功名。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448812582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口似含丹不賤，切防唇上縱紋，法令入口餓𣦸，交眉必定多連。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448828966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊眼蛇睛人必毒，毫生眉耳壽源増。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542802459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下肉枯防子，頭偏腦䧟傷親。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542818843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且觀和尚道士，必定貌古神清，眉粗眼小福薄，眉小眼大多貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542835227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉高眼深人狠，更兼赤脉貫晴，開眼瞳人神露，更兼夢裏多驚，下唇過上貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542851611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上唇葢下孤苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542867995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行看脚歩隂毒。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448845350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂無紋理，遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448861734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉卓如鎗，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542884379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口大不合.人貧而經身粗何用。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542900763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"户𧢲下垂無祿，準頭黄色多欣。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542917147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻酸人不入相，翍眉人不聊生。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542933531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958100163280932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日聚浮生泪泪。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542949915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳尖食祿多輕。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448878118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉垂多爲僧窺，穀道澁者爲榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542966299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呂后隂毛過膝，李牧神彩射人。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542982683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呂布身長七尺，叔敖隂德添令，世上有福有壽，腹垂胸淵勝深，次看脚跟有後，又看其後有根，如此當爲壽考。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331542999067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍鐘鶴髪之人，隂上無毛淨賤，乳小不黑，孤貧女子，面上黒子，不爲妨害風塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331543015451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皮藥面黟肉緊，小兒必䘮青春。","logicSentenceId":"7606688913448894502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣促語言不接，指日必見闇君。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331543048219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭上餘皮餘骨，男見出衆超群。","logicSentenceId":"7580389331543064603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繄相人之有術兮，肇東周之叔服。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686152218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"監昭晰之幽隱兮，亶休咎之是卜。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686168602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈惟貧富壽夭藉兹以前知兮，而至貴極賤，亦由之以品錄。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686184986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遵先哲之貽則兮，匪聲利之賈鬻。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686201370","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨氣色于幾微兮，定吉凶而占禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686217754","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因風土而知禀賦兮，閱清濁以分形局。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686234138","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眇一身而配三寸兮，僃","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686250522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958317885571110"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行與干支之相屬。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686250522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"列八卦以配九州兮，尊五嶽與四瀆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686266906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紛總總其殊相兮，均部位三百六十而又六。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686283290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨四時以推生剋兮，妙制化之嬴縮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686299674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘識鑒之不真兮，繆千里于亳忽。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686316058","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫頭象之法乾兮，宜峻極而隆圓，頭若小爲一極兮，又忌頂陷而尖偏。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686332442","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟額之主火星與紫氣兮，司禍福于少年。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686348826","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭司空之列位兮，要方濶而壁懸。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686365210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際高而邊地滿兮，伏犀輔骨隱隱而揷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686381594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天無亂紋之侵𧢲兮，保富貴之兩全。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686397978","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘削小而凸凹兮，兼雜理之纒聯。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686414362","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矧額小爲三極兮，必困苦而憂煎。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686430746","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958387758301193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟印堂之于闕庭兮，中正司空之上連。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686447130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲豐正而明潤兮，懼促陷而髪侵邊。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686463514","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢睂宇之于人兮，實顏面之奇表。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686479898","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左𦌴右計而對宮兮，須疎秀而光皎。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686496282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或一字而過目兮，或高長而人𩯭杪。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686512666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或彎如新月兮，皆享天爵而終壽考。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686529050","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若旋螺而粗濃兮，必罹禍而凶狡。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686545434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟攢蹙而主憂煎兮，骨格露而剛躁。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686561818","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘壓眼而交連兮，必行伍之凶暴。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686578202","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諭兩目之主監察兮，按右隂而左陽。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686594586","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑白分明而視瞻平正兮，聲蕐早振于巖廊。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686610970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍睛大而光明兮，鳳眼秀而入鬢長。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686627354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神收歛而澄徹兮，朱門顯逹","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686643738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958387758399497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎侯王。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686643738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑㸃漆以清秀兮，蔚爲葢世之文章。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686660122","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤縷于瞳而急轉兮，一身寧免于刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686676506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙睛鬭露以浮白兮，性少匹而夭殤。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686692890","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短細深而圓小兮，心抝毒而無良。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686709274","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似醉則淫而睡則困兮，仰剛俯險而斜不減。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686725658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雞蛇䑕而偷盜兮，羊不慈而蜂橫亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686742042","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破山根爲月孛兮，要柱直而圓平。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686758426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貫印堂以亘中正兮，多富貴而壽寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686774810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下接鼻而不曲兮，又瑩潤而朗明。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686791194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男得美妻而女賢夫兮，榮戚里之有徵。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686807578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中陷折而枯暗兮，則妨害而絶親。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686823962","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明看鼻居中而爲肺主兮，奠中岳而位土星。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686840346","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要端直而隆","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686856730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958435644604454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚兮，凖光瑩而黃凝。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686856730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如截筒懸膽而骨堅兮，風門濶大而藏形。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686873114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺廷尉之相應兮，則貴顯而富盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686889498","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟尖小而薄狹兮，或凸曲而斜傾。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686905882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必失禄而破産兮，或巧險而凶刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686922266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準黑暗而斑駁，復亂理之縱橫。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686938650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"匪貧病之倚伏兮，必憂疑之相因。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686955034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻毛出而誹謗滋蔓兮，孔昂露而甑釜塵生。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686971418","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫耳之採聽兮，金星左而木星右。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751686987802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳環白而深肥兮，輪廓分明而圓厚。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687004186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上週睂而下齊準兮，輪貼肉而垂珠朝口。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687020570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倉門容指而紅潤兮，斯富貴之兼有。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687036954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳有毫而後有骨兮，廼期頥之長壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687053338","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘軟缺","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687069722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958435644702758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而無輪廓兮，尖薄如箭羽而貧無守。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687069722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反無珠而不貼肉兮，雖見成而不久。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687086106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更皮粗而青黑兮，則破家而奔走。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687102490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繄人中之象溝洫兮，貴疎通而不塞。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687118874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内欲深而外濶兮，闕不垂而長不縮。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687135258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髭或交而藏隱兮，多子孫而壽益。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687151642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或短促以漫漫兮，或紋理之橫直。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687168026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則男女之不育兮，並孤滯而可惜。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687184410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿平斜蹇而不正兮，擬貧賤而困逼。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687200794","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟上廣而下狹兮，慨世緣之孤逆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687217178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚肥卷而肉疾兮，必壽命之夭人。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687233562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中有黑子而立理兮，養他姓之子息。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687249946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉痣塞而不通兮，主無媒之婚匹。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687266330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口出納而主","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687282714","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958435644784678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水宿兮，位奠坎而爲河海之源。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687282714","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橫濶而端正兮，方四字而朝天。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687299098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開大闔小而𧢲上向兮，内寛綽而容泰。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687315482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若銜丹而潑砂兮，官將相而祿食緜緜。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687331866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌開小而闔大兮，及尖反而薄偏","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687348250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687348250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而語略綽以撮緊兮，縮螺吹火而孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674387507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或無人而獨語兮，或未語而唇先掀。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687364634","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食淋漓而言露齒兮，兩𧢲垂而流涎。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687381018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必貧賤以貪狡兮，抑孤夭而遭愆。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687397402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但亂紋之入口兮，終餓死之必然。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687413786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇爲口之城廓兮，要上下之相稱。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687430170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無紋理之侵破兮，欲稜𧢲而方正。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674403891","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或紫赤似凝硃兮，此富貴之夙定。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687446554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淺薄而","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687462938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958435644899366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誕墮兮，紛謗議之相併。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687462938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或青黑而似䑕兮，破田園而貧病。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687479322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上不葢而下粗厚兮，主兵刅之非命。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687495706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌爲口之鋒刅兮，欲方大而微紅。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687512090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似潑砂而噀血兮，長至準而王公。","logicSentenceId":"7580389751687528474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋駁雜而横直兮，主祿庫之盈充。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374864422","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋八字之分明兮，卜異相于九重。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374880806","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖小窄而方赤兮，亦珥貂而扳龍。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374897190","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟紫暗而長薄兮，終困危于寒窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374913574","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌大口小兮貧夭，舌小口大兮，言語如蜂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374929958","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短而黑子兮，無始終。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374946342","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吐舌如蛇兮，性狡凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374962726","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無事䑛唇兮孤毒，漫勞心兮言無蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374979110","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒當門爲學堂兮，欲齊大而宻固。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751374995494","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟堅排而平整兮，","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375011878","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958467957620774"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則誠信而壽富。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375011878","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色如銀而瑩如玉兮，必榮逹于當路。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375028262","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綴石橊而光潤兮，貴九州之顯布。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375044646","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數六六而享福兮，滿三十而財豐。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375061030","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒若黑細尖斜兮，貧滯疎漏短折兮，誑誕而夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375077414","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375093798","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事多阻兮如竅出，窮無依兮聞口露。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375093798","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375110182","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人之有面兮，要圓正而平方。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375110182","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然五岳之拱峙兮，須上下之相當。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375126566","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大如斗而方如田兮，欲皮厚而無紋傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375142950","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山林秀而法令正兮，牆壁滿而豐祿倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375159334","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿深兮地閣厚，三停等兮日月光。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375175718","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但肥白而潤澤兮，或黃白而紫糖。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375192102","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必福壽而貴顯，宜富厚于田莊。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375208486","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色雖黑而身白，","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375224870","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958467957735462"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面雖短而眼長，皮雖粗而身細，皆早入于朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375224870","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面無肉而焦枯兮，主家耗而奔忙。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375241254","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皮薄無神兮破敗，肉橫生兮刑亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375257638","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橘皮破兮少子，甲黯散兮心非良，藍赤見兮公訟，白無光兮空囊。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375274022","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頰帶拳兮剛毅，塵埃暗兮志不揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375290406","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髮繫天而欲圓兮，黑長委地而極貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375306790","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髭須在中而繫人兮，欲三稜而㧞萃。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375323174","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本長硬直以黑潤兮，必朝野之善類。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375339558","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僻處下生而不露兮，法欲方而應地。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375355942","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或額上之有毫兮，實威權之雄勢。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375372326","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬚髮黃而多病兮，赤則氣熱而多訟事。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375388710","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項爲一身之棟兮，上扶首而下總百","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375405094","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958506989715465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骸之㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375405094","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富者豐圓而堅實。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375421478","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴者方隆而光漬。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375437862","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥人欲短而瘦欲長兮，有餘皮而衣食豐裕。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375454246","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘雙絛而合一兮，必黃耉而鮐背。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375470630","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟頸促而形魁兮命夭，反小弱兮非大器。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375487014","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"折無亳兮貧寒，擁如癭兮凶滯，㗋有結兮多賤流。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375503398","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦禍緩兮肥必戾。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375519782","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胷平正而長濶兮，斯福智之駢臻。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375536166","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉豐厚而覆舟兮，子貴祿而疣醇。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375552550","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有數毛而益壽兮，凸陷短薄而孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375568934","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳紫黑而下垂兮，又安榮之貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375585318","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若細小而窄白兮，廼下愚之庸民。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375601702","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腹圓厚如懸箕兮，有三壬之超倫。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375618086","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若皮粗而上重兮，或雀腹而貧","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375634470","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958506989830153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病之邅迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375634470","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心頭有毫而性剛兮，骨凸陷窄以走風塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375650854","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寛平皮厚兮，妙聰察而德有鄰。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375667238","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臍要寛深而向上兮，忌突淺而向低。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375683622","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂平厚而背若負兮，腰正直而有支。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375700006","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐碇石而不動兮，行平穩而有儀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375716390","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟形局之豐偉兮，或滯氣之未舒。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375732774","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戒逞才而輕進兮，在藏器而待時。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375749158","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗟貴人之未遇兮，猶槁木之含滋。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375765542","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羡一日之秀發兮，則名播千華夷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375781926","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖氣色之在面兮，豈淺識而見窺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375798310","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青主驚兮赤主擾，白憂服兮黑病罹。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375814694","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄主吉兮叅四季，隨生剋而例推。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375831078","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟女婦之于相兮，比男子而異宜。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375847462","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨法","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375863846","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958506989944841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"峻峭兮，神色嚴威。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375863846","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五岳寛大兮，持重而無媚姿。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375880230","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口小含丹兮聲音清徹，睂圓背負兮，重閣豐頥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375896614","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行不動塵兮笑藏齒，法令過口兮富貴滋。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375912998","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此女中之翹楚，必椒房之結縭。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375929382","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭白而向上兮，斯子息之難爲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375945766","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若子息之易得兮，必乳頭紫而下垂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375962150","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居九醜兮非良婦，具十惡兮豈美妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375978534","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇紫黑而下掩上兮，身必寡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751375994918","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臉薄赤而媚無威兮，節必虧。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674420275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而三顴兮夫𫇱喪，眼四白兮，淫無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376011302","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繄南北之殊產兮，紛形肖之絶異。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376027686","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廓千態而菡狀兮，政貴賤之靡類。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376044070","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖外貌之環持兮，或心德之奸獪。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376060454","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958538572840997"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟表裏之相副兮，則大福之可冀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376076838","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟存養之不恒兮，則災殃之難避。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674436659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外陋惡而内純厚兮，庶禎祥之來萃。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376093222","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"固善惡之萌于心兮，夫何相之足恃。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376109606","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔先子之精鑒兮，幸文皇之隆遇。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376125990","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣閱形以辨色兮，復察心而驚勵。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376142374","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指仁義以爲干櫓兮，申孝弟而爲鑿柄。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376158758","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俾脩省以懲艾兮，全堂堂之德器。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376175142","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余踵武以紹先烈兮，揆淺陋而懷愧。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376191526","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"感聖恩之念終居兮，賜懸車之嘉惠。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376207910","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"述舊聞以示同志","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376224294","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958538572922917"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兮，嗟精奥之罔備。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376224294","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或堯言舜趨而蹠其行兮，雖深察。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376240678","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而難試。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376257062","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故莽懿之有是兮，貽禍患于漢魏。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376273446","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識介甫于未萌兮，惟老泉與吕誨。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674453043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢金玉之混沙石兮，在良工之陶淬。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376289830","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粤簡編之有傳兮，必心融而面諭。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376306214","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無稽而肆言兮，則羞吝之並至。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674469427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘明哲之有取兮，亦庶幾乎垂世。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376322598","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生隂育，天尊地卑。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376355366","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦絶通玄，大父親傳于心鑑；術高神異，麻衣黙度于希夷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376371750","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實口傳而心授，皆意領而","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376388134","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958538573021221"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神知。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376388134","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蠢蠢羣生，按五行而取像；紛紛品彚，列八卦以開頥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376404518","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驗風土之厚薄，識人物之賢愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376420902","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問其年甲高下，知其運限興哀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376437286","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀形貌而可取，分貴賤以無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376453670","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清奇古怪，骨法見而貴必殊；老幼嫩弱，氣色濁而貧可知。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376470054","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聽其聲而審其滯與不滯，察其神而觀乎離與不離。","logicSentenceId":"7580391751376486438","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無神必壽夭，無聲必命危。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017097266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲韻似破鑼，終身孤獨；神清如電灼，才學衆推。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017113650","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南人似北相，家有青蚨而綰紫綬；北人類南相，身登翰苑而衣朱衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017130034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦人木形，見重金而最怕腴；肥人土局，遇濁水而豈嫌肥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017146418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火尖水下，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017162802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958538573135909"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未年不遂；金方聳上，初主爲魁。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017162802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形色焦枯，夭折易相。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017179186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面皮綳急，壽不可期；魚尾陷枯，安有賢妻俊妾；蠶囊綻裂，必無親子孫枝。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017195570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準小鼻狹，而最慳最吝；齒疎唇薄，而多是多非。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017211954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼露睛凸，性剛氣暴，色昏神散，夢杳䰟飛。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017228338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腐肉橫生，夭亾之兆；人中短促，速死之期。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017244722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤脉貫瞳，性惡而亾塡溝壑；螣蛇入口，項折而倒死街衢。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017261106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽不宜相反，君臣要得其正。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017277490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三隂三陽俱陷，難爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017293874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾奸門盡露，豈獲賢妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017310258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人口𧢲痣生，親夫早䘮；男子眼下黑見，有子先歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017326642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍宫要乎平滿，子位","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017343026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958570621599753"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈宜偏𧇊。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017343026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臥蠶盈滿，而多男足女；涙堂深廣，而無妾少妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017359410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂清而平生性無偏無黨；睛明而轉處心知變。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017375794","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知機手如綿囊，一生享安閒之福祿，面似灰袋，半世遭夭折而傷悲，頭額尖而早被刑害，骨法見而顯達不遲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017392178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五岳相朝，仕路早登于金闕。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017408562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四瀆俱美，顯官正守于邊陲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017424946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白過面而名標𢁺榜，晴黑如漆而身到鳳池。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017441330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名譽視乎兩耳，及第在于雙睂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017457714","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文官清秀，掛金魚而朝玉闕；武將古怪，佩𢁺符而拜丹墀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017474098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法令顯見，聳金縷，鎭江山之永固；𢁺睂露凸，連牛𧢲，保社稷以","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017490482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958570621698057"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無危。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017490482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍瞻𢁺視而平定北狄，燕頷狼顧而清蕩東夷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017506866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背厚腰圓，九州威鎭；面方耳大，四海名馳。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017523250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劒睂骨縱而性好殺，駢脅胸濶而戰多奇。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017539634","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴宦有全于五露，富貴豈削于兩頥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017556018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地必相朝揖，岳瀆勿要傾欹。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017572402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣厚而多田宅，天倉濶而實鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017588786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家肥屋潤，膊厚面肥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017605170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四倉豐盈而玉簮珠履，九州平滿而金鎖銀匙。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017621554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口濶唇方，必定有財有祿；鼻隆順滿，果然豐食豐衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017637938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱甲匱豐盈，庫中青蚨聚積；日𧢲輔𧢲平起，廏中寶馬交馳。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017654322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳有垂珠更朝口，毫長一寸，可延期。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017670706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行若龍奔，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017687090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958570621812745"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"英雄出衆；坐如𢁺踞，富貴當時發越。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017687090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覩乎神氣厚實，視于而皮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017703474","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣清出自丹田，貯積千鍾之粟；背隆高聳肩膊，堆積萬斛之珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017719858","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貌古形殊，富格先觀于面頰；神清精實，壽毫早見于雙睂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017736242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項條明而彭祖再生于中國；法令長而壽星永現于南箕。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017752626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面貎厚實，坐立如𢁺；背膊豐起，氣息如龜。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017769010","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福厚積而背腰圓，美德高而腹乳垂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017785394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中長，倉庫滿，福禄全美；壽骨高，準頭厚，富貴雙奇。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017801778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾笏紋朝耳，非壽星而其誰，龍宫黃氣盤眼，有隂騭而孰知。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017818162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三甲三壬，遐齡永保。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017834546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四反三露，寒賤","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017850930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958603492343818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何依。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017850930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口小唇掀，食難充腹；肩寒齒露，身無所居。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017867314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四瀆皆濁，五岳俱離，背陷胸窄，睂散齒疎。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017883698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行時手足褰掣，坐時眼目偷窺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017900082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天倉陷，祖業破敗，地𧢲尖，貲産灰飛。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017916466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上濶下尖是反形，初年勞漉；身上短下長爲逆局，一世遷移。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017932850","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面貌昏昏若塵垢，氣色黯黯比汚泥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017949234","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井竈露而厨無糧米，精神怯而舍没塘池。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017965618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳反無輪兮田園賣盡，頦尖少肉兮家業遷移。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017982002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂偏斜視，手常擺唇薄肩束，口似吹睂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907017998386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濃睂淡散，口濶口髙低。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018014770","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻孔仰天，錢無貫百，倉庫陷缺，食不𠑽飢。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018031154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對人言未語而面常","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018047538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958603492442122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羞澁，與人行未動而足失東西。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018047538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒𦈫而語多妄誕，言汛而信不可期。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018063922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局察乎雜與不雜，氣色觀乎移與不移。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018080306","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形像取乎彷彿，禍福不差毫釐。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018096690","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦語詳熟，果然神見。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018113074","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相法明鑑，叅透玄機。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018129458","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"人倫淵奥賦","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018145842","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"管輅","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674502195","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狀貌各異，形神不舒。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018162226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男心狠而害子，女性剛而殺夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018178610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪厚睂連，盡是凶愚之輩，頥尖額窄，但爲孤寡之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018194994","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原夫聲之韻而貧大，目有神而高壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018211378","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"威顯體重者，功名必遂；背削肩寒者，資財莫守。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018227762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏犀隆峻，終爲廊廟","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018244146","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958603492573194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之英賢；俊目修長，必作文章之領袖。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018244146","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果爲善惡易見，曲直莫量。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018260530","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜視倫觀兮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018276914","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自然損害，下視高窺兮，必致刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674518579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗟夫！","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018293298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉之間，何喜怒之不常。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674534963","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如失志之時，遽遭破財窘迫；若稱心之際，偶爾添祿榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018309682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵表直形端，言繁性燥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018326066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傲劣而可見愚濁，温厚而深知機巧。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018342450","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠齒漏而多非，猴面長而不飽。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018358834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黨結奸邪之輩，讎似孫、龎；締攀温粹之流，義同管、鮑。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018375218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而况氣有煙露之象，色欺日月之明。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018391602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或散或聚，或重或輕。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018407986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察其優劣，審其性情。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018424370","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滯則三寸之希，喜則八卦之盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018440754","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑旣見于隂","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018457138","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958635834605577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，身災无咎，青若有于年壽，官訟相縈。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018457138","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且夫肉不澤兮，競起旋途，語失常兮，徑趨冥路。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018489906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腮昏暗而朝夕，鼻慘黯以旦暮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018506290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃淺有遷變之喜，赤重有羈囚之苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018522674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如絲貫準，知泣涙以煎憂；火氣侵眸，忌官非之恐懼。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018539058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有耳紅更好，唇紅愈奇。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018555442","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似波瀾之潔兮，顯則莫比，如脂膏之膩兮，破而可知。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018571826","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜則求其望用，雜則阻其所爲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018588210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髩髪如拂鑑之光，欣然得祿；淡白若温灰之状，災䘮求醫。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018604594","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誠哉！","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018620978","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富不在于衣冠，貴不專于儒雅。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674551347","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慕德修義者，固窮守道；方頦豐頭者，輕裘肥馬。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018637362","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"的然聲不附","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018653746","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958635834720265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形，而身處優游者，未之有也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018653746","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"驚神賦","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018670130","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀夫神堯睂分八彩，大舜目有重瞳。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018686514","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武帝有二漏耳，文王有四乳身。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018702898","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漢祖龍顔，宋玉驢耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907018719282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔夫子河目海口。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109371913","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楚項羽𪈏頷虎頭，虞姬身似凝脂，陳平貌如冠玉。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109388297","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漢高祖左股七十二黑子，楚襄王堂中現出五花紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109404681","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前賢旣有如斯，後世焉能無相。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109421065","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色乃行年休咎，骨格乃一世鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109437449","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停平等，一生衣祿無虧；五岳朝天，一世資財足用。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109453833","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭高聳，少年富貴可期；地閣豐肥，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109470217","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958667052744755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晚景風光獨占。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109470217","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口爲水宿，定一世衣祿有無；鼻是財星，管中年窮通造化。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109486601","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂清目秀，攀龍附鳳之賢；氣濁神昏，鞭馬牧羊之輩。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109502985","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髮際低而皮膚粗澀，終是貧窮；手指密而脚背圓肥，當爲富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109519369","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準頭豐大，多爲福面肉橫生性必兇。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109535753","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"智慧生于皮毛，苦樂觀乎手足。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109552137","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜頭鼈腦，關門喫食之徒；羊目魚睛，緣木求魚之子。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109568521","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙眸㸃睛，盖世英雄；一㸃生臍，超羣志氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109584905","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋水爲神玉爲面，女人必作君妃；芙蓉如貌柳如睂，男子當爲泉客。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109601289","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼橫秋水，髻如鴉，月約星期；口是窑竈，行似雀，東奔","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109617673","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958667052843059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西走。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109617673","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亂紋生于口𧢲，當餓死之亞夫；赤脉貫于瞳中，是難封之李廣。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109634057","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吕望耳毫紅細，石崇鼻孔圓收。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109650441","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廉頗兩眼尾以豎天，鄧通雙口𧢲而向地，亞夫兩縧垂下，文王一痣當胷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109666825","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因形見心，足辨人之貴賤；聽聲察色，便知人之賢愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109683209","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗟夫！","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109699593","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露齒卓睂，豈作朝廷任用；攅睂撮口，難爲臺閣臣僚。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674567731","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠目獐頭，必竟難登仕路；蜂腰鵉體，如何去問功名。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109715977","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"林泉有碧眼神仙，朝野無交睂宰相。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109732361","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名高玉册，應知心廣體胖，身拜丹墀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109748745","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖是天庭高濶，龍行虎歩，將軍勇節制之臣；獅鼻龍睛，廊廟作","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109765129","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958667052957747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"股肱之佐。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109765129","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜形鶴骨，樂道山林；雀步蛇行，遭官囹圄。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109781513","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢凶有救，印堂静而黑不侵；遇難無凶，福堂明而神不露。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109797897","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼深骨起，至親恰似他人；邊地豐隆，非親卽同自已。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109814281","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犬形豕視，常懷嫉妬之心；鷂眼蝦睛，不脫强梁之性。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109830665","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下長上短，浪走他鄕；齒露結喉，難爲眷屬。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109847049","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜，爲金匱之有虧；當憂不憂，緣玉堂之朝拱。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109863433","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳如紙薄，休望榮華；而似皮綳，莫言壽算。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109879817","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭高濶，得上貴以提㩦；地閣傾斜，招下人之訕謗。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109896201","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃神與氣清，雖色滯而不貧；假饒氣弱神枯，縱色明而何用。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109912585","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109928969","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958700099665958"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"！","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109928969","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧寒婦女，無非胸凸臀高；淫泆娼妓，一定身粗面細。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674584115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺夫聲出雄壯，好慾面帶桃花，背負睂隄，唇掀齒露，倚門立户，鼻仰唇牽。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109945353","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒女刑傷，淚堂深黑，田園賣盡，井竈撩天，手脚揺動，平昔言而無信，承漿豐滿，晩年壽命有歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109961737","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋理攢睂，年年不樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109978121","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜紋貫印，日日多憂。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674600499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說是說非，盖爲唇輕舌薄；不仁不義，亦因睂厚睛流。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907109994505","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有福者手似綿囊，無福者唇如黑椹。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110010889","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女多子少，兩睂只看兩頭垂；父死母傷，額𧢲方知生黑子。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110027273","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"塵生滿面，其人不久前程。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110043657","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑子人中，抱養他人之子。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674616883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髭鬚拂右，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110060041","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958700099764262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定然妻弄夫權。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110060041","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行坐端莊，定是子承父業。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674633267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論運限，各部推之。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110076425","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細辨根基，各尋玄妙，賢愚壽夭，莫逃此篇，學者觀之。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674649651","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"燭謄經","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110092809","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人禀隂陽之正氣，形似天地以相同。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110109193","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面分金木水火土，色映東西南北中。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110125577","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中聖雖有全德，造化終無全功。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674666035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分清奇古怪之貌，班秀氣純厚之容。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110141961","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸者寒潭秋月，奇者聳壑喬松。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110158345","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古似嵯峨盤石，怪似峭壁孤峰。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110174729","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人能有此，富貴隆鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110191113","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀若深根直幹，異者舞鳳囘龍，純如","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110207497","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958700099862566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"良金美玉，重如泰岳華嵩。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110207497","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一于此，爵祿非庸。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110223881","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳平有冠玉之顔，身居九鼎；衛青有覆肝之額，食祿萬鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110240265","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或三高六下而不等，或六勢三端而不克。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110256649","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身有七尺之魁偉，面無一尺之豐隆，早年發福，中歲困窮，神昏氣滯，初主迍蹇，未主享通。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110273033","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面粗身細者，多趨利逹；身粗面細者，少吉多凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110289417","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道骨端圓，掇高科而登要路；鳯姿龍表，非世格而豈凡庸。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110305801","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉枕分品字者，超羣特達；伏犀貫頂門者，光祖榮宗。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110322185","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉停匀者，財通胡越；身形粗滿者，壽不穹窿。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110338569","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天有隂陽寒暑，人有悔悋吉凶，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110354953","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958700099944486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆出身形之外，超乎骨格之中。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110354953","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面部星辰如圓壯，時間氣色欲鮮明。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110371337","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月侵于印堂，仕宦騰路；山根驛馬光顯，動用皆成。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110387721","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左額𧢲偏，父必先亾；右額𧢲陷，母必早喪。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110404105","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下長上短，始于憂勤；下短上長，終于逸樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110420489","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸針印上，骨肉抛離；黑痣印堂，夫妻隔𧢲，氣哭聲和。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110436873","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺見易知，氣緩神利，深機莫測。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110453257","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面方耳大，官持一道之權；口大聲細，位至三台之列。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110469641","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴骨人髩，清貴玉堂；口弓朝天，姓名金闕。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110486025","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面無肉口縮囊，孤寡破敗易飄蓬；淚堂陷，山根折，少懐惡信何曾歇。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110502409","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九醜者羈難，六反者","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110518793","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958731850596361"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滅絶。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110518793","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭牆壁而方，早有騰昇；地𧢲尖削而短，終無發越。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110535177","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾深凹，男子多淫；奸门凸起，婦人少節。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110551561","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱光明，兒孫利益。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110567945","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下偏枯，妻子有刑。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674682419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜，多因印綬之糢糊。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110584329","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當憂不憂，乃有隂功而保免。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674698803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行則揺頭，處事隂謀，坐則低首，爲人詭譎。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110600713","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清奇拱應，少年龍乕榜中人。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110617097","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古怪藏神，終歲鳳凰池上客。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674715187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體骨如油如鐡，鬼魅胞胎。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110633481","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肌膚似蘭似馨，非凡骨格。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674731571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴形龜體，心雲變化若鵾鵬；龍腦鳳睛，浩氣凌摩于鵰鶚。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674747955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手眼脚邊帶破，未免徒刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110649865","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面耳鼻髪焦枯，必無餘剰。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674764339","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪亂之人，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110666249","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958731850694665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仁義多疎。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110666249","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腮凹之漢，情性更虚。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674780723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人骨起，隂反于陽，定孤剋。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110682633","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子肉絛，陽生于陰，必夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674797107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"川紋印上，數損憂煎。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110699017","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水字如弓，終主愚頑。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674813491","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴高頥突，剥削鰥夫寡婦。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110715401","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面藍色脫，靠子假妻窮漢。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674829875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者先宜熟觀此鑑，然後依各部相之，禍福有準。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110731785","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人形相定有方，不見街頭在舖廊，神凛凛，貌堂堂，地閣承漿更濟鏘。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110764553","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色雜神光都不見，直饒冨貴也尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110780937","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
