{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴賤前緣，何須怨天。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110813705","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根斷而幼遭疾苦，頤額尖而老受迍邅。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110830089","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫敎言語凄嗚，必防兒女。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110846473","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若耳輪反露，定破田園。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674862643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開唇露齒，黑子多咎。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110862857","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切記承漿平濶，善能杯酒山林，井竈缺而乏食，印堂明而官休，體香必有。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110879241","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官位屍殖，定知無壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110895625","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手短若蹄，昏迷可知。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674895411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少資金人面塵土，多妻妾人楊柳眉。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110912009","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤下卑，臥若屍而食若鼠；冨貴榮重，坐如山而行若龜。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110928393","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虚步稀逢，鍾聲少遇。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110944777","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼晴明白男聰智，頭髪稀疎婦刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110961161","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以知碧油紅","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110977545","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958766868840499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斾，因印堂廣而封衞青。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110977545","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉秀閻黃，與額骨隆而玉石勒。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674911795","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月有𧢲，不公卽卿，行傍觀而定無子，食䧟唇編應没情。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907110993929","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴形仙態，龜背壽形。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231006746","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨明大方居頭，一生獲福。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231023130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白長光過面，四海張名。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674928179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸高骨露，鼻竅毫長。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231039514","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇齒露齦而子孫薄，獐目西睛而兄弟少。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231055898","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌上有兩條紅絡，食祿天倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231072282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉間有三道顧紋，𣦸于兵刃。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674944563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨法雖備，榮年未至。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231088666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伎藝外巧，聰明内惠。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231105050","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨重身輕，獲財之俊；上長下短，官印得祿之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231121434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幼而心亂，先卑而後榮；長而性悟，始貧而後冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231137818","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○雙眉入鬓，胸襟懷冠世之","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231154202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958766868955187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才；黑睛如環，藴藉抱出群之器。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231154202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿有壽，却見三堂之貴，位極人臣，肉潤骨剛之秀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231170586","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五岳豐而貴永，三才缺而殍殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231186970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項後露頰，田園廣而私佞多；眉散目黃，結㗋露而子孫少。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231203354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡神入耳，祿承紫綬以何虚；龜息藏形，貴顯廟堂之半代。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231219738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉濃多滯，目在視而不可觀；下視偸窺，言㓗冷而自判。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231236122","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目有四白而多義，忽低首者而殺人。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231252506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不藏而橫夭，口眼小而壽短。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231268890","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近觀内明，逺視者大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231285274","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳大輪漫者壽永。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231301658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙眸有力者祿昌。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674960947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳竅有全絲，三寸貴而一寸冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231318042","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目視有神光，陽左顯而隂","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231334426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958766869069875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231334426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後不見耳雖貴，語言輕作必強。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231350810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨口和人者内空，低言頻語者内剛。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231367194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂頭有靨，位至矦伯豈非揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231383578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙手龜紋，祿慶終而官自久。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231399962","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時有先後貧富，睡易醒。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231416346","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難初中坎坷，白首孤单，目乏盖而終身貧賤，耳無輪而眉若擔山。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231432730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇掀齒露，遭凍餓以何疑。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674977331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱口理紋，𠷰口食而寡聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231449114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手足應紋，醫卜爲術而妙道。","logicSentenceId":"7610704241674993715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喟嘆在口，平生一日不舒顔。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231465498","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"披裘貴顯，榮祿優閑，有髮無髭，不可與之同侶。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231481882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髭髯大宻，得藝術以翻翻。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231498266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪鬂全美，有祿位而極壽。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704272946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬂下垂而口小。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231514650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離鄕失業，頂平額廣，眼","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231531034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958802365268005"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄眼碧。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231531034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲僧爲道以高榮，受平生之福德。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231547418","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"楊氏論神氣","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231563802","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古而無神謂之露，露而無氣謂之孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231580186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清而無神謂之寒，寒而無氣謂之亡。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704289330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怪而無神謂之粗，粗而無氣謂之枯。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704305714","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇而無神謂之薄，薄而無氣謂之弱。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704322098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀而無神謂之衰，衰而無氣謂之虗。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704338482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異而無神謂之醜，醜而無氣謂之拙。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704354866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端而無神謂之黯，黯而無氣謂之敗。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704371250","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"動静論","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231596570","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"達摩","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704387634","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相之大叚略備，尚有小節。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231612954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當知喜時常怒，必是艱心","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231629338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958802365349925"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苦力之人；怒時反笑，定主刻厲狼堅之性。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231629338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對人頻頻偷視，莫與交逰；無人忽忽自言，豈堪遠大。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231645722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐每低頭，心同豺蠆；食多淋落，身似絮萍。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231662106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無痰常吐而吐不收，先冨而貧","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231678490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，不收聲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有話欲言而言不足，有頭無尾，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231678490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不盡言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾言而口常撮聚，必破産飄蓬；無事而動每匆忙，終離宗困頓。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231678490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋絲纒眼，山根青筋起者，重刑","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231694874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，犯重刑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丹珠抹唇，滿目桃花浮者，浪蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231694874","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"雜論","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231711258","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"袁柳庄","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704404018","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"上篇","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231727642","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人貴之相有三：曰聲、曰神，曰氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231744026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖聲清則神清，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231760410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958802365497381"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神清則氣清，驗此三者，形骨次之。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231760410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以古者方伎之妙，有聞人之警恪，而知其必貴者，得之于神也；有察人之喜怒操守，而知其必貴者，得之于氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231776794","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲欲響濶而長，神欲精粹而藏，氣欲舒緩而淨，反此者，弗貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231793178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有聲而神氣怯，聲緩，則其貴遲；有神而氣怯聲破，則其貴不逺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231809562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冨貴而神濁聲慢，未可以言貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231825946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三者，幽而難明，玄而難測，惟意所解，言莫能窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231842330","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"中篇","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231858714","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形成而不可變，體具而不可缺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231875098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡形體，惟在完滿、隆厚、清潤、崇重、平正、華秀者，不貴則富也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231891482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惜夫","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231907866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958839652696115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怪而粗，古而露，清而寒，秀而薄者，皆非美相。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231907866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人論部位法，以額凖、地閣、左右顴爲五岳，以眼耳口鼻爲四瀆，以上下左右分爲九州十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231924250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此觀之，則一形之徵，其所𧧅也，烏可淺淺而論之哉？","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231940634","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故上有天子，下迨庻人，其五臟六腑九竅之形皆同，然其所爲形則異也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231957018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若辨折之，須于三停五行中求其要妙。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231973402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次看氣色，左顧右盻，尋根揣本，則貴賤貧富，吉㐫壽天，灼然可見。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907231989786","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"下篇","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232006170","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形體，相之根本也；氣色，相之枝葉也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232022554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根本固則","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232038938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958839652810803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枝葉繁，根本枯則枝葉謝。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232038938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫論相，所以先究形骨，而後觀其氣色，此皆氣色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232055322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫氣舒則色暢，氣恬則色潤，氣和則光澤華美見于色，此皆氣色之善也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232071706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣偏則色焦，氣滯則色枯，氣蔽則憔悴黯黑見于色，此皆氣色之㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232088090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫形如槁木，心若𣦸灰，淡然不與世俱，此又聖人之相，不可以氣色論也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232104474","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"雜論","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232120858","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麻衣","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704420402","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人之相，必以清竒古怪而爲貴，惡俗貧薄而爲敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232137242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清竒則名高位顯，古怪則貫朽粟陳，惡俗則貧賤之","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232153626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958871739039753"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒，孤薄則刑害之子。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232153626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人則身重脚輕，小人則身輕脚重。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232170010","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒似乾而溼，目似水而乾，手掌熱如火，軟如緜，色常潤者，乃福人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232186394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉高則名高，職高則鼻高，眼長而有學，口方而有辨，名在眉，職在鼻，計在口，俊在目。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232202778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽在耳，貴在額，福在背，富在腹。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232219162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上視高貴，下視隂毒，逺視賢，近視愚，平視德，高視激，下視狼，斜視盗，亂視淫，猛視暴。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232235546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有此視者，必有此騐矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232251930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲食貴人祿，須生貴人齒；欲穿貴人衣，須生貴人體。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232268314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人頭上少髪，賤人身上無毛。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232284698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人有金木水火、土之相，金不嫌方，木","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232301082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958871739154441"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不嫌瘦，水不嫌肥，火不嫌尖，土不嫌重。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232301082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋欲深而不欲淺，深則志深，淺則志淺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232317466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用則神施于外，收則神合于心。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232333850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近觀有志，逺觀有威，瞻視有力，睡臥易醒，此乃神之全也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232350234","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之爲氣，要内堅卽音，須潤和暢，不在剛徤，震嗚急促，内藴則和，外施則暢。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232366618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有清中之濁，則内輕而外重；有濁中之清，則内蔽而外明。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232383002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浙人氣重而不明，閩人氣明而不重；南人氣清而不厚，北人氣厚而不清。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232399386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以隂陽朗而山川秀，日月出，天地明，此乃氣之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232415770","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色須形于面目皮膚，欲深而不欲浮，欲聚","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232432154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958871739269129"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不欲散，發于五臟之表，爲一身之光彩。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232432154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有所得而喜主于内，有所失而憂生于中。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232448538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有老而色嫩者，謂之弱也；或有少而色老者，亦弱也。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232464922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面有三光，烏有四澤，烏有三暗。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232481306","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形與神相照，氣與色相附，神全則氣全，氣全則色全矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232497690","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"貴賤相法","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232514074","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人之生，爲萬物之貴，懐天地五常之性，抱隂陽二氣之靈。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232530458","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖秉彞之本同，肖容貌之非一。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232546842","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀其人，當觀其氣色；知其相，則知其賢愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232563226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以龍犀爲帝王之形，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232579610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958907189313562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜鶴爲公卿之器。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232579610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于穀下豐，則知其有後；李廣數奇，則宜其不侯。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232595994","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜形鶴骨而終軍棄繻，𢁺頭燕頷，而班超授䇿。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232612378","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂旣瑩，岑文本立顯詞章；蘭臺巳全，范仲淹身居輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907232628762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃知相法，端造玄機，當觀次第。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344252954","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖先觀其額而别其眼，然後察其形而聽其聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344269338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃取貌形，細觀氣色。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344285722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴賤不迯于藻鑑，災祥瞭若于筮龜。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344302106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善有則善之形，惡有則惡之相。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344318490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有善藏于惡之内，有惡隠于善之中。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344334874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善爲福之基，惡乃禍之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344351258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頗得其意，始舉其凡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344367642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是必頭聳腦豐，面方印濶。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344384026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼湛寒波而分明清媚，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344400410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958907189428250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂彎秋月而疎淡秀長。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344400410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獸耳下垂，獅鼻隆起，髪疎細而染漆，口方厚而含丹。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344416794","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語無囁唇，笑不露齒，腹垂而腰厚，肩圓而背平，人中長而井竈明，山根厚而倉庫滿。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344433178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三方皆正，五岳俱全。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344449562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言簡且清，若流泉之響幽谷；坐端又直，如釘石而起浮雲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344465946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不陷無虧，非貴則富，如權秉鈎衡，牆壁方厚，掌欲微紅，面生潤白，眼下隂陽有光，鼻邊法令修長。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344482330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡賦此形，皆爲善相。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344498714","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上相之善者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其眼雖長而睂促，額頦廣而頭尖。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344515098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背隆胃潤而嬈其腰，耳聳唇方而坑其腦。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344531482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形魁而雀歩，骨細而鸭聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344547866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344564250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958936817795099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清則神似癡，色瑩而坐不正。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344564250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆有深淺之善惡，豈無先後之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344580634","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言善中之惡者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或男顴低而女顴高，或女手軟而男手硬。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344597018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準或斜曲，頭或欹偏，睂或低昂，齒或疎缺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344613402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲妬害，豈不尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344629786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甚而肉緩皮粗，髪焦唇薄，㺅睛鼠耳，馬口雞胷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344646170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手短而脚長，身大而音小，脊高，睂縮額尖鼻低。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344662554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂曲則非愁而若愁，目粗則不怒而似怒。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344678938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色昏而神不粹，語泛而歩如奔。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344695322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪而不厭，淺識難明。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344711706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有靑浮赤緩，或有臉發靑藍。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344728090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃不令之形神，爲非常之兇惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344744474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上相之惡者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958936817877019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然而體雖薄而額廣，頭雖偏而氣清。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344760858","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩目粗大而身滑如苔，及眼迷蒙而聲聞似甕。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344777242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳雖似薄，起唇上之覆舟，牙或有尖；聳額中之圓鼓，未易置善惡之論，亦可爲富貴之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344793626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言惡中之善者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲定其容貌，可不取于形狀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344810010","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知飛走，巧以推尋。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344826394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要髣髴以略求，不必拘泥于全似。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344842778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳳晴龍眼者爲文貴，蜂睛豺聲者爲武榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344859162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猿背猿聲，未有不登科甲；𢁺視𢁺骨，當知定至兵刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344875546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜鶴者益年齡，牛猪者豐衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344891930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鷹嘴須防于蜂蠆，鳥喙必畜于狼心。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344908314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如蛇則少食","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344924698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958936817958939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而孤，似羊則多淫而夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344924698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上飛走取形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨衆形而爲喻，特片語之强名。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344941082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與其形似于羣類之殊兮，未若細繹于五行之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344957466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金方木瘦，水圓、火尖，土主厚肥，形分差别，有體形之相生。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344973850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋則爲災，生則爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907344990234","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看或肥或瘦，須要旋成旋就。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345006618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上五行取形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然論相而論形，尤必觀氣而觀色。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345023002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發有本末，應有深淺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345039386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如蠶口吐絲，似蜂唇挑粉。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345055770","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取五行而論五色，按四季而定四方。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345072154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有一日之間，綴以八年之内。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345088538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色由微至著，占徃知來。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704436786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在心目之妙觀，非唇舌之可述。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345104922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958936818073627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其初入孔孟之室，浪登許負之門。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345121306","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唐舉、許負裒集諸子百家，不勝于岐萬轍。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345137690","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或彼此之相反，吉凶之未詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345154074","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剪其繁蕪，撮其樞要。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345170458","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先緝簡易之數語，繼陳次第于篇中。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345186842","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘有補于缺辭，不敢望于同志。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345203226","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"心鏡歌","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345219610","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡相法有兩般，須看三停端不端。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345235994","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五岳四瀆要端正，一長一短不須論。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345252378","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額要濶兮鼻要直，口方四字豐衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345268762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭圓象日照天庭，睂曲彎彎多學識。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345285146","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂頭昂昂禀性剛，縱紋不使入天堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345301530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下眼觀人多毒害，羊睛四","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345317914","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958966836477978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白定孤孀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345317914","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻曲之人多孤獨，項短結㗋神不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345334298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男面似女女似男，心中懷事多淫慾。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704453170","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼眇微小有重睛。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704469554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"披緇學道有音聲，紅潤相兼秋水色，男人文學女多情。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345350682","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳形雖小有輪廓，衣食自然多不錯。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345367066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直須高聳平印堂，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345383450","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玄珠朝口内上截平印堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定掛金章膺品爵。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345383450","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉清秀而終不散。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345399834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入鬂雲鬟多燦爛，若教散短又無光，兄弟斷然不相盻。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345416218","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇要紅兮怕紫色，細潤分明富貴客。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345432602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘴尖唇薄招非辱，紫黑多傷凶暴厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345448986","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐要端，立要直。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345498138","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不端不直人不識，先笑後語人非良。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345514522","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不言不語人難測。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345530906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲音細語雖小，必在人間隨衆走。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345547290","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髻髪長如盖漆，形似𢁺狼當貴職。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345563674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"那堪紅紫短而乾，孤獨一生無福德。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704485938","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髮細長而黑且潤，不盖天庭聰與俊。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345580058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"委曲拳旋若盖垂，水色人情多少信。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704502322","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"得意歌","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345596442","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡相于人有三般，三停須要端。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345612826","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陷損面部定貧窮，隆厚萬般通。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345629210","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根見陷子孫少，義子來相呌。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345645594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臥蠶豐滿","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345661978","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330958966836723738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多子孫，損破定無因。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345661978","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何爲積榖多財住，眼下爲財庫。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345678362","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月𧢲中見骨生，貴壽永長榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345694746","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上顴骨有權衡，衆中最馳名。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345711130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭大須要地閣應，下尖無餘剰。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345727514","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣爲宅又爲田，肥厚富天然。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345743898","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地若陷定窮途，終是一樵夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345760282","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳輪須要三般厚，尖薄忙忙走。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345776666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩頭尖薄中心小，衣食終年少。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345793050","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩耳兩眼俱兩般，父母異無端。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345809434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左是假爺右假娘，細看不須忙。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345825818","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人衣食容易看，光澤面團團。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345842202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火相火色眞姿容，黑變定貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907345858586","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生好道","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449126921","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959004899835913"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼中黃，赤氣必性剛。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449126921","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腦後有骨伏犀生，此是封侯因。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449143305","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無相應卽平平，衣食却持均。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449159689","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂破時終少官，失職擾相干。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449176073","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更無牢獄兩邊勾，妻兒每爲愁。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704518706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒刑之處有三般，印堂横紋斷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449192457","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三更看天中紋，仔細定元因。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449208841","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中印堂謂妻娘，破時損田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449225225","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂中直上有三紋，喫酒賭錢人。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449241609","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒池若陷少酒器，肥滿能杯是。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449257993","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破陷少肉爲坑池，因酒損身巳。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449274377","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又名法令壽帶長，富貴彭祖上。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449290761","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四十之年要法令，五十年須定，若無法令爲中平，財","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449307145","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食兩難便。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449307145","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡相學堂有三以，三處一時看。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449339913","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三處拜將","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449356297","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959004899966985"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又轉官，兩處作公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449356297","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂若無定少官，只作衣食斷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449372681","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金形金色真爲貴，有火終須滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449389065","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"熾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木形木色是三清，此必是文人。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449405449","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水形水色若分明，衣食自然成。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449421833","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火形火色多宫災，災禍不曽停。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449438217","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土形土色部中看，衣食定無官。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449454601","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木水火土五行，要金要木正。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449470985","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之部只怕偏，莫斷作官員。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449487369","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行形中有古貌，古貌其中少。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449503753","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼目顴骨勢見高，終是作賢豪。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704535090","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行其中正色昌，無光終須旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449520137","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉人來問科塲事，天中黃色美。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449536521","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中白氣終須滯，必主悲泣至。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449552905","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋間是火定爲殃，金火反爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449569289","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無黃","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449585673","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959035430092809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣定無解，終是碌碌輩。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449585673","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬間黄，春得官，終是樂且歡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449602057","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中印堂見國印，甲科分明定，山根準頭地閣黃，及第登科忙。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449618441","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月無黃不須行，免其禍患生。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449634825","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樓臺之中見頭垂，腰曲面白死。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449651209","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之中更分明，眼昏終是貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449667593","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面見黑色及白氣，此是死須記。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449683977","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春間見有春間殃，萬定不相當。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449700361","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四季之中皆准此，樓臺倒定死。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449716745","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唐符國印定來因，四邊牆壁應。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449733129","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唐符爲大國星黄，","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449749513","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕發中陽。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449749513","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"國印爲主定天宫，三陽逢火星。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449782281","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中直下地閣排，終是見和諧。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449798665","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行凡相不相人，波波受苦辛。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449847817","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"國印紫色黃旗薦，定是轉官星。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449864201","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"號名赦書不日到，罪者心中好。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449880585","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面如鍾馗應少子，至老孤獨死。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449896969","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口似吹火絶嗣天，飢餓日無餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449913353","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男面似女定家破，活計少人做。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449929737","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面如水洗犯天羅，官災非橫多。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449946121","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面如麵袋終是破，妻子不團坐。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449962505","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男帶桃花眼主淫，不免被奸侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449978889","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人掩口掠睂頭，終是外人偷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907449995273","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡看人相部位，一一須仔細。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450011657","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面帶塵埃終是薄，心口多謀度。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450028041","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽在中年","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450060809","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959035430338569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不善終，終是主顛風。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450060809","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊睛四白終是惡，猝死更無錯。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450077193","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雞睛蛇睛眼愛偷，日夜使心謀。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450093577","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人上下分長短，終是富貴看。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450109961","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰薄頭尖終夀天，衣食終年少。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450126345","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥人不見肉爲貴，瘦者神清是。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907450142729","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嬰門玄壁青氣生，數年不稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680747547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又見黑雲同處起，剋爺妨兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680763931","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一年之內頻撓括，饑饉愛相爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680780315","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"客舍少府黃雲現，必位三公上。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680796699","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三榮遷職八遷階，不免中書相。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680813083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"商旅邊地及三女，青紫細看取。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680829467","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後先多記莫妄言，三堂黃財聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680845851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖宅荒墳青破家，災來自落花。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680862235","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不信直言一百日，一死臥黃沙。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680878619","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坑塹陂池氣似鎗，爲是黑紋長。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680895003","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"急急直言三五日，死葬高岡上。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680911387","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤白如螺準頭起，數年身不利。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680927771","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽見高聲語不來，立便有迍災。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680944155","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面多青色笑無","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680960539","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959149569785894"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顔，久病在人間。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680960539","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼前白練尤且可，凖白災難過。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680976923","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰練如煙拂而生，數載招災禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907680993307","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唐符國印紫氣生，非久處朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681009691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬重重發紫氣，朝命不日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681026075","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唐符驛馬國印生，紅黃定稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681042459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三日宜頭連夜天，勑召入朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681058843","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"有相人歌","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681075227","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍形及𢁺形，龜形與鶴形。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681091611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳳目獅子目，黑白自分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681107995","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂濃如八字，口方四字平。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681124379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳輪皆貼肉，手足紋理縈。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681140763","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登高如五岳，齊整于三停。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681157147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉頭兼視正。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681173531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閒口響鈴鈴。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681189915","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨格能平正，皮膚自滑凝，心神如鎮石。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681206299","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口肉自香聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681222683","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959149569916966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣學如無學，憂驚不自驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681239067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隱然色滑淡，神氣迨清清。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681255451","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更欲看心相，元來肉有明。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681271835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腦邊居五骨，胸上㸃三星。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681288219","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腦上通紋理，頥邊骨肉盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681304603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手中有黑子，足下踏龜成。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681320987","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飡啜如龍𢁺，如龜理歩行。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681337371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀從元氣足，紫炁抱胎生。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681353755","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不怒人皆畏，含嗔不欲爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681370139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等閒無處捨，當世不崢嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681386523","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語媚令人愛，㗋嚨是鼓聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681402907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡眠如伏𢁺，夢寐有眞徵。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907681419291","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是可皆先兆，心神似有靈。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907767877683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然連禍難，終有福神并。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907767894067","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"窮相歌","logicSentenceId":"7580391907767910451","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭骨無稜角，髮拳黃落索。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907767926835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂散睂心交，眼睡眼皮薄。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704666162","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959176790769674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻斜孔䨇露，目小唇掀薄。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704682546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牙齒疎黃尖，音聲散臺鐸。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907767943219","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩目不相同，耳内無輪廓。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907767959603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩頥尖復斜，髩髪皆交錯。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907767975987","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夜睡開眼眠，晨朝困冥寞。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907767992371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不醉似醉人，不病形如惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768008755","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不愁似愁多，不忙常霍索。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768025139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結㗋骨太多，骨前骨寥落。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768041523","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肚臍凸多露。","logicSentenceId":"7610705879704698930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳頭如太岳，皮血大粗疎，豎起于肩博。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768057907","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手内無紋理。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768074291","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚歩如行雀，飡飯羹不珍，口中滋味惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768090675","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飲酒未三杯，言辭盡交錯。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768107059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時聞抵對人，眼目似東郭。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768123443","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與人知聞，三好卽兩惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768139827","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背面是非人，言語難度着。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768156211","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看人如視地，結交無宿諾。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768172595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抵對少精神，行歩多虚霍。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768188979","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959176790884362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞人失卽歡，見人得不樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768205363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何用相精神，此人相心惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768221747","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"妍𡟎歌","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768238131","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妍𡟎歌訣不尋常，貴賤榮枯有隂陽。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768254515","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南北東西風土異，必須叅究要相當。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768270899","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君論此相有十法，先相三停與短長。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768287283","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次觀骨法及顴額。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768303667","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三看神清露昏光。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768320051","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四聽聲響","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768336435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亮焦破。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768336435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五視行輕重緩忙，六見坐立身偏正，七推心事善和强。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768369203","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八定星曜美與惡，九察部位豐與陷，十背胸腹手足隆，厚薄窄狹有低昂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768385587","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能依此十法相，禍福妍𡟎自昭彰。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768401971","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959205236490266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"何知歌","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768418355","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知君子多災迍，春夏額上常昏昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768434739","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知君子百事昌，準頭印上有黄光。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768451123","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家漸漸榮，顴如朱色眼如星。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768467507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家漸漸貧，面如水洗耳生塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768483891","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知白衣換綠袍，天倉豐滿福堂高。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768500275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知爲宫不食祿，坐時伸起頸頭縮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768516659","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家不生兒,","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768533043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽暗發如黑煤.何知人家怪來求，朦朦黑色遶唇腮。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768533043","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知兄弟成雙吉，山根高聳睂如一。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768565811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知兄第成雙凶，山根斷折睂不豐。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768582195","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家鬼打屋，天庭數㸃黑如粟。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768598579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人不及","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768614963","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959205236604954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第，眼中赤脉如線曳。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768614963","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人主皁發解，福堂豐滿精神快。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768631347","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家頻換妻，睂頭帶殺下位欹。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768647731","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家妻妾淫，奸門暗黑睂如金。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768664115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人生不聚財，但看法令破蘭臺。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768680499","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家被火傷，睂頭數㸃赤換長。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768696883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家弟殺兄，山根常黑不分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768713267","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家常被賊，但看雙岳如煙黑。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768729651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知生女不生兒，睂間但看兩頭垂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768746035","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知小兒常被驚，山根年壽色常青。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768762419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家妻受邪，奸門黑漆不光華。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768778803","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家兒受災，三陽暗色如煙煤。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768795187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家竹林旺，山根氣色遶周黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768811571","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768827955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959205236719642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貯積財，甲匱紫色常堆堆。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768827955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知爲官多災難，坐時睂攢口常歎。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768844339","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知爲官一舉超。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768860723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不發言詞語含笑。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768877107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知突睛殺人惡，但看當門兩齒落。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768893491","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家殺頭妻，必是山根年壽低。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768909875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家殺頭夫，左頸肥大右頸枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768926259","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知兄弟生同胞，必是睂頥有旋毛。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768942643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知官員剋舉主。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768959027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻曲印破多紋縷。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768975411","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知僧道有高名，必是古貌與神清。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907768991795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家遭劫盜，赤原抽位常乾燥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769008179","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家孝服生，眼下䘮門白粉痕。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769024563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知壽年九十六，天庭高聳精神足。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769040947","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知壽年八十二，法令低垂是。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769057331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769073715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959231308300314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四十五，面皮如綳鼓。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769073715","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"何知訣","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769090099","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知九十壽，且隨其翁晩景肥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769368627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人定生財，看看五露分明來。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769385011","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人常作冦，月孛鼻頭尖且小。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769401395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人一生閒，坐如釘石睂頭寛。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769417779","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知獄厄有災迍，但看睂间高斜紋，一紋一度入獄内，一紋二度入牢危。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769434163","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人無兄弟，睂短睂交皆不利。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769450547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知破家不齊整，面皮光滑薄如紙。","logicSentenceId":"7580391907769466931","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知一世不生兒，三陽陷了色如脂。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636098570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636114954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959231308546074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被劫奪，兩睂起紋生過目。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636114954","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人主服毒藥，土上損破黑子惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636131338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人主卒暴死，唇青年上生黑子。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636147722","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人生命帶空，長脚蜂腰摠一同。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636164106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人心偏曲，豹牙缺齒黃面目。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636180490","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人主餓死，縱紋入口乃如此。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636196874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人主水厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636213258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看他睂間雙黑子，何知父母早不全。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636229642","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人上唇若趫天，何知女人定剋夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636246026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼大睂高頰骨粗，何知破敗且伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636262410","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知貪財并好色，鼈背龜胸如何說。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636311562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636327946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959256935546918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人死相隨，初年卽便身充肥。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636327946","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知殃財且貧窮，看他上下露臀胸。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636344330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知男子定孤刑，項㗋恰似鷺𮭋形。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636360714","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知兄弟各相抛，睂毛蹙定常相交。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636377098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知幼小災厄故，但看鼻頭井竈露。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636393482","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知破祖又離鄉，三尖三露爲之殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636409866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知女人定抛夫，額𧢲入髩更何如。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636426250","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知其人兩三婚，但看奸門有多紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636475402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一紋必定剋一妻，二紋兩度重婚娶。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636491786","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知刑剋事招嫌，口下生鬚直到顴。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636508170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知未年主多災，但看其人無下頦。","logicSentenceId":"7580391908636524554","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫手者，其用所以執持，其情所以取舍。","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762321935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故織長，性慈而好施；短厚者，性鄙而好取。","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762338319","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手垂過膝，葢世英賢；手不過腰者，一生貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762354703","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身小而手大者，福祿；身大而手小者，淸貧。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930542106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手薄削者貧，手端厚者富；手粗硬者下賤，手軟細者淸貴；手香煖者淸華，手臭汚者濁下。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930558490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指纖","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762371087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959412842086426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而長者，聰俊；指短而突者，愚賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762371087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指柔而宻者，蓄積；指硬而疎者，破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930574874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指如春笋者，淸貴；指如黄槌者，愚𥚴。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930591258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指如剝葱者，食祿；指粗如竹節者，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930607642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手薄硬如雞足者，無智而贫；手掘強如猪蹄者，愚鹵而賤。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930624026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手軟滑如錦囊者，至富；手皮連如鵝足者，至貴。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930640410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌長而厚者貴，掌短而薄者賤；掌硬而圓者愚，掌軟而方者福。","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762387471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四畔豐起而中窪者，富有；四畔肉薄而中平者，財散。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930656794","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌潤澤者，富貴；掌乾枯者，貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762403855","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌紅如噀血者，榮貴；掌黃如拂土者，至賤。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930673178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑色者，貧苦，白色者，寒賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762420239","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌中當","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762436623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959412842184730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心生黑子者，智而富；掌中四畔生橫理者，愚而貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580352714762436623","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
