{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到處得人憐又惜，貪歡樂處勝西施。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737264975912","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"桃花紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花紋見主情邪，柳陌花街即是家。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737264992296","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正是中年臨此限，夣魂猶戀一枝花。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737265008680","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"偸花紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偸花紋現自多非，别處風花戀暗期。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737265025064","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自有好花心不喜，一心專戀别人妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737265041448","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"偷魚紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻位紋有魚，淸貴更何如。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737265057832","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"期妻能守節，冲破却淫愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737265074216","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959647601623067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"華葢紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫華葢葢朝妻，招得妻財逐後妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737265090600","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆是五行并掌相，他年更許有男兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580352737265106984","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"朝天紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻紋朝入向天女，妻起淫心悔父尊。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237774351","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交合遂成雲雨事，人倫不正亂家門。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237790735","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"奴僕紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕紋朝入向妻，必然奴僕共淫之。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237807119","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻心不正奴心壯，致此君家有此爲。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237823503","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"生枝紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻位紋生枝，天生狡滑妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237839887","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丈夫能省半，閫子賴施爲。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237856271","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959685471797257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"妻妾紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾生入奴僕宫，有妻意欲通私事。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237872655","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"一重纹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫只有一重紋，没個妻奴及弟兄。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237889039","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有兩纹并四畫，許君後續好兒孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237905423","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"尅父紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天文劈索朝中指，此是魁心成可喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237921807","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有二指縫中心，少年尅父無所倚。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237938191","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"尅母紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰若有紋冲破，必定親生母見之。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237954575","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是過房猶自可，親生必定見閻君。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237970959","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959685471895561"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"過隨紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌法文名是過隨，早年無怙不傷悲。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025237987343","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈思郤有隨娘嫁，拜啓他人作養兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238003727","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"貪心紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天紋散走有貪心，只愛便宐機未深。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238020111","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對而身心難捉摸，他人物事若相欺。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238036495","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"月角紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月角陰紋出兊來，平生偏得婦人財。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238052879","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好事也須當戒忌，莫教色上惹官非。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238069263","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"亾神紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手中橫直號亾神，破丁家財损六親。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238085647","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到處與人皆不足，更防性命險難慿。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238102031","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959685472010249"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"刼煞紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初中災了無刑害，妨限須教得意濃。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238134799","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"三煞纹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞紋侵妻子位，末妻害子空垂涙。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238151183","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還見尅後須輕，免致中年孤獨睡。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238167567","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"朱雀紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀紋生向掌來，一生終是惹官非。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238183951","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有又紋猶自可，最忌兩頭口又開。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238200335","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"酒食纹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横來酒食紋何似，坤上差池入興宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238216719","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好似斜飛三燕子，每逢横爼貴交中。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238233103","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959722264182794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相手","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238249487","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵人手欲軟而長，膊欲平而厚，骨欲圓而低。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238265871","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腕節欲小，指節欲細，龍骨欲長，虎骨欲短，骨露而粗，筋浮而散，纹緊如縷，肉枯而削，非美相也。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930755098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔王克正𣦸，身後無子，其家脩佛事，惟一女十餘歳，跪爐於像前。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238282255","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳搏入■出語人曰：王氏女，吾雖不見其面，但觀其捧爐手相甚貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238298639","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若果男子白衣入翰林，女子嫁即爲國夫人。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238315023","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後陳晉公爲叅知政事，無妻，太宗曰：王克正，江南舊族，一女令淑，卿可作配。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238331407","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太宗教諭再三，遂納爲","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238347791","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959722264313866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"室。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238347791","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不數日，封郡夫人。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238364175","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○手垂下膝","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238380559","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蜀先主身長七尺五寸，垂手下膝，目顧見其耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238380559","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手白如玉，貴，手直如笋福壽，手滑如苔，福壽龍長虎短，臂至肘，名龍骨象君，","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238413327","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲長而大；肘至腕，名虎骨象臣，欲短而小。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238413327","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相手篇","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930771482","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930787866","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手纹亂剉合，有福禄，孔無災害；","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238446095","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手有橫理紋，殺害不須論；","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238446095","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手有縱横纹，爵位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238446095","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑子掌中，財食無窮；黒子手裏，多婦少兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238495247","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌四方厚，中央薄，兼有深法，益仕宦，財食安樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238511631","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌通四起，容止君子。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238528015","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手有仰羊，行不","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238544399","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959722264395786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裝糧。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238544399","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手有三的約，必使奴僕。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238560783","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"手中有仰羊者，即難得也。指上紋有三行，名三道者，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手一約，必爲奴，走腳或作客，兼貧無福。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238577167","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十指三約並通，財食無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238593551","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手如虎屈，貧寒至骨。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238609935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手爪如𮗩瓦，必作大富。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238626319","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長者爪忽缺落，厄病數着。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238642703","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若似龍虎，貴名難得。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238659087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍龜紅直，必得宫職。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238675471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男手如錦囊，祿位似公王；女手竹竿槍，福禄至無疆。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238691855","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上相人□人，各富貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238708239","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人十指軟纎纎，不但淸閑福自添。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930804250","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還損折非君子，可斷㐫愚不識嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238724623","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959755789238310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論掌紋","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238741007","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手中有紋者，亦象木之有理；","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238757391","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木之紋美者，名爲竒材；手之有美紋，乃貴質也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238757391","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故手不可無紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238790159","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有紋者上相，無紋者下相。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238806543","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋細而深者吉，紋麄而淺者賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238822927","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌上三紋者，上書應天，象君象父，定其貴賤也；中畫應人，象賢象愚，辨其貧富也；下畫應地，象臣象母，主有夀夭也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238839311","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三紋瑩淨，無紋破者，福祿之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238855695","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"織理多者，性亂而災；横理多者，性愚而賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238872079","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"監理直貫上指者，百謀皆遂；亂理散出縫指者，諸事破散。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238888463","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋細如亂絲者，聰明","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238904847","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959755789336614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"美貌；紋粗如櫟木者，愚頑貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238904847","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋如亂剉者，一世貧苦；紋如散糠者，生快樂，有寳錢","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238921231","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絞者，主進貨財，有端笏紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238921231","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"插笏紋者，文官朝列。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238953999","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十指上如旋螺者，榮貴；","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238970383","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋漏出指節者，破散。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025238970383","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十指上紋横三鈎者，貴使奴婢；十指上紋橫一鈎者，賤被驅使。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239003151","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有龜紋者，將相；有魚","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239019535","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋者，郎官；有偃月紋、車輪紋者，吉慶；有陰隲紋、延夀紋者，福祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239019535","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有印紋者，貴；有田紋者，富；有井紋者，福；有十紋者，祿；有五策紋","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239052303","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上貫指者，名光萬國；有按劒紋加權印者，領軍四海。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239052303","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有結關紋者，𠒋逆而妨害；有夜","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239085071","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959755789418534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"义紋者，下賤而偸竊。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239085071","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡紋雖好而久破者，皆爲缺陷無成之相矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239101455","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論手背紋","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239117839","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手背之紋，其驗尚矣，故有人和之理，五者皆近於上兩節者，謂之龍紋，主爲天子之師；下節爲公侯，中節爲使相","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239134223","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；無名指者，主卿監；小指者，主朝郞；大指者，主巨富。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239134223","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手昔五指皆有橫纹旋繞者，主封矦；生立理貫者，主拜將相。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239166991","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手背食指之本，亦謂之明堂，有異紋黑子者，主才藝高貴","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239183375","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；若成飛禽字體者，主爲清顯之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239183375","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959803000291354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大指本有横紋者，謂之空谷紋，至𥙿無所不納，主大富。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239216143","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有繞腕紋周旋不斷者，謂之玉釧紋，主人敬𢜤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239232527","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239248911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋二紋者，主朝幕之榮；三紋仰上者，主翰苑之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239248911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女皆同，其紋雖得周匝，若或斷絕不匝，乃取證無驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239265295","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"玉掌記","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239281679","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相掌之法，先看八卦，次察五行。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239298063","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指有長短，掌有厚薄，或見星辰，應於文脉，命中華葢，掌上分明，或成文章。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239314447","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉樹","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239330831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"、結魚紋、曰羅紋、爻𨾏魚紋、凸玉堦紋、井金","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239330831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959803000373274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井紋、飛針紋、鴈陣紋、偃月紋、云環紋、南星見於中宫、北斗列於正位、禽獸形或作龜紋，","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239330831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239330831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等異紋爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239330831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239347215","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九羅生於八卦，定爲列諸矦。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239347215","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一路二路，穿過三節，乃是歸朝宰相。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239363599","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離宫五井必爲一品之官。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930820634","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌心印紋定主諸矦之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239379983","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錦紋噀血，貲財百萬。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025239396367","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌軟如緜，文武雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359409152","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋橫一路，其人必弃於市。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359425536","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中指生兩節，此輩終亾於途路。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359441920","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨重，定主","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359458304","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高明；紋竒，但當小爵。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359458304","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮筋露骨，身樂心憂；脯節漏風，神昏意懒。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359491072","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五常紋見，投水自縊。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359507456","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結喉紋如覆船，溺","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930837018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959803000487962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水而𣦸；鞭節亂紋，而决徒逺方；羅網四門，","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930837018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾坤艮巽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而投身徤卒。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930837018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心虚者，其紋必顯；心昧者，其理不明。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359523840","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於乾宫高聳，生長子之權豪；坎位高堆，受前人之庇蔭。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359540224","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮宫尅陷，損子父於初年；震上高朝，置田宅於一世。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359556608","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㢲宫散亂，多爲游蕩之徒；離位突高，必作功名之士。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359572992","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤宫带破，招兒女以凋零；兊位有傷，定夫妻之鰥寡。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359589376","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冷黄似水，平時多夢陰人；煖色如丹，到老少逢疾苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359605760","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲如銅瓦，脫洒心神；甲似瓜皮，沉昏神氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359622144","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲薄者，命年位促；甲厚者，壽算延長；甲尖者，小智；甲破者，無成。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359638528","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"里","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359654912","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959803000553498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滋润，則財榖豐盈；指尖長，則文學貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359654912","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高張華","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930853402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hygvx6w6/1-1708433976740.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=en6wIMSl2SiC6BmfWe5YBGrMFUM%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hygvx6w6/1-1708433976740.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7617741307930853402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，平生智岀於衆人；尖起三峯，限數福生於晚景。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930853402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有紋無掌，晚年衣祿平常；有掌無紋，早歲貲財散失。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359671296","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌平手薄，身賤；指甲皮乾肉枯，命孤而夭。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930869786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手大指小，浮蕩難聚貲財；掌細面寛，榮辱艱辛不免。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359687680","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節如雞卵，一生多得横財；掌似燕巢，萬煩富饒田産。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359704064","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌有堆峯，宐福厚；腕無孤骨，主官榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359720448","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田畔相近，三限俱良，㐫吉須决，貴賤以分。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359736832","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者精詳，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359753216","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相掌善惡","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359769600","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959838916149258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此紋朝三指上者，平生快樂風流。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359785984","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此紋在坎宫似柳絲者，積代簮纓富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930886170","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此紋合，主聰明，爲顯官。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359802368","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此名繩紋，在明堂者，主自縊。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359818752","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此名交紋，在兩指下，主兩處根基。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930902554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假子興家，異姓同居。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359835136","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此名兩條紋合，主聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359851520","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在掌内紋爲華葢星。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359867904","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此紋似生魚，平生手足兄弟和美；若魚尾貫指，須富。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359884288","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲金井紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359900672","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌中者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359917056","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙井三井，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359933440","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次宫","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359949824","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井朝震宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359949824","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井萬頃田。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359966208","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲一字紋，手中貫出天庭者，大發，平生有權。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930918938","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲金印紋，在明堂方正明白者，少年登","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359982592","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959838916231178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359982592","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲玉堦紋，在堂中，主有科名。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025359998976","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲棋盤紋，在艮宫者，心本無事，愁緒萬端。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360015360","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲穿錢紋，主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360031744","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930935322","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手軟如綿色更紅，㢲宫離位起高峯。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360048128","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然官祿紋端正，坐享榮華勝祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360064512","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印紋不拘部位，但是印足矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360130048","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"■交紋印、象眼印、三角印、手手字印、女女字印。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360146432","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡手中有印，爲人有","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360162816","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959838916313098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"信，自小無非橫之災，一生不畏鬼神，近高有權柄。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360162816","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲䡓天紋，在掌中爲天柱，主壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360179200","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穿過離宫，直过指節，主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360195584","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此宫名天一貴宫，離爲官星貴宫，坤爲福星貴宫，五指俱穿，爲五福俱備。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360211968","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過初中末限，有此紋不流出者，主此限發福。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360228352","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨掌高低斷之，一斷一續，一成一敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360244736","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井此爲斷紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360261120","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右手爲把刀紋，不利母；左手爲執劒紋，不利父。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360277504","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗云：左斷右不斷，骨肉損一半","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360293888","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；兩手一切斷，兄弟不相見。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360293888","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是眼紋，在大指名夫子眼，主聦明；在坤宮爲佛服，主孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360326656","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在掌中爲道眼，主","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360343040","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959838916395018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360343040","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲花柳眼，好淫洽。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930968090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在坤宫爲流淚眼，在第二指爲青眼，近貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360392192","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在巽爲貫索眼，主發横財。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360408576","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲棺材紋，逐年旋生。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360441344","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在艮官，非有紋，乃自起，生不全者無妨，生全者不問前後，其年生，其年𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360457728","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一片淹滞災撓，二片孝服，三片重重災事，四片𣦸在旦夕。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360474112","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如艮宫掌中黑，𣦸期近矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360490496","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：艮上不宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360506880","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鋪白板，掌中曾說宿烏鴉。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360523264","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎宫黑者，落水𣦸；震宫黑","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360539648","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959883040227337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，被雷傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360539648","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌宫黑脉過艮，主虎傷；巽宫黑脉過乾，主蛇傷；離宫黑脉過坎，主見灾。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360556032","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲盤旋紋，主自縊亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360572416","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無紋，乃黑脉也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360588800","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兊宫棺材紋有黒肺相衝，謂之催屍殺，必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360605184","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有黒紋自立身紋起，直穿二指上節，謂黒氣衝天，性命過關，縱無棺材亦㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360621568","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三㸃相連大好。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360637952","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更以所出處成字異相。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360654336","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡手中成一字，終身受用不盡。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360670720","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生在身命宫上，自身主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360687104","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生在父母宫上，父","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360703488","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母貴，生在子宫上，子孫貴，生在妻位上，妻貴，生在兄弟位上，兄","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360703488","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959883040342025"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360703488","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但要紋理方正。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360736256","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷頭紋、橫屍紋、刀字紋、丁字紋、枷鎖紋、夜乂紋、土字紋、火字紋、産𣦸紋、乃字紋、血妬妻紋巳上，凡手中犯一字者，大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360752640","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是甲破而黃，手斜而曲，骨粗而毛旋，逆角紋橫直指折，曰廢疾，主徒紋、刺字、軍役、自殺、自刑，十五種㐫亡數。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360769024","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有紅潤色，及有陰德。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307930984474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢紋可折一半。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360785408","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢紋主聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360801792","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看指紋大小尖秃、淡濃淺深、曲直、隱浮聚散，起伏大粗，爲人性慢，作事不思。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360818176","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後好紋得利，惡紋爲災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931000858","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋深入內，爲機深思慮，作","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360834560","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959883040440329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事不測。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360834560","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲紋背曲偎僻，不忠不直，一生作事難成。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360850944","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直聳而長不曲，性直而忠誠，不藏事而聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360867328","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有隱紋不見，作事不顯。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360883712","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難知。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360900096","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮紋不入內，爲人輕浮好高，事多難成，一生浩蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360916480","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚紋交鎖，爲人心邪，多學少成得人嫌，一生勞碌。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360932864","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散紋無定，一生散尖，作事無就。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360949248","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㐫未","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360965632","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應，起自下而向上，作事有成無廢。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360965632","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㐫皆應，起自高","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360998400","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而向下，作事性快不成，沉滯少通。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025360998400","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵有掌有紋，繁","logicSentenceId":"7580354025361014784","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華一世，無紋","logicSentenceId":"7580354025361014784","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有掌，始終不足；有紋無掌，有榮無辱。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025361014784","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋大性小，有事高呌，一語便嗔，囘頭相笑。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902129167","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959883040505865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：斷紋性難理，高强起伏低。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902145551","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言多招怨恨，朋友不相宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902161935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棋盤志萬端，撓事心無足。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902178319","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弄巧又成拙，終須幹一般。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902194703","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋大應無毒，心慈口却多。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902211087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自身愁自脫，閑事又相過。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902227471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合心慈善，爲人多應變。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902243855","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出入衆所欽，貴人偏相戀。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902260239","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋直所爲直，直言諌别人。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902276623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忠言多逆耳，轉背卻生嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902293007","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃性憂煎，般般手向前。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902309391","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然多執拘，却得貴人憐。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902325775","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
