{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮土飛針兄弟稀，總然多有也分離。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931115546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長糿不及中","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902538767","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959926480846886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年事，各自分居獨自棲。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902538767","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震爲妻妾，爲立身，居耶，屬木。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902555151","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931131930","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震爲身位自居東，聳起滋紅通。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931148314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低限此宮妻有尅，須教此位作書籠。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902571535","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽爲財帛，爲祿馬，居辰巳，屬木。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902587919","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931164698","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽宫驛馬位高強，若起高峯性必良。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931181082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低陷更兼紋又破，縱然富貴也顛狂。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902604303","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959926480912422"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離爲龍虎，爲官祿，居午，屬火。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902620687","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931197466","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離爲官祿鎭南方，破陷榮華不久長。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931213850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是文官加祿位，仕者爲官入廟堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902637071","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤爲福徳，爲父母，居未申，屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902653455","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931230234","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤宫屬土，位西方，怕見紋深尅陷傷。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931246618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋亂兒男終見破，更憂母位主分張。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902669839","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兊爲奴僕，爲子息，居酉，屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902686223","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959974773915686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931263002","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兊爲僕位此中求，肥潤高起性温柔。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931279386","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其宫低陷紋如破，子僕終須命不留。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902702607","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌中央，爲明堂五黄之宫，主目下之吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902718991","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902735375","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中央深處號明堂，目下㐫危此處藏。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931295770","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋有印角方必貴，色如暗黑定災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902751759","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相指掌","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902768143","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌爲虎，指爲龍，只可龍吞虎，不可虎吞龍。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902784527","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四指爲賔","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902800911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959974773997606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，中指爲主，賔主相濟爲美。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902800911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二指長者，平生近貴；四指長者，小人不足，性不耐煩。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902817295","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌長指短，暗惹人嫌，少年難養。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902833679","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五指斬傷，若或病損，亦有所主。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902850063","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大指破祖，二指尅父，三指尅母，四指妨妻，五指刑子，大指駢母，亦主疾苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902866447","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒殘指甲心緒多，古云：咬甲疑人。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902882831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指長紋橫紋多者，亦惹人嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902899215","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相骨肉","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902915599","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福生於骨，祿在於肉，骨重則福重，骨輕則福輕。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902931983","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨淸受清福，骨濁受濁福。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902948367","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉多食祿多，肉少食祿少。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902964751","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉少","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902981135","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330959974774128678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨多，有福無祿；肉多骨少，有祿無壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902981135","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉相稱，福祿雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025902997519","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉肥促急，軟而有骨，食祿巳定，𣦸期可卜。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903013903","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相骨","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903030287","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫掌最要有骨，骨露則寒，寒則主貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903046671","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵骨肉均平，衣祿自有。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903063055","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手若骨露，六親無力。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903079439","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論至驗。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903095823","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有獨骨者，老必㐫亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903112207","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相肉色","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903128591","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫手掌之肉，分春夏秋冬，四時之氣，春潤夏溫，秋清冬燥，得其正者，必然淸高。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903144975","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手背筋露肉堅，爲人辛勤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903161359","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960019929759771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筋藏肉積，眞實多財。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903177743","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫夏而燥，冬而温，必貧賤愚痴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903194127","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵手掌、手背一般色，斯爲上相。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903210511","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若掌面白而掌背黑者富，掌面黑而掌背白者貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903226895","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總而言之，肉厚一寸，家積千金也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903243279","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相三主","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903259663","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌則㢲爲初主，𬋩二十五年。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903276047","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離爲中主，𬋩二十五年。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903292431","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤爲中主，𬋩二十五年，看何宫豐滿，則財福興發，若缺，則有成敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903308815","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論財則掌中紋縷宻者，財祿聚；紋踈者，財福不聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903325199","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960019929907227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相三才","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903341583","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才紋者，乃掌中三大紋也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903357967","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論高低，人人","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903374351","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有之，乃在母胎受氣成形，擎拳掩耳而成，十分辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903374351","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三紋","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903407119","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不没。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903407119","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自上至下，第一紋居火，爲天紋，主根基；第二紋居土，爲地紋，主財祿；第三紋居明堂，爲人紋，主福德。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903423503","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於三限中取三限上紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903439887","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若三限上無紋，於夀紋上取","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903456271","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽紋，壽紋上無紋，三才上取三才紋，須取於面相叅之，庻得其眞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903456271","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相三竒","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903489039","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960019929989147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三竒者，坤、離、㢲突起三肉峯也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903505423","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉掌記云：掌中有堆峯，主福厚。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903521807","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋突起三峯，限内福増。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903538191","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如㢲宫一峯最高大者，旺財，初年發福。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903554575","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離官一峯高大者，主享高官重祿，中主顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903570959","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤宫一峯峻者，主有福德，終吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903587343","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相根基","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903603727","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎宫有紋如絲者，享見成鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903620111","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自艮上生一紋直上者，受祖考之福蔭。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903636495","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎宮紋開三股，主三處住塲，不然離祖斷續者，承接他人根基。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903652879","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋自坎官不斷，直上，自手根而起，平地發福，白手成家。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903669263","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960056709677082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相財禄","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903685647","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㢲宮有井紋，名關鎖，或印紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903702031","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三大紋不出指者，主","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903718415","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性慳吝，可主財。","logicSentenceId":"7580354025903718415","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤、兊有女字，可得陰人財。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076635170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌中有女字端正，因女人成家；紋理穿破，因女人敗，震宫有紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076651554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主招性急多口之妻，不然有疾，能主家。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076667938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺財物，坤宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076684322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有十字紋，平生得横財，陰貴扶助。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076700706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若女人掌震宫，高","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076717090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚軟而紅潤，有穿錢劒印紋，主奪勇子權柄，必大發福。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076717090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低陷紋流，不可主财，仍主刑夫尅子，難爲骨肉。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076749858","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相心性","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076766242","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960056709791770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫察人之心性，觀紋見掌，知掌地則知心地。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076782626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌平心亦平，紋正心亦直，紋横則性橫。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076799010","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋淺機亦淺，紋深機亦深。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076815394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋多心緒多，紋少機關少。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076831778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋小見小，纹大見大紋生斷續，易勤易懶紋。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076848162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hygvy8ti/1-1709525234276.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=KNyND6OUZQQXwMnjOGTpyL%2B03Vo%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hygvy8ti/1-1709525234276.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580354026076864546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主屈曲多疑多慮，紋深不出掌，機深難可量。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076864546","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相志膽氣","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076880930","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"志者在於甲。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076897314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乃筋之餘，肝之所出，膽之所附焉。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076913698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲堅而大者，志高膽大，諸事敢爲；短而軟者，志弱膽小，臨事怯懦。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076930082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲堅者，心高多貧；甲硬者，性剛，作事風火","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076946466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960091044151334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076946466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲軟者，臨事懶惰，立身窮蹇，多學少成，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931312154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腫節通風，心志不定，巧中生拙，内無機關，不能藏事。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076962850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋直上而流者，口快心直。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076979234","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580354026076995618","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色在於掌心，一觀爲定，久看則昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077012002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古云：掌有紫色。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077028386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下亦有之，須叅同推之。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077044770","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青主憂驚，赤主官事，白主孝服，黑主病厄，黄主喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077061154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色應在正、五、九月，寅、午、","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077077538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌日，赤色應在二、六、十月，亥、卯、未日，黑色應在三、七、十一月，甲子、辰日，白色應在四、八、十二月，巳、酉、丑日，","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077077538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960091044233254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄色應在三、六、九、十二月，辰、戌、丑、未日，色淡事巳過色濃事未至。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077077538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色看起何部，若田宅部上起，則是因田宅惹官事，其餘以意推之。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077110306","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相色","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077126690","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相掌玅訣，只在觀形察色。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077143074","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌中𠸃血，衣禄自得；掌中噴火，衣祿無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077159458","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌中生黃，家有𣦸亾；掌中生青，是非憂驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077175842","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且看精神，四時决斷。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077192226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一日禍病，全在眼力。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077208610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人飲酒不可相，只在朝晨相之。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077224994","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開掌未可便相，少待片時，神定色見，相之必見。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077241378","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌中有𠸃血色，主榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931328538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌白","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077257762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960091044347942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如面者，主起家成立；掌軟如緜者，主高年富足。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077257762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掌有雜路，指上有刀剉痕者，主貧賤；掌中有痣，指上有挫路者，主少年駁雜，晩年成立。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077274146","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相憂喜","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077290530","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面若黒，凖頭明，掌紋紅潤，憂中有喜；面若光，凖頭枯黑，掌乾燥，喜中有憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077306914","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人有六甲，掌中青紅生男，黑白生女，明艷易産，枯槁難生。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077323298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如懐胎，左脚先舉爲男，右脚先舉爲女。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077339682","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相𣦸生","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077356066","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960127400394778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人雖久病，不怕瘦削，但十指紅潤，凖頭明朗，雖危不𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077372450","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天庭黑，山根靑，竹衣生，兩耳頾鬚似鐵條，眼光流射出身，𣦸在三朝十日，主甲黑，棺材紋見，朝病暮𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077388834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hygvylgm/1-1709869869968.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=uBRtXxXEJYPyf1ORhQihQ4cL%2Fo4%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hygvylgm/1-1709869869968.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580354026077405218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自玉掌記至此，皆相手法。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077405218","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論爪","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077421602","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爪之爲相，亦可詳其善惡，見其賢否也。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931344922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"纎而長者，聰明；堅而厚者，老壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077437986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而粗者愚鈍，缺而落者病弱。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931361306","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色黄而瑩者主貴，色黑而薄者主賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077454370","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色靑瑩者，忠良之性；色白淨者，閑逸之情；如銅葉者，禜華；如半月者，快","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077470754","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960127400509466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樂；如銅瓦者，伎巧；如板尾者，惇重；如尖鋒者，聰俊；如皺石者，愚下。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077470754","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論足","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077487138","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足者，上載一身，下運百體，爲足之量焉。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077503522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲地之體象，故雖至下而其用大，是可别其妍醜，而審其貴賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077519906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲得方而廣，正而長，膩而軟，富貴之相也，不可側而","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077536290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄，横而短，粗而硬，乃貧賤之質也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077536290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚下無紋理者，下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077569058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足下有黑子者，食祿；雖大而薄者，下賤；雖厚而橫","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077585442","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077585442","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3xgcp/1-7603996505846497321_%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%8710.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=Av0sn5r93aBY%2Bm8AghQURS2zkwg%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3xgcp/1-7603996505846497321_图片10.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7603996505846530089"},"logicSentenceId":"7580354026077618210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚下成跟者，福及子孫；脚下旋紋者，令譽于","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077618210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960127400640538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"里；脚下平如板者，貧愚；脚下可容龜者，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077618210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足指纎長者，忠良之貴；足指端齊者，豪","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077634594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3xszt/1-7603991994071777306_%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%8711.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=pQeJL1ihCAd5j%2FYD4SY2hv5krKg%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3xszt/1-7603991994071777306_图片11.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7603991994071810074"},"logicSentenceId":"7580354026077634594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之賢；足厚四方者，巨萬之富；足排三指者，兩省之權。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077634594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵貴人之足小而厚，賤人之足薄而大。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077650978","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相足","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077667362","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足者，相地也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077683746","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要有跟，宐厚而正，閑樂官榮；横窄小薄，辛苦惡弱。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077700130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足下無紋，愚賤之相；闊大而薄，亦主貧下也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077716514","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相足篇","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077732898","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許負","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931410458","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960163932782619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚下龜理紋，主一相。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077749282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚下容龜三","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077765666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公封矦。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077765666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚下理長，位至公王。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931377690","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有相理紋者，好。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通心達理，三公刺史之位。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931394074","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚心黒紫，祿至二千石；脚下三紋理，公王將相位。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077798434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚下無紋，法主寒貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077814818","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足薄而指長，之子沒兒郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077831202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足中指長，客𣦸他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077847586","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足蹈齊短，爲人安穩。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077863970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚骨節強，妨非一兩，兼主辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077880354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足厚四寸，必主大禄，富貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077896738","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960163932913691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論足圖","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931426842","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960163932995611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足下軟細而多紋者，貴相；足下粗硬而無紋","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077913122","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，貧","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077913122","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077913122","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足下有龜紋者，二千石禄；足下有禽紋者，入位之職。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077929506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足下五指有策紋上達者，兩府使相；足下有十字一策紋上逹者，六曹侍郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077945890","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足下有紋如錦繡者，食祿萬鐘；足下有紋如花尌者，積財無數；足下有紋如剪刀者，藏鏹巨萬。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077962274","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足下有紋如人形者，貴壓千官。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077978658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有三䇿","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077995042","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紋者，福而祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026077995042","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有螺紋者，富而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078011426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩小指無則是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078027810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩小指皆有，謂之十螺紋，主性鄙怪，十指皆無紋者，多破散矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078044194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足下有紋，大旺子孫；足下龜紋，一世淸名。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078060578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078076962","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960197378162698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下黒痣，富貴賢士。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078076962","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論四肢","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078093346","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫手足者，謂之四肢，以相四時。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078109730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加之以首，謂之五體，以相五行。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931443226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故四時不調，則萬物大闋；四肢不端，則一身困苦；五行不利，則萬物不生；五體不稱，則一世貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078126114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以手足亦象木之枝幹也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078142498","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多節者，名爲不材之木。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078158882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然手足欲得軟而滑凈，而筋不露，其白如玉，其直如幹，其滑如苔，其軟如綿者，富貴之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078175266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其或硬而粗大，筋纒骨出，其粗如土，其硬如石，其曲如柴，其肉","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078191650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960197378277386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如腫者，貧下之徒也。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078191650","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相毛","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078208034","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚上多毛者好。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078224418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柔細者，貴而祿，粗大者，賤而貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078240802","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7580354026078257186","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚上毛多好，貴榮必是柔。","logicSentenceId":"7617741307931459610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不宐粗與大，貧賤定須憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580354026630283279","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960197378359306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960231750500379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960231750647835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960266491854898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"宋希夷陳摶秘傳  明柳庄袁忠徹訂正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"婦女相","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903225379","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡相婦人，骨法峭峻，神氣成嚴，持重而少𡡾，五嶽寛大，行動快如流水，聲音如玉在石璞，后𡚱之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903241763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五岳端厚，骨氣磊落，神色温和，觀視不凡者，夫人之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903258147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若醜面蓬頭，蛇行雀躍，豕視龜胷，睂反聲雄，髭唇臀高，巳上十惡，有之則爲貧賤孤淫之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903274531","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960266492084274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"秋潭月論女人","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903290915","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麻衣","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661631016","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地日月與星辰，江湖山石配山林。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903307299","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行造化成秀氣，三才應物合人倫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903323683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古怪淸竒定富貴，金木水火土當形。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903340067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞古眞怪切要神，眞清眞濁在分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903356451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靈臺一㸃合天意，旣富且貴前程榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903372835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怪古清秀無神氣，虚用心機更不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903389219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不待男兒分富貴，女人也要合人倫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903405603","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和𡡾温柔量有餘，語言詳緩歩行舒。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903421987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦禮三從并四德，因縁有分字賢夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903438371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準尖齒露并喉結，額側唇掀骨格粗。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903454755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪焦似火龍宮陷，敗盡人家尅盡夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345008903471139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毬頭額廣背豊","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915857935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960300520259594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隆，耳反神清唇更紅。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915857935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須剋一夫并破祖，骨清衣祿自然豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915874319","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂如新月氣神淸，鳳閣龍樓滿更成。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915890703","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手似乾薑身必貴，腹垂肩厚必聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915907087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐露臀并露背，刑夫剋子過平生。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915923471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根斷盡準頭偏，短促人中更露顴。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915939855","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼長黑白神如水，初主艱難貴晚年。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915956239","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水木形人并鳳體，百年終保子孫賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915972623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面大額方如手底，地閣方圓凖勢豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571915989007","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語話輕清神更好。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661647400","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歩如流水立如峯。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916005391","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌蛇行并雀歩，一生長在是非中。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661663784","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼短聲雄氣又剛，手如鷹爪甲如鎗。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916021775","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一身肉滑如紅土，少年親近貴公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661680168","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣粗屍睡","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916038159","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960300520374282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多夢驚，寤寐強言不暫停。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916038159","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體氣行欹無可取，半爲奴妾半風塵。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661696552","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎睡龍蟠息不聞，身無蘭麝自然馨。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916054543","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐如山岳精神緩，鶴骨松筠福海深。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916070927","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲速肩寒顧後頻，坐久精神郤似驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916087311","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下長上短蜂腰細，說盡媒人夫不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916103695","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪長清薄天庭黄，耳大頭圓地閣方。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916120079","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三壬三甲和丹厚，眼似刀裁福吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916136463","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫教射視精神短，背壻尋夫做不良。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916152847","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目洗寒波貴氣淸，少年魁满露睂臀。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916169231","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假饒富貴帷中坐，只恐頭尖少子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916185615","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"缺唇火目頭無髪，肢體相傷神帶殺。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916201999","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妨刑父母剋夫多，鰥寡孤獨思不歇。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661712936","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916218383","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960300520472586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陷盡如坑井，邊地全無驛馬羸。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916218383","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜視桃花并色冷，不犯風塵必作尼。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916234767","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人娠孕要先知，預識胎中女與兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916251151","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽黑色須生女，火起二陰必是兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916267535","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽部主如塵上，產育難分定是遲。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916283919","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人蟬面更毬頭，口上髭生不自由。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916300303","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂濃髪厚腰肢折，私地隨人走外州。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916316687","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭尖額窄鼻勾紋，雀䑕蛇行顧後頻。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916333071","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭小露臀肩背聳，不爲婢妾必風塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916349455","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人生得男兒相，氣冷神剛骨不淸。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916365839","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一床錦被須閒半，休問兒孫枉用心。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916382223","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尊嚴威重精神秀，美貌輕盈舉歩徐。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916398607","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼似桃花常帶殺，中主刑夫休要圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916414991","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960337863802889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴高額窄鳯池深，粗骨三堂少子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916431375","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下羅紋還宿債，兩次刑夫三度婚。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916447759","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看人斜視幷回頭，淫蕩精神賤有餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916464143","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項短髪濃腰背露，未出閨門早尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916480527","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端嚴尊重身肥滿，額上横紋語氣雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916496911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖殺多夫猶未止，空房獨坐月明中。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916513295","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男兒若得生陽氣，假饒淸潔也貪淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916529679","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女帶桃花搖膝坐，雖爲良婦亦私情。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916546063","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸針入印山根斷，相貌全虧額不平。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916562447","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫災莫問三堂位，歲歲生男定是空。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916578831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人眼下肉乾枯，不尅三夫尅二夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916595215","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見人掩口笑不斷，愛逐行人夜半逋。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916627983","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲雄脣厚面擷聳，縱得身榮必","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916644367","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960337863868425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916644367","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膝搖背聳多淫蕩，手似乾薑福有餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916660751","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然窈窕從夫貴，眼似流星口似吹。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916677135","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發言先笑腰肢折，相法名爲破敗猪。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916693519","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額窄唇掀微露齒，殺夫無子亦無居。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916709903","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960337863950345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有威無𡡾精神正，行不動塵笑藏齒。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916857359","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無肩有背立如龜，此是婦人貞潔體。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916873743","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有𡡾無威舉止輕，此人終是落風塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916890127","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假饒不是娼門女，也是屏風後立人。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916906511","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼晴黄赤家無糧，尅子刑夫别異鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916922895","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不投河自縊𣦸，也須産厄血中亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916939279","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人須要婦人形，行不離形出本情。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916955663","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絕郤本形帶男相，雖教尅害主伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916972047","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人眼下肉常枯，不殺三夫定二夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571916988431","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見人掩面嘻嘻笑，愛喚他人作丈夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917004815","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪長雲黑天庭廣，額正頭圓地閣方。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917021199","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇若丹砂銀齒宻，謹身節用永無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917037583","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳯頭龍瞳兩位强，身無蘭麝自","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917053967","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960337864032265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然香。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917053967","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不益財三十載，也須伴個綠衣郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917070351","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是面長額又長，刑夫尅子决難當。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917086735","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂粗口濶精神急，到處無媒自嫁郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917103119","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人髪亂顔色無，頭斜背反及乾枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917119503","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雄聲更帶男兒面，此輩雄豪殺丈夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917135887","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗟㢤貧賤婦，胞凸𦡍高擎。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917152271","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺夫三顴面，離夫額不平。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917168655","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若知三度嫁，女作丈夫聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917185039","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然有此相，終見不安寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917201423","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨自倚門立，搔頭整頭衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917217807","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無媒身自嫁，月下與人期。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917234191","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仰面眸偏顧，難爲子息宮。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917250575","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"托腮并咬指，必定入烟花。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917266959","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背人如對語，低首弄衣襟。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917283343","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"測識其中意，","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917299727","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960373895397426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"私情似海深。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917299727","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人掩口笑，或是整娥睂。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917316111","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倚物常閑立，逢人必趂隨。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917332495","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與人摇膝語，背是面言非。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917348879","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見蜂腰相，終宵不見歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917365263","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺壻三顴面，離夫額不平。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917430799","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知三度嫁，女作丈夫聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917447183","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○女人𢳸膝坐，蜂腰口大垂。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917463567","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如斯衣食薄，背壻却爲","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917479951","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960373895495730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非。","logicSentenceId":"7580345571917479951","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○女人桃花眼，須防柳葉睂。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947414051","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無媒猶自嫁，月下與人期。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947430435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○見人掩口笑，手慣掠睂頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947446819","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對人偸眼覷，終須趂客游。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947463203","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○骨粗終是賤，眼大不爲良。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947479587","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂如新月曲，夜夜喚新郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947495971","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○行歩身揺動，臀髙足不閑。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947512355","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挑蘿給爲日，鼻孔自朝天。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947528739","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○面仰多貧賤，胷高必困窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947545123","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲雄妨害重，色潤意情濃。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947561507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○羊目意晴多，蝦晴意不和。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947577891","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無毛陰戶賤，無處不呵呵。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947594275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○無事帶憂容，塵灰滿面籠。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947610659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生瘢并黑子，𣦸向杳㝠中。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947627043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○腰折步行横，終朝受苦辛。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947643427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衣糧難度日，背脊是成坑。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947659811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○聲似破銅鑼，三刑六害多。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947676195","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960373895577650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語言如結澁，到處被人磨。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947692579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○牙齒若參差，靑黄黑不宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947708963","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若如榴子樣，富貴是賢妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947725347","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○口薄鼻又薄，耳輪又反廓。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947741731","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪短眼睂濃，一生不安樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947758115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○手冷如氷鐵，衣食𨿽歇滅。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947774499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瞳重喚難應，下賤爲愚拙。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947790883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○飲食大淋漓，難爲貴顯妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947807267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂尖生黑子，夜夜趂人歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947823651","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有女生來面細圓，五官六腑細須添。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947856419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼長髪黑蓮花臉，定嫁朝中富貴賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947872803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦女身形上下停，目如㸃漆必聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947889187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身材周正三才滿，富貴豊饒足一生。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947905571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦女身形","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947921955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960373895643186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端聳直，行周坐正不曽偏。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947921955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭圓齒白唇方正，富貴豊盈更有錢。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947938339","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦女身形富貴全，行藏温語氣聲圓。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947954723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼一顧無欹側，必主安詳老亦賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947971107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦女身形面大方，眼長睂聳足衣糧。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038947987491","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才五岳俱豐厚，利益兒孫活計昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948003875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦女身形吉慶羅，神淸體潤髪猶烏，更兼耳聳山根直，争奈生來富貴殊。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948020259","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有女生來髪鬓無，頭斜身側面輕枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948053027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼斜視多嬉色，一夜三夫與四夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948069411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭仰窺斜面有毛，額方睂大殺夫刀。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948085795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雄聲更若男兒貌，至老孤單獨自勞。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948102179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭方額起鼻生低，在室無貞郤有非。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948118563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任有","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948134947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960420900962314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親夫都害了，及當再嫁又貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948134947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是額長而又長，殺夫妨子實難量。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948151331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有人斜視精神急，到處隨人覓嫁郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948167715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目露睂黃幾嫁人，養男不得老來貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948184099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妨爹害母貲財滅，嫁得人家甑有塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948200483","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼大目拳面帶凹，逢人說語口嘐嘐。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948216867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"側頭斜視須貪色，背了賢夫走外郊。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948233251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目細頭圓眼口尖，貪淫多愛暗偸隣。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948249635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼行歩如禽雀，須信腰長脚又懸。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948266019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髮捲也須防損害，面歪鼻陷剋爹娘。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948282403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼唇薄身形蹙，過盡人家走外鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948298787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭面横肥鬓髪枯，眼光傾侧背兒夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948315171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行行坐坐無多定，到處逢人便是夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948331555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960420901060618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦女淫多面帶靑，眼根斜起室無貞。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948347939","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額方盡是偸情疾，嫁夫尅子受多辛。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948364323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人頭仰多淫慾，自嫁心情常不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948380707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無鬂生毛滿面過，通同到處隨人宿。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948397091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊目婦人色慾多，偸姦淫亂奈如何。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948413475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丈夫抛郤隨人去，世得爲妻定是婆。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948429859","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一見嬌姿多笑語，低頭側視愛偷淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948446243","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行如雀歩并光鼻，心裏奸機用意深。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948462627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢人含笑語聲頻，強掠睂頭傾郤身。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948479011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額下若拳頭不正，閃夫背子外人親。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948495395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人形急性𠒋強，看人不正大乖張。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948511779","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知奸滑多淫蕩，背郤夫兒走外方。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948528163","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲雙垂薄更斜，孤單獨目𠋣","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948544547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960420901142538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人家。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948544547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸𨐧生紋并黑子，出母貧窮甚可嗟。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948560931","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂婦人威厚，燕語聲和，耳厚白額，圓鬂烏潤，懷若抱子，眉削項長，目神澄清，視端嬌𡡾，人中分明，腮顴隱隱平平，懸壁端正，唇紅齒白，骨肉相輔，手纎鼻狹峻直，此女中之至貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948593699","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂耳漫唇厚，手掌紅潤，懸𨐧正，目美性寛，腮滿額濶，人中長，食𫝉滿，𧖟囊平，四倉俱滿，蘭尉分明，井竈平，厨匱滿，酒池平，地閣濶，鹅鴨豊，玉霞明，此女中之至","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948610083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960420901224458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948610083","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂口撮如吹火，鼻凹目露，蛇行雄聲，體冷齒尖，腰削𦙪高，胷凹眼露，額窄腰直，聲重而破，龍唇鳳口，頰高神淺，人中斷，手粗指短，上有天𧢲，此女中之至賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948626467","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂瞻視分明，剛柔有力，顴壽隠顯有勢，法令深，目神澄，黑白分明，目不斜視，嬌而有威，𡡾而態，行緩歩輕，身正性柔，耳厚額圓，鼻直，髪踈潤而光，聲清嚴而不散，此女中之至貞也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948642851","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂反顧，蛇行雀躍，耳反羊目，神薄，嬌而無威，𡡾而不","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948659235","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960466862145574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"態，剛中柔，五官不定，犯日角、天𧢲、龍角，神流，口濶舌長，笑而不定，惞唇撮口，睂如偃月，聲浮氣淺，此女中之至輕浮淫賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948659235","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂口高唇露，聲散髪黄，人中蹇，鼻促，下唇進前，耳窄鼻曲，竅露，目㴱，鼻有節，骨橫面黑，黃髪粗澁，體硬無𡡾，聲破無韻，項短面促，此女中之至惡也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948675619","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂二顴面，睂厚硬稜高，下唇過上，鼻準大，耳窄，頭如立卵，額窄削，目長無葢，聲雄，面黑如蝇，坐斑滿面，唇髭羊目，眼三𧢲，鼻鈎紋，山根斷，此女中之至孤也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948708387","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人骨格定竒異，看看乃與神仙隣。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948839459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非怪古與淸秀，明是端黒而停勾。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948855843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨格磊落松上鶴，頭𧢲挺時眞麒麟。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948872227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"森森脩竹鎖流水，峩峩硯石收寒雲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948888611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崑山片玉巳琢出，南海明珠光照靈。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948904995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靈桃繁杏𡡾春花，可憐容易摧風日。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948921379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"座中初見形昂藏，孰識漸覺無精光。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948937763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論言泛泛失倫序，舉動碌碌多愴惶。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948954147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人賦得此形相，薄薄微官難久長。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948970531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看發見何氣色，𢿘中惟有火多殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038948986915","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青多憂擾黑多病，白多破散黄乃昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038949003299","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湛然澄静無瑕翳，靑雲萬","logicSentenceId":"7580346038949019683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960466862440486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"里看翶翔。","logicSentenceId":"7580346038949019683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴賤貧各賦定，但把形𥙍來取正。","logicSentenceId":"75803460389490360 {"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一部吉兮吉必生，一部㐫兮㐫多應。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027105832","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部位吉㐫皆有主，全身養氣皆由命。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027122216","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流視神驚顧似悲，頦尖額窄少年肥。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027138600","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聳肩露背更歩速，兩重父母早西歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027154984","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽兩眼不相同，反耳高低壓月宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027171368","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喩以蓮火生臭水，身榮終是六親空。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027187752","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花入眼非賢婦，兩臉生腮最不良。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027204136","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭短齒踈額骨聳，少子刑夫終不長。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027220520","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣淸神静兩分明，齒細唇紅神更淸。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027236904","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻聳卧蚕豐更滿，語言詳緩歩輕盈。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661762088","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨淸神秀豐腰背，富貴天年享子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027253288","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不痴不醉不曾歡，顧","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027269672","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960508444540955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"視精神怕不安。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039027269672","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色似輕塵氣如土，辛苦還夫債萬端。","logicSentenceId":"75803460390272860 {"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人端臉好容儀，緩步輕移出水龜。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039028662312","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行不動塵言有節，終須約是貴人妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039028678696","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人輕步在人間，擺手搖頭口似丹。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039028695080","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愛自衣衫誇窈窕，與人私約笑情歡。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039028711464","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人對面少心情，眼有浮光似水晶。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039028727848","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒小睂踈髪際下，一生辛苦主伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140352035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人鼻上横骨起，脚長腿短要搖頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140368419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逃眠寄宿僧房内，潜地隨人走外州。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140384803","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
