{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"態而無艶終須貴，懿德昭然性自淳。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140466723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艷而無態何須道，此是尋常賤婦人。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140483107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩目如羊更抝胷，雀行鴨歩又","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140499491","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960625696292914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140499491","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生髭龜背喉嚨結，魚尾交紋總是㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140515875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見人掩口笑不休，等閒無事皺睂頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140532259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有時𠋣物閒尋物，定是随人走外州。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140548643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人因與人談詁，整襟弄袖又低頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140565027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識人間女子事，和情如海又如油。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140581411","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人眼下肉常枯，不殺三夫定四夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140597795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見人未語先嬉笑，愛逐行人走逺途。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140614179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人身體何不吉，額高耳大聲如泣。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140630563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雌雄更似男人面，至老孤單獨自棲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140646947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺夫只爲三抝面，口濶額高眼又深。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140663331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"借問如何三度嫁，郤因女作丈夫聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140679715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩目之下黑而枯，必定尅子又妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140696099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑黃若見方爲吉，赤黑難","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140712483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960625696374834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迯産難虞。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140712483","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要識婦人眞貴處，無非齒白與唇紅。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140728867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若𮟃尖齒唇兼黑，獨自聲容總是空。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140745251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上唇過下必多詐，下唇過上亦妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140761635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要識唇齒不相葢，又是還憂産難平。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140778019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人唇紫甚非良，須知妨子又妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140794403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邊紫黑來侵口，入耳須教七日亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140810787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右邊青色來侵口，當知孕者是男兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140827171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還左右知生女，依此詳觀定不疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140843555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目尾近上屬奸門，貴賤宐於此處論。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140859939","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因甚最多淫慾事，都緣遶口色皆靑。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140876323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼鼻上生雙靨，此必同人私與情。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140892707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右耳厚時先産女，左耳厚時必生男。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140909091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仰天鼻孔因何事，只","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140925475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960625696489522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是貪淫酒色酣。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140925475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中黑色貞爲貴，必主夫而自欽畏。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140941859","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中兩曲非良婦，至老心中也好淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140958243","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人若是男人相，淫亂芳心必有名。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140974627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誰知人中雙黑子，婦人有者必𩀱生。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039140991011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人額窄眞爲害，額上横紋夫更妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141007395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂中黑子夫遭害，睂裏三紋再嫁郞。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141023779","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐時搖膝無休歇，行則囘頭反看人。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141040163","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淫亂此身無所托，一生不免在風塵。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141056547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額上左邉生黑子，須防恐𣦸在刀兵。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141072931","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臀高胷突眞奴婢，此相何如定有名。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141089315","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人身相細兼全，眼長鼻直口如蓮。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141105699","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才第一常美闊，定招富貴嫁英賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141122083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"良婦有威而無","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141138467","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960670961188874"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡡾，娼妓有𡡾而無威。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141138467","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令人一見心生侮，所以生身在賤微。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141154851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形骨雖竒安可恃，亦須修身與立義。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141171235","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心形相稱福有根，不在天機在人事。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141187619","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夢中若與公卿合，穩上青雲萬丈梯。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141204003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休說形粗必招𥚽，但行忠孝福相隨。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141220387","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醜面生顴爲一惡，刑尅夫宫無差錯；結喉露齒爲二惡，無事招非閒擊括；蓬頭亂髪爲三惡，暮稱朝糧無積作；蛇行䑕歩爲四惡，至賤至貧人落魄；睂連粗重爲五惡，妨害六親猶隔𧢲；鼻下鈎紋爲六惡，妨害兒男身又弱；羊目四白爲七惡，心上陰凝如毒藥；雄聲焦烈爲八惡，心性剛暴難忖度；生髭黑子爲九惡，心性愚頑難倚托。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141285923","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人之相，但有一惡，難作善相。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661958696","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額窄又交睂，唇高齒不齊。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141810211","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面粗身鐡硬，體弱更無威。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141826595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960707715874854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳小垂珠淺，拳睂鼻骨低。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141842979","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哭聲須再嫁，男面必無兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141859363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淫紋生眼𧢲，嫉妬更好竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141875747","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫言時下富，晚歲更悽樓。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141892131","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人赤黑，主有産厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141924899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇齒不葢，終有妨害。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141941283","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人面上黄，懐孕得平康。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141957667","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中發黑紫，婦孕必生𩀱。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039141974051","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孕婦左邊靑色至，是男。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824023592","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右畔紅色至，是女。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661975080","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此，無不驗矣","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824039976","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"氣神昏暗論","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824056360","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神昏者，神亂者，神浮者，神離者，俱主𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824072744","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣昏者，氣亂者，氣變者，俱主死。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384661991464","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面黑色，耳白者，主財氣順。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824089128","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面白色，","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824105512","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960707715940390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳黑者，主財散人離，應在六旬之外，又不以此論夏秋。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824105512","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面白耳黑，主大㐫，冬月猶不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662007848","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人耳紅面白者，主淫賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824121896","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色紅圓耳白者，主尊貴。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662024232","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面黑眼光者，主淫賤。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662040616","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面白齒白者，主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662057000","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面白髪鬂濃者，淫賤。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662073384","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有孕婦人，氣重，色艷，脚浮，主育女。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824138280","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣青色青，唇黑，凖頭明，肉痩，脚手不浮，育男。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662089768","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824154664","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"妬氣歌","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824171048","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面黑心難揣，頭喎行不堪。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824187432","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與人一面笑，毒在腹中含。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824203816","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鷹視幷狼顧，羊飡與雀行。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824220200","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語言必勤舌，妬忌不聊生。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824236584","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960707716022310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女面肉横靑，沉吟不作聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824252968","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也知含妬忌，應不順人情。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824269352","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行坐如思事，低頭或㸃頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824285736","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲焦斜眼視，看著惹傷悲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824302120","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引𦡍如蛇走，低頭作女聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824318504","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟多詐僞，仍是没人情。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824334888","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"管輅","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662106152","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡小兒呌聲連延，初生小兒呌聲連延者，主壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824367656","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲絕復揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824384040","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初生小兒聲呌而復揚者，不壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824400424","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額有旋毛，早貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824416808","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枕骨不成，能言而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824433192","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睛大而光，富貴難量。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824449576","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𩕄門不合，八嵗防厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824465960","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數歲未言語遲者，神定必爲重器。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824482344","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰入如無，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824498728","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭上髪稀者，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662122536","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五岳有偏，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662138920","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身上有汗，","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662155304","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960707716120614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662155304","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通身柔軟而如無骨者，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662171688","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臍小而低，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662188072","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早行，早坐，早言，早齒，不成人。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824515112","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭成四破，不成人。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662204456","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"啼聲散，不成人。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662220840","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常𢭌手足，不率敎。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824531496","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小便如膏，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824547880","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰大，囊皮皺堅實者，富壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824564264","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉色浮慢者，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824580648","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相嬰兒貴賤","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824597032","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孩童可養，聲大有神。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824613416","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭折難成，腎浮不𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824629800","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭圓骨聳，易養而利益雙親。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662237224","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額方面長，無險而吉祥迭至。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662253608","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根靑氣出照，累見災危。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824646184","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻上赤色，初歲多生膿血。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824662568","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰囊若荔實，實爲堅耐之兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824678952","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面肉類浮漚，必是虗花之子。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662269992","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960759096115210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭匾無腦骨，能言而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824695336","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目緩欠精神，善行而夭。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662286376","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色𦂳而實，可養無危。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824711720","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲響神淸，形端頴異，鼻梁低小，早年常有啾喞之災。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824728104","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際壓遮，出身實是孤刑之子。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824744488","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際高濶，必多聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662302760","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲短氣促，終須夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824760872","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂頭牽額，利處山林。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824777256","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面陷無顴，難居家宅。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662319144","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤峯獨起，骨肉參商。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824793640","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四尾低垂，二睂散亂，妻兒隔𧢲。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662335528","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橫紋額上，男女盡主孤刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824810024","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑痣淚堂，子息例有傷尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824826408","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂不葢眼，財利耗散之。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824842792","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼大露神，數歲夭亾之子。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662351912","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下輕上重，末主伶仃上。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824859176","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濶下尖，何由結果。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662368296","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項白過面，衣食豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824875560","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神賽於形，田庄","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662384680","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960759096197130"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662384680","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒玉枕，名曰玉環骨。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824891944","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高起者，可養壽具。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662401064","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉環平者，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662417448","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉環陷如坑，不過八歲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824908328","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初生孩兒相，其耳門大者，壽大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824924712","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲響亮者，壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824941096","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好戲耍者，神有餘，必富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824957480","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語聲弱，不好戲耍者，神不足，主多疾病，氣怯無壽。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662433832","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒項下絛紋者，富而壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824973864","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行早者，貧。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662450216","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語晩者，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662466600","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八嵗衣服齊整，語聲響亮，秀而不俗，長富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039824990248","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不愛衣服，行坐穢物，語聲不淸，長貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662482984","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲常有涎，多爲奴婢。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825006632","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有旋毛者，妨父母。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825023016","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰如截筒者貴，陽大者愚蠢。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825039400","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825055784","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960759096262666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒聲似鴉，富貴足榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825055784","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破聲多不足，又主破人家。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825072168","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒聲歌啼，孤獨無兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825088552","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷父又離母，方得更加期。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825104936","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：肉𦂳，面𦂳，皮𦂳，小兒必䘮靑春。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825121320","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"人像禽獸形","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825137704","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"總禽獸詩","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825154088","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨秀神淸正鳯凰，分明眼目勢偏長。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825170472","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自然貴處多忠義，美譽淸朝必異常。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825186856","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○行歩昂昂正虎形，精神安㤗眼分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825203240","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣豪言語如鐘鼓，似類深山必貴榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825219624","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○虎形","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825236008","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960759096328202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳯類得其眞，正類淸朝必貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825236008","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得地失時貧也貴，自然明白富和貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825252392","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○或如龜鶴勢能良，脚手逡巡項更長。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825268776","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心性寛和神氣俊，壽同松檜亦難量。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825285160","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○燕雀顛狂不自由，語言虚詐更搖頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825301544","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人又或多機巧，衣食徒勞分外求。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825317928","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○蛇䑕之人下視頻，行歩低頭去似奔。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825334312","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼小又圓多下賤，害物奸偸不可論。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825350696","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"人像鳯形論","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825367080","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭昂睂高，眼長鼻正，骨淸肉秀，神形異常，氣候安和，舉止詳雅，動爲出俗，大事不能動搖，有此者，乃據鳯","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825383464","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960759096393738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之形也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825383464","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主好義風，有學識，見深逺，有過人之象，必位極人臣，淸名天下。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825416232","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或似乎飛，或似乎困。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825432616","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其貴賤耴類而言之，類於優則優，類於劣則劣。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825449000","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㐫𥚟福，取象而言之，或類其牛馬，則平生辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825465384","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其氣候得地，光肥則富貴；或憔悴終身，勞力少安閒。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825481768","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或類其鷹鷂，其小爲小人象。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825498152","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其物㐫則㐫，吉則吉，善則善，惡則惡，無不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825514536","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"人像禽名類","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825530920","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"各禽名斷訣類，凡二十形像。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鳳形第一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960804914708490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形眼單長，睂輕細，𫝉庫低，鼻高曲，神骨秀，聲韻淸，性温雅，超倫類。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825547304","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"痩則通，肥則滞，頷朝額，是天地相應也。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662499368","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或睂眼細，下短上長，身側，即是小鳳形人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825563688","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若身長面大，部聳直，精神𢚩速，即丹鳳形也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825580072","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：睂眼頭長五岳豐，齒如含玉智英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825596456","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身形細美行藏秀，位極人臣貴國公。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825612840","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鶴形第二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形𫝉庫䧟，眼尾垂，身體弱，頭骨粗，項細長，行歩濶，","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825629224","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960804914806794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停長，性温柔，好山水，多名譽。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825629224","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四部陷者孤鶴，五部露者病鶴。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039825645608","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴不必要項長，假如睡鶴、蹲鶴美相者，豈見項也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853383714","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：額短頭圓項後紅，鼻梁尖聳性靈聰。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853400098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不于佐主權生殺，更出幽玄含上穹。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853416482","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鷹形第三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭方額圓，鼻曲嘴鈎，眼圓睛赤，耳卓口小，性急難捉模，爲事猛浪。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853432866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入此相者，爲上將軍，好殺，多不善","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853449250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960804914888714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853449250","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：額廣睂濃眼彩光，腮垂頥重有連裳。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853465634","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲淸歩濶多雄猛，解說兵威武事揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853482018","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"燕形第四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面圓腮起，輔骨靑黃，腰身委𡡾，性慢多言，愛榮宅舍，身多出入。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853498402","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：口小唇紅準促圓，形單體瘦藝雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853514786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼深黑白多","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853531170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960804914970634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明朗，成就多應枉早亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853531170","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鴿形第五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形身委頰白，眼赤靑色，起坐不久，視色不轉，常𢜤吟哦。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853547554","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：形身倭短眼微靑，舉動能増逺月明。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853563938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫道生來衣祿足，傍人門戶且平安。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853580322","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鵝形第六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形口尖眼小，項長脚短，鼻頭縮，行歩慢，頷腮動。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853596706","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960856869584905"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：口小眼小上停長，脚短行遲自有常。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853613090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衣祿不愁還自足，綠波千頃好田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853629474","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鸚鵡形第七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形眼微長，内外翅垂，鼻準圓大，行歩𢚩躁，語言急迫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853645858","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：凖頭圓大眼微長，歩急言辭𡡾且良。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853662242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身貴近君終有用，何愁不似雪衣娘。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853678626","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960856869683209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"孔雀形第八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面小而身大，性慢多敬，愛華餙，貪好美名。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853695010","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面小身肥惜羽翰，平生艮友鳳和鸞。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853711394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侯門祿食堪依倚，莫把凡禽一様看。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853727778","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"雀形第九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形身俱小，眼急圓，睛黃色，多驚懼，貪淫慾，舉動相窮，平生勞祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853744162","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853760546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960856869781513"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身形俱小雙眸急，多懼多驚性喜淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853760546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食艱辛且隨分，得依大厦少安心。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853776930","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鴝鵒形第十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面色紫黑，眼小赤光，鼻大口尖，見物常嗔，人多憎惡，白撰是非。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853793314","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：紫黑形容眼赤輝，口尖白撰是和非。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853809698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不踰濟洛溪頭逺，若作行商便不歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853826082","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鴛鴦形第十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960899085221898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面紅而白，眼圓而𡡾，行歩無威，語言邪穢，性好奢華，宣淫㤀巳。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853842466","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面紅眼白太多情，行歩無威性喜淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853858850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得真形還入相，鴛行早列佐皇明。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853875234","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鵲形第十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面小，靑白色，耳卓，行歩急，談吐寛容，人見多喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853891618","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面小形容白又靑，出言人盡喜聞聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853908002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胷中自有封","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853924386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960899085303818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侯印，忠厚傳家表令名。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853924386","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鷄形第十三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭小面小，睛黃，急義，多子，維嗜慾不失信。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853940770","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：禀性從來自有靈，更兼文彩足天成，生平不失言前信，管取人人聞俊聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853957154","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鴨形第十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形身圓脚短，面小行慢，得侶強悲嗚，先貧而後富。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853973538","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853989922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960899085385738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面小身團貌不揚，更兼口濶下停長。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039853989922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只因行歩遲遲好，不貴須教有富藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854006306","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鷓鴣形第十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面微紅，眼赤黃，身小耳小，視地搖頭行。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854022690","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：雙眸黄赤面微紅，行即搖頭貌不隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854039074","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是此般形狀者，區區終不出樊籠。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854055458","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鷺鷥形第十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其身細長，鼻柱長，睂缩眼黃，脚長身縮背伏，行路頭","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854071842","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960899085451274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"搖，飮食驚慌，主人辛苦勞碌，寒相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854071842","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：潔白形容不染塵，歩行搖動本天真。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854088226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只因身縮孤寒相，終日區區爲色貪。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854104610","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鶻形第十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形肩微卓，眼又圓，心性急，多精神，好貪非義之物。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854120994","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：監起𩀱睂眼欲圓，精神人獨本天然。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854137378","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪求口食皆非義，只作儉人非是賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854153762","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960935256866854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鴈形第十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形身性急，多驚疑，睂目小，面紫色，臀高，喜出入，無祖業，與衆和。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854170146","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面側雙眸小伴睂，多驚多恐更多疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854186530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天倫友愛無相失，祿食江湖自有時。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854202914","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鴉形第十九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面稍圓，嘴鼻尖，眼靑黑，多語言，面黑紫，人皆惡之。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854219298","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960935256932390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面貌微圓嘴鼻尖，三言出口便成嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854235682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽然得食無虧缺，終是貪婪不自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854252066","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鹳形第二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形眼大，口尖，耳小，天𫝉陷，額𧢲峻，聲音小，性不定，少祖業也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854268450","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：𩀱眸不小口尖長，言語聲微性不常。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854284834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額峻天𫝉多缺陷，如何招得祖田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854301218","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960935257030694"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"人像獸名類","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854317602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"各獸名斷訣，凡三十形像。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"人像虎形論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭大，項方，肩圓背厚，腰濶，額高，目大，黑白分明，口大而方，唇若抹硃，瞻視平逺，光彩射人，精神安㤗，語言鐘磬，作用豁逹大度，乃林中之虎也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854333986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此相者，必位極人臣，或作將軍帥。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854350370","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此精神太猛，瞻視不定，行歩太昂，謂之出林虎。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854366754","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽發猛烈，作用有斷，處貴不久，終失祿位。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854383138","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此前說，精神詳雅，語言有序，瞻視平穩，謂之靠山虎。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854399522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"享祿久長，晩猶顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854415906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此前說，精𥚞不定，","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854432290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960935257161766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉頭𢚩速，謂之克山虎。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854432290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或貴或賤，得失不等，平生多㐫少吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854448674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此前說，不愁似愁，不嗔私嗔，神氣溺倦，不病如病，謂之穿山虎。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854465058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖居富貴之中，尋常笑呀不足，果然大稱，意必早亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854481442","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"龍形第二十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫龍形者，其人鼻高耳聳，形貌端嚴，身體長大，骨格淸秀，睂自分明，舉指出衆，有威權，足機變。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854497826","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔漢高帝隆凖龍顔，唐太宗龍姿日𧢲，乃帝王之相，非常人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854514210","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854530594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960984619679782"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體勢飛朝宛若龍，美髯頭𧢲鼻高隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854530594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"威靈赫奕人無比，萬國雲從仰帝聰。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854546978","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"麟形第二十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫麟形者，項骨高，身形仰，耳高眼深，睂粗額闊，音中宫商，行中規矩。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854563362","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得麟形真者，皆主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854579746","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：額廣睂粗腮額橫，耳高齊厚黑睛平。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854596130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人形高仰威雄勢，佐國昇平獨秉名。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854612514","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"獅形第二十三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960984619745318"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形眼白睛黑，圓滿而大，山根斷，口闊方，睂婆娑，多鬚鬂，子出一二，面頭方，骨格髙，爲事深逺，難見心腹。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854628898","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：威鎭山河佐主忠，頭方額高更睂濃。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854645282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腦後骨起天庭突，列土分茅爵累封。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854661666","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"虎形第二十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形身細長，眼赤，長二寸半，面紅𦂳堅，黑少白多。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854678050","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂與眼齊，尖直口大，上唇齊有鎌鉒，下唇齊色紅潤，齒粗白，頭短圓，額長方厚，髭髪踈硬黑，口大舌長紅厚，","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854694434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960984619810854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語聲如雷。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854694434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲語則有眼光起威猛，看人似作怒。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854710818","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身或肥或瘦，人中方正，五岳皆起。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854727202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入此相者，爲上將軍。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854743586","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面大頭圓項後紅，鼻梁尖起性靈聰。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854759970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性高志烈權生殺，或乃君王會一宮。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854776354","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"象形第二十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭起，印堂平，睂長眼小，鼻仰唇反牙露，身大肉多，耳大無輪，鈍慢，多不腄，少望。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854792738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得此相者，非富卽貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854809122","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854825506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960984619860006"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枕上明珠額廣平，身形長厚美三停。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854825506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行粗坐穩言深重，逺鎭山河協聖明。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854841890","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"犀形第二十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形上下三停一體肥，睂目相等，天庭高，伏犀骨起，天地相朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854858274","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：頭圓眼大更睂濃，耳内毫毛體肉豐。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854874658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得正形台鼎位，其他巨富壽而終。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854891042","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"猿形第二十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330960984619925542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面圓而小，睂目俱圓，臂長音響，好淸潔，静脩餙，喜花果，鼻小口尖，猖狂輕燥，不尊重，多嗔怒，心性靈長，體瘦唇薄腮豐。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854907426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入此相者，當爲武職。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854940194","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：頭圓眼黑頸腮平，脚短手長行歩輕。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854956578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常在碧霄閑散處，一生終是主虚名。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854972962","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"㺅形第二十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形颧骨高，眼圓深，面赤黄，耳鼻卓，膽小，猖狂不定，輕薄不尊重，多嗔含怒，心靈智巧。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039854989346","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961028567580699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：額突頭圓五岳平，齒靑唇薄體金形，腮頥垂下髪髭黑，爵重分茅佐聖明。","logicSentenceId":"7580346039855005730","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"龜形第二十九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形項長下短，頭尖眼圓，睂濃鼻聳，嘴長，肩背伏厚，睛定性淳，平生好山水，多尊重，身體圓肥，五岳相稱。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386060303","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得此相者，主財主富。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386076687","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：額起頭高鼻聳齊，睂濃眼大厚腮頥。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386093071","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"櫃𫝉豐滿精","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386109455","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961028567646235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神異，富壽兼全佐主威。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386109455","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"牛形第三十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形身魁，心性慢，眼黑光，口常動，項粗頭廣，平生罕病。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386125839","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：生來福厚不容言，面壯心平語話謙。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386142223","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若更歩行遲且緩，千倉積貯富田園。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386158607","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鼠形第三十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形赤紫色，眼微圓，暗處窺，宻處食，好蓄積。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386174991","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961028567744539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：性天小巧又通靈，衣食資才僅養身。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386191375","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狀貌有拘難顯逹，不遭惡𣦸也艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386207759","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"蛇形第三十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭長，五岳不正，額平睂小，眼長口聚，濶身，粗齒，細耳，上大下小，鼻小長，行歩腰軟，頭搖仰面，未論見舌，行步如之字樣，性毒不憫念人，被人觸便欲傷人，行動急速，使人莫測之也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386224143","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386256911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961028567842843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面長頭短眼靑昏，唇口高青事莫論。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386256911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻小準尖行歩速，位雖郡佐性難分。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386273295","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"馬形第三十三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面長眼大，口濶勢尖，齒大腰長，性慢，夜多不睡，行坐尊重，主人貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386289679","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：天然三面側如磚，禀性温良好着先。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386306063","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子比之因有德，前程萬里可安然。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386322447","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"羊形第三十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961084100198409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭方面長，無額，地閣尖削，口聚有鬍，眼黄黑少白多，睛濁，脚短，頭垂則視地。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386338831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得此形者，位至七品官。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386355215","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人得之，須富而淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386371599","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：生來顔色最淸白，玉骨氷肌多酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386387983","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婚得形容端正妻，會合自然成福德。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386404367","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"鹿形第三十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形行歩如走，性情不定，見人多驚疑，起坐不久，眼靑黑而微長。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386420751","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961084100280329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：雙眸靑黑更微長，行歩如飛性却剛。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386437135","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得山林相隱映，自然福祿異尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386453519","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"熊形第三十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形身體圓，鼻定仰，起坐不久，喘息急促，無垂白壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386469903","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：狀體形儀又匪猪，徒然力勇逞𠒋愚。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386486287","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子良不是生斯子，敖氏𮟃能滅也無。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386502671","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楚子良生子越𥚔，弓又曰：熊虎豺狼不殺，必滅敖氏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"魚形第三十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961084100378633"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形眼圓項縮，耳小睂薄，口聚身長，眠不開目，性格猶豫不定。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386519055","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：項縮何曾閉眼眠，水星相得免憂煎。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386535439","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禹門三級桃花浪，變化成龍上九天。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386551823","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"猪形第三十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭濶面長，額平眼深，口聚耳尖，腮肥無項，脚短，見人乍驚，愛居僻猥，口常微動，終主横亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386568207","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386584591","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961129549627442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項短身微賦性愚，衣才雖足亦無餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386584591","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若爲僧道須還吉，外此營求只自知。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386600975","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"狗形第三十九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭大頂粗，睛黄面尖，口聚，耳尖聳，性急，飲食無厭，身與脚相等，小人多憎惡，於人有心力。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386617359","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面尖額濶眼睛黄，喜怒平生自不常。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386633743","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指示得逢蕭相國，一生心力佐高皇。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386650127","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"蟹形第四十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961129549709362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形眼凸耳卓，身圓多懼，坐立不正，與衆不睦，性格僻澁。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386666511","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：眼露横行直又愚，生平賦性喜江湖。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386682895","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直形若得當爲郡，休問監州有也無。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386699279","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"猫形第四十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面圓，眼圓，腰長，性慢多言，見識淺窄。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386715663","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：眼中黄色面微圓，禀性温純好飽鮮。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386732047","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有力有才堪","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386748431","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961129549807666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任使，一生常得貴人憐。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386748431","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"獐形第四十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面長嘴尖，眼似大而細，睂粗稜高，眉狹鼻凖小，耳長露反，身小腰小無肚，脚長行急，愛静，性驚，多憂疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386764815","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：身肥項短脚頭圓，睂大分明眼亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386797583","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不信人言常使性，平生衣食也迍邅。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386813967","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"蝦形第四十三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961129549905970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形睂骨起而齒露，骨肉不和，眼常靑色。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386830351","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：操心直亮貌昂然，挺挺英風自莫前。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386846735","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇水年方得志，直須論事可回天。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386863119","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"豹形第四十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形五岳急，天倉窄，地閣圓，爲事猛烈，喜外人，憎骨肉。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386879503","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面長齒宻鼻隆高，多惠多文性且豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386895887","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫道南山終","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386912271","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961167290023946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露隱，會須變化不辭勞。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386912271","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"驢形第四十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形眼黄白，無和氣，行歩急，多𡚶談，性𤰞汚，面長耳長，語音粗散。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386928655","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：眼中黄白面形長，耳大分明相畏常。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386945039","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴兆巳成眞大貴，不然稱賞動君王。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386961423","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"帝𡮢謂李忠臣曰：卿耳大，貴兆？對曰：驢耳大，龍耳小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"狐形第四十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形面紫色，睂目𡡾形，頰大，情和美，性急，凥骨起，淫","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386977807","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961167290105866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慾中，多巧詐。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386977807","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：面帶酒容睂目媚，心𤫊奸滑事多疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040386994191","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"那堪更得山林茂，衣食從容樂且宐。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387010575","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"豺形第四十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭方額濶，地閣尖，睂粗睛大圓，五岳起，口大齒宻，豺牙尖露，耳輪貼肉。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387026959","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得此相者，當爲將軍。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387043343","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：元來此相號豺狼，頭方額濶眼睛圓。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387059727","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂粗口大牙","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662515752","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961167290253322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖露，耳輪貼肉壽延年。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662515752","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"猩猩形第四十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形睂目相近，鼻高直上，口濶，上唇掀，面濶身肥，髪粗赤旋，腮削𦡍長，性急言直，主人多才多藝，爲僧道，女人必爲賢德人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387076111","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：猩猩之相鼻梁高，眼睂相近髪粗毛。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387092495","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇掀面濶身肥大，腮削爲人德重褒。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387108879","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"兎形第四十九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961204300562458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭小額小，睂細口小，耳長圓大，齒細宻，鼻細而紅，脚短。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387125263","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入此相者，五品之官，女人亦主夫人之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387141647","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：額頭口眼最分明，四小元來號兎形。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387158031","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂細耳長兼齒細，定教男女貴榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387174415","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"駱駝形第五十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形頭圓而長，額濶項長，背伏睂高，五岳不正，睂粗目深，口聚髪粗，膞濶骨粗，齒露，頭低，腳手長，聲雄，行慢能負重。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387190799","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲此相者，三品之官。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387207183","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961204300627994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：駱駝背伏更睂粗，頭項圓長額濶扶。","logicSentenceId":"7580346040387223567","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口聚目深眉聳上，聲雄榮貴佐皇圖。","logicSentenceId":"7609661384662532136","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分一面之貴賤，辨三輔之榮辱，莫不定乎額也。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196350976","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故天庭、天中、司空俱列乎額，是能攝諸部位，係人之貴賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196367360","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其骨欲隆然而起，聳然而濶，玉柱入頂，貴爲天子。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196383744","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其峻如立𨐧，其廣如覆肝，明而澤，方而長者，貴壽之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196400128","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左偏者，損父。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196416512","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右偏者，損母。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029531145","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小而狹者，貧夭；缺而","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196432896","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961360731340854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟者，妨害。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196432896","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"痕瘠者，迍蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029547529","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左爲日，右爲月，日月之角，百骨稜稜而起者，二千石。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196449280","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂上至天庭，有骨隱然而見者，必逹而榮。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029563913","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邊地山林，皆欲豐廣，坑䧟貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196465664","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額兩邊輔𧢲骨起者，三品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196482048","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中、天庭、司空、中正、印堂五位，須得端正明浄，則聰明顯逹也。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196498432","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若狹小而亂髪低覆復者，愚而貧賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196514816","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196531200","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭小而窄，至老孤厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196531200","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額大而方，至老吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029580297","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額濶面廣，貴居人上。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196580352","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額方峻起，吉無不利。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029596681","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961436442820619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額上亂紋交差者，則貧苦多灾。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196891648","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人額上有三橫紋者，妨夫害子。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196908032","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196924416","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火星宮分濶方平，潤澤無紋氣色清。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196924416","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犀骨三條川字相，少年及第作公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196940800","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○火星尖狹是庸流，紋亂凹兜主配囚。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196957184","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤脈兩條侵日月，刀兵刑法𣦸他州。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196973568","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○額高光澤貴而榮，横貫三紋道術通。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326196989952","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女定妨夫多不利，額欹偏小早歸冥。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326197006336","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○額上微成小理紋，生來高貴異時人。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326197022720","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男居職位爲僚佐，女嫁賢才作縣","logicSentenceId":"7580347326197039104","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961436274901026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326197039104","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○三畫横紋在耳邊，定知聰惠是良賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326197055488","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若携書劒于明主，應有文章動九天。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326197071872","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中直理太乖期，無柰生來有此儀。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326197088256","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食平平終日有，只緣形相損妻兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580347326197104640","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
