{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之骨法，中貴者，莫岀於頭額之骨。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082138659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭額之奇者，莫出於腦骨。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029711369","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成枕之人，有枕骨，如山石有玉，江海有珠，一身以恃其榮顯也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082155043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故人雖有奇骨，亦須形貌相副，神氣清越，方受天祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082171427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，恐未盡善也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082187811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫腦之後名曰星臺，若有骨者，名曰枕骨。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082204195","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡豊起者，冨貴，低䧟者，貧賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082220579","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyh8fqk3/1-1710154543459.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=adD7PZSbfUZsp1TxonN6OEK921o%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyh8fqk3/1-1710154543459.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348273082662947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒樽枕，主近貴，有祿無官。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082662947","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyh8g377/1-1710154552538.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=xo3GurW1s4lVzgNky152SUrqwAs%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyh8g377/1-1710154552538.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348273082679331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上字枕，志高膽大，成敗小貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082679331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：凡人有此玉枕者，皆主貴相。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082695715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如僧道之人，雖不貴，有此玉枕者，皆主壽命長逺。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082712099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人玉枕，但稍有骨微起者，皆主祿壽平下無者，祿壽難逺。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082728483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人有者，皆主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082744867","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhd97nt/1-1710154597008.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=RSd9bMEZaKE1Ibn%2FQ%2BliE8n89Kw%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhd97nt/1-1710154597008.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348273082761251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰鼓枕，主小貴無定，多成敗反覆。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082761251","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhd9kax/1-1710154603119.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=RIF7lVX3%2FopIUYfSF8aKFILfElE%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhd9kax/1-1710154603119.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348273082777635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如珠枕，主近貴而不實。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082777635","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhd9wy1/1-1710154614772.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=GI495DqoqOOqCbTrPm1lNg76dj4%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhd9wy1/1-1710154614772.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348273082794019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁字枕，主性寛，近貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082794019","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961615874981903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhda9l5/1-1710154707172.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=KOGdKsjte8hF7xIQArOdDrl0w90%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhda9l5/1-1710154707172.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348273082810403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三骨直起，一骨下橫承之者，名曰山字枕，主聰明、冨貴、壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580348273082810403","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhdam89/1-1710154771350.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=P8puRgdZgwRIAzH%2FVNAKqlNlo2c%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhdam89/1-1710154771350.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348356698832936","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一骨員，一骨方，名曰疊玉枕，主冨而榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698832936","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhdayvd/1-1710154784873.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=yXzjYyJ3TK6giQ%2F%2B8JdOkFsaN1s%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhdayvd/1-1710154784873.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348356698849320","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一骨聳起而尖峻者，名曰象牙枕，主兵將之權。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698849320","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhdbbih/1-1710154794550.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=vwiHCVlxQc%2BLeXT%2FKJVt6qwwlm4%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhdbbih/1-1710154794550.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348356698865704","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨起分四𧢲者，名曰懸計骨，主節察武臣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698865704","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhdbo5l/1-1710154808123.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=Z3z4Fi3xp15azvwLglOcY1RecAg%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/3/ref/1k2v9hyhdbo5l/1-1710154808123.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580348356698882088","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一骨横截者，名曰一陽枕，主巨冨高壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698882088","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡枕骨欲得，共下者，過腦而易辯，近上者，淺而難驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698898472","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨者，一定之相，有之則應也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698914856","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故古人有言：頭無惡骨，面無好痣，斯言信之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698931240","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961609067872297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相骨節","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698947624","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：骨節要豊隆，天中何上攻。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698964008","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橫生主封爵，鷄子定孤窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698980392","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍𧢲如雙柱，陞朝有始終。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356698996776","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂三寸起，伯牧位相同。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699013160","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻與山根直，求婚帝室同。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699029544","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩顴欹更露，權勢盡成空。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699045928","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸𨐧須豊起，歌斜禍必逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699062312","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨龜連腦戸，宰輔位尊崇。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699078696","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精舍林中廣，仙風道骨藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699095080","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏犀三路起，僧道骨爲良。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699111464","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬連邊地，兵權守一方。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699127848","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神分五指，極品在","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699144232","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961615875063823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵓廊。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699144232","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武庫冝爲將，傾危必主亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699160616","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉梁具耳鼻，清顯冨文章。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699177000","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大海尖如指，支干愼折傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699193384","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門欲平濶，尖䧟定婬娼。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699209768","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王樓如伏臂，名重三台位。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699226152","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛𧢲連虎眉，直起冝侍衛。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699242536","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日𧢲父康寧，月缺母難備。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699258920","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項後見兩頥，兄弟多不義。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699275304","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知壽綿逺，耳後聳餘地。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699291688","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頦額方且平，揖讓最爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699308072","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更忌虎吞龍，粗露功須忌，旣聳堅且明，巍巍堂","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699324456","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961662268194870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廟噐。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699324456","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相面部骨格","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699340840","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中骨起，主冨貴，䧟缺無田地。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699357224","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天門骨合，得四方，朋友及弟兄姊妹之力。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699373608","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○百合骨起，邊地之将，高聳，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699389992","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○命門骨長，壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699406376","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟低并色惡，不然。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029760521","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○子位豊滿，主多子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699422760","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○甲匱骨起，女主后𡚱，男爲金吾，將相領兵。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699439144","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○邊上骨起及肉紅潤者，主冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699455528","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699471912","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法令骨起，爲大理、主事、少卿等官。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699471912","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色惡，主多厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699488296","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○井𥩋骨起，冝田宅。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699504680","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○輔𧢲骨起，能文案合爲大尹。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699521064","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地閣骨滿，主","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699537448","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961615875162127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屋宅。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699537448","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地倉骨起，冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699553832","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○虎耳骨起，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699570216","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○承漿骨滿朝天者，主冨足酒食。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699586600","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○懸𨐧骨起及肉滿，冝奴僕。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699602984","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟者無。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699619368","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○燕頷骨起，大冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699635752","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○武庫骨起，爲上將。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699652136","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○房心骨起，國師。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699668520","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○四殺骨起，節度使。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699684904","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○大陽骨起，爲御史。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699701288","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○輔骨起，爲侍郎、給事中、中書舍人。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699717672","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如黃色，一品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699734056","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○邉地骨起，爲諫議、大夫、監察御史。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699750440","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天庭骨起紅潤者，丞相之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699766824","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○日月𧢲起，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699783208","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○額𧢲骨起，司徒、太保之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699799592","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○父墓骨起，大貴，廕襲子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699815976","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○戰堂骨起，爲驃騎將軍、節度副使、行軍、司馬之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699832360","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961662268293174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○郊外骨起，三品卿，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699848744","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○司空骨起，刺史、員外郎、省舍人之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699865128","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○道中骨起，遠州刺史。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699881512","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○交額骨起，官小有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699897896","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○重眉起，主小貴，有節行，人性不常。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699914280","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○懸𧢲骨起，或肉黄者，七十日内主三公卿相、天下綂帥。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699930664","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○中正骨起，司馬令長。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699947048","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山林骨起，州牧之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699963432","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○虎眉骨起，爲將軍。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699979816","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○龍𧢲骨起，主封矦，尚書僕射。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356699996200","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○輔犀骨起，封矦伯，一品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700012584","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○華葢骨起，冨壽人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700028968","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○福堂骨起，主三品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700045352","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○兩眉𨶹門骨起，合得國師，库藏錢物，肉䧟合，主市死。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700061736","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此部近兩獄也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700078120","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂骨起，合主大","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700094504","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961615875260431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬，三品太保、司徒之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700094504","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○三陽明浄，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700110888","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○司空骨起至式枕者，三品、下四品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700127272","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○中正骨起至玉枕者，二品、下三品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700143656","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根骨起，如𨥁股，上有稜似刀背，至枕者，或如月樣，明潤異者，爲大將軍之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700160040","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天庭骨起至枕者，四品、下五品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700176424","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中骨起至枕，五品下、六品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700192808","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○伏犀骨起至枕，六品下、七品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700209192","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○坤山骨起至枕，七品下、八品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700225576","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○鳳池骨起至枕，八品下、九品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700241960","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○華葢骨起至枕，九品下雜流小貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700258344","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等之骨，皆似稜利，以手捫之，覺隱隱然似刀背，祿主冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700274728","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○玉枕骨起，方","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700291112","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961662268407862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三寸，有像似十九般骨節，如刀背者爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700291112","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鷄子橫縱，似仰月、覆月、背月、玉環等樣，主壽，異常，女人有者，吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700307496","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨氣似有似無，見如諸部，如釵股之樣起，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700323880","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏犀骨如小指半大，有稜如線，位極上","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700340264","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700340264","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨如指者，爲名僧。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029776905","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨有稜如𧢲，大指者，上將軍。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029793289","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此名伏犀骨，玉枕頭，各有取焉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700373032","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中骨起，如筋大，有稜，合主國師。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700389416","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近聖人，貴至三品。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700405800","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○左廂骨起，祿二千石，骨肉相稱，至白衣拜相。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700422184","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○高廣驛馬骨起，封矦大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700438568","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面部隱然骨起，不出十年，爲方面。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356700454952","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉色俱好，五年之内，陞遷也。","logicSentenceId":"7610705418029809673","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

ontent":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961706096246824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣主少田宅。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770442250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家信主家破散也。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770458634","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫黑子者，若山之生林木，地之出堆阜也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809703459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山有美質，則生善木，以顯其秀；地積汚土，则生惡阜，以樂其濁。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809719843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物之理皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809736227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以人有美質也，則生其黑，以彰其貴；有濁質也，則生惡痣，以表其賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809752611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故漢高祖左股七十二黑子，則見帝王之瑞相。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809768995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡黑子生於顯處者多㐫，生於隱處者多吉，生於面上者皆不利也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809785379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且黑者，其色黑如漆，赤如硃者，善也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809801763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶赤者，主口舌闘競。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809818147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶白者，主憂驚刑厄。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770524170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶黄者，主遺忘失脫。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770540554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此義理之辯","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809834531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961743658876982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809834531","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"相黑子","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809850915","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中貴位不冝居，男防父母女防夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809867299","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見天庭憂市死，印堂官事或才儲。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809883683","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽上防妻尤自得，承漿若有醉中殂。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809900067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人地閣須憂産，詔獄或見死囚拘。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809916451","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横事相妨左廂出，若臨高廣二親無。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809932835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尺陽主往他鄕殁，魚尾奸門盗賊辜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809949219","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢暴亡天井水，太陽官舍外陽逋。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809965603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武庫主兵邊地逺，遊軍亡陣或兵誅。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809981987","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或主書上憂無學，井部冝防井厄虞。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356809998371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小便伎堂掌内閣，主無侍養自區區。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810014755","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961799111622696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不脩幃帕看門閣，祖宅如生沒故廬。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810031139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門作事無終始，學館看來學豈餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810047523","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止口囁喘多咀隅，帳厨妻室恐難胥。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810063907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根鼻凖兼廷尉，家業飄零骨肉疎。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810080291","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下悲啼當不絶，耳根雙出倒商途。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810096675","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正面所爲皆不遂，人中或有立身孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810113059","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坑塹陂池并大海，诸方不見始安舒。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810129443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擁旌杖節何由得，有痣深藏足底膚。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810145827","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五彩如龍下遶臂，梁武貴妃生赤痣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810162211","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七星左脇貴爲郎，未若班班七十二。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810178595","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論班㸃","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810194979","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀卵班者，主妻子難爲，作事犯重，作事愛便冝，女人","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810211363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961831743193127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷夫尅子，天年不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810211363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豆班者，主作事犯重，極其奸詐便冝，男傷妻尅子，三度作新郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810227747","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人如此，亦如是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810244131","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五色","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810260515","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人抱陰陽以爲質，上成則五形之色属焉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810276899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其青色属木，白色属金，赤色属火，黑色属水，黃色属土。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810293283","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故五色之人，得其本色者正，或得相生之色者善也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810309667","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然五色得地者，春色要青，夏色要紅，秋色要白，冬色要黑，又盡善也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810326051","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若春有白色爲相尅，赤色爲相反，黑色爲相生，青色爲比和。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810342435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏有黑色爲相刑，黃色爲相反，青色","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770556938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961799111721000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲相生，赤色爲比和。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770556938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋有赤色爲相刑，青色爲相反，黃色爲相生，白色爲比和。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770573322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬有黄色爲相刑，赤色爲相反，白色爲相生，黑色爲比和矣。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770589706","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961831743291431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"九州八卦干支之圖","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770606090","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961799111802920"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"定九州氣色吉㐫","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810358819","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀州豊滿，多田宅，缺䧟，多灾禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810375203","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○揚州豐滿，足衣食，缺䧟，多進退。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810391587","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○青州豊滿，足金帛，缺䧟，多成敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810407971","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○雍州豊滿，足官祿，缺䧟，多是非。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810424355","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○豫州豊滿，多福壽，缺陷，不長久。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810440739","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○荆州豊滿，多文章，缺䧟，少知見。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810457123","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○徐州豊滿，多兒女，缺䧟，多傷悲。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810473507","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○梁州豊滿，足信義，缺䧟，人情少。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810489891","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○兗州豊滿，長安秦，缺䧟，多貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810506275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右九州豊滿，或一處常有好氣色及毫痣，必主此處食祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810522659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"復又看山林及後福終始，大吉，缺䧟塵累，","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810539043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961831743438887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦非眞人。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810539043","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雍州在乾左，笑厭面下。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356810555427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾位，起於西北𧢲乃天門也。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770622474","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黄，常滿中宮，喜樂之相。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921573411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其色忽見左右，君子加官，小人進財。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921589795","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961935623815179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論四時氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921606179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"總斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡觀人之氣色，妙者，如祥雲襯，曰：温粹可愛，方爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921622563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如枯燥暗惡，不獨難發，主𦜉胃心腹之疾，水災訟獄之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921638947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之氣色，須精氣不亂，觀之易見。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921655331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒色過度，易進易退，似明不明，似暗不暗，謂之流散。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921671715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似醉不醉，似睡不睡，謂之氣濁也。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770704394","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又集解曰：辨四時之氣者，别其氣，五色之所属也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921688099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青、红、黄、白、黑，乃四時之正氣也，在于皮上者，謂之色，皮裏者，謂之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921704483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者，如粟、如豆、如絲、如髪，隱于毛髪之","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921720867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961895652032546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内，細者如春蚕之絲。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921720867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲察五方正色，如浮雲覆日之微，在夫熟詳而辨之。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921737251","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞微玉鑑曰：氣一而已矣，别而論之，則有三焉：曰自然之氣，曰㴠養之氣，曰所襲之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921753635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自然之氣，五行之秀氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921770019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾禀受之，其清常存。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921786403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所養之氣，是集義而生之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921802787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾能自安，物不能擾，所襲之氣，乃邪氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921819171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若所存不厚，所養不𠑽，則爲邪氣所襲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921835555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又推而廣之，則有青、赤、黄、白、黑五色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921851939","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄正公論神與氣，有曰：神大爲神有餘，神怯爲神不","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921868323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961992372568105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921868323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣過于神，爲氣有餘，氣下于神，爲氣不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921884707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此說尤妙，冝以意致，斷可騐矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921901091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣通五臟，則有所見。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921917475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之人喜怒哀惧，一至于心，則色斯變矣，又況疾病死生乎？","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921933859","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"論五色吉㐫應時生死","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921950243","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄色，土也，其敷潤貼肉，不凝不浮者，爲正色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921966627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅、紫二色同，皆主喜悅。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921983011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若凝滯若烟雲汚泥者，初年曰土犯，主三十年；中年曰土病，主三十年；末年曰土死，應甲乙寅卯年，旺戊巳辰戌丑未。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356921999395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年，月，日皆同。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770720778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下准此。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922015779","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○青色，木色也，其色榮暢條達，如竹柳葉者，爲正色","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922032163","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961895652098082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922032163","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乾枯凝結，明閃不定者，初年曰犯木，主二十四年；中年曰水病，主六十年；末年曰木死，應庚辛申酉年，旺甲乙寅卯年。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922048547","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○赤色，火色也，其色光澤華秀，如脂塗丹，爲正色。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922064931","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若焦烈燥煩，如火熖熾者，初年曰犯火，主二十年，中年曰火病，主四十年；末年曰火𣦸，應壬癸亥子年，旺内丁巳午年。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922081315","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色，金也，其色温潤","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922097699","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如玉，經久不變者，乃正色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922097699","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若塵蒙乾枯無潤，色如乾衣者，初年曰犯金，主二十七年；中年曰金病，主十八年；末年曰金𣦸，應丙丁巳午年，旺庚辛申酉年。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922130467","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922146851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961992372731945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色，水色也，其色條暢，風韻光彩，有鋒鋩顯露者，爲正色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922146851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若烟霧昏昏，四時汚濁不明者，初年曰犯水，主十八年；中年曰水病，主十一年；末年曰水死，應戊巳、辰戌、丑未年，旺壬癸、亥子年。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922163235","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"又論四時氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922179619","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡觀氣色者，取四時旺相休囚，察人之巳發未發。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922196003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𥚞色者，乃人之日。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770737162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯青，憂。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770753546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑，疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770769930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白，孝服。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770786314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤，官事。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770802698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫黄二氣色皆爲吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770819082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢神又别形，形又别神，神又别色。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922212387","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此四者，骨則是形，日則是神，氣如烟霞，色若毫毛，","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922228771","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961980322299919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青發於肝，黄發於脾，黑發於腎，赤𤼲於心，白發於肺。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922228771","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如春三月木，東方甲乙在顴骨是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922245155","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴青氣色，旺相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922261539","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦先憂驚而後喜。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770835466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯赤色者，相生也，雖相生，亦先生口舌，或因官司，後成大喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922277923","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯白色者，囚也，乃金尅木，爲牢獄也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922294307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯黄二氣色者，𣦸也，故木尅土也，以此死亡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922310691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：春得木而青爲本色，不反者。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922327075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如變白色者，是金尅木，主孝服哭泣，九十日見。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922343459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鼻赤自巳，主有杖棒、家下人中瘡疾、血光之災。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922359843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根黑氣獨起者，兄弟有灾，僕馬走失。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922376227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂黑氣者，文章阻滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922392611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922408995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962042519650367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橫過眼下入耳者，主家下哭聲，重則自巳身𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922408995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩顴骨爲朱雀、玄武，黑者破財，赤者官事。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922425379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三隂青色，女子之殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922441763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽青色，男子之殃。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770851850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三隂、三陽青潤黃光者，主生女。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922458147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽紅黃，光彩潤澤者，生男子之喜，如有喜將產。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770868234","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽俱帶黑色，晦滯全無彩者，主喜中有憂，恐子母不全。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922474531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡凖頭至山根、印堂透天庭，有紅黃光彩者，主三七日或四七日内有財喜，或進田宅、生子娶妻等喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922490915","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上唇白者，自巳腹肚之病。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922507299","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏三月火，南方丙丁額是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922523683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯赤色，旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922540067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖旺，主先","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922556451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961980322398223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官司口舌而後吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922556451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯黃白二氣色者，相生也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922572835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖相生，白色先吉後㐫，黃色先㐫後吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922589219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯黑色者，囚也，疾病也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922605603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯青色者，死也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922621987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：夏乃火爲正色，赤者無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922638371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕黑色太重，乃北方壬癸水來澆火。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922654755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有紫色者，乃官司中生不測之禍患，失物不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922671139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眼及眉毛并法令中有晦，主司命破損不安，招口舌上門及人口病患，失物不足。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922687523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左眼黑，男子病，右眼黑，女子病，蘭臺庭尉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922703907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑赤者，主血光疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922720291","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根黑氣，兄弟官司，僕馬病死走失。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922736675","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳珠黑者，主財穀耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7580348356922753059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳輪黑者，主其人不","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770884618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962042519781439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"久而𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770884618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩顴赤氣，朱雀動而玄武旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437030452","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭至山根及天庭，有紅黃光彩者，主幹文書喜氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437046836","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無不順，快有財。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437063220","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如或此位青黑色，求財不遂，出入不遇，如求官中勾當，皆無成就。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437079604","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻梁黑重者，主病患，黑甚者，主𣦸亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437095988","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如凖頭獨光者，福祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437112372","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"准一半，災矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437128756","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋三月，金乃西方庚辛也，左顴是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437145140","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯白色者，旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437161524","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先號哭而後大笑。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437177908","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770901002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯黑色者，相生也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437194292","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故先病而後吉。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770917386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯青色者，囚也。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770933770","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯赤色者，𣦸也。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770950154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：秋以白色爲","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437210676","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正色，怕赤色太重，是爲火尅金也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437210676","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭有火𦦨者，主","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437243444","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330961980322480143"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官司破財，桎梏之撓，杖棒之難。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437243444","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭至山根，一路有紅黃之氣，主文書官貴、印綬，無不稱心。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437259828","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左眼下赤，男子憂，右眼下赤，女子災。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437276212","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾若見黑氣者，主有水厄之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437292596","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根黑赤暗昧，主兄弟僕馬病患走失。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437308980","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲并腮如有黑氣，此是臟腑之暗疾。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437325364","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口畔如此，形色雖盧","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437341748","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫枉用心神口邊，最嫌黑氣來侵犯，豈知旬日入泉臺。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437341748","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫中的黑無虗者，不問青黑，主大災。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437374516","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬三月水，乃北方壬癸地閣是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437390900","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯黑色者，旺也，雖旺，先㐫而後吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437407284","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯青色者，相生也，主先驚而後喜。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770966538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437423668","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962095258796073"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄赤色者，囚也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437423668","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯白色者，死也。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770982922","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：冬以黑色爲正色，怕土來尅水。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437440052","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有黑黄氣者，主家下人口迍邅，留連患病。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437456436","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩顴骨，主官災，破財失脫。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437472820","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眼下黑赤，主男女之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437489204","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根黑黃色，僕馬不利，兄弟有災。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110770999306","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂青黃，所爲文書阻滯。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771015690","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有黑氣者，主落水墜馬之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437505588","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口有白色，主貧困。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437521972","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼常青，主夭，常被人所賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771032074","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額有黄色，主一月内有喜慶；紫色，主六十日内有喜慶及官榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437538356","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色，主六十日内有孝服，公訟，不冝遠出。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771048458","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色，主百日内有憂虞不測病厄。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771064842","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下有青色，旬日内有虗驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437554740","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771081226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962076770271267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色，有公訟。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771081226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄色，有喜事。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771097610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色，主病夭。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771113994","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉頭有赤色，主有非橫不明之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437571124","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辨色歌","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437587508","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早觀氣色非虗詐，一寸一分俱眼下，男觀左兮女觀右。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437603892","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膜肺腑中多不假，短于菽粟細于絲，吉㐫可辨須詳推。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437620276","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或隱毛髪紋理中，氣色都輸談相者。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437636660","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"面部氣色詩","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437653044","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額上紅黃二等絲，三旬定見轉官資。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437669428","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庻人自有求冝望，僧道遷榮有住持。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437685812","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962095258959913"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額上有紅黄二色，如絲露者，貴祿有此色，三十日内加官，印堂有，其餘人百事吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437702196","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求有望，僧必有住持之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437718580","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫色紛紛，三六十日内喜事冝動。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437734964","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色有事不分明，防二季内攪擾，及日下公訟。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437751348","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色不冝遠出，更防田宅有撓，六十日内應。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437767732","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437784116","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額上紛紛紫氣侵，六旬喜氣定來臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437784116","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若𨘣黑氣侵其上，一季災殃不稱心。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437800500","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂額門青色，切須隄防，不可登高遠，方應六十日","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437816884","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962076770369571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中謹愼，恐田庄公訟。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437816884","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437833268","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額上紅黄生貴子，舉人㮄上有高名。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437833268","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘求望招財橫，一季須知見此榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437849652","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂上紅黄二色，主家生貴子，餘人得横財，主舉人解首名，求官吉，一季應此吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437866036","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂紫色如豆粒者，主進田庄，一季内應。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437882420","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771130378","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂紫色似珠圓，一季之中進田園。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437898804","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色若如絲","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437915188","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962157724565558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露見，須防孝服事相煎。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437915188","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂白色若絲，主孝服至一季内。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437931572","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂黑色如黑水，主僕馬相欺之憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437947956","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771146762","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂青色事紛紛，五旬决定事纒身。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437964340","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色兼青如黑水，須憂僕馬有災迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357437980724","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771163146","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根黄紫色加官，印動三千里路聞。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438013492","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道庻人諸","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438029876","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962076770484259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事吉，須知一季喜侵顏。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438029876","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根位上黄紫二色，主三十里矦。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438046260","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印動，貴人加官宣詔之歡。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438062644","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中正紫雲，四十日有囬還之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438079028","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中黃色，九十日陛除。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771179530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣黑青，一年内必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771195914","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連腮氣黑，六八而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438095412","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿額赤光，二四而訟。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771212298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青雲貫額，九十日内有不測之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438111796","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤白年壽，五十日内有䘮亡之事。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771228682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣黑霧，冝防酒食之災。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438128180","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額𧢲黑雲，應當噎食之病。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771245066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中黃紫，九十日加官。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438144564","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎紫氣，五十日及第。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771261450","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花色貫年壽五五登科。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438160948","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄氣臨于白眼，半年攺職。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438177332","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑黑驛馬，出入遭","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771277834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962157724713014"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771277834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色滿額，在家不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771294218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下赤黑，官事眼前。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771310602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲白乾，病臨眼下。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771326986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寜心細察，定想消詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438193716","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無越綱紀，禍福必騐。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438210100","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辨氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438226484","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫氣色者，發于五岳，隱于六腑，朝則見於面容，暮則歸於肺腹。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438242868","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨年隨月，隨日隨時，氣色升降，各分面色。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438259252","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白青黑紅黃，按金木水火土形氣者，出於青塵，又如烟霧，忽於何位，有成有敗，有吉有㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438275636","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色眞形一寸二分。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438292020","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按一年十二月，一日十二時，年年各有興廢，月","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438308404","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962170403880994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月亦冇成敗，日日生發禍福，時時不測憂喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438308404","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲觀人者，先要定所居方位，若得知之，吉㐫無不應矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438324788","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辨四季色","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438341172","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春要青兮夏要紅，秋間白色喜重重。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438357556","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬間黑氣乘來往，若不相刑應始終。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438373940","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三五日或十日内，見凖上黑白色，主孝服，并自生災。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438390324","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲并腮有黑紋，須憂臟腑不調匀。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438423092","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病人口畔如斯色，縱是靈丹未保身。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438439476","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962214372868135"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲及腮上有青黑，防一月或半月内，臟腑内暴患在床。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438455860","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辨口色","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438472244","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲紅黄紫色多，此般氣象最安和，忽然𧢲畔青青色，飯食侵刑没柰何。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438488628","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口𧢲有黑色，謂之𣦸氣，入日逺至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438505012","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一百日内定𣦸，口𧢲有紅黄紫色者，自身安樂，口𧢲有黑有青，主飲食之悮。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438521396","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辨眼色","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438537780","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962170404012066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼邊黑色切須知，百事施爲亦不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438554164","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾禍之來看十日，更防小輩暗欺軀。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438570548","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下黑色，不利百事防，有不利，小人相撓，在十日内應兼望不成事，宜守舊。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357438586932","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右眉頭赤色㐫，定遭公事在官中。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596512290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉頭見得常明澤，所作施爲百事通。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596528674","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
