{"lines":[{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962264259854390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明澤之爲吉慶順也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596741666","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辨四時詩","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596758050","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春青只向三陽取，夏赤須于印内求。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596774434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋白但觀年壽上，冬觀地閣黑光浮。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596790818","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春三月属木。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596807202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○青色出面，木旺也，主更變喜美之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596823586","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅色出面，木生火也，因妻妾上喜，三七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596839970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色出面，金尅木也，主官鬼相撓，一七日内至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596856354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑色出面，水生木也，二三月間有𣦸亡之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596872738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黄色出面，木尅土也，七七日内有横財喜至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596889122","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962254222868520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏三月属火。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596905506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○紅色出面，火旺也，得貴提携，三五日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596921890","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○青色出面，木生火也，父母有喜事，一七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596938274","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色出面，火尅金也，諸事次吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596954658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黄色出面，火生土也，因子孫有喜，三七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596971042","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋三月属金。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357596987426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色出面，金旺也，七七日得隂人財。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597003810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色出面，金尅木也，得橫財，拾得古噐之物，三七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597020194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅色岀面，火尅金也，争訟損財主。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597036578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771392522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黄色出面，土生金也，父母有封贈，常得人財，三七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597052962","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑色出而，金生水也，主兄弟哭泣，三七","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597069346","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962264260001846"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597069346","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬三月属木。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597085730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑色出面，水旺也，須得財不足喜，防官災詞訟，雖有無患。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597102114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色出面，金生水也，得貴人力，七七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597118498","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○紅色出面，水尅火也，得隂人財，交易貴人喜，三五日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597134882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黄色出面，土尅水也，三七日内失財，諸事不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597151266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○青色出面，水生木也，父母子孫進喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597167650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771408906","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色若四季有之，皆欠順。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597184034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作諸事者，當忌此等氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597200418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，必主𣦸亡之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597200418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五色者，俱以五行相生相尅，有","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597233186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962254222950440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢無勢，四時定其吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597233186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水生木，木生火，火生土，土生金，金生水。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597249570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木尅土，土尅水，水尅火，火尅金，金尅木，推此相生相尅，在此消息之間，以定吉㐫，則禍福無差矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597265954","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五色所属","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597282338","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金色白，乃肺之神，如付粉汗出流，不似白露。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597298722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凖頭上見之，主災父母。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597315106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下以左右隂陽言之也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597331490","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木色青，乃肝發之神，發時如初生柳葉，又如青線。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597347874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凡人面不可有此氣，主憂事，在祿位，主失財，在父","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597364258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962329816825919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母兄弟妻子，主憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597364258","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水色黑，乃腎之神，發時如鴉成片黑。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597380642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根年壽，凖頭見之，生病。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597397026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下主孝服，兩耳邊至眼，六十日内主𣦸夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597413410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸部以上主病。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597429794","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火色赤，乃心神之發，發之赤散如醉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597446178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂見之，主牢獄公訟杖責，三七日至，發濃赤，立見災應。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597462562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴骨主疾病至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597478946","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土色黃，乃脾之神，發時如卯黄，多喜事。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597495330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中印堂見之，如雲霧，大喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597511714","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牢獄見之，遇大赦。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597528098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眼下家宅","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597544482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962254223048744"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見之，大喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597544482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭山根見之，貴人成將，有财喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597560866","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"九仙會源氣色歌","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597577250","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲臨門，額上昏昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597593634","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏不散，年多災迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597610018","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○奏書一部，初出黃光，凖頭相應，百事皆昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597626402","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○金神一部，左右天𫝉，或紫或赤，朝見君王。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597642786","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○大隂青紫，右眼眉側，君子傷財，小人材責。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597659170","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○博士三陽，冝紫冝黃，女黑産厄，男黑必殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597675554","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○力士兩顴青黑之色，其子徒流，女子産厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597691938","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眉上黃光，喜樂年當。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597708322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天𫝉地閣，穀麥盈𫝉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597724706","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○大耗一部，地位乾燥，赤黑交加，必遭刼盗。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597741090","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○面色青黑，","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597757474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962329816973375"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年遭邑遊，亦冝守舊，出厄他州。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597757474","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眼鼻赤色，命帶飛亷，女遭産厄，男病風癲。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597773858","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑色入口，印綬如烟，五鬼絶命，破敗田園。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597790242","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○心多驚惧，面無顔色，休問年紀，命逢吊客。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597806626","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眼下䘮門，白如粉痕，若無哭泣，必有争論。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597823010","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白氣朝口，多號白虎，恐遇毒藥，困傷道路。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597839394","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黃幡豹尾，鼻柱兩傍，常要明淨，黑氣火殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597855778","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○大殺一部，眉頭眼𧢲，總然雜色，不冝動作。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597872162","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○五虗六耗，䘮憂口撓，身心不寧，破敗之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597888546","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"秋潭先生氣色歌","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597904930","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962254223147048"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中如珠一㸃赤，住宅須防遭火厄，天庭定有公事來。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597921314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官司刑獄應十日，中正其人被辱侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597937698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂文學應朝夕，山根莫去州縣遊。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597954082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被人謀害必端的，壽上驚憂因得財，凖頭定是遭官責，人中失物有災臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597970466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿莫飲酒忘溺，地閣争田被凌辱。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357597986850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸部視之終不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357598003234","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中如絲一縷青，官司勾追不得停。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357598019618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中正隂私婦女厄，司空暗主撓心情。","logicSentenceId":"7580348357598036002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂刑獄更非輕，舊事巳發應天庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358082953256","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根外人莫寄物，只因無事起喧爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358082969640","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽父母當有疾，凖頭莫向當風睡，人物醉後忽成驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358082986024","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿酒","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083002408","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962381876527167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食須防謹，地閣經波䘮此生。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083002408","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中天庭一㸃白，果然父母遭危厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083018792","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司空叔伯服臨門，中正外親及叔伯，印堂兄嫂卒𣦸來，山根姑姨病急追。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083035176","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上重䘮家破憂，壽上有子無魂魄。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083051560","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門魚尾及隂陽，妻宮之中如路陌，凖頭自身如塵侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083067944","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸𨐧奴僕黄泉客，人中妻孕血成池，滿面天羅灰土色。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083084328","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中莫令氣色黑，定有天災君莫測。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083100712","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭呪詛被人寃，中正定有非常疾，司空乘馬必墜傷，印堂家宅憂病危。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083117096","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根自身因疾生，年壽宫中見疾厄，凖頭黑遍","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083133480","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962343158939700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫求醫。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083133480","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中火急憂患發。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083149864","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿醉後水中歸，地閣橋梁牢獄折。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083166248","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中偶得一㸃黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083182632","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武官文節授朝郎，天庭財至并寵。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083199016","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜司空定有雁書揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083215400","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中正夫妻多喜事，印堂急詔至都堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083231784","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根橫財不可量，若逢年壽家宅安，凖頭必定足錢粮。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083248168","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中信息兼財至，承漿必定宴高堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083264552","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣田地增兩倍，増田加祿兩相當。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083280936","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邊地驛馬連輔𧢲，兼接山林外吉祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083297320","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍宮眼下必生子，魚尾奸門主洞房。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083313704","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸𨐧僕馬人財吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083330088","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月𧢲上有黄光，父母官中多喜慶，","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083346472","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962381876691007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文書詔擢探花郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083346472","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中光潤色帶紫，官祿榮華財帛至，天庭必有詔書臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083362856","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中正家財報馬至。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083379240","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司空定至三公位，印堂遷職必受封。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083395624","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根妻位喜非常，年壽妻財即便來。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083412008","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準頭橫財應人巳，人中大忌身有災，此人軀魄在棺裡。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083428392","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿外人送物臨，地閣置田在都里。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083444776","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中仰月一片紅，七日朝廷印信對。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083461160","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭立有詔書至，司空文書至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083477544","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中正妻妾身懷孕，印堂主喜有來蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083493928","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根妻妾非常美，年壽運動知壽隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083510312","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭財帛","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083526696","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962343159054388"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"两三重，人中不信婚姻事，承漿酒食喜英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083526696","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣見時加倍喜，卧蚕貴子兆能羆。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083543080","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嬌妻美妾何宮見，魚尾好門色帶紅。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083559464","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相中此法君須記，惟有江西人不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083575848","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色者，自天庭中正司空。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083592232","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂、山根、年壽、凖頭、人中、承漿、地閣各位巳定吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771425290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色起明潤，卽應七日，遲則二十，或慢則百日，應順則吉，逆則㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083608616","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"六氣","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083625000","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍之氣，如祥雲襯日，朱雀之氣，如晩霞映水。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083641384","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳之氣，如黑風吹雲。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771441674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騰蛇之氣，如草火將灰，白虎之氣，","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771458058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962434171109439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如凝指塗油。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771458058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武之氣，如朝烟和霧。","logicSentenceId":"7610707110771474442","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六氣者，青龍爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083657768","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘或主破財，或主留連，或主驚恐，或主疾病，或主隂賊。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083674152","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如形骨不入格，終身爲其所累。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083690536","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如形骨旣正，當候其數，然後氣可定而名顯也，又須觀其所付深淺，而消息平之。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083706920","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有能浄無爲，故其氣其容湛寂，同止水無紋，六氣可得而明也。","logicSentenceId":"7580348358083723304","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962343159152692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962434171256895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962427489615887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962493860233279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其辭曰：湛然淸淨，百禍難侵；或氣相雜，一事不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704716307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣若穿五竅，身陷幽冥；旺氣如犯三堂，祿從天降。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704732691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居官見任，逢赤色與同任交爭；士庻無權，見紅色同兄弟爭競。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704749075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故天庭白氣，春愁口舌刑傷；地閣黑雲，秋怕交爭詞訟。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704765459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神門黃氣，因奸而尙然成婚；妻部黑雲，","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704781843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962485962604554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故舊而中間變盜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704781843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色忌侵法令，酒色身亡；炎官怕見水宮，妨妻産厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704798227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑氣生于眼下，必是妻妾子女之憂；白氣長于鼻準，頓有父母昆仲之服。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704814611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中央土色，逢紅而終見災殃；靑白𥚞色，總紅而必無多慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704830995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中黑霧，失官退職。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704847379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂黑色，移徙之愁。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058814474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上色黃，卽封官爵；壽上色紅，必妻爭競。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704863763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上横紋赤黑，或憂父母或憂身；壽上黃雲紅色，上亦喜子孫亦喜祿。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058830858","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白爲死䘮，赤乃官災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704880147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑爲病患之憂，靑爲罵辱之事，眼下赤色而爭訟，睂上黄明而受祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704896531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑如油抹，人命多傷；黃似塗","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704912915","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962427489812495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酥，財帛廣聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704912915","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黃入于面上，多因敇賜金帛。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058847242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上黑霧應天獄，定見官中一而招責也。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058863626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾微靑奸事敗，凖頭紅黃祿位成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704929299","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑連年上，女必招災；青入人中，男須敗業。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704945683","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮禍起于白頭，憂病長在睂山。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704962067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際黃明，求官易得。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704978451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻孔黑暗，幹事難成。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058880010","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸壁眞紅，因奴馬以爭强；淚堂黃色，爲功名而必淹滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629704994835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下黑色，左害子而右害妻；睂上白光，右損母而左損父。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705011219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤黑色動，防財帛與官災；天嶽赤遮，慮人指而虚詐。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705027603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根赤色貫兩目，火燭血光之厄；年上黑氣侵法令，酒食色慾之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705043987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705060371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962541063028745"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官進職，三堂上以明光；財退官災，五獄中而黑暗。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705060371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小求大得，蓋天庭兩頭分明，不勞而成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705076755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因蘭臺四方明淨。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705093139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂黃色，如柳葉朝邊地，九十日二品登壇。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058896394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高廣紫雲似月明于天中，一年間分符拜相。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705109523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬紫氣，四十日内有小人，","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705125907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百事吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705125907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道名目，至半年内應。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058912778","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"山根黑色","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705158675","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根黑色狀如烟，乘舟涉險恐迍邅，不然𡨥盜侵財帛，公撓三旬卽見官，山根位上黑色如烟狀，涉危險，渡江虚驚，不然財帛","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705175059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962524394782760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有撓中𡨥賊，二十日應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705175059","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準上紅黄紫色時，半年之內有重鿋，進田增僕身安吉，此事俱祥不用疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705306131","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962541063208969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖有紅黃紫色，百事吉昌，","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705322515","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半年内應重重加進田宅。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705322515","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又僕馬位喜，又身平安，","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705355283","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五十日内見喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705355283","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"凖上紅黃","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705388051","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖上紅黃主有權，自然所作稱心田。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705404435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還紫色侵其後，一季妻生子必賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705420819","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖上紅黃色，大宜執權道，大吉之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705437203","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖上紫色，主妻宮見宜子之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705453587","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"凖上青紫","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705469971","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭青紫不堪論，半月災危及子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705486355","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是家中無","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705502739","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962524394881064"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子息，水災火厄恐臨門。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705502739","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖上青色，必主子孫之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705519123","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無子息，防水火之驚厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705535507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應在四時方見。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705551891","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論色類","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705568275","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳圖南云：色之無光，不可謂之色，蓋無光則虚色矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705584659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"災喜皆不成，不必斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705601043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先視其主休囚死旺，然後遍看諸位吉㐫善惡，審而言之，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705617427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天之蒼蒼，其正色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705633811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲霧乃其氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705650195","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之職形受命與天地同，所稟之氣有變動，則所發之色有定體也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705666579","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962590543265819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色隠神隱眸者貴，明則吉，暗則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705682963","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黃紫爲吉，靑白黑爲災，紅黃色喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373629705699347","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫氣遷宫之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494244918","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮主未來，沉主過去。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494261302","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮沉相竝，去去還來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494277686","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色定爲災害，發深則應近，發淺則應遠，或無貴而色頓開，則不爲祥，此說非可言而進也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494294070","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有色未透天庭而亦發者，是其凖頭開而部位之貴皆開以相應，不必至天庭也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494310454","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂、内庫、驛馬、龍虎角、日月角皆爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494326838","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或隂晴未定，必在凖頭，不可發也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494343222","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焦燥暗惡，不獨難發，多脾胃心腹之病，水火刑訟之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494359606","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若視之寂然，難","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494375990","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962524394962984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取難捨，有道者之色也；視之赤然，似浮似沉，奔競者之色也；視之瑩然不雜，得意者之色也；視之𢡖然，隂合陽散，細人之色也；視之泰然，如驕如滿，自定之色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494375990","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"氣令色草","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494392374","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上光潤，財祿日進，若問此人，漸漸得運。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494408758","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上昧氣，財祿日退，若問此人，漸漸色滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494425142","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡面上有惡氣如垢痕者，災色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494441526","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人中至凖頭，上至天庭、印堂之間見之，五七日内應，必生災疾。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494457910","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962590543396891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"氣色歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494474294","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謾向空中設彩絲，齊分六色發神輝。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494490678","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉心竚目徐徐視，妙理無過細察之。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494507062","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若看紫色無神光，雪上下雪霜上霜，但看年上青黑色，不過三七有災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494523446","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色只在皮膚出，見了之時須要防，一年半載多不退，定主家中有死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494539830","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要看氣，不須忙，但看年上與印堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494556214","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還喜事來何處，認取一㸃淡土黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494572598","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者，所以養神形而化神也，週流於五臟六腑之間。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494588982","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因七日之汎，故發於五岳四瀆之上也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494605366","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實則壽，虚則","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494621750","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962524395061288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494621750","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○紫氣片成，黃氣散，青氣如霧，紅氣肉裏，火氣在皮上。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494638134","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上五氣，須看厚薄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494654518","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫氣雖貴人，庻人難得，官員巨富方有。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494670902","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如染重紫色相似。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494687286","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅氣，是喜色，火氣則有災。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058929162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人有相異骨貴，爲雜氣所撓。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494703670","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如遠山有奇峰秀景，爲雲所蔽，不可得見也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494720054","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一遇匝地淸風，當天皎日，則奇峰秀景，非獨可以觀覽，必使人留戀而難捨也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494736438","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"靑色類","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494769206","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962638396031003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青臨日角須憂賊，升似川文官祿遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494785590","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日角臥蠶須有分，印堂近日病遲延。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494801974","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然牆壁來金匱，財物三旬失可憐。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494818358","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道上來還須有願，山林蛇虎厄相連。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494834742","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門必定外失物，眼下横來病不痊。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494851126","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽上若橫家内鬼，公婆鬼願未曾還。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494867510","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邊金匱金銀生，右畔如絲或進田。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494883894","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口畔食來須餓死，更兼淫欲事縈牽。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494900278","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根須有隂功助，乞得來時額上全。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494916662","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三畫内陽須轉動，片身居菒墓應穿。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494933046","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天門三旬財來到，地部部橫天地纏。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494949430","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看神光垂十字，其兒哭在七旬邊。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494965814","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨天井懸珠勢，必定居武掌","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494982198","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962616090722344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"威權。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494982198","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是病人因口願，囚人無願亦無𠎝。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630494998582","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"赤色類","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495014966","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤點白睛憂重罪，凖頭應是病相纒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495031350","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨珠上或條貫，一歲一煞雖命懸。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495047734","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牆壁山林財必失，外圓黃紫得招財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495064118","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武官巡簡看魚尾，盜賊收擒倍稱情。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495080502","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛馬但看牛馬死，山林蛇虎事堪煩。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495096886","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然眼下如珠發，妻子囚何呌鬬聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495113270","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱魂門招怪異，承漿若得有喧爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495129654","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陂池井部相連接，因水逢財喜慶田。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495146038","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬圓珠富貴勝，須承勑命赴提刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495162422","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得樽得肉宜歌㑹，地閤因田訟訴生。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495178806","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962638396162075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在山根須愼火，更兼家内損","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495195190","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂白色哭爺娘。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495342646","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顴上命門兄弟當，只在命門全不散，三年之内定身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495359030","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓如品字葬須傷，半角垂珠一","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495375414","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962616090853416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495375414","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是小人須相眷，又兼牛馬損災傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495391798","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門妻有通私事，魚尾同途一等詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495408182","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月角中憂服制，坎中須有外䘮亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495424566","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽侵年上公婆死，若見行兵必得强。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495440950","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天井如龍封上將，小人孝服在門房，陂池法令相連接。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495457334","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"駒犢多應有損傷，中岳橫來過兩目，本家非久看衣裳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495473718","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田倉上有須憂賊，散失兼因此位詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495490102","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直入眼中三七日，妻兒父母哭高堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495506486","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侵歸兩耳迍災禍，好看今因更顯禳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495522870","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下垂珠夫婦閙，凖頭二八境田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495539254","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若來鼻上九旬内，公事相爭閙一塲。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495555638","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣橫遮牛馬傍，又兼大","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495572022","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962686655627314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小破田塘。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495572022","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更來入口分明記，口舌君須自審詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495588406","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽上見時五十日，多應自害入泉鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495604790","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色天中分别土。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495637558","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日角須受三公府，又似片錢呼相公。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495653942","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常人喜應財來聚，印堂鍾鼓勢分明，七旬之内公侯主。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495670326","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更從甲匱入耳中，祿至三公能振府，墓位食招祖有龍。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495686710","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道上得財如意取。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495703094","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛角但知牛馬吉，睂凖必有主傷亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495719478","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲匱卽逢掌印信，更兼箱篋不尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495735862","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散失得地盜財物，得樽得肉會重重。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495752246","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入口定知瘟病到，冬","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495768630","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962701411172404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看水入得財濃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495768630","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙獄囚人枷鎻脱，感皇恩赦則歸農。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495785014","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫色天中分八字。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495817782","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更應非久便封侯。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495834166","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺日角二十日，節度當權都府頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495850550","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庻人必得添財物，重重有喜稱游優。","logicSentenceId":"7580373630495866934","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常在氣凝全不散，貴人逢着意綢繆。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931083300","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法令經朝印信來，凡人爭競罪全休。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931099684","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若來壽上橫如一，家内妻兒人事酬。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931116068","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牆壁捲雲如連珠，三日須乘駟馬車，凡人必得財來應，地角横來好宅居。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931132452","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是爲官加守上，二旬之内豈言虛。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931148836","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山林就勢觀察使，驛馬生龍到中書。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931165220","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962686655758386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅應不過三十日，分明定取莫粗疎。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931181604","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝王殿前登正位，日角臥蠶樞宻呼。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931197988","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂頭雙起豐太使，山根如錢如祿初。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931214372","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸紋上巳乾紋發，結喉將軍發有餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931230756","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法令圓珠巡簡使，二旬應候定機謀。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931247140","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日角卧蠶相省位，食倉形勢進田畬。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931263524","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田産有時同此節。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931279908","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山林林木喜相須。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931296292","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下有來三月内，妻財貴子喜歡娛。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931312676","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牆壁二邊看二七，爲官上馬好登途。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931329060","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看三旬如此的，陂池位上似懸珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931345444","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文武將相權生殺，魚尾自得盜財物。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931361828","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍潜剛專滿牆壁，常人與居三百石。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931378212","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿嫩龍觀察使，僧道定當須","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931394596","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962701411287092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掛紫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931394596","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門若見喜非常，遷官掛綠皆因此。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931410980","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣天中年上遇，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931443748","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更來地閣如煙霧，又如黑汗發來時。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931443748","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此輩須臾歸死路，睂橫左右一百日。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931476516","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若歸黃泉因此遇。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931492900","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上山根週歲死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931509284","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣爭田起訟訴，法令牽連公事生。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931525668","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七旬之世須覺悟。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931542052","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢此色發來時，纔入三朝死堪懼。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931558436","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發來若也貫山根，定是難過來年春。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931574820","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大海見時二七日，逃走奴婢及生災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931591204","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽山垂墻呪咀死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931607588","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一百二旬須尅身。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931623972","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中岳橫來生兩耳，十日之内定災迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931640356","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962686655905842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑色未侵兩邊蠶，十日之内定生男。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931656740","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若到承漿忌六旬，問官不睦定生嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931673124","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道定看白兼赤，二旬口舌禍來侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931689508","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色來臨兩邊口，二旬之内病災纒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931705892","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色來侵卧蠶下，婦人小口定災迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931722276","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅應定看三十日，更兼口舌事堪猜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931738660","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄色凖頭看七七，婦人驚恐自身災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870931755044","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
