{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春月如逢色見青，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932049956","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主有喜慶之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重新進入後來人。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932049956","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"添財益產多歡慶，一季無憂少有迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932066340","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夏月如靑不可逢，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932082724","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主父母上有喜慶事，五十日見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一如珠玉陷泥中。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932082724","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求財望事無亨泰，迍","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932099108","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962746554597414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滯重重且見踪。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932099108","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○秋逢青色且威權。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932115492","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主添人進口，家宅平康，謀爲稱遂，乃吉兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○冬月如逢靑色崇，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932131876","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主禍患破財，凶惡之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定敎禍患一塲凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932131876","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是非唇吻重重至，退了生財尅子宮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932148260","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論紫色","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932164644","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春逢紫色喜重重，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932181028","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"紅色主妻妾有喜，二十日內應之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉事臨時削去凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932181028","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女婚烟多喜慮，資財金帛也相從。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932197412","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夏逢紫色大不祥，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932213796","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"紅色得貴人提携，三五日内有應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資財一似雪澆湯。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932213796","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身邊常患多啾唧，更莫經商出外鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932230180","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○秋月如逢色紫呈，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932246564","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火尅金，主進生財，一月内應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定敎財谷見豐盈，家添貴子文昌盛，從","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932246564","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962769090543650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此優游日顯榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932246564","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○冬間紫色主憂煩，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932262948","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冬屬水，紫屬火，水尅火，水火相戰，乃水旺得地，但災厄宜破財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍患重重有數般。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932262948","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善事日加多大吉，主無災害得相干。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932279332","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"諭黃色","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932295716","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春逢黄色旺資財，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932312100","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木尅土，木爲主，七七日内見財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人口重重進入來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932312100","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作事自然敎稱意，運謀無所不如懷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932328484","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夏月逢黃豈有憂，運謀無不遂營求。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932344868","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田牛興進今須定，一歲安然得自繇。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932361252","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○秋逢黃色亦如靑，進財進產又添丁，必是婚姻須進契，保之一歲自安寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932377636","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○冬月逢黃主動驚，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932394020","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962808483364891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相他家下未安寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932394020","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼禍患重重至，唇吻憂危日日増。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932410404","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論白色","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932426788","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春逢白色不爲奇，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932443172","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金尅木也，主官鬼相持，十日内見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子災迍更有非。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932443172","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六畜重重逢損失，定須坷坎主憂疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932459556","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夏逢白色吉來臨，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932475940","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火尅金，但陽人刑害，三十曰内官刑見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飮酒于中百事成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932475940","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一應田園并六畜，無非無害到門庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932492324","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○秋逢白色主不虞，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932508708","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白屬金，遇秋金旺，五十日內或傷之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一防口舌二防非。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932508708","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必然交易經唇吻，暗退資財未可知。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932525092","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○冬逢白色善而歡，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932541476","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主貴人提携成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962769090723874"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事，五十日内應之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬事從容名有權。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932541476","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女定中錢穀進，女人姻事必團圓。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932557860","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"論黑色","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932574244","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春逢黑氣主榮權，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932590628","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主有喜慶之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文契重重有數般。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932590628","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜事口加多大吉，主無災害得相干。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932607012","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夏逢黑氣主憂驚，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932623396","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主有驚厄、被産之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子于中必有刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932623396","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不屢敎兒女病，定應田宅自危傾。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932639780","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○秋生黑氣不爲凶，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932656164","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金生水，或兄弟上有災厄，二七日見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平等門庭事不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932656164","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身畔自然新盛舊，非災橫禍豈相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932672548","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○冬月如呈黑色凶，","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932688932","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主有官災、疾厄之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數憂編索禍重重。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932688932","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962808483545115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資財退了多啾唧，六畜須敎死絕踪。","logicSentenceId":"7580373870932705316","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"黃氣歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871014969380","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄色紛紛如陣雲，天庭或見五三分。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871014985764","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼日月相連起，不日須知面聖君。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015002148","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○忽然帝坐及天庭，色似包金隱隱明。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015018532","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或見細光連下起，遷榮過日有餘成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015034916","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○龍虎之間日月邊，或生光彩半相連。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015051300","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更于大次當求進，宰相須能薦擢權。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015067684","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○滿天光彩半相交，祿位前程自此高。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015084068","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽向廣寒求進取，必逢平地上靑霄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015100452","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○忽現還從四季中，定知前路必亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015116836","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須分部位兼𫝉庫，必定凡","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015133220","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962836249706496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求有分榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015133220","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○忽生印綬虎兼龍，兩睂上下最和同。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015149604","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以爲官身位祿，終身决在九霄中。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015165988","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○忽然妻位及山根，更兼光潔潤和溫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015182372","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽隂位分明起，必榮妻妾見兒孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015198756","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○忽然地閣及山根，財物如雲漸漸生。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015215140","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更從邊地相連接，出入深知道路亨。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015231524","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○金匱相連顴上明，更從地閣及天庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015247908","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兼出入求財物，也知珎賂有豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015264292","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○耳上𫝉黃漸漸生，須防多病半相縈。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015280676","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如雲黑暗相連接，朝夕須防事不明。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015297060","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"赤氣歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015313444","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962864213131273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上紅光滿印堂，職祿高遷入帝鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015329828","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更于何處當求進，目下須知近帝王。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015346212","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○滿天光彩亂如麻，名祿重重有進加。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015362596","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論朝士兼民俗，孤寒踪跡出涯沙。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015378980","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○兩耳光明復潤溫，財路通知自有門。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015395364","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不求自有人扶職，産業生營不可論。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015411748","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○或在天庭帝王邊，必知官祿橫加遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015428132","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若相轉營相連接，定有公侯薦職卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015444516","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凖頭年壽及山根，日近須知有邅迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015460900","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是貴人扶失職，在于民庻害其身。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015477284","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地閣相兼𫝉庫間，也應財祿更終年。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015493668","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土形人猶未可，或于金水病相纆。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015510052","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○滿面交加赤氣","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015526436","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962836249870336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，家宅年終事不寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015526436","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無論四季相爭競，子孫遭病必遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015542820","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○或於憂令更于冬，財物凡求處處通。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015559204","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可小求當大用，却須人事更和同。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015575588","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○若於祿庫更分明，官職求官定顯榮，祥光細細朝天去，月中一物兩般成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015591972","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地閣承漿仔細分，奴僕波濤去似奔。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015608356","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上運夀帶侵金匱，災禍臨家及子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015624740","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"靑氣歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015641124","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑光滿面潤還溫，財物亨通不可論。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015657508","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六畜竝興土產旺，不宜城市向山村。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015673892","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○靑氣紛紛半上天，名祿干求","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015690276","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962864213262345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總不全。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015690276","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨日角竝妻妾，妾隂貴扶持自有緣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015706660","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○龍虎之間及學堂，定知功業兩皆荒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015723044","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不問遠尊須用病，臨官多失病堪傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015739428","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○細看睂下位三陽，須知怪夢作乖張。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015755812","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家宅不寧眞有象，是男爲盜女爲娼。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015772196","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凖上光侵金匱中，財位多招使不窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015788580","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必有小人相扶助，他年遷盛有誰同。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015804964","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○耳輪靑色半乾枯，腰間多病卒難除。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015821348","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕不來財又破，朝飡却敢棄精粗。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015837732","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○遶口青靑枯粹多，男女姦偷不奈何，奴妾走逃終不見，也防夫死犯天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015854116","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○日月朦朧暗又昏，名譽皆亡杳不存。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015870500","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是士","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015886884","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962886644301858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人求進用，禍來囚繫豈堪論。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015886884","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○或于邊地暗還明，遠信求之卒不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015903268","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六畜竟災人口散，不宜出入路中行。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015919652","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地閣承漿散又生，不能安産變還更。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015936036","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却向靜中求不得，自然漂泊走途程。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015952420","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"白氣歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015968804","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或生光彩貫天庭，清望還如滿四邊。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871015985188","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是封侯爲將相，此人朝野更功權。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016001572","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凖上分明散又生，更須光彩滿天庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016017956","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能光潤朝諸部，本主還須知姓名。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016034340","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○更于虎角甚分明，須見公侯事立成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016050724","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但向朝廷求大用，决","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016067108","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962906009305098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然目下有高名。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016067108","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○龍虎之間及印堂，横遷高祿必非常。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016083492","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若從發處秋風起，不是封侯作郡王。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016099876","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○禄位分明及印堂，名高遷入帝王鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016116260","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜向侯門求進用，貴人扶助力偏長。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016132644","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○或生光彩兩睂間，名譽清朝不可閑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016149028","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七八月間求進用，定知此際見天顏。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016165412","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○妻妾三陽位上全，女人懷孕半終年。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016181796","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如何測辨生男女，左右神光一子賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016198180","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○分明目下貫蘭臺，定是家中口舌災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016214564","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫向内外求訟事，自然消散走塵埃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016230948","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○相及形神不可言，人亡財散足終年，若論舉措須防愼，百事求之物不前。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016247332","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962886644465698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○五岳相逢潤又明，不論髙大有豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016263716","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或作武人求大用，宜于危位立功名。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016280100","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"黑氣歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016296484","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下紛紛光又明，須知妻子孕還生。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016312868","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子必正多淸潔，男子求官位不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016329252","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○司空中正見還多，名目參差沒奈何。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016345636","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有似靑雲來蔽日，不安閑散見蹉跎。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016362020","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂年壽及山根，名目俱亡杳不存。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016378404","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切恐有時成不得，尋常多病豈堪論。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016394788","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○兩耳愴惶及壽門，脾腎猶多退没因。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016411172","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是在途歸不得，在家得失幾傷神。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016427556","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○下歸金匱","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016443940","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962906009501706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及三陽，男女狂痴奸又娼。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016443940","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多向外邊歸不得，多虚少實似風狂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016460324","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○福堂兩下及山根，父子天涯杳不聞。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016476708","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常在異鄉歸不得，十年之内却相親。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016493092","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○或于厨竈亂交加，須至征夫入我家。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016509476","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻女或隨人去走，不知消息向天涯。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016525860","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○正面如烟散又生，往來穿鼻亂交横。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016542244","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或于九夏常常見，家破人亡有哭爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016558628","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑氣如烟向口邊，更兼𫝉庫亂生烟。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016575012","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論貴賤并高下，死向郊原及野田。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871016591396","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑氣如烟散四邊，旅人歸去巳應難，不特春夏秋冬面，向外途中必不安。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119826987","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962938766966824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"氣色論","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119843371","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一行禪師曰：氣色凡有七，靑、黃、赤、白、黑、紅、紫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119859755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡在於雞鳴之後，平旦之前，當血氣未亂，飮食未進，神色未雜，人事未接，立身端正，不可洗面漱口。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119876139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見于面部者，自然之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119892523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以燭照之，自上至下，見于面部，察其氣色，定其吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119908907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫氣色朝出于面部，暮歸于肺腑，状有大小，或如粹米，或如長針，或方如印，或圓如珠，或如浮雲之狀，或如飛鳥之形。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119925291","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑色主憂驚，黃色主吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119941675","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄屬土，四季各旺十八日，又爲胎養之氣，故","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119958059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962965887189042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲吉慶之福德也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119958059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色主血光口舌，白主折傷孝服。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119974443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色主牢獄死亡之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871119990827","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑色初起，如蠶吐絲，盛如蠶繭之絲，來如黃馬牛之色，去如桃花斑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120007211","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色仞起如火來，盈如研開硃砂，去如蓮花葉累累。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120023595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色初起如脂膏林，又如塗粉，去如垢泥也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120039979","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色初起，散如馬尾，又如溫灰色，去如塵汚也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120056363","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"斷四季論","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120072747","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如春三月，青旺赤相，黑主休，白主囚，黃色主死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120089131","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○若是夏三個月，赤旺黃相，靑主休，黑主囚，白色死也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120105515","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120121899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962989421477888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若値秋三月，白旺黑相，黃主休，赤主囚，靑主死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120121899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○如遇冬三個月，黑旺靑相，白主休，黄主囚，赤色斷死也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120138283","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"氣色相福歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120154667","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫白赤黃靑與黑，精細微妙誠難測。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120171051","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官災終不錯分釐，定喜須敎時不尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120187435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枷鎻慰色號災紋，半年迍否定理魂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120203819","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然一叚靑臨位，便防六畜更災瘟。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120220203","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫紅忽有黃絲髪，三陽若見主新婚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120236587","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知福禄人來訪，紫入蘭臺更造門。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120252971","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃氣未來逢宴樂，白紋深入主憂疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120269355","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知福祿色變動，恰似青烟罩遠山。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120285739","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命値烏雲漫耳裏，忽","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120302123","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962965887336498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然臨注黑霧起。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120302123","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如今須是世間人，不久便爲冥道鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120318507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏昏淡淡入三陽，忽然如線似難當。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120334891","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家憂小口歸㝠路，深處公門入禁房。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120351275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門若有青紋見，妻有私情夫不見。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120367659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能妙藝得其傳，易曉黎民數憎怨。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120384043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅𭛒藍痕應見喜，白色繚繞喜多驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120400427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然小輩逢其色，災禍來侵也不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120416811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑氣氣紋半上陽，若見紅絲必主亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120433195","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤防才散傷牛馬，定見身邊有禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120449579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍鬰鬰兩邊分，紫氣交加不可論。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120465963","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌隂人并小口，只因疾病見災迍。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120482347","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微微黄色發天庭，五七旬中喜氣臻。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120498731","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六品以下皆爲","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120515115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330962989421658112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對，三遭以上定榮遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120515115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽分明一歲安，印堂紫氣必遭官。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120531499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭垂垂赤氣遶，加位遷移主異端。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120547883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白氣團團運部中，又爲印綬妙相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120564267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋看喜氣重重至，只恐遷官更不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120580651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門黑氣到山根，五旬之内入墓墳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120597035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼眼下如抹粉，必至妻房及子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120613419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中天庭黑氣來，更須細看有何災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120629803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年夀忽然齊發動，斷定週年必主衰。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120646187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司空黃色入堂中，爲官轉職事皆通。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120662571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人只得財來散，赤色失財亦是空。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120678955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂青色至山根，光發下來似斑痕。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120695339","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母宮中無尅應，細讀看來限六旬。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120711723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂白色","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120728107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963010535555122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哭爺娘，若在命門兄弟當。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120728107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只在命門全不散，三年之内自身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120744491","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天柱倒時黑又光，唇如隔歲浸生姜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120760875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行如兩步來侵我，不過兩載也身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120777259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣色黃主遠行，買賣求財事事榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120793643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無黑色無田宅，謀事年年也不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120810027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣浮雲靑黑色，三年之内黑光亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120826411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅色俱如加是位，靑黑憂煎必致傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120842795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺高廣一般般，紅紫兼黃祿轉官。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120859179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑黑赤時愁不落，定遭刑獄事相干。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120875563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽黄必天庭來，大喜今年得橫財，若是爲官加爵祿，娶婦色婚不用媒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120891947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑發三陽青氣多，失官傷職事奔波。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120908331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若求","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120924715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963021805699124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發來年壽上，天中亦合見閻羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120924715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲見他人壽不長，但看雙眼昏濁黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120941099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天壽有如题筆樣，週年之内入泉鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120957483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色雜神光都不見，直饒冨貴也尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120973867","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"五言詩訣","logicSentenceId":"7580373871120990251","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂青色起，知君身有災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121006635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無孝服折，定是損錢財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121023019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂血色起，必是損血財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121039403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豕馬牛羊犬，遇早好收囘。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121055787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂紅色起，知君喜事來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121072171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無婚嫁娶，定是進田財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121088555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂紫色起，知君官職來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121104939","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然生貴子，必是祿遷階。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121121323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂白色起，孝服見悲哀。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121137707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家中若無事，六親外服來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121154091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963010535751730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂黑色起，定是見凶災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121170475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同床并子息，作福免災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121186859","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"七言訣","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121203243","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下靑靑色有無，心中不樂暗嗟吁。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121219627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白花切須防父母，兄弔須還一月餘。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121236011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天鼓不鳴一月死，神光不明十日亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121252395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天柱側斜一月死，年上無光黑氣侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121268779","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣漫漫皆部傷，安樂見時須大忌，病中决定主身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121285163","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺法令無光氣，有位之人定失官。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121301547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是俗人無澤色，也須家破主饑寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121317931","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神氣皆昏是醉痴，前程不遠不須疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121334315","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任是有言并有祿，看看只是半年期。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121350699","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂坑陷無光澤，","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121367083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963021805813812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有光明亦少官。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121367083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使祖宗封職廕，中年夫位或貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121383467","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生辛苦手無色，貴者須紅賤者黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121399851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"那更粗麄紋理亂，立見破敗少田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121416235","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人求好事不須功，龍角無光定不成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121432619","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更見印堂如黑黯，因求事後反爲刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871121449003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面分塵土無光澤，須知失位横災臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442788394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更添赤色山根上，煩惱朝朝妖福侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442804778","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"九靈歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442821162","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭紅色見，職官多遷轉，仕路有異名，黎庻皆榮變。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442837546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂色白青，官司主有驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442853930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見紅黄色，恩詔赴皇庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442870314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963069356572699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根赤黑浮，火盜兩悠悠。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442886698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑白人宅散，蹇滯未能休。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442903082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻凖靑黑凶，黃紫喜財隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442919466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色血光見，更防刑殺充。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442935850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正口赤光病，青黑難存命。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442952234","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白光主唇舌，黃色家須慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442968618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿地閣黄，家宅慮火光。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871442985002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅色招財穀，靑白色憂惶。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443001386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法令有白氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443017770","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒病緣此意，靑黑主喧争。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443034154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黄現者吉，黑氣入三陽，千金不可禳，爲官須失祿，士庻破財亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443050538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443066922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑或青，非久必歸㝠。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443066922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色身遭患，白光主哭聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443099690","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"歌喜氣","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443116074","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色騰騰起，朝天祿位成。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443132458","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如雲縈日角，旬日拜公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443148842","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963021805928500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖有明黃動，縈紆入食倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443165226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進財兼進喜，猶看旺何方。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443181610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印信有微黃，天門紫氣光。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443197994","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍頭橫鳳尾，高甲占金鎗。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443214378","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一點如絲髪，微微在印堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443230762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離明兼有應，名位貴中揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443247146","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅喜看牆壁，身宮認子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443263530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書來尋驛馬，邊地武功存。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443279914","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖赤憂煎動，縈纒有訟文。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443312682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜靑來口角，卒病號亡魂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443329066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂尾青連黑，隂人位最憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443345450","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人斜須見哭，赤間定難畱。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443361834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藹藹靑雲起，災來在夏秋。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443378218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然歸口角，身恙卒難瘳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443394602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白氣騰騰起，中秋號應時。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443410986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若纒睂額上，長位見雙悲。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443427370","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963069356785691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂氣開還合，非時定有災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443443754","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還凝聚久，猶自更徘徊。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443460138","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官員品次色難知，二部仍將仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443492906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進職加官天上看，誰於地閣見遷移。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443509290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移爲是紅光面，纔發天中只轉資。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443525674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直下印堂兼五部，紫來同見亦如期。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443542058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然五岳皆紅起，加職仍兼産貴兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443558442","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見天中黃赤色，加官一位莫嫌疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443574826","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中紫氣發生時，堂廟官封紫誥飛。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443591210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲匱若逢官職至，三句之内定何疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443607594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中黃白如圓光，七個旬中坐廟堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443623978","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得發從高廣上，貴兼才吉作侯王。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443640362","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963071541772328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄生龍耳封侯客，自見天中武職加。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443656746","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但是黃生諸部上，臨官驛馬事無差。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443673130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中金匱見黄紋，驛馬遷官四海聞。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443689514","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更得龍蛇左右上，定須拜相喜如雲。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443705898","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬忽從青黑色，到官停職不堪詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443722282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更加岳凟都尖陷，縱然爲官不久長。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443738666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印信喝唱發青苔，退職休官定見災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443755050","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見印堂同此位，斷須三六九朝來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443771434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黄印上發天中，三七遷移位不隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443787818","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内外發來魚尾去，加官妻位喜重重。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443804202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂紅色必加官，及有家書到喜懽。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443820586","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色書中言孝服，紅居年上壽延長。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443836970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫臨喝唱主遷移，若在西邊祿","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443853354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963110221758490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向西。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443853354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看四邊看向上，便知食祿有歸期。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443869738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉止皆從部位看，印堂紅色是加官。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443886122","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭轉對府中天，人鬂須知上位權。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443902506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非次加官從此道，紫金之喜近朝邊。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443918890","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅來食祿兼歸口，若是靑來位不遷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443935274","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂喝唱有紅光，天桂生來主正郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443951658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色發來宫改動，黑時應主命傾亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443968042","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅光印信不移鄉，二七加官喜倍常。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871443984426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百姓進財妻有喜，不拘貧賤一般詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444000810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黃喝唱官須轉，二七之中人正郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444017194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小官員加二等，常人財帛喜蕃昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444033578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅從印堂𨓺上尾，一月須移東北方。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444049962","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在左邊魚尾出，西北之","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444066346","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963071541903400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位定榮光。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444066346","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭紅色攺官榮，赤色官災見血傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444082730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色印堂悲父母，馬肝之色自身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444099114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫臨顴上色光新，便主邊方作帥臣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444115498","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一載之中須正拜，武官同位鎭邊庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444131882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉人印信發紅黃，只作當年員外郞。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444148266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若要高名科第一，紅居喝唱是其祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444164650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中黃色更加蒸，下過山根與凖齊。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444181034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加官印信求須速，不過三旬便得知。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444197418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或在山根并地閣，色分紅紫喜相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444213802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然無事心微怒，顔色皆昏若醉時。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444230186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙眸赤𭛒兼靑黑，禍至君須仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444246570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉𠊱莫言無疾病，隄防須是早尋醫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444262954","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
