{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼頭面下有靑苔，父母悲兒必見哀。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444295722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右隂陽居四位，靑憂白服赤官災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444312106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑臨年上須長病，赤色身亡七十來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444328490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄到食倉并入口，須看二七進身木。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444344874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑獄須同赤色光，耳邊横過至魚方。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444361258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"魚尾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六旬之内須傷死，刑獄官災必見殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444377642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑從年上至中陽，二七須防落水傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444394026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑黒耳邊魚尾過，水災二七及雷傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871444410410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色奸門大不祥，六旬中忌女人殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581200426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横來公事須防愼，禍患頻來必異常。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581216810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食倉之庫發紅黄，須主資才典質郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581233194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此有三般倉","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581249578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963147441831951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫位，三般凶吉細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581249578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑曰中陽色亂飛，四旬之内更妨妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581282346","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂有發爲凶兆，必定爺娘見哭悲。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581298730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口裏烏來入耳中，須知一七内身終。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581315114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳門出到食倉上，蛇兔須看月内終。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581331498","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月角烏來主大災，三旬之內莫疑猜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581347882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑臨日角并月角，一旬内殃馬上來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581364266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邊魚尾黑兼排，四十旬中抵法歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581380650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右半須防三七日，殺妻父母又并兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581397034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日角以上帶靑苔，二七須憂退失財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581413418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛馬亦防偷失走，且宜防愼莫敎來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581429802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邊刑獄赤非祥，刑罰臨身七十防。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581446186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若到天庭須至配，天中應是法傷亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581462570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印信靑","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581478954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963146900979738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸左右魚，須防妻子大災虞。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581478954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中陽若有靑并黑，父母凶災解免無。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581495338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人六甲最難量，青色左歸須是陽，倉庫紅黃應是女，分爲左右細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581511722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫臨髪際三元位，僧道之人有服章。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581528106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百姓一生俱巨富，女人分向貴中藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581544490","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然黑色身憂死，白服靑災喜主黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581560874","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二四八朝須有應，淡黄分與月中詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581577258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中少紅黃兄弟興，更看骨肉有遷榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581593642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泪痕落者看䘮至，便是悲哀哭泣聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581610026","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂黃貫子宮來，貴子須生又没災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581626410","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更在三陽逢紫色，定知極品至三台。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581642794","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻上紅黃如柳葉，司空不見亦徒然。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581659178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581675562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963147441946639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"财定入兼逢喜，睂上金匱主妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581675562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横紋目下入奸門，五個旬中主暗昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581691946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻部目邊如忽見，婚姻事至不堪論。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581708330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額上橫紋官職遷，更觀交友發同然。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581724714","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中定主邊方信，凖頭才逢庭尉年。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581741098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中紅色官榮至，若過司空立橫災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581757482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽發印堂八旬内，定知南地遠信來。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581773866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤氣常憂入厨竈，防家失火不寧居。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581790250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更愁秋靑兼爭競，點如麻子大如珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581806634","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"五色詩","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581823018","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色居倉庫，僧道着紫衣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581839402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官資封二品，百姓有財","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581855786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963189267496987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581855786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑色來衝甲，官封員外郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581872170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論僧道俗，受氣且尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581888554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○靑色來承漿，能文福不常。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581904938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論顴額處，僧道不安康。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581921322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○紫氣天庭起，宫封至正郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581937706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兵權宜武職，僧俗亦多祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581954090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色至凖頭，居宫不出州。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581970474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然居官職，僧道福難求。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871581986858","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"希夷子氣色論","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582003242","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣滯五年，色滯三年。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582019626","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色者，氣之精華，神之胎息，氣大通而色不及，乃受秀之色也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582036010","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滯三年，隂數盡而復散。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582052394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形雖貴，色亂之，骨雖貴，氣亂之，深可惜也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582068778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"待十年以也。上氣色不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963147442061327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亂，隨色而貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"圖南氣色論","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582085162","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色或昏、或亂、或浮、或變、或衰者，死氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582101546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色應之速者，最在凖頭，上至天庭數步之間，人中地閤之際，與眼之上下、睂之左右，得正色與形不尅者，不滯也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582117930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟忌雜色所蔽，氣之上亦不可無氣，但欲如祥雲襯日，溫粹可愛，方爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582134314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或骨法部有可取者，氣色之發不正，則災害不旋踵而至矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582150698","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"氣色生死脉侯","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582167082","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963189267644443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫欲觀氣，先須辨色，矣之亳釐，别有差謬。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582183466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更宜以五方推究時節氣候，刻日，定憂喜生死，方爲學術之至。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582199850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今將氣形圖畵，及論五色氣候，詳著于篇。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582216234","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其圖專論面部脉色，須於見時察色端的，以論休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582232618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵吉少內多，而動處尤可驗其真，若乍見而復沉，則應亦淺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582249002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後五圖并依此推測。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582265386","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"日辰看氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582281770","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯時靑黃正色，巳午時赤黃正色，申酉時白黃正色，亥子時黑黄正色。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582298154","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963211212046336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上色之不正者，皆有小耗。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582314538","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"脉色應候訣","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582330922","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩脉如睂反下兜，青知疾病必來仇。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582347306","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅時定主刑傷近，黑道終當塟墓丘。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582363690","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面見黑靑無百日，白時半歲死堪愁。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582380074","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫中浮見黑斑點，死不過于一月休。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582396458","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡時節從天中直下一停，四月至睂，三停合十二月看之。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582412842","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色發向何月相應，當停分爲十二月，季月在兩邊，仲月居中，孟月亦然，居中左右，各從此中行，三停具矣。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058945546","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963239825604635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：髩額中間脉氣交，靑時貧賤禍來饒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582429226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦紋終死刀兵下，白見兒孫盡早抛。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582445610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨有黃紋知大貴，十分形貌壽難牢。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582461994","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有膚潤與膚燥，潤不憂心燥更勞。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582478378","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：印堂屬離，爲揚州；地閤屬坎，爲冀州；太陽屬巽，爲靑州；太隂屬兌，爲梁州；食倉屬乾，爲雍州；外堂屬艮，爲兗州；邉地屬坤，爲荆州；驛馬屬震，爲徐州；山根戊巳，為豫州。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582494762","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凡官員授任食祿，看有氣色在","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582511146","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963211212177408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何方上發，是其遊行之處，可以求官遊歷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582511146","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若黑子紋痕在其方位，卽不宜任，及其遊行，皆有凶惡也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582527530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開口纔言脉便揺，相牽眼動便凶饒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582543914","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯人貧賤中年死，赤色須還受一刀。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582560298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色定知奴婢害，青時日逐自焦熬。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582576682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然黃氣非爲貴，纔有稱呼死氣抛。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582593066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面者身之表，髪乃血之餘，面傾欹則早傷父母，髪不到則骨肉參商。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582609450","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：血餘不到處，骨肉主參商。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582625834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面部傾欹側，隨方細審","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582642218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963239825768475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582642218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿面脉浮如見出，少入氣絕老風癰。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582658602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑紅百日中應死，黄色貧寒壽命慳。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582674986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白見一色辛苦狀，皮膚燥潤不相關。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582691370","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十一曜曰：額火，印氣，山孛，凖土，睂左羅、右計，眼左日、右月，耳左木、右金，口水。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582707754","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九曜曰：鼻金，眼木，耳水，口火，面土，左頷骨羅候，右頷骨計都，睂紫氣，人中月孛。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582724138","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑屬木，木生于亥，旺于卯，墓于未，故曰木生亥卯未。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582740522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963211212308480"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤屬火，火生于寅，旺于午，墓于戌，故曰火生寅午戌。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582756906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白屬金，金生于巳，旺于酉，墓于丑，故曰金生巳酉丑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582773290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑屬水，水生于申，旺于子，墓于辰，故曰水生申子辰。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582789674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃屬土，土生于中央，浮游四季，寄在丙丁，旺在辰戌丑未。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582806058","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"定月分氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580373871582822442","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月分，黃氣者，三日大喜；赤濁者，七日違和。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871899967530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○二月分，白氣濃者，二十日大哀之事，其餘氣則平平。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871899983914","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○三月分，紅色喜；靑色，六十日內定，其人父母亡身死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900000298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963291080015899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四月分，紅黄色，七日内有印信之喜及妻事至。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900016682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五月分，紫氣，定三月內進財帛喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900033066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○六月分，靑氣，定主破財，在旬日內憂妻事至。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900049450","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○七月分，赤氣，主有財喜；靑色大㐫，七日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900065834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○八月内，白色，主有父母兄弟重服，十日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900082218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○九月分，有黑氣，枷鎻失財，三日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900098602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○十月分，黃色，大哀事，旬日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900114986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○十一月分，紅白色，大進田庄財帛，二十曰内應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900131370","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○十二月分，白色，忌手足生災，三七日內應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900147754","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅色爲上，青色主官事。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900164138","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900180522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963279155625984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙中陽左右尋，火到楊州定殿庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900180522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"司空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金入壽官秋得地，靑龍學館自分明。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900196906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春無秋色皆爲吉，水到㐫宫定是災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900213290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋是火王須鬬戰，上臨坎地必傷災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900229674","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"面圖氣色出没吉㐫歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900246058","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官員印堂喝唱，上有失官退職。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900262442","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眼下内色常青，主丑年破財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900278826","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根色重者，削官破財，遠動千里。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900295210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上忽發，凡事不吉，在百日内見奸刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900311594","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根色重者，陷獄破財，凡庻遠動千里。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900327978","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根靑白，主人宅敗，又主滯蹇，靑藍滿面，多㐫惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900344362","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○正口青色、黑色，主死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900360746","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○牢","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900377130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963291080196123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獄、印堂有，主病，六十日至，四季同。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900377130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天獄連凖頭青潤，獄內死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900393514","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○妻部有黑氣，主三妻及死亡事。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900409898","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○臉上有，主憂家，又及隂人疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900426282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○奸門青色甚者，主隂人病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900442666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽上有，主病，又損手足。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900459050","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門連外陽有靑白色。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900475434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主內奴婢逃走，及私奸事。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900491818","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○海門上靑色，落水死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900508202","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○年上見此起者，主一年間疾，弔喪之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900524586","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○龍角靑色，侵中正、立，有害巳事，有重病方免。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900540970","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眼下内常靑，三五年破財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900557354","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○承漿靑色，飲酒成病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900573738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左魚尾有道路驚恐，老人忌失跌；右魚尾有主失奴婢。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900590122","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○父母、兄弟、妻、男","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900606506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963279155724288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女、姊妹、伯叔各部上有靑色，主病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900606506","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏季起，鼻上如指大，主水痢之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900622890","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如錢大者，主得書信之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900639274","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色入神光者，百日內主法刑死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900655658","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右竝同。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900672042","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或一邊出者，災禍不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900688426","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○靑貫牢獄者，終冬必病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900704810","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑色垂下至閣門横過，主口舌事。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900721194","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色貫盈，從左橫過入右耳，六十日内大厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900737578","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從神光垂下如鈎者，一月主䘮子。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900753962","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色從鼻上出者，十日內必中毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900770346","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩邊直下，主刑獄之厄，二年内應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900786730","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色從口出，三日内必中風疾。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900803114","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900819498","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎宮地閣青作點者，主大憂。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058961930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○輔角、武庫有，主短壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900835882","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○額上髪際有露紫色，","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900852266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963340983877669"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得大財，三十曰内應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900852266","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂青常點點者，短壽，不滿三十。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900868650","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○賊部主乞食。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900885034","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○道路守門部靑點點者，主口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900901418","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○外祖主重病，立至，主百日内爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900917802","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○婦人靑發大岳左頰，短夀，亦無子，主多疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900934186","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○司空常有靑，餓死，后閣發如錢者，三十内大厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900950570","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○交友上見靑白色，主賢豪；僕使見主車馬僕從不安。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900966954","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○承漿青黑色，主酒肉至，又主傷酒也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900983338","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○靑黄二色近山根，主重服病及死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871900999722","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○日月角靑點者，主二十日内憂事。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901016106","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○邊地山林靑色黑者，主鞍馬進入，滿面靑藍，多逢災否。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901032490","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963346893570082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"靑色出沒","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901048874","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑色初起如銅青，将盛之時，如草木初生，欲去之時，如碧雲之色，霏霏然落散也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901065258","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行爲木，旺在春，相于夏，囚于秋，死於冬，發則主憂，橫則主外憂，潤主外憂，沉主遠憂，散主憂散。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901081642","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應在亥卯未月，以色淺深斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901098026","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"靑色吉㐫歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901114410","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中光澤爲詔旨，枯燥須憂詔裏亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901130794","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋日發時壽上去，隂司口舌厄難當。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901147178","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽尺憂行兼疾病，天庭主客繁堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901163562","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交友婦順通于客，司空忽起后徒囚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901179946","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巷路但宜","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901196330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963340984041509"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"客路吉，印堂必被落身資。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901196330","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根枯燥遭囚繫，年上能成百里威。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901212714","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽定與妻相打，外陽枉死被讒言。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901229098","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然少陽連日中，必遭縣宰惡笞鞭。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901245482","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"房中春發當生子，耳上當憂口舌牽。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901261866","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坑塹對須看大旺，陂池蛇怪不堪言。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901278250","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山林花木足夭異，攔攊牛馬怪相愆。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901294634","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽在井竈金鳴響，不然井液湧寒泉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901311018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門甲匱憂㐫厄，凖頭兄弟父母䘮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901327402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散失主得邊方職，人中愁有别離鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901343786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿不日當遭病，大海須防水溺亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901360170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨月角須憂賊，若有川紋官祿妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901376554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日角臨才如傳粉，印堂退日病遷延。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901392938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道上","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901409322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963346893717538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽逢憂阻滯，山林蛇虎厄難當。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901409322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若來金匱并墻壁，財物三旬失可傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901425706","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門怕被外妻撓，眼下橫來病苦纒。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901442090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽上若逢憂疾厄，更憂債負儻來前。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901458474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口畔入來憂餓死，更兼淫濫事干牽。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901474858","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽内陽子孫損，半月之間入墓眠。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901491242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天門三日有財至，天井圓珠武官位。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901507626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病人値此亦難安，囚人見之尤遲滯。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901524010","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官員印堂、天倉如粉塗者，失職，謂之破祿，休廢退官。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901540394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○面上白無光，罷印及重服。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901556778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上白色深者，又看命門無異者，主死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901573162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○年上白至兩眼起，主一年内凶","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901589546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963385770655754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍悲泣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373871901589546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂色入耳口鼻，十日重病事故。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013230143","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○命門白色，主口舌并殺傷之驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013246527","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凖頭白色圓光，年","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013262911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内水厄死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013262911","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天倉連耳白者，爲人好學聦明。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058978314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂白色。","logicSentenceId":"7608866024058994698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主哭泣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013295679","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○年上直連口者，凶死，臉上主刀兵之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013312063","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○司空白色圓光，主夏月之厄，及有官訟。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013328447","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○人中白色橫過，主藥毒死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013344831","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中連邊地至印堂，有主犯王法。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013361215","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○墻壁四圍有白色，主餓死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013377599","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○壽上白色，主父母有病而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013393983","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天𫝉連尾邊地，有旬日遭賊所傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013410367","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○外陽白至法令，三七日内必犯王法。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013426751","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○父母兄弟各部位","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013443135","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963346893864994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上見，主哭聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013443135","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○壽上忽生白色，十日財散","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013459519","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如錢者，二年內主大厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013459519","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中白色乾枯，貧賤人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013492287","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂有無，子孫亦貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013508671","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○賊部常白，王餓死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013525055","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○守門部白色，九十日內死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013541439","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山林常白，主聽明。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013557823","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○後閣有者，主哭泣。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013574207","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○年中或項下如塵如烟氣起者，百日内主刑獄死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013590591","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中春日來年上，鬬戰刀兵事可愁，左炎必定多憂惱。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013688895","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽赤將行步外州，發在天庭憂婦女，皮乾入獄主遭囚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013705279","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又主男女于妬害","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013721663","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交友，婦被外人求。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013721663","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根亦見主憂囚，男女逢他必死憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013754431","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽上徒囚君必見，堂上父母死堪愁。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013770815","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金門甲匱凶來息，内厨酒肉致傷忘。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013787199","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013803583","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963409204264960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逸見身多䘮，若是奸門妻妾當。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013803583","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月角中有車服，法令被他脚足傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013819967","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下橫門夫婦鬬，凖頭還是競田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013836351","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣橫遮牛馬死，若侵年上損公婆，入口分明憂口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013852735","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天𫝉上有賊還多。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013869119","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官員色上凖頭停管取退官及疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013901887","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○壽上有黑掩赤者，停替之死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013918271","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印信喝唱，有主死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013934655","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天柱上有，主印信喝唱，主死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013951039","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○睂上月角散點如麻子如豆，主病憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013967423","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○命門或靑黑色，不久病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872013983807","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡庻凖頭主枷鎖，六十","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014000191","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963433426321418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日至；","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014000191","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門下半日，主盗賊。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014000191","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○邊地主春、秋及夏，一百二十日獄死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014032959","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○邊地至龍角有，一百二十日內離鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014049343","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○臉上黑氣如雲霧者，七日内死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014065727","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○妻部有者，不論春夏秋冬，妻必主産難。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014082111","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○臉上黑入法令者，主妻病，連年在床；忽見黃色，必差。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014098495","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○小人及口邊有七日內橫死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014114879","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中黑氣頭垂者，死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014131263","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中有長一寸，秋三月必死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014147647","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○牢獄寃死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014164031","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○奴婢上有，主死奴婢。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014180415","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天倉連邊地，主破財田產，或牢獄公事，六十日應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014196799","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○蘭臺，主下泪，馬失。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014213183","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○睂上一寸爲四煞，有黑氣，不利行兵。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014229567","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963409204379648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○左魚尾，死馬牛。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014245951","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○承漿，因酒死，○海門，落水死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014262335","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○壽上有，死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014278719","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○承漿冬有黑色曰衣，爲縣令，常人得財，及田產、鞍馬進人，不然穿共得物。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014295103","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○冬睂上眼如大指者，主身有疾病，十五日應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014311487","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○司空常黑窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014327871","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○左目下是妻位，黑氣起，主妻病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014344255","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"季夏偏面蒼赤如馬肝，入鼻口耳，竝主道路得財。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014360639","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○輔骨、武庫常見，多難死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014377023","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦部常現，禽財常在，守門部，一生多病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014393407","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○口邊一寸爲家食，有之，食不足人。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014409791","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○額上，七日間死，精神恍惚。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014426175","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根暗起，主災㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014442559","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○命門有黑點遮之，卽死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014458943","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○左眼","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014475327","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963433426501642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尾去一寸命門、命門黑色如蟋蟀脚大小，號爲鬼書，卽看病人；鼻孔下是棺槨，丙看病人，棺槨陷一寸，并黑色遮如指頭大，卽死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014475327","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○三陽部位發爲方形如衣","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014491711","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶，衝入口邊，主死，百日内應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014491711","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○頤頷如塵霧，枷鎖之災，死獄中。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014524479","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○月角有橫過，主水火之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014540863","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○年上有如指大小，號爲鬼印，卽死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014557247","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看鼻孔有冷氣，卽死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014573631","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭有赤色，有官災；如有黑色厭之，其年破業。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014590015","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○年上有黑氣，主重病，及有五百里外之役。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014606399","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"黑色出沒","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014622783","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963458965438464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色初起，如烏馬尾，將盛之時，如髪和膏，欲去之時，如落垢沬。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014639167","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，五行爲水，旺于冬，相于秋，囚于夏，死于春，發主疾病災厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014655551","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潤主死，亦主兵；色枯翳，客死，發主病。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014671935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春日應在甲子辰日旬中，甲寅辰及冬，以旺爲應。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014688319","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"黑色吉㐫歌","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014704703","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中必主失官勲，不至顴上似圓形。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014721087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還下來侵年上，病患相纒丧此身。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014737471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天獄年正囚獄死，高廣逢時定主亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014753855","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大陽過來凶可待，天庭客死向他方。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014770239","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四煞賊來或賊㐫，司空疾病苦纒身。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014786623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右府忽來宫失位，重睂不","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014803007","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963483007205402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利遠行征。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014803007","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額角黑廣善爲偷，印堂移徙在他州，山根必死于旬日。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014819391","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽疾病厄堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872014835775","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家獄至服憂牢獄，法令至口刑八分，更及睂頭靑黑色，","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361340934","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主百日內酒還醉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其中更兼赤色間。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361340934","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三旬成訟見血光，外陽發動被人謀，年上憂死困災傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361357318","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女憂他男女厄，壽上入耳卒中亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361373702","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門甲匱主燒死，凖頭憂病外來殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361390086","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑發三陽怨氣多，失官停職事奔波。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361406470","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更若發來年夀上，天中有黑見閻羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361422854","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣入口死于夏，顴上兄弟居長夜，奸門切忌女相奸。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361439238","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日角若臨妻亦怕，井郤黑氣水溺死。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361455622","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂退官","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361472006","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963458965602304"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非謬假，橫非壽上必逢災。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361472006","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六十日内須應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣額下父母死，生來眼下子孫殂。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361488390","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見下來年壽上，自然病死入冥途。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361504774","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣三陽至盜門，奸私盜賊豈堪論。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361521158","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有黑生鼻凖上，知君財破避無門。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361537542","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑生妻部及年上，妻厄身。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361553926","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"災是非誑，更兼入井下陂池，切忌水殃心莫忘。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361570310","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣濛濛出面門，四時切忌有災連。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361586694","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生入口并厨竈，必是遭他毒藥薨。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361603078","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣天中年上逢，更從地閤入烟籠。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361619462","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神相黑汁初潑散，此個須臾命必終。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361635846","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂間横入左右見，殃中井部水中亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361652230","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽山根同位斷，地閤爭田訟","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361668614","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963483007385626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361668614","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大氣見之奴婢逃。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361684998","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墻壁生來命中岳，定歸泉下哭聲高。","logicSentenceId":"7580373872361701382","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂黃色平散者，官皆假擾。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588762676","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色連口連印授，不連金匱者，只得尉。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588779060","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬飮食。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207741993","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色如帶發額上者，遷益祿位。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588795444","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○春黃色居印堂如濺珠，主改官加職，在私者得橫財，七十日内應。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588811828","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○春從眉至髮際者，主大喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588828212","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963509494349865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夏至眼上及眉，道路得財。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588844596","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡庻皆同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夏在眉下，主得財及妻、子、孫有喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588860980","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡庶同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夏在魚尾及天倉上，如錢大者，攺官，庻人得財。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588877364","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○高廣如絲起，主百日内爲官長。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588893748","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其與攺舊革，所食祿無𢀴。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588910132","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂至山根，凖頭并中。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588926516","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正如蒸霧盤旋者，赴詔殿上，近君王。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845588942900","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○重眉連眉毛者，春夏大喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810143272","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
