{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○年上赤色，或黄色如半月者，大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954522664","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○赤色上下，過口者，二","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954539048","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十日内口舌至。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954539048","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如赤色。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954571816","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"點點入口，亦主口舌争訟。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207823913","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凖頭橫下赤青色橫過口者，貴人求問道術事。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207840297","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色帶桃花仍不久。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954588200","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色如春花，易成敗，惟一時之可觀，不久必變。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207856681","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：桃花色動仍迷目。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954604584","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迷戀歌謳寵外妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954620968","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954637352","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：色嬌色嫩邪人也，縱有成名。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954637352","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不久。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954670120","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○火色鳶肩","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207873065","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㪯文本相馬問：火色鳶肩，騰上必速，恐不能久，必改推抑。○五色之中，赤色最難辩，或聚嗔怒，或驚或恐，或勞心力。至面色赤，俄頃欲退，若不辩也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207873065","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963794866356224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"赤色出没","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954686504","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色出没，如火始然。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954702888","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將盛之時，炙交如綘繒，欲去之時，如連珠累累而去。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954719272","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行爲火，旺于夏，相于春，𣦸于秋，囚于冬，發主公私闘訟，口舌驚撓之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954735656","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潤主刑厄，細薄主口舌鞭笞。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954752040","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應在寅午戌并巳午未，日旬則辰戌，以色定之。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954768424","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"赤色吉㐫歌","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954784808","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中連印鼻頭去，三旬事馬驚同𣦸，下來年上争競灾。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954801192","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左相逺行須病在。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954817576","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尺陽切妨驚恐厄，潤生武庫相","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207889449","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963768521998348"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷災。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207889449","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭必有憂囚事，若見司空闘馬來。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954833960","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交友歸來離别去，在職當憂上位刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954850344","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無職定同交友闘，額𧢲如豆𣦸于兵。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954866728","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂争闘被憂囚，若在山根驚拍擾，太陽夫妻求離别，年上夫妻亦主愁。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954883112","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又却知他生貴子，房中妻室産賢矦。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954899496","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三男三女病災迍，壽士如豆與妻爭。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954915880","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上准頭連發此，夫妻争閗大難明。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954932264","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門甲匱須兵死，準頭官府事牽縈。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954948648","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墻壁上赤財必失，外陽常紫得宫榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954965032","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武官巡捕看魚尾，盗賊收擒彼稱情。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954981416","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛𧢲看來牛馬𣦸，山林蛇虎又堪驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874954997800","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然眼下如絲發，妻子因","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955014184","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963794866470912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何問哭聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955014184","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱奸門招撓事，承漿花酒起喧争。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955030568","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陂池井部相連接，因水逢災不稱情。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955046952","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅是知田宅退，口邊橫入福全生。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955063336","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒樽酒肉冝相㑹，地閣因由訴訟成。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955079720","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在山根須謹火，又兼家内横資生。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955096104","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命門發至山根上，更過眉上左耳平。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955112488","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐六旬遭法死，如歸右。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955128872","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳病來頻。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955145256","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○人面凖頭上有赤色，老人主失跌，中年血光，或杖罪。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955161640","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小男女，主失火災。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955178024","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿面如火，官災，滿面愁色，初不歸，二年内𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955194408","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"紅色吉㐫相","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955210792","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963768522096652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官员。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955227176","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂紅色或紫，加官進職。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955243560","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂上红，進士有。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955259944","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955276328","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂紅黄色，非次改官。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207905833","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根紅色或紫色，加官進職。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955292712","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○顴骨紅色，可分一寸，明者，八十日内受印，有重權。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955309096","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○驛馬上紅色，加官進職。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955325480","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○龍宮魚尾上紅色，因捉獲攺官。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955341864","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天柱骨上紅紫，非次攺宫，當得大官保舉。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955358248","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○正面紅黃遭帝位，名高台輔到朝庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955374632","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○正口紅色，主佳慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955391016","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天柱骨上紅黃起，僧道有住持。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955407400","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○左眉頭爲驛馬，如有紅色光作艷色，古忽生肉起發皮外，紅如醉，正是火色。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955423784","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左三陽，主家不富，骨内之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955440168","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955456552","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963853179732002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面紅色，定主榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955456552","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上紅光，多聲，顯揚","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955472936","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五色定災祥","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955489320","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色赤色，獄堂起，枷鎖旬日至。","logicSentenceId":"7580340874955505704","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色面無赤，合家人變白。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875062935604","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中黃色瑩，赤色，主憂驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875062951988","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭紅如勾，損財又損牛。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875062968372","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色罔眼生，三七日臥丘。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875062984756","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門青色生，婬婦，切莫逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063001140","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門赤如勾，五旬𣦸他州。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063017524","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽黑氣生，𣦸在野山林。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063033908","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色發三陽，貌神主不祥，定取于三日，憂災自身防。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063050292","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人要轉官。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063066676","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭紫色端，眼中忽生黄，須立𣦸路傍。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063083060","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高聲語不來，立便見官災。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063099444","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色起承漿，三日謹","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063115828","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963848456945683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刀鎗。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063115828","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月𧢲時黃，重重見財至。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063132212","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒池赤官實，三七口舌至。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063148596","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白氣入壽門，父母各離分。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063164980","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲匱紅色起，財物時時至。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063181364","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"氣色骨肉生死訣","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063197748","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天一生水，在人爲賢，賢藏精，腎之竅爲耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063214132","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色如水，發時如鴨模樣，乃是腎之神，發時黑成片，冬行夏令則傷腎也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063230516","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅色發在肉裏，面如橘紅色，火氣在皮上，俱災。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063246900","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫氣，極貴之色，庶人難得，惟尊貴大冨人方有。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063263284","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫如染重色，黃色如蠟，雲霧開散，冬黑得令。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063279668","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地二","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063296052","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963853179895842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生火，在人爲心，心藏神，心之竅爲口，夏行冬令則傷","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063296052","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063296052","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色如火，火色發時如珠，乃心神之最靈。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207922217","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人之色，形于滿面，土色爲正紅則非時，是乃心煩之所關繫也，主驚恐事擾。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063328820","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天三生木，在人爲肝，肝藏魂，肝之竅爲眼，春行秋令則傷肝。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063345204","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色似苽，發時似柳眉，初生相似，不大青模樣。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063361588","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人面上不可有此色，主憂百事不能成也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063377972","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地四生金，在人爲肺，肺藏魄，肺之竅爲鼻，秋行夏令則傷肺也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063394356","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色如腊，發時如白線，又似梨花細片，又如女人，夏月搽粉，汗出流下，又似","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063410740","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963848457043987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白露，主刑尅，破財流涕。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063410740","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天五生土，在人爲脾，脾藏意之竅爲耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063427124","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色如蠟無定，散在四圍，準頭常黃吉，或黑，或黃或青俱災。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063443508","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤半吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063459892","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"神氣雜論","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063476276","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神湛色清氣涵浮，清濁女加骨有餘，一㸃神光不分散，官高職顯豈庸居。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063492660","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○清又貴，濁又貴，清濁交加方足是，若人認得濁中清，須當福夀居高貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063509044","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○清怕寒，濁怕實，更怕骨毛粗是一。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063525428","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨中骨堅得毛清，聰明早佐邦家職。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063541812","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假濁氣骨神又瀾，乞丐下人真此謂，丈夫","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063558196","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963912864694312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必作人中奴，女人必作人中婢。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063558196","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣克滿，又假神，浮氣人滿難氤氲，骨觔似重而不重，亦作皇家食祿人。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063574580","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○全元氣，獄有神，如此眞清亦貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063590964","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不于武職人全祿，多求恩䕃立其身。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063607348","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○夜有視人神光燦，坐立如繩縳。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063623732","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱如身痩薄，肉露如玉𤥨。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063640116","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左臂肩頭高，右臂肩頭落。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063656500","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼若更含眞，官極一品爵。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063672884","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○神太急，氣有餘，神氣如期心膽粗。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063689268","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君能含忍千般事，此是人間大丈夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063705652","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○骨氣濁，神氣清，讀書無官空有名。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063722036","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨氣清，神氣濁，君後却居官品爵。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063738420","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○又云：形滯之人相必重，神滯之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063754804","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963848457142291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉不開，氣滯之人言必懶，色滯之人面塵埃。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063771188","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063787572","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知人䘮情失靈，沉溺而不自覺者，𣦸之徒也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063803956","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣衰而神滯，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063820340","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣淸而神短，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207938601","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○，氣昏而神寒，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207954985","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣亂而似驚，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207971369","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣浮而神奔，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214207987753","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣變而削，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208004137","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣乃神之母，色之父，週流于五臟六腑之間，七情七泛而發于表，始則爲氣，定則爲色。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063836724","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有寛可容物，和可接物，剛可以制物，清可以表物，正可以理物。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063853108","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不寛則隘，不和則戾，不剛則懦，不清則濁，不正則偏。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063869492","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃論前後之色，探其色之氣量，然後知者始得而知進退","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063885876","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963912864858152"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063885876","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"神氣之子","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063902260","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天一生水，地二生火，水爲精，火爲神，精合者，然後神從之。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063918644","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故神能畱氣，氣不能畱神；氣能畱色，色不能畱氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063935028","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神散色亂，不足取也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063951412","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○神不快，滯八年。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063967796","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣滯五年。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208020521","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色滯三年。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208036905","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○更看驛馬發之如何耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875063984180","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳發而滯者，神氣俗而聲硬濁。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064000564","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○神氣散聚，少孤破家；氣散神聚，作事不定。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064016948","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神與氣合，主神深逺而清秀者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064033332","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○痴神，人壽不過四十。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064049716","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○神重肉緊，作事有準。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064066100","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○神重肉","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064082484","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963919198044201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慢，老至貴宦。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064082484","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○神色須要清與赤，無如肉色佳。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064098868","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定訣曰：妙相之法在何方，觀其神氣在學堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064115252","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者有之最是良。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064131636","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人認得神與氣，冨貴貧賤足審量。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064148020","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○神恍恍，似有似無，在面上，一㸃神光俱不散，此人定作公矦相。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064164404","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"氣神之母","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064180788","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之在人，如烟之發于四肢，散如毛髪，聚如米豆，望之有形，按之無迹。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064197172","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故山有石則谷響，人有實則氣清。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064213556","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064229940","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963965729669155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淮人浙人俗于氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064246324","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淮人氣重不響，浙人氣明不清，北人氣深無韻。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064262708","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色在心而見于面。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064279092","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○氣柔而散，有祿","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064295476","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多難貴人，有輕有重，有肥有痩，有粗有细，有濁有清，皆要秀媚，不在形與骨及部位。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064295476","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全無秀媚之氣，雖貴而不近清無也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064328244","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"肉虚無氣","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064344628","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有肉而無氣者，猶如蠧木，内巳空虚，雖外有皮膚，暴風迅雨，不能久禦，乃未得地而空魁梧者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064361012","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"肉實有氣","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064377396","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963919198142505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無肉而有氣者，猶如松栢久枯，皮膚尚潤，根蒂深逺，忽一日華秀，名振天下，已得地而漸魁梧者也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064393780","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"色神之父","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064410164","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生于肝，如以縞褁青；生于心，如以縞褁紅；生于脾，如以縞褁苽作實；生于肺，如以縞褁素；生于腎，如以稿褁紫也","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064426548","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064426548","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"縞者，白色也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208053289","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青如翠羽者生，如藍色者死。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064442932","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤如鷄冠者生，如魾血者死。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064459316","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白如猪膏者生，如枯骨者死。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064475700","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963965729832995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑加烏羽者生，如烟煤者死。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064492084","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃如蟹膏者生，如枳殻者死。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064508468","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：色無光，不足謂之色。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064524852","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色光則性静，色暗則情亂，如花之易盛易衰，雖暫榮而不能經久，曰色嫩；如松栢枝葉，久而清光，寒暑不變，曰色老；如草木一日百變，百秀而無定，曰色雜。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064541236","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色暗者，如浮雲蔽日。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875064557620","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色光者，如秋月連天。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208069673","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色快者，如長流之水；","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142627362","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○色滯者，如汚池之水。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208086057","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨色者，如霜上辨雪，雪上辨霜，何處是霜，某處是","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142643746","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963919198257193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雪，切在專心詳察。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142643746","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫欲觀其相，先觀其形，次認其色，若失之毫髪，則有差謬。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142660130","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今將氣色形圗并尅應訣法及生𣦸論詳著，附于形部後，續占應而窺之，庻幾觀形而察色，以定其吉㐫云。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142676514","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"二十四氣尅應氣形圗","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142692898","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應時則喜，逆時則憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142709282","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964022021423138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"水波紋","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142725666","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此氣動如水波紋勢。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142742050","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜：應三、七日，主陰人財帛事。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142758434","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂：應四、七日，主水厄、血災厄。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208102441","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"圓珠形","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142774818","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此氣見如圓珠形樣。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142791202","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜：應一、五日，主音信財祿喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142807586","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂：應二、六日，主官、文書虚驚。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208118825","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"棗核形","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142823970","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此氣見如棗核形樣。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142840354","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜：應四時辰日，主名聲官祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142856738","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂：應六、八日，主失職官災事。","logicSentenceId":"7610708214208135209","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"草根形","logicSentenceId":"7580340875142873122","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病人眼有神氣者生，氣脫者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693129762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天柱正目活者生，目低項下𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693146146","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦而不枯悴者生，肥而無血者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693162530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有喜容而色正者生，悲啼者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693178914","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌濡唇者生，舌短縮者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693195298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693211682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964194268938294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而口禁者生，開口者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693211682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神光上黃明者生，暗者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693228066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣如擎盖者生，聚者𣦸，黃紅如雲者生，黑青氣斜入口者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693244450","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣息而長者生，氣短者死。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693260834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語聲響滑者生，短澁者死。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693277218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中潤澤者生，乾楛者死。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693293602","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"氣色古應訣","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693309986","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占五臟安","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693326370","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心善三陽光㸃㸃，脾安鼻凖見黃明。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693342754","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丹田無病耳輪赤，壽上黃光六府明。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693359138","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占五臟病","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693375522","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占死氣","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693424674","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾相牽入太隂，游魂無定𣦸將臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693441058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑侵口耳如烟霧，不日形軀入水津。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693457442","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"父母孝服","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693473826","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂額上白氣發，刑獄之上發亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693490210","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中白氣與䘮服，當憂父母入黃泉。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693506594","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"夫婦分别","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693522978","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964194269069366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面上忽然右顴青，此妻主合病相縈，若不生離須病𣦸，不然夫婦别離情。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693539362","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占婚姻","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693555746","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"又婚姻","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693604898","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蚕下黃光臥隱明，貴人欲娶女爲婚。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693621282","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有妻必是夛。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693637666","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賢德生子登科入帝閽。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693654050","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占姙娠","logicSentenceId":"7580340875693670434","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占破財","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822153763","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣煙生田宅毀，更從地閣侵倉庳。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822170147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂黑暗金匱昏，懸壁無光金玉去。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822186531","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占失財","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822202915","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人獄訟以何期。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822268451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝座乘黃更赤脂。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822284835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或生青黑咸池畔，變吉成㐫定可知。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822301219","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占亨通","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822317603","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二陽紅紫心神喜，隂位微紅福徳生。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822333987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或見凖頭并印内，等閒明潤是亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822350371","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢中正至年黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822481443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知君進逹受衣冠。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822497827","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但向庻人増古慶，多應禮會意安歡。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822514211","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占印信","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822579747","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲占印信及文書，華蓋印堂騐實虗。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822596131","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄色黃光爲定得，黑光黑色定應無。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822612515","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占行人","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822628899","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲問行人早晚歸，虎眉黃色稱心時。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822645283","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青路色應多不意，隔月經年未有期。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822661667","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"病及官事","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822678051","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964275210666036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂黑色連年起，在位失官并病至，此色更敎官事厄，忽然乾枯身必否。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822694435","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占男女","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822710819","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色看生眼欲週，君家男女定堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822727203","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若渾黃色須懷孕，黑盛困危須早除。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822743587","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飮食之部食厨帳，色似流星口舌疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822776355","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下來朝日爲夭陽，色面無人可療飢。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822792739","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占捕捉","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822809123","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占失火","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822907427","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手上發赤脉，人中色亦入。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822923811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事在半年間，延火來燒屋。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822940195","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占水厄","logicSentenceId":"7580340875822956579","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚尾共奸門，其間赤色迍，青枯來壽上，眼下赤同論。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823022115","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"占妨妻","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823038499","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"五星六曜定官","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823136803","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"單犀須直下","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823153187","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橫起天庭者，謂之伏犀，貫頂而下者，謂之單犀骨。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823169571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中有伏犀者多，單犀者少。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823185955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王矦一品之貴，方有單犀。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823202339","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必五星相應，然後可别。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823218723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此相止有單犀，而諸部不應，多爲清高道徳之人，馳譽四方，亦不在王矦之下。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823235107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃前身夙慧非常之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823251491","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964370270224424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"見鼓凖頭方","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823267875","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸鼓謂額上懸骨也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823284259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：額上懸骨病不生，骨廣大貴冨兼榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823300643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：額鼻連形如甲字。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823317027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有額骨如懸鼓者，必要準頭方正。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823333411","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"懸鼓詩","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823349795","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腦骨須是貴人星，地閣天庭耳目明。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823366179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看鼻梁高直正，須爲監給至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823382563","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡骨如懸鼔，凖又方正，諸部相朝，雖無單犀，亦爲二品之官。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823398947","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964352348241974"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"隂陽生黑白","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823415331","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目之黑白各有所主。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823431715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑主腎氣，黃則土所尅而神不清；白主肺筋，赤則穴所侵而氣不明。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823448099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若神清氣明，必爲貴相。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823464483","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辨左右眼","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823480867","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼長一寸封矦伯，龍眸鳳目實難得。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823497251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑白分明信義流，雞目鼠晴須作賊。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823513635","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"陰陽二目","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823530019","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眼睛光是貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823546403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍光麟視骨將軍，牛眼多慈龜","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823562787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964370270322728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目智，蛇睛羊眼莫爲鄰。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823562787","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡位中惟眼最係貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823579171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無單犀，又額準不應，而眼獨秀異氣，羅、計分明，金水木相副，亦爲三品之官也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823595555","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"紫氣在高强","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823611939","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫氣在司空中正之間，以高强爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823628323","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辨額廣","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823644707","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額廣方平是貴人，兩邊額上更豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823661091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還中正來相應，必定封矦宰相榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823677475","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964424896921639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得高厚，學堂不陷，而又眉秀口紅，金水相應，必爲侍從之官也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823693859","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"羅計如烏黑","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823710243","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右眉曰羅候，左眉曰計都。","logicSentenceId":"7580340875823726627","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"辩雙眉","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442861603","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眉朝髪直長濃，其人在祿定宫榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442877987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見豐滿生貴骨，須敎富壽有英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442894371","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉之鳥黑長如一字者，主有威權。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442910755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又須眼不垤露，方爲相稱。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442927139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有此相，雖無以上諸位，而金水木星","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442943523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964370270388264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又相應，亦爲五品之官也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442943523","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"分明火不剛","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442959907","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼中瞳人爲火星，是黑上加黑，須是分明上辩眼色。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442976291","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉眼分明骨氣清，目如㸃漆，正聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876442992675","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若眉濃厚而眼剛，則爲武職之相也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443009059","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"金水齊紅照","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443025443","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金相在金匱之上，以光圓爲貴，口主於脾。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443041827","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色如丹者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443058211","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更上有㮙鍔則朝烟竈，下有㮙鍔則朝承漿，","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443074595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964424897052711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩𧢲起則朝眼珠。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443074595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若更三輔相應，此爲貴相。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443090979","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟金水紅照，又兩耳高强，亦不失爲六品之官也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443107363","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"木星次品郎","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443123747","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木星在兩耳，竅門欲廣，輪欲深，聳過眉仍貼肉，縣鼓朝口。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443140131","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有如此者，必爲官職。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443156515","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤人有貴耳而無貴眼，貴人有貴眼而無貴耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443172899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若諸部皆不相應，而兩耳獨異，故以七、八品斷之也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443189283","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"木星","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443205667","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木居兩耳認高强，紅曰垂圓聳又方，輪薄頭尖骨反","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443222051","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964370270486568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"復，不登差信犯空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443222051","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾枯紫黑通明者，斷定全無到學堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443238435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見此般休用相，多成多敗少田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443254819","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"金星","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443271203","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金星金匱要光圓，連臉平肥厨竈邊。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443287587","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑脯多𮈄多破敗，又無屋宅少田園。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443303971","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓紅光彩身終貴，印稱諸星見大賢。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443320355","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是尖斜須見破，亦無半分少人憐。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443336739","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"月孛","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443353123","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛星居甲櫃頭，不須高大認情由，若生朱紫紅黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443369507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印非犯空亡身不憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443385891","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脯黑垤高紋理大，何勞苦苦去","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443402275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964489300377663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"營求。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443402275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星越甚諸星惡，更犯空亡二世憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443418659","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"草木將灰","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443435043","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草木將灰驚恐來，騰蛇病起又官災。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443451427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黃紫潤無憂惱，赤黑相和定破財。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443467811","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"凝脂塗面","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443484195","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎凝脂似抹油，因傷疾病在心頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443500579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月染病秋即散，春冬有疾主淹留。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443516963","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"晚烟如霧","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443533347","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武如烟曉霧和，陰仇不害小鬼魔。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443549731","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裡外有人來竊","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443566115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964464046506024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物，夜間怪夢又還多。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443566115","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"觀氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443582499","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀九品以上官，先看天中、天庭、司空、中正、印堂，次看山根、年壽、凖頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443598883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人中、承漿、地閣，又其次也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443615267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然氣色有輕重，朝見于面，暮歸于臟腑。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443631651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知其形狀，大如毛髪，小如蚕之吐絲，長者不過一寸，短者似一粒粟米，又如塵末，或衰或盛，有休有咎，但以五色形部經，灼然見之，可言吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443648035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖五色之氣，有青黄、黑、白赤，有紅紫，寄在其間。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443664419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青，水旺也，黃，土旺也，","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443680803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964489300541503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發之各有形狀，青色如柳葉，黄色如瓜，白色如脂，赤色如火，黑色如㸃漆。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443680803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上五色，更看厚薄，發之盛，六十日内方應，發之浮，於事不應。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443697187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今將諸位部氣色，開具於後也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443713571","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中部有黃光之氣，一百二十日，須爲極品。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443729955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有龍虎𧢲紅潤，有六十日，謂之三合照也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443746339","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天中部有紫黃之氣，二品之官，若有紅黄之氣，須爲都綂兵權。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443762723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右職亦如是。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443779107","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○司空部直犀骨，忽紫黃之氣，官至三品。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443795491","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○中正部旗庭並在其中，生有紫氣深厚，一百日内，","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443811875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964464046620712"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須見賜金紫。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443811875","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凡五品以下之官，即無其氣，紅黃相印，只見遷資輔職之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443828259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外驛馬同此斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443844643","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂謂之五品，上應天部，下應凖頭，紅黃隱印，光明一季之内，見詔書逢慶，九品以下之官得之，須見馳聲，貴人薦舉。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443861027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"京縣之官，須居清職，百姓有之，得大財。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443877411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青黑發之，三十日内，主公家文字不了。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443893795","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根部黃光之氣如臥龍者，百日内須爲行運都綂，不然見進身之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443910179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白衣人如有此，必爲官也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443926563","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○年壽部紅黄之氣，且平常則主病。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443942947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤即官事，發之輕，主口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7610709025004666886","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青則有憂，白則","logicSentenceId":"7610709025004683270","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964558594474025"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主哭，一七、二七、三七應之。","logicSentenceId":"7610709025004683270","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅絲垂法令，不免奴僕上須有虚驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443959331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近在二七，遠不過六十。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443975715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876443992099","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○凖頭部黃氣發至天中，貴可封矦，只一部有之，須當大財，百","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444008483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姓亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444008483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若氣色如蜘蛛眼，須見破家而身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444024867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發之浮，猶可也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444041251","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○人中部須分明，謂之有信人，若窄傾陷，皆不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444057635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發氣清白，須見離情之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444074019","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○承漿部紅色，實能飲酒，赤則因酒而身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444090403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青黑則𣦸，一七日之應。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444106787","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地閣部紅黄，須見進田園鞍馬。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444123171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五品之官發紫色，須入","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444139555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩地，女人有此，須見生貴子也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444139555","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○禁室部預白禁室","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444172323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964464046735400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤黑色，官事皆有驚，果然生白色，父子見離情。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444172323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄色，須見妻位。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444188707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜慶、神光同此斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444205091","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○嬪門部黃氣發蚕室，須生貴子，紅氣須生女。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444221475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三七紅氣起，則主逺信至，百姓有主，逺年骨肉相見，兼則相濟也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444237859","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○天倉部、地倉部紅黃氣發，主人得祿還鄉，或進士及第，百姓見之，家活稱遂榮進，南方田土，百里之外，並馳名也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444254243","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○法令部發黃光，幕職之官須轉官，九品以上有之，須見得權。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444270627","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○三陽三隂之部，如黑色發見，觀上破財，官員失職，或有水厄，在私失財，家宅不寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444287011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽爲家，三","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444303395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964558594588713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂爲宅，青則主憂，白則主哭。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444303395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅黄色喜慶，只斷男女","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444319779","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上有喜，須生貴子，看女不然。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444319779","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○日𧢲、月𧢲之部黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444352547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光，須見進身之事，不然，詔書來百二十日，又恐封官。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444368931","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444385315","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得紫氣同生，名利朝庭，須見","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444385315","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"提察功勞。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444385315","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○龍虎𧢲二部，常見黃色而不散，三年内須爲上將軍，出将","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444418083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入相。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444418083","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○兩顴部勢，黃則子息有喜，不然財至。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444450851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤則兄弟口","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444467235","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌，官事並行。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444467235","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○驛馬部黃，則六十日動，赤，則因馬有。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876444483619","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"災，交友，天庭白氣，半路囬程，須見哭聲，青黑因馬并。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665159732","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水隋災。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665176116","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○奸門部。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665192500","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄則爲姦淫之人，赤則爲公事臨","logicSentenceId":"7610709025004699654","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964558019936271"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身，青則憂，白則哭妻，一七二七須應。","logicSentenceId":"7610709025004699654","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○盗門部。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665208884","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官員有青色，公家文字不了，當因差出重難處失職。","logicSentenceId":"7610709025004716038","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅色有印信，二七加官，百姓得大財。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665225268","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發之則左驛馬，次至魚尾，百日移向東北去，發之則又驛馬下唱唱，紅黄光發左右印信，印堂官員加職如其位。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665241652","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑赤失官退職，萬不失一。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665258036","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○印堂喝唱：有天柱骨，紅紫色，位是正行。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665274420","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○左眼下名曰淚痕，若見青白黑赤色者，半年見父母之災。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665290804","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次長男、中男、少男，如赤青白黑兼之，亦如此斷。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665307188","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右眼頭下，母姊妹只如前斷。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665323572","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○學堂部明白須","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665339956","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964558594687017"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見貴人，舉薦入清職，百姓各無此部也。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665339956","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"觀氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665356340","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麻衣相法斷三陽，氣色須敎要紫黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665372724","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"住宦得之官爵重，庻人見貴最高强。","logicSentenceId":"7610709025004732422","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"山根印堂","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665389108","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃色山根若臥龍，爲官遷職祿盈豊。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665405492","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂部内仍同此，紫綬金章立帝宮。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665421876","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"年壽承漿","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665438260","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"憂色歌","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665503796","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天中排至到山根，六處明明次第分。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665520180","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫色定知官見覓，紅黄必定轉官尊。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665536564","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色若臨家主哭，赤氣臨之官鬼存。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665552948","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬事不離從此看，吉㐫災禍别無門。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665569332","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"死色歌","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665618484","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上赤光橫，同前赤色生。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665667636","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能行路險，或有小温","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665684020","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665684020","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下赤相隱，旗庭白哭聲。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665700404","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根憂恐怖，凖頭哭父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665716788","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交友丹砂起，宜災未可寧。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665733172","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中青白氣，必定是離情。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665749556","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"四季吉㐫氣色","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665765940","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色爲尅木逆時，居財帛則破財，居父母則父母有疾，居子息則子息。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665815092","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有疾。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665831476","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
