{"lines":[{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"夏季","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665913396","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色爲正氣，旺財發福，過旺，主公訟口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665929780","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑氣主大禍，居疾厄，主𣦸，居官祿，爲囚禁，爲降官失職。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665946164","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白色爲金，主發財大旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665962548","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黃色火生土，爲滯氣，財憂相半。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665978932","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○青色爲木，生火太盛，亦主悲憂，美惡相半。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876665995316","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"秋季","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666011700","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白爲正色，旺財潤澤，主大發財祿，順時太過，則主外","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666028084","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964626856902675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孝。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666028084","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黑色爲泄氣，主破財，又主大病。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666044468","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○赤爲火尅金，主大禍，公訟卒哭，重重不足，家下虚驚恐怖，百不如意。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666060852","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○青爲木，金尅木爲財，主喜相半。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666077236","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黃色士生金，謀事有成，財氣百事稱心。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666093620","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"冬季","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666110004","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑爲正色，順時太過，主重災。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666126388","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○白爲金生水，主有財祿，百事稱心。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666142772","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○黃色土尅水，主災阻厄，見女有疾，居財帛主破見。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666159156","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"口部","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666175540","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964650365911080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄色臨口，橫財到手。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666191924","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口部黃氣，起千日内。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666208308","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱紫唇紫，衣食足。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666224692","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇赤爲上客，唇紅遇面，五十七年稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666241076","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人貴在。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666257460","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇紅齒白，食天祿多，則多貴多子。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666273844","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口青色，女多奸。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666290228","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口上紫色，貪財防害。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666306612","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇有黑紫，妨妻害子女。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666322996","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇紫。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666339380","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫早𣦸，亦防子，唇黑色，路𣦸厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666355764","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑氣從口入耳，七日内亡，男左女右。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666372148","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口部青色，百日内災，九十日破財。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666388532","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑色，一千日内父母亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666404916","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青色口邉入來，須餓𣦸，更兼淫慾事𦍒連。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666421300","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤色口邊横入，殃禍立至。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666437684","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"十四休廢","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666454068","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330964701863493686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口四邊色白饒轉者，爲動口，休廢，主五十日大厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666470452","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下□□爲左右，或眉下一條，名曰成口，休三十日廢，内大厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666486836","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右兩耳員，上下忽如白粉起者，名曰玄聲，休廢。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666503220","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六十日，大厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666519604","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腦□□□有官榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666535988","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白色若臨家有哭，赤氣如臨官鬼生。","logicSentenceId":"7580340876666552372","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
